            }
            // ① 云端 ASR 优先（配置了 Key 就走网络，手机不再加载本地模型）
            val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("mentara", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            val asrKey = prefs.getString("asrApiKey", "") ?: ""
            if (asrKey.isNotBlank()) {
                val asrBase = prefs.getString("asrBaseUrl", "https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1") ?: "https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1"
                val asrModel = prefs.getString("asrModel", "TeleAI/TeleSpeechASR") ?: "TeleAI/TeleSpeechASR"
                val outF = File(outDir, "transcript.json")
                val chunks = splitWav(wav, 60.0) // 60 秒/块：时间戳更细、单包更小、可断点续跑
                val existing = if (outF.isFile) runCatching {
                    json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), outF.readText())
                }.getOrDefault(emptyList()) else emptyList()
                val segsAll = ArrayList<TranscriptSegment>(existing)
                val covered = existing.lastOrNull()?.end ?: 0.0
                val cli = com.learnagent.llm.CloudAsrClient(asrKey, asrBase, asrModel)
                android.util.Log.d("MENTARA", "云端 ASR：${chunks.size} 块（60s/块）→ $asrBase model=$asrModel")
                chunks.forEachIndexed { ci, (file, off) ->
                    if (off + 60.0 <= covered) { file.delete(); return@forEachIndexed }
                    segsAll.removeAll { it.start >= off - 0.5 }
                    val r = cli.transcribeFile(file) // 失败直接抛错，不静默
                    if (r.segments.isNotEmpty()) {
                        r.segments.forEach { (s, e, t) -> if (t.isNotBlank()) segsAll.add(TranscriptSegment(off + s, off + e, t, null)) }
                    } else if (r.text.isNotBlank()) {
                        segsAll.add(TranscriptSegment(off, off + 60.0, r.text, null))
                    }
                    file.delete()
                    outF.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), segsAll)) // 每块落盘，断点续跑
                    onWhisperProgress(((ci + 1) * 100 / chunks.size).coerceIn(0, 100))
                    android.util.Log.d("MENTARA", "云端 ASR 块 ${ci + 1}/${chunks.size} 完成，累计 ${segsAll.size} 段")
                }
                if (segsAll.isNotEmpty()) return@withContext segsAll
            }
            // 兜底：系统识别器（分段）
            val chunks = splitWav(wav, 25.0)
            val segments = ArrayList<TranscriptSegment>()
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                chunks.forEach { (file, offset) ->
                    val segs = awaitTranscribe(context, file.absolutePath)
                    segs.forEach { s ->
                        segments.add(
                            TranscriptSegment(
                                start = offset + (if (s.start > 0) s.start else 0.0),
                                end = offset + (if (s.end > 0) s.end else 25.0),
                                text = s.text,
                                speaker = s.speaker
                            )
                        )
                    }
                    file.delete()
                }
            }
            if (segments.isEmpty()) {
                val reason = AndroidSpeechTranscriber.lastError.ifBlank { "语音识别无结果" }
                throw IllegalStateException("语音转写 0 段：$reason")
            }
            File(outDir, "transcript.json")
                .writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), segments))
            segments
        }
    }

    /**
     * 三模型共识纠错：读 transcript.json → 纠错（改错别字/去幻觉、禁止新增信息）→ 覆盖写回
     * transcript.json（供时间线读取）+ 生成 transcript_polished.md。返回纠错后句数（-1=无转写）。
     */
    suspend fun polishTranscript(
        videoId: String,
        dir: File,
        apiKey: String,
        modelA: String,
        modelB: String,
        modelC: String,
        onProgress: (Int, Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): Int = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val f = File(dir, "transcript.json")
        if (!f.isFile) return@withContext -1
        val segs = json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), f.readText())
        if (segs.isEmpty()) return@withContext 0
        fun c(m: String) = com.learnagent.llm.AndroidNimClient(apiKey, m)
        val polisher = TranscriptPolisher(
            listOf("A" to c(modelA), "B" to c(modelB), "C" to c(modelC)),
            timeoutMs = 120_000, retries = 1
        )
        val r = polisher.polish(videoId, segs, onProgress)
        val corrected = r.segments.map { TranscriptSegment(start = it.start, end = it.end, text = it.final, speaker = null) }
        f.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), corrected))
        File(dir, "transcript_polished.md").writeText(polisher.markdown(r))
        corrected.size
    }

    /** 把 16k 单声道 16bit PCM WAV 按秒切分成若干子 WAV；返回 (文件, 起始秒)。 */
    /**
     * 视觉模型画面描述：给 frames.json 里的关键帧生成 caption（已有描述的跳过），
     * 写回 frames.json（经 merge 并入时间线的 caption 字段 → 进入大模型证据）。
     * 返回已带描述的帧数（-1 = 没有 frames.json）。
     */
    suspend fun captionFrames(
        dir: File,
        apiKey: String,
        visionModel: String,
        maxFrames: Int = 1_000_000,
        everyNth: Int = 1,
        onProgress: (Int, Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): Int = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val f = File(dir, "frames.json")
        if (!f.isFile) return@withContext -1
        val frames = json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), f.readText())
        val step = everyNth.coerceAtLeast(1)
        val toDo = frames.filter {
            it.caption.isBlank() && it.imagePath.isNotBlank() && File(it.imagePath).isFile
        }.filterIndexed { p, _ -> p % step == 0 }.take(maxFrames)
        if (toDo.isEmpty()) return@withContext frames.count { it.caption.isNotBlank() }

        val captioner = com.learnagent.llm.VisionCaptioner(apiKey, visionModel)
        val byTs = frames.map { it.timestamp to it }.toMap().toMutableMap()
        var done = frames.count { it.caption.isNotBlank() }
        fun persist() {
            f.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), frames.map { byTs[it.timestamp] ?: it }))
        }
        toDo.forEachIndexed { i, fr ->
            val c = try {
                captioner.caption(File(fr.imagePath))
            } catch (e: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
                persist() // 取消：已完成描述先写盘，下次增量续跑
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                ""
            }
            if (c.isNotBlank()) {
                byTs[fr.timestamp] = fr.copy(caption = c.take(200))
                done++
            }
            if ((i + 1) % 10 == 0 || i == toDo.size - 1) persist()
            onProgress(i + 1, toDo.size)
        }
        done
    }

    private fun splitWav(wav: File, secondsPerChunk: Double): List<Pair<File, Double>> {
        // V8 流式切块：只读 4KB 头 + 分段拷贝；78 分钟音频不再整段进内存（旧 readBytes 约 150MB 会 OOM）
        if (wav.length() < 44) return listOf(wav to 0.0)
        var channels = 1; var sampleRate = 16000; var dataOff = -1L; var dataLen = -1L
        java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav, "r").use { raf ->
            val head = ByteArray(4096)
            val n = raf.read(head)
            var pos = 12
            while (pos <= n - 8) {
                val id = String(head, pos, 4, Charsets.US_ASCII)
                var size = 0
                for (b in 0 until 4) size = size or ((head[pos + 4 + b].toInt() and 0xFF) shl (8 * b))
                when (id) {
                    "fmt " -> {
                        channels = (head[pos + 10].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((head[pos + 11].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8)
                        sampleRate = 0
                        for (b in 0 until 4) sampleRate = sampleRate or ((head[pos + 12 + b].toInt() and 0xFF) shl (8 * b))
                    }
                    "data" -> { dataOff = (pos + 8).toLong(); dataLen = size.toLong() }
                }
                if (dataOff >= 0) break
                pos += 8 + size + (size % 2)
            }
        }
        if (dataOff < 0 || channels < 1) return listOf(wav to 0.0)
        val avail = wav.length() - dataOff
        if (dataLen <= 0 || dataLen > avail) dataLen = avail // 容错：声明长度不靠谱时按实际文件截取
        val bytesPerSec = sampleRate * channels * 2
        if (bytesPerSec <= 0) return listOf(wav to 0.0)
        val chunkBytes = (bytesPerSec * secondsPerChunk).toLong().coerceAtLeast(1)
        val out = ArrayList<Pair<File, Double>>()
        java.io.RandomAccessFile(wav, "r").use { raf ->
            val buf = ByteArray(1 shl 16)
            var off = 0L; var idx = 0
            while (off < dataLen && idx < 100000) {
                val len = minOf(chunkBytes, dataLen - off)
                val f = File(wav.parentFile, "chunk_%03d.wav".format(idx))
                f.outputStream().use { os ->
                    val h = ByteArray(44)
                    fun put32(p: Int, v: Long) { for (b in 0 until 4) h[p + b] = ((v shr (8 * b)) and 0xFF).toByte() }
                    fun put16(p: Int, v: Int) { h[p] = (v and 0xFF).toByte(); h[p + 1] = ((v shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte() }
                    "RIFF".toByteArray().copyInto(h, 0); put32(4, 36 + len); "WAVE".toByteArray().copyInto(h, 8)
                    "fmt ".toByteArray().copyInto(h, 12); put32(16, 16); put16(20, 1)
                    put16(22, channels); put32(24, sampleRate.toLong()); put32(28, bytesPerSec.toLong())
                    put16(32, channels * 2); put16(34, 16)
                    "data".toByteArray().copyInto(h, 36); put32(40, len)
                    os.write(h)
                    raf.seek(dataOff + off)
                    var copied = 0L
                    while (copied < len) {
                        val want = minOf(buf.size.toLong(), len - copied).toInt()
                        val r = raf.read(buf, 0, want)
                        if (r < 0) break
                        os.write(buf, 0, r); copied += r
                    }
                }
                out.add(f to (off.toDouble() / bytesPerSec))
                off += len; idx++
            }
        }
        return if (out.isEmpty()) listOf(wav to 0.0) else out
    }

    private suspend fun awaitTranscribe(context: Context, wavPath: String): List<TranscriptSegment> =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
            AndroidSpeechTranscriber(context).transcribe(wavPath) { segs ->
                if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(segs)
            }
        }

    /**
     * 抽帧 OCR（V4 全量不省略）：
     *  - OPTION_CLOSEST 精确取帧（不吸附关键帧 → 不再出现"同一画面重复"）；
     *  - 删除了原来的 3000 帧硬上限（那是静默截断的根因）；
     *  - 增量续跑：已抽过的时间点自动跳过（取消/中断后重跑不浪费）；
     *  - 每 500 帧落盘一次 + 取消时落盘，进度不丢；
     *  - 帧图缩到 ≤1280px 再存（省磁盘，OCR 精度不受影响）。
     */
    suspend fun ocrFrames(
        context: Context,
        sourcePath: String,
        outDir: File,
        everySeconds: Double = 1.0,
        onProgress: (done: Int, total: Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): List<FrameOcr> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val retriever = MediaMetadataRetriever()
        val framesFile = File(outDir, "frames.json")
        val all = ArrayList<FrameOcr>()
        try {
            retriever.setDataSource(sourcePath)
            val durMs = retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION)
                ?.toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
            val total = if (durMs > 0) ((durMs / 1000.0) / everySeconds).toInt() + 1 else 30
            // 增量续跑：载入已抽过的帧
            if (framesFile.isFile) {
                runCatching {
                    all.addAll(json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), framesFile.readText()))
                }
            }
            val doneTs = HashSet<Double>(all.size * 2)
            all.forEach { doneTs.add(Math.round(it.timestamp * 1000.0) / 1000.0) }
            onProgress(all.size, total)
            val recognizer = TextRecognition.getClient(zhOptions)
            var newCount = 0
            var skipCount = 0
            var processed = 0
            var prevSig: IntArray? = null
            var nullStreak = 0
            var t = 0.0
            try {
                while ((durMs > 0 && t * 1000 < durMs) || (durMs <= 0 && nullStreak < 5 && all.size < 200000)) {
                    ensureActive()
                    val key = Math.round(t * 1000.0) / 1000.0
                    if (!doneTs.contains(key)) {
                        val bmp = runCatching {
                            retriever.getFrameAtTime((t * 1_000_000).toLong(), MediaMetadataRetriever.OPTION_CLOSEST)
                        }.getOrNull()
                        if (bmp != null) {
                            processed++
                            val sig = signatureOf(bmp)
                            val sim = if (prevSig != null) similarity(sig, prevSig!!) else 0.0
                            if (total <= 60 || processed % 10 == 0) {
                                android.util.Log.d("MENTARA", "抽帧 $processed/$total 相似度=" + "%.2f".format(sim))
                            }
                            if (prevSig != null && sim >= 0.90) {
                                // 画面未实质变化（PPT 停留/静止镜头）：跳过 OCR，不送入识别流程
                                skipCount++
                                bmp.recycle()
                                onProgress(processed, total)
                                t += everySeconds
                                continue
                            }
                            val cropped = runCatching {
                                val cw = bmp.width; val chh = bmp.height
                                Bitmap.createBitmap(bmp, 0, chh * 6 / 100, cw, (chh - chh * 6 / 100 - chh * 10 / 100).coerceAtLeast(1))
                            }.getOrDefault(bmp)
                            val rawText = ocrText(recognizer, cropped)
                            if (cropped !== bmp) cropped.recycle()
                            val text = if (TextQuality.isGarbageOcr(rawText)) "" else rawText
                            val saveBmp = if (bmp.width > 1280) {
                                Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bmp, 1280, (bmp.height * 1280 / bmp.width).coerceAtLeast(1), true)
                            } else bmp
                            val img = File(outDir, "frame_%05d.jpg".format(all.size + 1))
                            runCatching { img.outputStream().use { saveBmp.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 78, it) } }
                            if (saveBmp !== bmp) saveBmp.recycle()
                            val mood = runCatching { moodOf(bmp) }.getOrDefault("")
                            all.add(FrameOcr(key, text, img.absolutePath, mood = mood))
                            doneTs.add(key)
                            bmp.recycle()
                            prevSig = sig
                            newCount++
                            nullStreak = 0
                            if (newCount % 2000 == 0) persistFrames(framesFile, all)
                            if (newCount % 20 == 0) onProgress(processed, total)
                        } else {
                            nullStreak++
                        }
                    }
                    t += everySeconds
                }
                onProgress(processed, total)
                android.util.Log.d("MENTARA", "抽帧完成：处理 $processed/总 $total，OCR 留存 ${all.size} 帧，相似跳过 $skipCount")
            } catch (e: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
                persistFrames(framesFile, all) // 取消：进度落盘，下次增量续跑
                throw e
            }
            runCatching { recognizer.close() }
        } catch (e: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // 出错也不崩，但绝不再静默：打进 Logcat 供排查
            android.util.Log.e("MENTARA", "ocrFrames 异常中断（已取 ${all.size} 帧）", e)
        } finally {
            persistFrames(framesFile, all)
            runCatching { retriever.release() }
        }
        all
    }

    /**
     * Mentara 永久 skill：把「完全未删减」的合并时间线（语音+画面+氛围+画面描述）提炼成 skill.md，
     * 永久存档（换页/重启/换视频都不丢）；问答时作为「永久知识库」注入模型。
     * 返回合并时间线条数。
     */
    suspend fun buildSkill(dir: File): Int = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val tf = File(dir, "transcript.json")
        val ff = File(dir, "frames.json")
        if (!tf.isFile && !ff.isFile) return@withContext 0
        val transcript = if (tf.isFile) runCatching {
            json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), tf.readText())
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList()) else emptyList()
        val frames = if (ff.isFile) runCatching {
            json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), ff.readText())
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList()) else emptyList()
        val timeline = com.learnagent.core.merge(transcript, frames)
        val body = com.learnagent.core.Evidence.aiDigest(timeline, 3000, 300_000)
        val header = buildString {
            append("# Mentara 永久知识 · ").append(dir.name).append('\n')
            append("生成时间：").append(java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss").format(java.util.Date())).append('\n')
            append("语音段：").append(transcript.size).append(" · 原始帧：").append(frames.size)
            append("（完全未删减，全部保留在 frames.json；时间线显示层仅折叠完全重复的连续同画面帧）\n\n")
        }
        File(dir, "skill.md").writeText(header + body)
        timeline.size
    }

    /** 画面原图校对：视觉模型逐帧"看图改字"，直接修正 frames.json 里的 OCR 错别字。返回改掉的字数。 */
    suspend fun proofreadFramesWithVision(
        dir: File,
        apiKey: String,
        visionModel: String,
        maxFrames: Int = 300,
        onProgress: (Int, Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): Int = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val f = File(dir, "frames.json")
        if (!f.isFile) return@withContext -1
        val frames = json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), f.readText())
        val toDo = frames.filter { it.text.isNotBlank() && it.imagePath.isNotBlank() && File(it.imagePath).isFile }.take(maxFrames)
        if (toDo.isEmpty()) return@withContext 0
        val vlm = com.learnagent.llm.VisionCaptioner(apiKey, visionModel)
        val byTs = frames.map { it.timestamp to it }.toMap().toMutableMap()
        fun persist() { f.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), frames.map { byTs[it.timestamp] ?: it })) }
        var changed = 0
        toDo.forEachIndexed { i, fr ->
            val corrected = try {
                vlm.correctOcr(File(fr.imagePath), fr.text)
            } catch (e: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) { persist(); throw e }
            catch (e: Exception) { "" }
            if (corrected.isNotBlank() && corrected.trim() != fr.text.trim()) {
                byTs[fr.timestamp] = fr.copy(text = corrected.take(500))
                changed++
            }
            if ((i + 1) % 20 == 0 || i == toDo.size - 1) persist()
            onProgress(i + 1, toDo.size)
        }
        changed
    }
    /** 读取「语音(Whisper) + 画面(OCR)」合并原文（供大模型纠错后处理）。 */
    suspend fun rawEvidence(dir: File, maxChars: Int = 12000): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        runCatching {
            val tf = File(dir, "transcript.json"); val ff = File(dir, "frames.json")
            val tr = if (tf.isFile) json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), tf.readText()) else emptyList()
            val fr = if (ff.isFile) json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), ff.readText()) else emptyList()
            com.learnagent.core.Evidence.render(com.learnagent.core.merge(tr, fr), maxChars)
        }.getOrDefault("")
    }

    private fun persistFrames(file: File, frames: List<FrameOcr>) {
        runCatching {
            file.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(FrameOcr.serializer()), frames))
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import android.content.Context
import java.io.File

class ModelManager(private val context: Context) {
    
    fun getModelPath(modelName: String): File {
        return File(context.filesDir, "models/$modelName.bin")
    }
    
    fun isModelDownloaded(modelName: String): Boolean {
        return getModelPath(modelName).exists()
    }
    
    fun downloadModel(modelName: String, progress: (Float) -> Unit) {
        // 简化实现 - 模拟下载
        for (i in 0..100 step 10) {
            progress(i.toFloat() / 100)
            Thread.sleep(100)
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.VideoMeta

/**
 * Transcription progress states
 * 
 * Represents different states during the transcription process
 */
sealed class TranscribeProgress {
    
    /**
     * Transcription is idle
     */
    object Idle : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Transcription has started
     */
    object Started : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Extracting audio from video
     */
    object ExtractingAudio : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Processing audio with whisper model
     */
    object Processing : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Transcription completed successfully
     */
    data class Completed(val result: TranscriptionResult) : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Transcription was cancelled
     */
    object Cancelled : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Transcription failed with error
     */
    data class Error(val message: String) : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Downloading model
     */
    data class DownloadingModel(val progress: Float, val modelName: String) : TranscribeProgress()
    
    /**
     * Model download completed
     */
    data class ModelDownloaded(val modelName: String) : TranscribeProgress()
}

/**
 * Transcription result data class
 */
data class TranscriptionResult(
    val text: String,
    val confidence: Float,
    val language: String,
    val duration: Float,
    val segments: List<TranscriptionSegment>
)

/**
 * Transcription segment data class
 */
data class TranscriptionSegment(
    val start: Float,
    val end: Float,
    val text: String,
    val confidence: Float,
    val words: List<Word>
)

/**
 * Word data class
 */
data class Word(
    val word: String,
    val start: Float,
    val end: Float,
    val confidence: Float
)

/**
 * Transcription options
 */
data class TranscriptionOptions(
    val model: String = "base.en",
    val language: String? = null,
    val temperature: Float = 0.0f,
    val bestOf: Int = 5,
    val beamSize: Int = 5,
    val patience: Float = 1.0f,
    val lengthPenalty: Float = 1.0f,
    val suppressBlank: Boolean = true,

package com.learnagent.llm

import com.learnagent.core.WebResult
import com.learnagent.core.WebSearch
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * AnySearch 联网搜索（中国团队；个人注册每日 1000 次免费；不填 Key 也可匿名访问，限流较低）。
 * 失败/无结果时自动回落到免费必应（AndroidBingSearcher），保证"总有免费联网"。
 */
class AndroidAnySearcher(private val apiKey: String) : WebSearch {

    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(12, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .build()

    private val bing by lazy { AndroidBingSearcher() }

    override suspend fun search(query: String): List<WebResult> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val primary = runCatching { anysearch(query) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (primary.isNotEmpty()) primary
        else runCatching { bing.search(query) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    }

    private fun anysearch(query: String): List<WebResult> {
        val payload = buildJsonObject {
            put("query", query)
            put("max_results", 5)
            put("language", "zh")
        }.toString()
        val rb = Request.Builder()
            .url("https://api.anysearch.com/v1/search")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .header("X-Anysearch-Client", "Mentara/1.0 (Android)")
        if (apiKey.isNotBlank()) rb.header("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
        val req = rb.post(payload.toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType())).build()
        client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
            if (!resp.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("AnySearch HTTP ${resp.code}")
            val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(resp.body?.string().orEmpty()).jsonObject
            val results = root["data"]?.jsonObject?.get("results")?.jsonArray ?: return emptyList()
            return results.mapNotNull { e ->
                runCatching {
                    val o = e.jsonObject
                    WebResult(
                        title = o["title"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull ?: "",
                        url = o["url"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull ?: "",
                        content = o["content"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                            ?: o["snippet"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull ?: ""
                    )
                }.getOrNull()
            }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private val regClient by lazy {
            OkHttpClient.Builder()
                .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                .readTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                .build()
        }

        /**
         * 一键注册（仅需真实邮箱，无需验证码）——官方设计的 Agent 注册流程。
         * 成功返回 api_key（as_sk_...）；失败 message 透传官方错误（如 email_already_registered / Rate limited）。
         */
        suspend fun register(email: String): Result<String> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            runCatching {
                val payload = buildJsonObject { put("email", email) }.toString()
                val req = Request.Builder()
                    .url("https://api.anysearch.com/v1/auth/email/register")
                    .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                    .header("X-Anysearch-Client", "Mentara/1.0 (Android)")
                    .post(payload.toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType()))
                    .build()
                regClient.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                    val bodyStr = resp.body?.string().orEmpty()
                    val root = runCatching { Json.parseToJsonElement(bodyStr).jsonObject }.getOrNull()
                    val data = root?.get("data")?.jsonObject
                    val code = root?.get("code")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                    val msg = root?.get("message")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull ?: ("HTTP ${resp.code}")
                    val retry = data?.get("retry_after_seconds")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                    if (!resp.isSuccessful && root == null) throw IllegalStateException("HTTP ${resp.code}")
                    if (code != "0") {
                        val extra = if (retry != null) "（约 $retry 秒后重试）" else ""
                        throw IllegalStateException(msg + extra)
                    }
                    val key = data?.get("api_key")?.jsonObject?.get("key")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                        ?: throw IllegalStateException("未返回 Key，请到 anysearch.com/console/api-keys 手动获取")
                    key
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.llm

import android.util.Base64
import com.learnagent.core.WebResult
import com.learnagent.core.WebSearch
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import java.net.URLDecoder
import java.net.URLEncoder
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * 免费联网搜索：抓取必应中国的搜索结果页（cn.bing.com）。
 * 零 Key、零注册、国内直连——作为博查/Tavily 都未配置时的自动兜底。
 * 说明：网页结构可能变化导致偶发解析失败（属正常），失败时返回空列表、不影响回答。
 */
class AndroidBingSearcher : WebSearch {

    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(12, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .followRedirects(true)
        .build()

    private fun stripTags(s: String): String {
        val noTags = s.replace(Regex("<[^>]*>"), " ")
        // 程序化解码常见 HTML 实体（amp/quot/apos/lt/gt/nbsp 及 &#数字;）
        val decoded = Regex("&(#?)([a-zA-Z0-9]{1,10});").replace(noTags) { m ->
            val kind = m.groupValues[1]
            val name = m.groupValues[2]
            when {
                kind == "#" -> name.toIntOrNull()?.let { it.toChar().toString() } ?: " "
                name == "nbsp" -> " "
                name == "amp" -> "&"
                name == "quot" -> "\""
                name == "apos" -> "'"
                name == "lt" -> "<"
                name == "gt" -> ">"
                else -> " "
            }
        }
        return decoded.replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ").trim()
    }

    /** 必应新外链格式（/ck/a?...&u=a1<base64url>）还原真实地址 */
    private fun unwrap(url: String): String {
        if (!url.contains("/ck/a?")) return url
        return runCatching {
            val m = Regex("[?&]u=a1([A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+)").find(url)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: return url
            val bytes = Base64.decode(m, Base64.URL_SAFE or Base64.NO_PADDING or Base64.NO_WRAP)
            URLDecoder.decode(String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8), "UTF-8")
        }.getOrDefault(url)
    }

    override suspend fun search(query: String): List<WebResult> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val q = URLEncoder.encode(query, "UTF-8")
        val req = Request.Builder()
            .url("https://cn.bing.com/search?q=$q&count=8&mkt=zh-CN&setlang=zh-CN")
            .header(
                "User-Agent",
                "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36"
            )
            .header("Accept-Language", "zh-CN,zh;q=0.9")
            .get()
            .build()
        val html = runCatching {
            client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
                if (!resp.isSuccessful) return@use ""
                resp.body?.string().orEmpty()
            }
        }.getOrDefault("")
        if (html.isBlank()) return@withContext emptyList()

        val out = ArrayList<WebResult>(6)
        val chunks = html.split("<li class=\"b_algo\"")
        for (i in 1 until chunks.size) {
            val chunk = chunks[i].substringBefore("</li>")
            val hrefM = Regex("<h2[^>]*>\\s*<a[^>]+href=\"(https?://[^\"]+)\"", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL).find(chunk) ?: continue
            val url = unwrap(hrefM.groupValues[1])
            val titleM = Regex("<h2[^>]*>\\s*<a[^>]*>(.*?)</a>", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL).find(chunk)
            val title = stripTags(titleM?.groupValues?.lastOrNull().orEmpty())
            val snipM = Regex("<p[^>]*>(.*?)</p>", RegexOption.DOT_MATCHES_ALL).find(chunk)
            val snippet = stripTags(snipM?.groupValues?.lastOrNull().orEmpty())
            if (title.isNotBlank()) {
                out.add(WebResult(title = title, url = url, content = snippet.take(400)))
            }
            if (out.size >= 6) break
        }
        out
    }
}

package com.learnagent.llm

import com.learnagent.core.LlmClient
import com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig
import com.learnagent.core.StreamingLlmClient
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.addJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
import kotlinx.serialization.json.putJsonArray
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * NVIDIA NIM 客户端（Android，用项目已有的 OkHttp，不引入新依赖）。
 * 支持：system 提示词、temperature / max_tokens、流式（SSE）+ reasoning_content。
 */
class AndroidNimClient(
    private val apiKey: String,
    private val model: String,
    private val baseUrl: String = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"
) : LlmClient, StreamingLlmClient {

    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(12, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(180, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .build()

    private fun payload(config: LlmConfig, prompt: String, stream: Boolean, maxTokensOverride: Int? = null): String =
        buildJsonObject {
            put("model", model)
            putJsonArray("messages") {
                if (config.system.isNotBlank()) {
                    addJsonObject {
                        put("role", "system")
                        put("content", config.system)
                    }
                }
                addJsonObject {
                    put("role", "user")
                    put("content", prompt)
                }
            }
            put("temperature", config.temperature)
            put("max_tokens", maxTokensOverride ?: config.maxTokens)
            put("stream", stream)
        }.toString()

    private fun request(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig, stream: Boolean, maxTokensOverride: Int? = null): Request =
        Request.Builder()
            .url("$baseUrl/chat/completions")
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .header("Accept", if (stream) "text/event-stream" else "application/json")
            .post(payload(config, prompt, stream, maxTokensOverride).toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType()))
            .build()

    override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val t0 = System.currentTimeMillis()
            android.util.Log.d("MENTARA", "NIM 请求开始：model=$model prompt=${prompt.length} 字符（读超时 180s）")
            client.newCall(request(prompt, config, stream = false)).execute().use { response ->
                if (!response.isSuccessful) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("NIM HTTP ${response.code}")
                }
                val body = response.body?.string().orEmpty()
                val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(body).jsonObject
                val message = root["choices"]?.jsonArray?.firstOrNull()
                    ?.jsonObject?.get("message")?.jsonObject
                val content = message?.get("content")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                val reasoning = message?.get("reasoning_content")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                val result = (content?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: reasoning ?: "").trim()
                android.util.Log.d("MENTARA", "NIM 请求结束：${System.currentTimeMillis() - t0}ms，返回 ${result.length} 字符")
                result
            }
        }

    override suspend fun streamResponse(
        prompt: String,
        config: LlmConfig,
        onToken: (String) -> Unit,
        onReasoning: (String) -> Unit
    ): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        client.newCall(request(prompt, config, stream = true)).execute().use { response ->
            if (!response.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("NIM HTTP ${response.code}")
            val reader = response.body?.charStream()?.buffered() ?: return@use
            var line = reader.readLine()
            while (line != null) {
                val l = line.trim()
                if (l.startsWith("data:")) {
                    val data = l.removePrefix("data:").trim()
                    if (data.isNotEmpty() && data != "[DONE]") {
                        runCatching {
                            val delta = Json.parseToJsonElement(data).jsonObject["choices"]
                                ?.jsonArray?.firstOrNull()?.jsonObject?.get("delta")?.jsonObject
                            val c = delta?.get("content")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                            val r = delta?.get("reasoning_content")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                            if (!r.isNullOrBlank()) onReasoning(r)
                            if (!c.isNullOrBlank()) {
                                sb.append(c)
                                onToken(c)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                line = reader.readLine()
            }
        }
        sb.toString()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.llm

import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.MultipartBody
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.asRequestBody
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * 云端语音转写（OpenAI 兼容 POST /audio/transcriptions，multipart 上传）。
 * 兼容：SiliconFlow（FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall）、OpenAI whisper-1、任何同协议服务。
 * 手机端只负责传音频文件，不再本地加载模型。
 */
class CloudAsrClient(
    private val apiKey: String,
    baseUrl: String = "https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1",
    private val model: String = "TeleAI/TeleSpeechASR"
) {
    private val base = baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/')

    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .writeTimeout(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(120, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .build()

    /** text = 整段文本；segments = (start秒, end秒, 文本)（服务返回 verbose_json 时才有）。 */
    data class Result(val text: String, val segments: List<Triple<Double, Double, String>>)

    suspend fun transcribeFile(wav: File): Result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val body = MultipartBody.Builder()
            .setType(MultipartBody.FORM)
            .addFormDataPart("model", model)
            .addFormDataPart("language", "zh")
            .addFormDataPart("response_format", "json")
            .addFormDataPart("file", wav.name, wav.asRequestBody("audio/wav".toMediaType()))
            .build()
        val req = Request.Builder()
            .url("$base/audio/transcriptions")
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            .post(body)
            .build()
        client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
            val text = resp.body?.string().orEmpty()
            if (!resp.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("ASR HTTP ${resp.code}：${text.take(200)}")
            val root = runCatching { Json.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject }.getOrNull()
                ?: return@withContext Result(text.trim(), emptyList())
            val full = root["text"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty().trim()
            val segs = root["segments"]?.jsonArray?.mapNotNull { e ->
                runCatching {
                    val o = e.jsonObject
                    Triple(
                        o["start"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content.toDouble(),
                        o["end"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content.toDouble(),
                        o["text"]!!.jsonPrimitive.content.trim()
                    )
                }.getOrNull()
            }.orEmpty()
            Result(full, segs)
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.llm

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.util.Base64
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.addJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
import kotlinx.serialization.json.putJsonArray
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.Request
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * 视觉描述（VLM）：用 NIM 的视觉模型看关键帧，生成"画面里能看到什么"的一句客观描述。
 * 图像会先缩到 ≤512px 再 base64 上传，控制流量与时延。
 */
class VisionCaptioner(
    private val apiKey: String,
    private val model: String = "meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct"
) {
    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
        .connectTimeout(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .readTimeout(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        .build()

    /** 看图改字：让视觉模型逐字核对原图中的真实文字，返回正确文本（供 OCR 校对）。 */
    suspend fun correctOcr(imageFile: File, ocrText: String): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!imageFile.isFile) return@withContext ""
        val bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imageFile.absolutePath) ?: return@withContext ""
        val scale = (768f / bmp.width).coerceAtMost(1f)
        val scaled = if (scale < 1f) Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bmp, (bmp.width * scale).toInt(), (bmp.height * scale).toInt(), true) else bmp
        val bos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 85, bos)
        if (scaled !== bmp) scaled.recycle()
        bmp.recycle()
        val b64 = Base64.encodeToString(bos.toByteArray(), Base64.NO_WRAP)
        val payload = buildJsonObject {
            put("model", model)
            putJsonArray("messages") {
                addJsonObject {
                    put("role", "user")
                    putJsonArray("content") {
                        addJsonObject {
                            put("type", "text")
                            put("text", "这是教学视频的截图。下面是从图中自动识别的文字（可能有错别字）：\n「" + ocrText.take(400) + "」\n请逐字核对图片中真实显示的文字，输出正确的文字。只输出文字本身，不要解释、不要引号；若图中没有文字、或文字是乱码/播放器残留（如 TRACE、进度条字样），输出：无")
                        }
                        addJsonObject {
                            put("type", "image_url")
                            put("image_url", buildJsonObject { put("url", "data:image/jpeg;base64,$b64") })
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            put("temperature", 0.1)
            put("max_tokens", 500)
            put("stream", false)
        }.toString()
        val req = Request.Builder()
            .url("https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions")
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .post(payload.toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType()))
            .build()
        client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
            if (!resp.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("VLM HTTP ${resp.code}")
            val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(resp.body?.string().orEmpty()).jsonObject
            val out = root["choices"]?.jsonArray?.firstOrNull()
                ?.jsonObject?.get("message")?.jsonObject?.get("content")
                ?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (out == "无" || out == "（无）" || out.isEmpty()) "" else out
        }
    }
    suspend fun caption(imageFile: File): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        if (!imageFile.isFile) return@withContext ""
        val bmp = BitmapFactory.decodeFile(imageFile.absolutePath) ?: return@withContext ""
        val scale = (512f / bmp.width).coerceAtMost(1f)
        val scaled = if (scale < 1f) {
            Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bmp, (bmp.width * scale).toInt(), (bmp.height * scale).toInt(), true)
        } else bmp
        val bos = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 70, bos)
        if (scaled !== bmp) scaled.recycle()
        bmp.recycle()
        val b64 = Base64.encodeToString(bos.toByteArray(), Base64.NO_WRAP)

        val payload = buildJsonObject {
            put("model", model)
            putJsonArray("messages") {
                addJsonObject {
                    put("role", "user")
                    putJsonArray("content") {
                        addJsonObject {
                            put("type", "text")
                            put("text", "用一句话（30字以内）客观描述这个教学视频画面里能看到什么（人物/板书/图表/演示）。只描述可见内容，不要推测。")
                        }
                        addJsonObject {
                            put("type", "image_url")
                            put("image_url", buildJsonObject { put("url", "data:image/jpeg;base64,$b64") })
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            put("temperature", 0.2)
            put("max_tokens", 160)
            put("stream", false)
        }.toString()

        val req = Request.Builder()
            .url("https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions")
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .post(payload.toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType()))
            .build()

        client.newCall(req).execute().use { resp ->
            if (!resp.isSuccessful) throw IllegalStateException("VLM HTTP ${resp.code}")
            val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(resp.body?.string().orEmpty()).jsonObject
            root["choices"]?.jsonArray?.firstOrNull()
                ?.jsonObject?.get("message")?.jsonObject?.get("content")
                ?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.trim().orEmpty()
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import com.learnagent.ambience.AmbienceCore

/**
 * Android 人为因素 Compose 状态层：纯逻辑在共享 AmbienceCore（与桌面同源）。
 */
object AmbienceState {

    var particleCount by mutableStateOf(36)
        private set
    var speedFactor by mutableStateOf(1f)
        private set
    var sleeping by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    var nightMode by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    var breakNotice by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set

    init {
        AmbienceCore.start(System.currentTimeMillis())
    }

    fun noteInteraction() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        AmbienceCore.noteInteraction(now)
        if (sleeping) sleeping = false
    }

    fun dismissBreakNotice() {
        breakNotice = false
    }

    fun updateContentVolume(videoCount: Int) {
        particleCount = AmbienceCore.particleCount(videoCount)
    }

    /** 由主界面每秒调用一次。 */
    fun tick() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        speedFactor = AmbienceCore.speedFactor(now)
        sleeping = AmbienceCore.isSleeping(now)
        nightMode = AmbienceCore.isNightMode(now)
        if (AmbienceCore.shouldShowBreakNotice(now)) breakNotice = true
    }
}

private fun tlFmt(sec: Double): String {
    val t = sec.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
    fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
    return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
}

/**
 * 安卓学习时间线：内嵌播放原视频（VideoView，带原音频）+ 逐段列表；

 */
@Composable
fun AndroidStudyTimeline(
    videoFile: File?,
    timeline: List<TimelineItem>,
    onClose: () -> Unit
) {
    var videoView by remember { mutableStateOf<VideoView?>(null) }
    var fullscreen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val keyTags = remember(timeline) { com.learnagent.core.KeyKnowledge.tags(timeline) }
    val tlCtx = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext.current
    var clickPlays by remember { mutableStateOf(tlCtx.getSharedPreferences("mentara", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getBoolean("timelineClickPlays", true)) }
    val sideTags = remember(timeline) { com.learnagent.core.SideNote.tags(timeline) }

    Dialog(onDismissRequest = onClose, properties = DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false)) {
        Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(10.dp), color = Veil.copy(alpha = 0.98f), shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)) {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(10.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text("学习时间线", style = androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, color = Accent)
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Text("点某段 → 视频跳到该帧并暂停", style = androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = TextMid)
                    Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(
                        if (clickPlays) "点击后：继续播放" else "点击后：暂停记笔记",
                        style = androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = TextMid,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                            clickPlays = !clickPlays
                            tlCtx.getSharedPreferences("mentara", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit().putBoolean("timelineClickPlays", clickPlays).apply()
                        }
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                    if (videoFile != null && videoFile.isFile) {
                        TextButton(onClick = { fullscreen = !fullscreen }) { Text(if (fullscreen) "退出全屏" else "全屏") }
                    }
                    TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("关闭") }
                }
                if (videoFile != null && videoFile.isFile) {
                    AndroidView(
                        factory = { ctx ->
                            VideoView(ctx).apply {
                                val mc = MediaController(ctx)

                                videoView = this
                            }
                        },
                        modifier = if (fullscreen) Modifier.fillMaxSize() else Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(230.dp)
                    )
                } else {
                    Text("找不到源文件（请重新导入）", color = TextMid, modifier = Modifier.padding(8.dp))
                }
                if (!fullscreen) {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                if (timeline.isEmpty()) {
                    Text("暂无内容：先点『抽帧 OCR』『转写』", color = TextMid)
                } else {
                    LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        items(timeline.size) { i ->
                            val item = timeline[i]
                            val keyTag = keyTags.getOrNull(i)
                            Column(
                                Modifier.fillMaxWidth().clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                    .background(if (keyTag != null) Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.14f) else MoonSilver.copy(alpha = 0.06f))
                                    .clickable {
                                        videoView?.let { vv ->
                                            runCatching {
                                                vv.seekTo((item.start * 1000).toInt())
                                                if (clickPlays) vv.start() else vv.pause()
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    .padding(8.dp)
                            ) {
                                Text("[${tlFmt(item.start)} - ${tlFmt(item.end)}]" + if (keyTag != null) "   ★必学·$keyTag" else "" + (sideTags.getOrNull(i)?.let { "   ⤼$it" } ?: ""), color = Aureate, style = androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall)
                                Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
                                if (item.speech.isNotBlank()) {
                                    Text("语音：${item.speech.take(140)}", color = TextHigh, style = androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                                }
                                if (item.screenText.isNotBlank()) {
                                    Spacer(Modifier.height(2.dp))
                                    Text("画面：${item.screenText.take(80)}", color = MoonSilver, style = androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

androidApp/src/main/kotlin/com/learnagent/ui/AudioFx.kt (3.7KB)
package com.learnagent.ui

import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioManager
import android.media.AudioTrack
import com.learnagent.audio.PcmSynth
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/**
 * Android 音效播放层：合成在共享 PcmSynth（与桌面同音色），
 * 这里用 AudioTrack 声线池（3 条常驻、异步、可叠加、空闲 2.4s 自动释放）。
 * 触屏无 hover → HOVER 音效在 Android 上不触发。
 */
@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
object AudioFx {

    @Volatile
    var enabled: Boolean = true

    private val cache = HashMap<PcmSynth.Sound, ByteArray>()

    private class Voice {
        val queue = LinkedBlockingQueue<ByteArray>(8)
    }

    private val voices = List(3) { Voice() }
    private val started = AtomicBoolean(false)

    /** 预热声线池（后台线程，不阻塞 UI）。 */
    fun warmUp(context: android.content.Context? = null) {
        if (!enabled) return
        if (!started.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        voices.forEach { voice ->
            Thread {
                while (true) {
                    var chunk = runCatching { voice.queue.take() }.getOrNull() ?: return@Thread
                    runCatching {
                        var track: AudioTrack? = null
                        try {
                            val minBuf = AudioTrack.getMinBufferSize(
                                PcmSynth.SAMPLE_RATE,
                                AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
                                AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT
                            )
                            track = AudioTrack(
                                AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC,
                                PcmSynth.SAMPLE_RATE,
                                AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO,
                                AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT,
                                maxOf(minBuf, 16384),
                                AudioTrack.MODE_STREAM
                            )
                            track.play()
                            while (chunk != null) {
                                track.write(chunk, 0, chunk.size)
                                chunk = voice.queue.poll(2400, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                            }
                        } finally {
                            track?.runCatching {
                                stop()
                                release()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }.apply {
                isDaemon = true
                name = "mentara-voice"
                start()
            }
        }
    }

    fun play(sound: PcmSynth.Sound, volumeScale: Float = 1f) {
        if (!enabled) return
        warmUp()
        val pcm = synchronized(cache) {
            cache.getOrPut(sound) { PcmSynth.render(sound) }
        }
        val data = if (volumeScale == 1f) pcm else PcmSynth.scale(pcm, volumeScale)
        val voice = voices.minByOrNull { it.queue.size } ?: return
        voice.queue.offer(data)
    }

    // 桌面 Feedback 语义对齐的快捷方法
    fun tap() = play(PcmSynth.Sound.TAP)
    fun success() = play(PcmSynth.Sound.SUCCESS)
    fun error() = play(PcmSynth.Sound.ERROR)
    fun open() = play(PcmSynth.Sound.OPEN)
    fun close() = play(PcmSynth.Sound.CLOSE)
    fun splashTone(v: Float = 1f) = play(PcmSynth.Sound.SPLASH_TONE, v)
    fun chime(v: Float = 1f) = play(PcmSynth.Sound.CHIME, v)
    fun drone(v: Float = 1f) = play(PcmSynth.Sound.DRONE, v)
    fun whoosh(v: Float = 1f) = play(PcmSynth.Sound.WHOOSH, v)
    fun rest() = play(PcmSynth.Sound.REST)
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.GenericShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Outline
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Path
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shape
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Density
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.LayoutDirection
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

/**
 * 高端异形卡片形状（替代标准 16dp 全圆角）。
 * 每类内容一种形状：斜切角 / 弧顶 / 双层 / 不对称气泡 / 标签切角 / 缺口。
 */
object CardShapes {

    /** 视频卡：左上 + 右下大圆角，右上 + 左下直角（被光斜切）。 */
    fun videoCard(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = 24.dp,
        topEnd = 0.dp,
        bottomEnd = 24.dp,
        bottomStart = 0.dp
    )

    /** 学习单元卡：弧顶（曲线）+ 左右 20dp 过渡 + 底部直角。 */
    fun learningUnitCard(): Shape = GenericShape { size, _ ->
        val radius = 20f * 2f
        moveTo(0f, size.height)
        lineTo(0f, 40f)
        quadraticBezierTo(size.width / 2f, 0f, size.width, 40f)
        lineTo(size.width, size.height)
        lineTo(radius.coerceAtMost(size.width / 2f), size.height)
        close()
    }

    /** 技术卡：16dp（双层玻璃由使用处叠"影子卡片"实现）。 */
    fun techCard(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)

    /** 用户气泡：右下角 4dp，其余 20dp。 */
    fun userBubble(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = 20.dp, topEnd = 20.dp, bottomEnd = 4.dp, bottomStart = 20.dp
    )

    /** AI 气泡：左下角 4dp，其余 20dp。 */
    fun aiBubble(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = 20.dp, topEnd = 20.dp, bottomEnd = 20.dp, bottomStart = 4.dp
    )

    /** 决策卡：右上斜切 24dp（文件夹标签角）+ 其余三角 12dp 圆角。 */
    fun decisionCard(): Shape = object : Shape {
        override fun createOutline(size: Size, layoutDirection: LayoutDirection, density: Density): Outline {
            val r = 12f * density.density
            val cut = 24f * density.density
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            val path = Path().apply {
                moveTo(r, 0f)
                lineTo(w - cut, 0f)
                lineTo(w, cut)
                lineTo(w, h - r)
                quadraticBezierTo(w, h, w - r, h)
                lineTo(r, h)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, h, 0f, h - r)
                lineTo(0f, r)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, 0f, r, 0f)
                close()
            }
            return Outline.Generic(path)
        }
    }

    /** 导入课程卡：四角 32dp 大圆角 + 左侧中间半圆缺口（被咬一口的饼干）。 */
    fun importCard(): Shape = object : Shape {
        override fun createOutline(size: Size, layoutDirection: LayoutDirection, density: Density): Outline {
            val r = 32f * density.density
            val notch = 14f * density.density
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            val path = Path().apply {
                moveTo(r, 0f)
                lineTo(w - r, 0f)
                quadraticBezierTo(w, 0f, w, r)
                lineTo(w, h - r)
                quadraticBezierTo(w, h, w - r, h)
                lineTo(r, h)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, h, 0f, h - r)
                lineTo(0f, h / 2f + notch)
                quadraticBezierTo(notch * 1.6f, h / 2f, 0f, h / 2f - notch)
                lineTo(0f, r)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, 0f, r, 0f)
                close()
            }
            return Outline.Generic(path)
        }
    }
}

import androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility
import androidx.compose.animation.core.Animatable

/** 导入按钮协调化：玻璃渐变 + 全大写 + 2sp 字距 + 按压 TAP 音与触感。 */
@Composable
fun GlassImportButton(onClick: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val shift by animateFloatAsState(if (pressed) 1f else 0f, Motion.standard, label = "importShift")
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .pressScale(interaction)
            .clip(CardShapes.importCard())
            .background(
                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Accent.copy(alpha = 0.10f),
                        Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.16f),
                        Accent.copy(alpha = 0.10f),
                        Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.16f)
                    ),
                    startX = -200f + shift * 300f,
                    endX = 300f + shift * 300f
                )
            )
            .clickable(interaction, indication = null) {
                AudioFx.tap(); Haptics.tap(context)
                onClick()
            }
            .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
    ) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            ImportIcon(18)
            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
            Text(
                t("btn_import"),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge.copy(
                    letterSpacing = 2.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
                ),
                color = TextHigh
            )
        }
    }
}

/** 视频卡片：20dp 无边框光晕 + 微缩略图 + 单元数 + 新鲜度条 + ±4dp 错落 + 持续微倾斜。 */
@Composable
fun VideoCardAndroid(
    id: String,
    segments: Int,
    freshness: Float,
    selected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    // 卡片激活态：hover（外接鼠标/触控笔）/pressed（触屏回退）统一 0..1，200ms
    val activation = rememberCardActivation(interaction)
    val goldBorder by animateDpAsState(
        targetValue = if (activation > 0f) 1.dp else 0.dp,
        animationSpec = tween(200),
        label = "cardGoldBorder"
    )
    val wobbleDp = ((id.hashCode() and 0x7FFF) % 9) - 4
    val accentPalette = listOf(
        Color(0xFF4A7AB8), Color(0xFFB8A8D4), Color(0xFF7FB89C), Color(0xFFE8C87A), Color(0xFFE89A9A)
    )
    val accentColor = accentPalette[(id.hashCode() and 0x7FFFFFFF) % accentPalette.size]
    val enterRotation = remember { Animatable(-15f) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { enterRotation.animateTo(0f, tween(400, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)) }
    GlowBox(
        glow = if (selected) Accent else Aureate,
        intensity = if (selected) 1f else 0.30f + 0.70f * activation,
        radius = 130.dp,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().floatIn(distanceDp = 14.dp)
    ) {
        Surface(
            color = Color(0xFF243044).copy(alpha = 0.95f),
            shape = CardShapes.videoCard(),
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .graphicsLayer {
                    translationY = wobbleDp.dp.toPx()
                    rotationX = -1.5f
                    cameraDistance = 18f * density
                    scaleX = 1f + 0.025f * activation
                    scaleY = 1f + 0.025f * activation
                }
                .rotation3D(enterRotation.value)
                .border(goldBorder, Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.55f * activation), CardShapes.videoCard())
                .pressScale(interaction)
                .clickable(interaction, indication = null) {
                    AudioFx.tap(); Haptics.tap(context)
                    onClick()
                }
                .hoverable(interaction)
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .background(
                        Brush.linearGradient(
                            listOf(
                                Color(0xFF060A0F).copy(alpha = 0.55f - 0.47f * activation),
                                Color(0xFF060A0F).copy(alpha = 0.16f - 0.14f * activation)
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    .padding(DesignTokens.SpaceCardInnerDp.dp)
            ) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    // 封面：默认暗滤镜（能看出轮廓）→ 按压/悬停明显提亮 + 金色描边/光晕
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .size(width = 52.dp, height = 38.dp)
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                    ) {
                        // 程序化封面底：冷调画面 + 柔光，避免纯黑
                        Canvas(
                            Modifier
                                .matchParentSize()
                                .graphicsLayer { alpha = 0.85f + 0.15f * activation }
                        ) {
                            drawRect(
                                Brush.linearGradient(
                                    listOf(
                                        Color(0xFF3C5878),
                                        Color(0xFF243449),
                                        Color(0xFF17202E)
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                            drawRect(
                                brush = Brush.verticalGradient(
                                    listOf(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.85f), accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.12f))
                                ),
                                size = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size(size.width, size.height * 0.34f)
                            )
                            drawCircle(
                                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                                    listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.22f), Color.Transparent)
                                ),
                                radius = size.width * 0.50f,
                                center = Offset(size.width * 0.30f, size.height * 0.30f)
                            )
                            drawCircle(
                                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                                    listOf(Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.26f), Color.Transparent)
                                ),
                                radius = size.width * 0.42f,
                                center = Offset(size.width * 0.80f, size.height * 0.72f)
                            )
                        }
                        // 原三点缩略图（批次 1 视觉不变）
                        MiniThumb(seed = id)
                        // 暗滤镜：Abyss 0.65 → 0.20（按压/悬停）
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .matchParentSize()
                                .background(Abyss.copy(alpha = 0.45f - 0.40f * activation))
                        )
                        // 金色描边：0dp → 1dp
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .matchParentSize()
                                .border(goldBorder, Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.90f * activation), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                        )
                        // 径向金色 halo：强度 0 → 1
                        Canvas(Modifier.matchParentSize()) {
                            drawCircle(
                                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                                    listOf(Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.30f * activation), Color.Transparent),
                                    center = center,
                                    radius = size.maxDimension * 0.75f
                                ),
                                radius = size.maxDimension * 0.75f,
                                center = center
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        Text(
                            id,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium.copy(
                                shadow = Shadow(
                                    color = Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.55f),
                                    offset = Offset(0f, 1f),
                                    blurRadius = 3f
                                )
                            ),
                            color = TextHigh,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text(
                            if (segments > 0) t("home_indexed", "", segments.toString()) else t("home_not_indexed"),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            fontFamily = androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily.Monospace,
                            color = TextMid,
                            maxLines = 1,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                        )
                    }
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                // 新鲜度条
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .height(3.dp)
                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                        .background(Mist.copy(alpha = 0.4f))
                ) {
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth(freshness)
                            .fillMaxHeight()
                            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                            .background(
                                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                                    listOf(Accent.copy(alpha = 0.8f), Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.8f))
                                )
                            )
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/** 微妙的程序化"缩略图"：Logo 同源三点结构微缩视觉（accent 由组合层取好传入）。 */
@Composable
fun MiniThumb(seed: String) {
    val accent = Accent
    Canvas(Modifier.size(width = 52.dp, height = 38.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))) {
        drawRect(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Glimmer, Abyss)))
        val t1 = Offset(size.width * 0.28f, size.height * 0.36f)
        val t2 = Offset(size.width * 0.64f, size.height * 0.30f)
        val t3 = Offset(size.width * 0.44f, size.height * 0.72f)
        drawLine(accent.copy(alpha = 0.4f), t1, t3, strokeWidth = 1f)
        drawLine(accent.copy(alpha = 0.4f), t2, t3, strokeWidth = 1f)
        val a = 0.5f + ((seed.hashCode() and 0x7FFF) % 5) * 0.1f
        drawCircle(accent.copy(alpha = a), radius = 3.2f, center = t1)
        drawCircle(Aureate.copy(alpha = a), radius = 2.4f, center = t2)
        drawCircle(accent.copy(alpha = a), radius = 4f, center = t3)
    }
}

/** 成功光带：顶部中心向两侧扩散绿色光带，2 秒消散。 */
@Composable
fun SuccessFlashAndroid(trigger: Int, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    var visible by remember { androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf(false) }
    LaunchedEffect(trigger) {
        if (trigger == 0) return@LaunchedEffect
        visible = true
        kotlinx.coroutines.delay(2000)
        visible = false
    }
    AnimatedVisibility(
        visible = visible,
        enter = expandVertically(expandFrom = Alignment.Top) + fadeIn(tween(200)),
        exit = shrinkVertically(shrinkTowards = Alignment.Top) + fadeOut(tween(500)),
        modifier = modifier
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(3.dp)
                .background(
                    Brush.horizontalGradient(
                        listOf(Color.Transparent, SuccessGreen, SuccessGreen, Color.Transparent)
                    )
                )
        )
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.animation.core.Animatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutSlowInEasing
import androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateDpAsState
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloat
import androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.blur
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.graphicsLayer
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

/**
 * 电影级运镜（8 种镜头）：
 * dollyIn / dollyOut / parallax / rackFocus / rotation3D / breathing / shake / panTransition。
 * 协调规则：每次只用一种镜头；时长 300-500ms；缓动 FastOutSlowIn / Spring。
 *
 * 性能保护：帧率低时 parallax 幅度 0.08 → 0.04，关闭 blur（rackFocus 直接清零）。
 */
object PerfGuard {
    /** 由性能采样置位（帧率 < 50fps 时 true）。 */
    var lowFps: Boolean = false
    val parallaxScale: Float get() = if (lowFps) 0.04f else 0.08f
    fun shouldUseBlur(): Boolean = !lowFps
}

/** 镜头 1：推进（进入详情页）scale 1.0 → 1.08，400ms。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.dollyIn(active: Boolean = true): Modifier {
    val scale = remember { Animatable(1f) }
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        scale.animateTo(
            targetValue = if (active) 1.08f else 1f,
            animationSpec = tween(if (active) 400 else 350, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)
        )
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale.value
        scaleY = scale.value
    }
}

/** 镜头 2：拉远（返回列表）scale 1.08 → 1.0，350ms。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.dollyOut(active: Boolean): Modifier {
    val scale = remember { Animatable(1.08f) }
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        scale.animateTo(
            targetValue = if (active) 1f else 1.08f,
            animationSpec = tween(350, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)
        )
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale.value
        scaleY = scale.value
    }
}

/** 镜头 4：视差（鼠标 ±100px → 图层 ±8px；低帧率降为 ±4px）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.parallax(mouseX: Float, centerX: Float): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer {
        translationX = (mouseX - centerX) * PerfGuard.parallaxScale
    }

/** 镜头 5：景深（focused=false 时 blur 0 → 4dp，500ms；低帧率关闭）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.rackFocus(focused: Boolean): Modifier {
    val blurDp by animateDpAsState(
        targetValue = if (focused || !PerfGuard.shouldUseBlur()) 0.dp else 4.dp,
        animationSpec = tween(500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
        label = "rackFocus"
    )
    return if (blurDp.value > 0f) this.blur(blurDp) else this
}

/** 镜头 6：3D 旋转（卡片翻面）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.rotation3D(angle: Float): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer {
        rotationY = angle
        cameraDistance = 12f * density
    }

/** 镜头 7：呼吸（空状态/加载态，scale 1.0 → 1.02，周期 3s）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.breathing(): Modifier {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "breathing")
    val scale by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 1f,
        targetValue = 1.02f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(1500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "breathingScale"
    )
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale
        scaleY = scale
    }
}

/** 镜头 8：抖动（错误提示 -4 → +4 → -4 → 0，300ms）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.shake(active: Boolean): Modifier {
    val tx = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        if (active) {
            tx.animateTo(-4f, tween(60, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
            tx.animateTo(4f, tween(60, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
            tx.animateTo(-4f, tween(60, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
            tx.animateTo(0f, tween(120, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
        }
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer { translationX = tx.value }
}

/** 镜头 3：平移（Tab/页面切换的位移量）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.panTransition(offset: Float): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer { translationX = offset }

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import com.learnagent.core.DebateEngine
import com.learnagent.core.DebateModels
import com.learnagent.core.DebateResult
import com.learnagent.core.LlmClient
import com.learnagent.core.LocalDebater
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/**
 * 全局辩论宿主：辩论任务挂在应用级作用域上，切换页面/窗口不会中断；
 * 进度、阶段、耗时与结果都存在这里，回到面板即可续看。
 */
object DebateHost {
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main)
    private var job: Job? = null

    var videoId: String? by mutableStateOf(null)
        private set
    var result: DebateResult? by mutableStateOf(null)
        private set
    var busy: Boolean by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    var phase: Int by mutableStateOf(0)
        private set
    var startedAt: Long by mutableStateOf(0L)
        private set
    var error: String? by mutableStateOf(null)
        private set

    fun cancel() {
        job?.cancel()
        job = null
        busy = false
        phase = 0
        startedAt = 0L
    }

    fun start(
        videoId: String?,
        topic: String,
        timeline: List<TimelineItem>,
        apiKey: String,
        modelA: String,
        modelB: String,
        modelC: String,
        netAvailable: Boolean = true
    ) {
        if (busy || timeline.isEmpty()) return
        this.videoId = videoId
        result = null
        error = null
        if (apiKey.isNotBlank() && !netAvailable) {
            error = "当前无网络连接，无法在线辩论。请连网后重试。"
            busy = false
            phase = 0
            return
        }
        busy = true
        phase = 1
        startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
        job = scope.launch {
            try {
                // NIM 连通性预检：有网但连不上 NIM（代理/防火墙）时立刻给出明确原因，不再干等超时
                if (apiKey.isNotBlank() && !nimReachable(apiKey)) {
                    error = "连不上 NVIDIA NIM（模型服务）：设备有网但到 NIM 不通（代理/防火墙/运营商拦截）。请换网络后重试；离线辩论可清空 API Key 使用。"
                    busy = false
                    return@launch
                }
                val context8 = com.learnagent.core.Evidence.render(
                    timeline.sortedByDescending { (it.speech + it.screenText).length }.take(8)
                )
                val engine = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    if (apiKey.isNotBlank()) {
                        val a: LlmClient = com.learnagent.llm.AndroidNimClient(apiKey, DebateModels.resolve(modelA, DebateModels.DEFAULT_A))
                        val b: LlmClient = com.learnagent.llm.AndroidNimClient(apiKey, DebateModels.resolve(modelB, DebateModels.DEFAULT_B))
                        val c: LlmClient = com.learnagent.llm.AndroidNimClient(apiKey, DebateModels.resolve(modelC, DebateModels.DEFAULT_C))
                        DebateEngine(a, b, c, com.learnagent.llm.AndroidNimClient(apiKey, DebateModels.FAST_FALLBACK))
                    } else {
                        DebateEngine(
                            LocalDebater("概述", timeline),
                            LocalDebater("挑战", timeline),
                            LocalDebater("证据", timeline)
                        )
                    }
                }
                val r = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    engine.debate(
                        topic, context8,
                        onPhase = { phase = it },
                        onRound = { _, partial -> result = partial }
                    )
                }
                result = r
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                error = e.message ?: "辩论失败"
            } finally {
                busy = false
                phase = 0
                startedAt = 0L
                job = null
            }
        }
    }
}
