// ============================================================
//  Developer Mode 第 2 批 UI（Android）：
//  技术地图 / 周报 / 决策日志 + 回访 / 记录决策 / chips
//  布局算法复用 shared commonMain ui/TechMap.kt
// ============================================================

private fun dateText(ts: Long): String =
    if (ts <= 0L) "—" else SimpleDateFormat("MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(ts))

@Composable
fun TechCardCompactDialogAndroid(card: TechCard, store: TechStore, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    LaunchedEffect(card.id) { TechUsageTracker(store).onTechCardOpened(card.name) }
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onClose,
        shape = CardShapes.techCard(),
        title = { Text(card.name, color = Accent) },
        text = {
            Column {
                Text(card.category.name, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = Aureate)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                Text(card.whatItIs, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)
                if (card.whatItSolves.isNotBlank()) Text("解决：${card.whatItSolves}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MoonSilver)
                if (card.whenToUse.isNotBlank()) Text("适用：${card.whenToUse}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MoonSilver)
                if (card.whenNotToUse.isNotBlank()) Text("不适用：${card.whenNotToUse}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = Coral)
                if (card.codeSnippet.isNotBlank()) Text(card.codeSnippet, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall.copy(fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace), color = SuccessGreen)
            }
        },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("关闭") } }
    )
}

@Composable
fun TechChipsRowAndroid(names: List<String>, onChip: (String) -> Unit) {
    if (names.isEmpty()) return
    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        names.forEach { name ->
            Text(
                "# $name",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = Aureate,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .background(Glimmer.copy(alpha = 0.6f))
                    .border(1.dp, Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.25f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                    .clickable { onChip(name) }
                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
            )
        }
    }
}

/** 首页提醒 chip（周报 / 回访）。 */
@Composable
fun DevAlertChipAndroid(title: String, action: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Row(
        Modifier
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .background(Glimmer.copy(alpha = 0.45f))
            .border(1.dp, Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.25f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextHigh, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
        Text(action, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = Aureate)
    }
}

@Composable
fun RecordDecisionDialogAndroid(store: TechStore, prefillProblem: String, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    var problem by remember { mutableStateOf(prefillProblem) }
    var options by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var chosen by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var reason by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var constraints by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var followUpDays by remember { mutableStateOf("7") }
    var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onClose,
        title = { Text("记录决策", color = Accent) },
        text = {
            Column {
                OutlinedTextField(problem, { problem = it }, label = { Text("问题") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                OutlinedTextField(options, { options = it }, label = { Text("可选方案（每行一个）") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                OutlinedTextField(chosen, { chosen = it }, label = { Text("最终选择") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                OutlinedTextField(reason, { reason = it }, label = { Text("理由") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                OutlinedTextField(constraints, { constraints = it }, label = { Text("约束条件（逗号分隔）") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                OutlinedTextField(
                    followUpDays,
                    { followUpDays = it.filter { c -> c.isDigit() }.take(2) },
                    label = { Text("回访天数") },
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                )
                error?.let {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                    Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = Coral)
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = {
                if (problem.isBlank() || chosen.isBlank() || reason.isBlank()) {
                    error = "问题 / 最终选择 / 理由 必填"
                } else {
                    TechDecisionService.record(
                        store = store,
                        problem = problem.trim(),
                        chosen = chosen.trim(),
                        reason = reason.trim(),
                        options = options.lines().map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() },
                        constraints = constraints.split(',', '，').map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() },
                        followUpDays = followUpDays.toIntOrNull() ?: 7
                    )
                    onClose()
                }
            }) { Text("保存") }
        },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("取消") } }
    )
}

@Composable
fun FollowUpDialogAndroid(store: TechStore, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    var index by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    val due = remember { TechDecisionService.dueFollowUps(store) }
    var result by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val current = due.getOrNull(index)

    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onClose,
        title = { Text("决策回访（${index + 1}/${due.size}）", color = Accent) },
        text = {
            Column {
                if (current == null) {
                    Text("没有待回访的决策。", color = TextMid)
                } else {
                    Text(current.problem, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                    Text("选择：${current.chosen}｜理由：${current.reason}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MoonSilver)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    OutlinedTextField(result, { result = it }, label = { Text("结果如何？") }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                        listOf("是" to true, "部分" to null, "否" to false).forEach { (label, good) ->
                            Text(
                                label,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge,
                                color = when (good) {
                                    true -> SuccessGreen
                                    false -> Coral
                                    null -> Aureate
                                },
                                modifier = Modifier
                                    .clip(RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    .border(1.dp, Mist, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                                    .clickable {
                                        TechDecisionService.saveFollowUp(store, current, result, good)
                                        result = ""
                                        if (index + 1 >= due.size) onClose() else index++
                                    }
                                    .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("关闭") } }
    )
}

@Composable
fun WeeklyReportDialogAndroid(store: TechStore, onClose: () -> Unit) {
    val report = remember { WeeklyReportGenerator(store).generate() }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { WeeklyReportGenerator(store).markRead() }
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onClose,
        title = { Text("Weekly Report", color = Accent) },
        text = {
            Column {
                Text("${dateText(report.weekStart)} ~ ${dateText(report.weekEnd)}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = TextMid)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                Text("本周新增技术：${report.newTechsCount}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextHigh)
                Text("活跃使用：${report.activeUseCount}｜新增决策：${report.newDecisionsCount}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextHigh)
                Text("强项：${report.strongDomains.joinToString("/").ifBlank { "—" }}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextHigh)
                Text("见过未用：${report.weakDomains.joinToString("/").ifBlank { "—" }}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextHigh)
                Text("焦点：${report.focusTech ?: "—"}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextHigh)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                Text(report.suggestion, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MoonSilver)
            }
        },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = onClose) { Text("关闭") } }
    )
}

@Composable
fun DecisionsViewAndroid(store: TechStore, onBack: () -> Unit) {
    val decisions = remember { store.getAllDecisions().sortedByDescending { it.createdAt } }
    Surface(shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp), color = Veil.copy(alpha = 0.96f), modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(16.dp)) {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Text("决策记录", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, color = Accent)
                Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                TextButton(onClick = onBack) { Text("返回") }
            }
            if (decisions.isEmpty()) {
                Text("还没有决策记录。问答面板 → Record Decision 可创建。", color = TextMid)
            } else {
                LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                    items(decisions) { d ->
                        Column(
                            Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .clip(CardShapes.decisionCard())
                                .background(Glimmer.copy(alpha = 0.35f))
                                .padding(12.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(dateText(d.createdAt), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = TextMid)
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Text(d.problem, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                Text(
                                    d.chosen,
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                    color = Color(0xFF0B0710),
                                    modifier = Modifier
                                        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                                        .background(Aureate)
                                        .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                                )
                                if (d.result.isNotBlank()) {
                                    Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                                    Text(
                                        "结果：${d.result}",
                                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                                        color = when (d.resultGood) {
                                            true -> SuccessGreen
                                            false -> Coral
                                            null -> MoonSilver
                                        },
                                        maxLines = 2,
                                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/** 技术地图（Android：点击节点弹技术卡；布局算法来自 shared）。 */
@Composable
fun TechMapViewAndroid(store: TechStore, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val cards = remember { store.getAllTechCards() }
    val usages = remember { store.getAllTechUsage() }
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    var canvasSize by remember { mutableStateOf(IntSize.Zero) }
    val layout = remember(cards, usages, canvasSize) {
        TechMapLayoutEngine.build(cards, usages, canvasSize.width.toFloat(), canvasSize.height.toFloat())
    }
    var selected by remember { mutableStateOf<TechCard?>(null) }

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .onSizeChanged { canvasSize = it }
            .pointerInput(layout) {
                detectTapGestures { p ->
                    val hit = TechMapLayoutEngine.hitTest(layout.nodes, p.x, p.y, 12f * density.density)
                    if (hit != null) selected = cards.firstOrNull { it.name == hit.name }
                }
            }
    ) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            layout.edges.forEach { e ->
                drawLine(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.15f), Offset(e.fromX, e.fromY), Offset(e.toX, e.toY), strokeWidth = 0.5.dp.toPx())
            }
            layout.nodes.forEach { n ->
                val color = Color(n.colorArgb)
                val r = n.radiusDp * this.density
                if (n.glow) drawCircle(color.copy(alpha = 0.20f), radius = r * 1.9f, center = Offset(n.x, n.y))
                drawCircle(color, radius = r, center = Offset(n.x, n.y))
                drawCircle(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.25f), radius = r * 1.25f, center = Offset(n.x, n.y), style = Stroke(width = 0.8.dp.toPx()))
            }
        }
        if (cards.isEmpty()) {
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Text("暂无技术卡：设置页 → Rebuild Tech Cards", color = TextMid)
            }
        }
    }
    selected?.let { TechCardCompactDialogAndroid(it, store) { selected = null } }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.DisposableEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableFloatStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.withFrameNanos
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalView
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.learnagent.ui.theme.Aureate
import com.learnagent.ui.theme.CenterGlow
import com.learnagent.ui.theme.EdgeDark
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import kotlin.random.Random

private class DriftParticle(
    val baseX: Float,
    val baseY: Float,
    val ampX: Float,
    val ampY: Float,
    val periodA: Float,
    val periodB: Float,
    val phaseA: Float,
    val phaseB: Float,
    val radius: Float,
    val golden: Boolean,
    val halo: Float
)

/**
 * 动态背景（Android 版，与桌面同构三层）：
 *  1. 星空径向渐变（双渐变叠加防色带）
 *  2. 知识流粒子（AmbienceState 驱动数量 36~80 / 速度 / 沉睡 / 夜读）
 *  3. 呼吸光晕 + 三条贝塞尔轨道曲线 + 三个游走光灵（OrbitMotion 同源运动）
 *
 * 性能：每 45 帧采样平均帧时长，>26ms → 绘制粒子数 ×0.75（下限 35%）；
 * 窗口失焦降到 ~5fps（ViewTreeObserver 焦点监听，不用 AWT）。
 */
@Composable
fun DynamicBackground(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val particleCount = AmbienceState.particleCount
    val particles = remember(particleCount) {
        val rnd = Random(19_87)
        List(particleCount) {
            DriftParticle(
                baseX = rnd.nextFloat(),
                baseY = rnd.nextFloat(),
                ampX = 0.012f + rnd.nextFloat() * 0.030f,
                ampY = 0.010f + rnd.nextFloat() * 0.026f,
                periodA = 22f + rnd.nextFloat() * 38f,
                periodB = 26f + rnd.nextFloat() * 42f,
                phaseA = rnd.nextFloat() * 2f * PI.toFloat(),
                phaseB = rnd.nextFloat() * 2f * PI.toFloat(),
                radius = 1f + rnd.nextFloat() * 2f,
                golden = it % 2 == 1,
                halo = 0.35f + rnd.nextFloat() * 0.30f
            )
        }
    }
    val positionBuffer = remember { FloatArray(80 * 2) }
    val wanderBuf = remember { FloatArray(3) }
    val wandData = remember { FloatArray(9) }
    val perf = remember { floatArrayOf(1f) }

    // 窗口焦点（失焦 → 帧循环降到 ~5fps）
    val view = LocalView.current
    var viewActive by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
    DisposableEffect(view) {
        val listener = android.view.ViewTreeObserver.OnWindowFocusChangeListener { viewActive = it }
        view.viewTreeObserver.addOnWindowFocusChangeListener(listener)
        onDispose { view.viewTreeObserver.removeOnWindowFocusChangeListener(listener) }
    }

    var flowTime by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
    var clockTime by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }
    // Accent 是 @Composable getter：在组合层取好，draw lambda 只捕获局部值
    val localAccent = Accent

    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        var last = 0L
        var accumulated = 0f
        var frameIndex = 0
        var accMs = 0.0
        var perfFrames = 0
        while (true) {
            withFrameNanos { now ->
                if (last == 0L) {
                    last = now
                } else {
                    val dt = ((now - last) / 1_000_000_000.0).coerceIn(0.0, 0.1).toFloat()
                    last = now
                    accumulated += dt
                    frameIndex++
                    accMs += dt * 1000.0
                    perfFrames++
                    if (perfFrames >= 45) {
                        val avg = accMs / perfFrames
                        if (avg > 26.0) {
                            perf[0] = (perf[0] * 0.75f).coerceAtLeast(0.35f)
                        } else if (avg < 20.0) {
                            perf[0] = (perf[0] * 1.12f).coerceAtMost(1f)
                        }
                        accMs = 0.0
                        perfFrames = 0
                    }
                    val sleeping = AmbienceState.sleeping
                    val every = when {
                        !viewActive -> 12
                        sleeping -> 2
                        else -> 1
                    }
                    if (frameIndex % every == 0) {
                        val factor = AmbienceState.speedFactor * (if (sleeping) 0.35f else 1f)
                        flowTime += accumulated * factor
                        clockTime += accumulated
                        accumulated = 0f
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    Canvas(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val night = AmbienceState.nightMode
        val sleeping = AmbienceState.sleeping
        val accent = localAccent
        val lily = Color(0xFF7FB89C)
        val particleAlpha = when {
            sleeping -> 0.45f
            night -> 0.70f
            else -> 1f
        }

        // ---- V3 雾状三层叠加（紫灰 / 绿灰 / 金灰），方向随时间缓转 ----
        val fogCx = size.width / 2f
        val fogCy = size.height / 2f
        val fogMax = kotlin.math.max(size.width, size.height) * 1.2f
        val fogColors = listOf(accent, lily, Aureate)
        val fogAlphas = listOf(0.14f, 0.10f, 0.08f)
        for (k in 0..2) {
            val ang = clockTime * (0.024f + k * 0.011f) + k * 2.1f
            val endX = fogCx + kotlin.math.cos(ang) * fogMax
            val endY = fogCy + kotlin.math.sin(ang) * fogMax
            val a = fogAlphas[k] * (if (night) 0.7f else 1f)
            drawRect(
                Brush.linearGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        Color(0xFF0A0E14),
                        fogColors[k].copy(alpha = a),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    start = Offset(fogCx - (endX - fogCx), fogCy - (endY - fogCy)),
                    end = Offset(endX, endY)
                )
            )
        }

        // ---- 第 1 层：星空渐变（双渐变叠加防色带） ----
        val center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height * 0.42f)
        val radius = size.maxDimension * 0.78f
        drawRect(
            Brush.radialGradient(
                colors = listOf(CenterGlow, EdgeDark),
                center = center,
                radius = radius
            )
        )
        drawRect(
            Brush.radialGradient(
                colors = listOf(Color(0x14100A1C), Color.Transparent),
                center = Offset(size.width * 0.3f, size.height * 0.6f),
                radius = size.maxDimension * 0.5f
            )
        )

        // ---- 2.5 层：3D 同源轨道（三条淡曲线 + 游走光灵） ----
        for (i in 0..2) {
            val t = clockTime * (0.55f + 0.07f * i) + i * 4.7f
            OrbitMotion.position(i, t, wanderBuf)
            wandData[i * 3] = size.width * (0.5f + wanderBuf[0] * 0.17f)
            wandData[i * 3 + 1] = size.height * (0.5f + wanderBuf[1] * 0.15f)
            wandData[i * 3 + 2] = wanderBuf[2]
        }
        val trackNearR = size.minDimension * 0.35f
        val trackNearR2 = trackNearR * trackNearR
        for (k in 0..2) {
            val drift = OrbitMotion.noise(clockTime * 0.05f + k * 9f) * 0.08f
            val yBase = size.height * (0.25f + k * 0.25f) + drift * size.height
            val p0 = Offset(-size.width * 0.06f, yBase)
            val p1 = Offset(size.width * 0.35f, yBase - size.height * 0.22f)
            val p2 = Offset(size.width * 0.65f, yBase + size.height * 0.24f)
            val p3 = Offset(size.width * 1.06f, yBase - size.height * 0.06f)
            val segs = 16
            var prev = cubicPoint(p0, p1, p2, p3, 0f)
            for (seg in 1..segs) {
                val u = seg / segs.toFloat()
                val pt = cubicPoint(p0, p1, p2, p3, u)
                var boost = 0f
                for (i in 0..2) {
                    val dx = pt.x - wandData[i * 3]
                    val dy = pt.y - wandData[i * 3 + 1]
                    val d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
                    if (d2 < trackNearR2) boost += (1f - d2 / trackNearR2)
                }
                val a = (0.030f + 0.085f * boost.coerceAtMost(1.2f)) * particleAlpha * (if (night) 0.7f else 1f)
                drawLine(
                    color = (if (k == 1) Aureate else accent).copy(alpha = a),
                    start = prev,
                    end = pt,
                    strokeWidth = 1f
                )
                prev = pt
            }
        }
        for (i in 0..2) {
            val near = ((wandData[i * 3 + 2] / 2.4f + 1f) / 2f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
            val c = if (i == 1) Aureate else accent
            val wpos = Offset(wandData[i * 3], wandData[i * 3 + 1])
            val rr = 3f + 5f * near
            drawCircle(c.copy(alpha = (0.10f + 0.16f * near) * particleAlpha), radius = rr * 3.2f, center = wpos)
            drawCircle(c.copy(alpha = (0.45f + 0.40f * near) * particleAlpha), radius = rr * 0.45f, center = wpos)
        }

        // ---- 第 2 层：知识流粒子 ----
        val count = (particles.size * perf[0]).toInt().coerceAtLeast(18)
        if (count * 2 <= positionBuffer.size) {
            for (i in 0 until count) {
                val p = particles[i]
                val x = (p.baseX + p.ampX * sin(2f * PI.toFloat() * flowTime / p.periodA + p.phaseA)) * size.width
                val y = (p.baseY + p.ampY * cos(2f * PI.toFloat() * flowTime / p.periodB + p.phaseB)) * size.height
                positionBuffer[i * 2] = x
                positionBuffer[i * 2 + 1] = y
            }
            val maxDist2 = 150f * 150f
            for (i in 0 until count) {
                val xi = positionBuffer[i * 2]
                val yi = positionBuffer[i * 2 + 1]
                for (j in i + 1 until count) {
                    val dx = xi - positionBuffer[j * 2]
                    val dy = yi - positionBuffer[j * 2 + 1]
                    val d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
                    if (d2 < maxDist2) {
                        val d = sqrt(d2)
                        val a = (150f - d) / 150f * 0.15f * particleAlpha
                        val color = if (particles[i].golden) Aureate else accent
                        drawLine(
                            color.copy(alpha = a),
                            Offset(xi, yi),
                            Offset(positionBuffer[j * 2], positionBuffer[j * 2 + 1]),
                            strokeWidth = 0.8f
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            for (i in 0 until count) {
                val p = particles[i]
                val color = if (p.golden) Aureate else accent
                val pos = Offset(positionBuffer[i * 2], positionBuffer[i * 2 + 1])
                drawCircle(color.copy(alpha = 0.5f * p.halo * particleAlpha), radius = p.radius * 3.2f, center = pos)
                drawCircle(color.copy(alpha = 0.85f * particleAlpha), radius = p.radius, center = pos)
            }
        }

        // ---- 第 3 层：呼吸光晕 ----
        val gx = size.width * (0.5f + 0.25f * sin(2f * PI.toFloat() * clockTime / 10f))
        val gy = size.height * (0.45f + 0.18f * sin(2f * PI.toFloat() * clockTime / 10f + 1.7f))
        val breathe = 0.05f + 0.05f * (0.5f + 0.5f * sin(2f * PI.toFloat() * clockTime / 10f))
        val glowAlpha = when {
            night -> breathe * 0.55f
            sleeping -> breathe * 0.60f
            else -> breathe
        }
        val glowRadius = 400.dp.toPx()
        drawCircle(
            brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                colors = listOf(
                    accent.copy(alpha = glowAlpha),
                    accent.copy(alpha = glowAlpha * 0.35f),
                    Color.Transparent
                ),
                center = Offset(gx, gy),
                radius = glowRadius
            ),
            radius = glowRadius,
            center = Offset(gx, gy)
        )
    }
}

/**
 * 幻域感组件（Android 精简版，与桌面同语义）：
 * pressScale（触屏替代 hover）、idleTilt（持续微倾斜）、floatIn、GlowBox、
 * BreathingOrb、BurstParticles、MistDivider、RotatingLogo。
 */

/** 三次贝塞尔取点（轨道曲线绘制，Android 端几何工具）。 */
internal fun cubicPoint(p0: Offset, p1: Offset, p2: Offset, p3: Offset, t: Float): Offset {
    val u = 1f - t
    val w0 = u * u * u
    val w1 = 3f * u * u * t
    val w2 = 3f * u * t * t
    val w3 = t * t * t
    return Offset(
        p0.x * w0 + p1.x * w1 + p2.x * w2 + p3.x * w3,
        p0.y * w0 + p1.y * w1 + p2.y * w2 + p3.y * w3
    )
}

/** 预点击反馈：按住缩小 0.98，松开恢复。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.pressScale(interaction: MutableInteractionSource): Modifier {
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val scale by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (pressed) 0.98f else 1f,
        animationSpec = Motion.fast,
        label = "pressScale"
    )
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale
        scaleY = scale
    }
}

/**
 * 卡片激活态统一封装（Compose 通用 API，三端可用）：
 * hover（桌面/外接鼠标）+ pressed（Android/iOS 触屏回退）→ 0..1，200ms。
 * 只监听传入的 interactionSource，每张卡片独立维护，互不影响。
 */
@Composable
fun rememberCardActivation(interaction: MutableInteractionSource): Float {
    val hovered by interaction.collectIsHoveredAsState()
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val fraction by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = if (hovered || pressed) 1f else 0f,
        animationSpec = tween(durationMillis = 200, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
        label = "cardActivation"
    )
    return fraction
}

/** 触屏没有 hover：用"持续微倾斜"保持 3D 悬浮感（桌面 tilt3d 的静止态）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.idleTilt(degrees: Float = 1.5f): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer {
        rotationX = -degrees
        cameraDistance = 18f * density
    }

/** 入场：从下方浮起 + 淡入（spring + fadeIn，≈400ms）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.floatIn(delayMillis: Int = 0, distanceDp: Dp = 22.dp): Modifier {
    val progress = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
        if (delayMillis > 0) delay(delayMillis.toLong())
        progress.animateTo(1f, Motion.softSpring)
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        alpha = progress.value
        translationY = (1f - progress.value) * distanceDp.toPx()
    }
}

/** 卡片光晕（萤火虫感）：无边框，用主色 0.2 透明度径向光晕代替。 */
@Composable
fun GlowBox(
    glow: Color,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    intensity: Float = 1f,
    radius: Dp = 180.dp,
    content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit
) {
    val animated by animateFloatAsState(
        targetValue = intensity,
        animationSpec = Motion.standard,
        label = "glowIntensity"
    )
    Box(
        modifier = modifier.drawBehind {
            val r = radius.toPx()
            drawCircle(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        glow.copy(alpha = 0.20f * animated),
                        glow.copy(alpha = 0.07f * animated),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    center = center,
                    radius = r
                ),
                radius = r,
                center = center
            )
        },
        content = content
    )
}

/** 等待状态：呼吸光球（替代转圈）。 */
@Composable
fun BreathingOrb(size: Dp = 48.dp, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, color: Color = Accent) {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "orb")
    val scale by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.72f,
        targetValue = 1.12f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(1400, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "orbScale"
    )
    val alpha by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.35f,
        targetValue = 0.90f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(1400, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "orbAlpha"
    )
    Box(modifier.size(size), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
        Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val r = this.size.minDimension / 2f
            val c = Offset(r, r)
            drawCircle(
                brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                    colors = listOf(
                        color.copy(alpha = alpha * 0.55f),
                        color.copy(alpha = alpha * 0.12f),
                        Color.Transparent
                    ),
                    center = c,
                    radius = r
                ),
                radius = r,
                center = c
            )
            drawCircle(color.copy(alpha = alpha * 0.55f), radius = r * 0.40f * scale, center = c)
            drawCircle(color.copy(alpha = alpha), radius = r * 0.20f * scale, center = c)
        }
    }
}

/** 完成时"炸开"：光球完成后化作 16 个粒子四散（620ms 淡出）。 */
@Composable
fun BurstParticles(trigger: Int, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, color: Color = Accent) {
    val p = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(trigger) {
        if (trigger == 0) return@LaunchedEffect
        p.snapTo(0f)
        p.animateTo(1f, tween(620, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
    }
    val v = p.value
    if (trigger > 0 && v > 0.001f && v < 0.999f) {
        Canvas(modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val cx = size.width / 2f
            val cy = size.height / 2f
            val maxR = size.minDimension * 0.34f
            repeat(16) { i ->
                val ang = i * (2f * PI.toFloat() / 16f) + 0.2f
                val dist = v * maxR * (0.55f + (i % 4) * 0.15f)
                val alpha = (1f - v) * 0.8f
                val pos = Offset(cx + cos(ang) * dist, cy + sin(ang) * dist)
                drawCircle(color.copy(alpha = alpha * 0.4f), radius = 3.2f, center = pos)
                drawCircle(Aureate.copy(alpha = alpha), radius = 1.7f, center = pos)
            }
        }
    }
}

/** 极淡渐变分割线：从透明到 0.1 透明度主色再到透明。 */
@Composable
fun MistDivider(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Box(
        modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(1.dp)
            .background(
                Brush.horizontalGradient(
                    listOf(
                        Color.Transparent,
                        Accent.copy(alpha = 0.10f),
                        Color.Transparent
                    )
                )
            )
    )
}

/** 空状态 / 等待区：中央巨大、缓缓旋转、半透明 Logo。 */
@Composable
fun RotatingLogo(size: Dp = 160.dp, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, alpha: Float = 0.45f) {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "rotatingLogo")
    val rotation by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0f,
        targetValue = 360f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(60000, easing = LinearEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Restart
        ),
        label = "logoRotation"
    )
    val bob by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = -1f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(4200, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "logoBob"
    )
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .size(size)
            .graphicsLayer {
                rotationZ = rotation
                this.alpha = alpha
                translationY = bob * 6f
            }
    ) {
        LearnAgentLogo(size = size.value.toInt())
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import android.content.Context
import android.os.VibrationEffect
import android.os.Vibrator

/**
 * 触感反馈（对齐桌面"窗口微震"语义）：
 *  - 成功 = 轻震 2 次 / 错误 = 3 次，仅关键操作
 *  - Splash 三节点落地各轻震一次
 */
object Haptics {

    @Volatile
    var enabled: Boolean = true

    private fun pulse(context: Context, pattern: LongArray) {
        if (!enabled) return
        val vibrator = context.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as? Vibrator ?: return
        if (!vibrator.hasVibrator()) return
        runCatching {
            vibrator.vibrate(VibrationEffect.createWaveform(pattern, -1))
        }
    }

    /** 按压轻触。 */
    fun tap(context: Context) = pulse(context, longArrayOf(0, 18))

    /** 成功：2 次轻震。 */
    fun success(context: Context) = pulse(context, longArrayOf(0, 30, 70, 30))

    /** 错误：3 次轻震。 */
    fun error(context: Context) = pulse(context, longArrayOf(0, 40, 60, 40, 60, 40))
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloatAsState

/**
 * 图标系统 V3（20 个）：
 *  - 1.5dp 细线、圆角端点、不填充、不对称但平衡
 *  - 渐变光照：左下暗 → 右上亮，悬停 300ms 流动偏移（桌面 hover / Android 固定相位）
 *  - 禁止：闭合整圆、靶心、准星、齿轮、放大镜、纸飞机、实心星
 */
private fun stroke(w: Float) = Stroke(width = w, cap = StrokeCap.Round, join = StrokeJoin.Round)

private fun DrawScope.iconBrush(color: Color, phase: Float = 0f): Brush {
    val s = this.size
    val shift = phase * 0.10f * s.width
    return Brush.linearGradient(
        colors = listOf(color.copy(alpha = 0.45f), color.copy(alpha = 0.95f)),
        start = Offset(s.width * 0.08f - shift, s.height * 0.92f + shift),
        end = Offset(s.width * 0.92f + shift, s.height * 0.08f - shift)
    )
}

/** 图标渲染壳：24dp 基准，渐变笔刷 + 悬停光效。 */
@Composable
private fun IconCanvas(
    sizeDp: Int,
    modifier: Modifier,
    draw: DrawScope.(Color, Float) -> Unit
) {
    val content = androidx.compose.material3.LocalContentColor.current
    Canvas(modifier.size(sizeDp.dp)) {
        draw(content, 0f)
    }
}

private fun DrawScope.arcRect(cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float): Pair<Offset, Size> =
    Offset(cx - r, cy - r) to Size(r * 2f, r * 2f)

// ============================== 20 ICONS ==============================

/** 1. MentaraLogo：三个大小不一的圆非对称 + 缺口曲线连接。 */
@Composable
fun MentaraLogo(sizeDp: Int = 24, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    IconCanvas(sizeDp, modifier) { c, p ->
        val b = iconBrush(c, p)
        val sw = 1.5.dp.toPx()
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val n1 = Offset(w * 0.28f, h * 0.26f)
        val n2 = Offset(w * 0.76f, h * 0.34f)
        val n3 = Offset(w * 0.44f, h * 0.74f)
        fun gapLink(a: Offset, b2: Offset, gapStart: Float) {
            val mid = Offset((a.x + b2.x) / 2, (a.y + b2.y) / 2)
            val dx = b2.x - a.x
            val dy = b2.y - a.y
            val len = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(1f)
            val ctrl = Offset(mid.x - dy / len * len * 0.14f, mid.y + dx / len * len * 0.14f)
            val steps = 24
            for (k in 0 until steps) {
                val t0 = k / steps.toFloat()
                val t1 = (k + 1) / steps.toFloat()
                if (t0 in gapStart..gapStart + 0.16f) continue
                val u0 = 1f - t0
                val u1 = 1f - t1
                val p0 = Offset(u0 * u0 * a.x + 2 * u0 * t0 * ctrl.x + t0 * t0 * b2.x, u0 * u0 * a.y + 2 * u0 * t0 * ctrl.y + t0 * t0 * b2.y)
                val p1 = Offset(u1 * u1 * a.x + 2 * u1 * t1 * ctrl.x + t1 * t1 * b2.x, u1 * u1 * a.y + 2 * u1 * t1 * ctrl.y + t1 * t1 * b2.y)
                drawLine(b, p0, p1, sw, StrokeCap.Round)
            }
        }
        gapLink(n1, n2, 0.30f)
        gapLink(n2, n3, 0.55f)
        gapLink(n1, n3, 0.72f)
        drawCircle(b, radius = size.minDimension * 0.085f, center = n1)
        drawCircle(b, radius = size.minDimension * 0.055f, center = n2)
        drawCircle(b, radius = size.minDimension * 0.115f, center = n3)
    }
}

/** 2. SearchIcon：向内收缩的螺旋（指纹意象）。 */
@Composable
fun SearchIcon(sizeDp: Int = 24, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    IconCanvas(sizeDp, modifier) { c, p ->
        val b = iconBrush(c, p)
        val sw = 1.5.dp.toPx()
        val cx = size.width * 0.5f
        val cy = size.height * 0.5f
        listOf(0.36f, 0.22f, 0.10f).forEachIndexed { i, r ->
            val (tl, sz) = arcRect(cx, cy, size.minDimension * r)
            drawArc(b, 20f + i * 30f, 300f - i * 50f, false, topLeft = tl, size = sz, style = stroke(sw))
        }
        drawCircle(b, radius = sw * 0.6f, center = Offset(cx, cy))
    }
}

/** 3. ImportIcon：从上往下的瀑布曲线 + 底部水面。 */
@Composable
fun ImportIcon(sizeDp: Int = 24, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    IconCanvas(sizeDp, modifier) { c, p ->
        val b = iconBrush(c, p)
        val sw = 1.5.dp.toPx()
        val fall = Path().apply {
            moveTo(size.width * 0.42f, size.height * 0.12f)
            cubicTo(size.width * 0.60f, size.height * 0.30f, size.width * 0.24f, size.height * 0.52f, size.width * 0.46f, size.height * 0.72f)
        }
        drawPath(fall, b, style = stroke(sw))
        val wave = Path().apply {
            moveTo(size.width * 0.14f, size.height * 0.86f)
            cubicTo(size.width * 0.32f, size.height * 0.78f, size.width * 0.44f, size.height * 0.94f, size.width * 0.60f, size.height * 0.86f)
        }
        drawPath(wave, b, style = stroke(sw))
        drawLine(b, Offset(size.width * 0.66f, size.height * 0.88f), Offset(size.width * 0.84f, size.height * 0.84f), sw, StrokeCap.Round)
    }
}

/** 4. GraphIcon：三圆错落 + S 形曲线连接。 */
@Composable
fun GraphIcon(sizeDp: Int = 24, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    IconCanvas(sizeDp, modifier) { c, p ->
        val b = iconBrush(c, p)
        val sw = 1.5.dp.toPx()
        val w = size.width
        val h = size.height
        val n1 = Offset(w * 0.22f, h * 0.28f)
        val n2 = Offset(w * 0.74f, h * 0.42f)
        val n3 = Offset(w * 0.46f, h * 0.76f)
        val s1 = Path().apply {
            moveTo(n1.x, n1.y)
            cubicTo(w * 0.42f, h * 0.18f, w * 0.56f, h * 0.28f, n2.x, n2.y)
        }
        drawPath(s1, b, style = stroke(sw))
        val s2 = Path().apply {
            moveTo(n2.x, n2.y)
            cubicTo(w * 0.62f, h * 0.62f, w * 0.30f, h * 0.58f, n3.x, n3.y)
        }
        drawPath(s2, b, style = stroke(sw))
        drawCircle(b, radius = size.minDimension * 0.075f, center = n1)
        drawCircle(b, radius = size.minDimension * 0.050f, center = n2)
        drawCircle(b, radius = size.minDimension * 0.095f, center = n3)
    }
}

/** 5. TimelineIcon：微微起伏的波浪线 + 3 个大小渐变的点。 */
@Composable
fun TimelineIcon(sizeDp: Int = 24, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    IconCanvas(sizeDp, modifier) { c, p ->
        val b = iconBrush(c, p)

            drawCircle(
                c.copy(alpha = if (lit) 0.9f else 0.25f),

            )
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTapGestures
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke
import androidx.compose.ui.input.pointer.pointerInput
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin

/** 从文本提取关键词（长度 >= 2 的词）。 */
fun extractKeywords(text: String): Set<String> {
    val cleaned = text.lowercase().replace(Regex("[\\s,，。、/！？；：\"'`()（）：]"), " ")
    return cleaned.split(" ").filter { it.length >= 2 }.toSet()
}

private fun nodePositions(canvas: Size, count: Int): List<Offset> {
    if (count <= 0) return emptyList()
    val cx = canvas.width / 2f
    val cy = canvas.height / 2f
    val rx = canvas.width * 0.34f
    val ry = canvas.height * 0.34f
    return (0 until count).map { i ->
        val ang = (2.0 * Math.PI * i / count) - Math.PI / 2
        Offset((cx + rx * cos(ang)).toFloat(), (cy + ry * sin(ang)).toFloat())
    }
}

/**
 * 知识图谱：每个 TimelineItem 一个节点；共享关键词的节点连线；
 * 节点大小按度数决定；点击节点回调其索引。
 */
@Composable
fun KnowledgeGraph(
    items: List<TimelineItem>,
    selectedIndex: Int?,
    onNodeClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val primary = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    val secondary = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary
    val outline = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface

    val keywords = remember(items) {
        items.map { extractKeywords(it.speech + " " + it.screenText) }
    }
    val edges = remember(items) {
        buildList {
            for (i in items.indices) {
                for (j in i + 1 until items.size) {
                    if (keywords[i].intersect(keywords[j]).isNotEmpty()) add(i to j)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    val degree = remember(items) {
        IntArray(items.size).also { d -> edges.forEach { (a, b) -> d[a]++; d[b]++ } }
    }

    Canvas(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .pointerInput(items) {
                detectTapGestures { off ->
                    val pos = nodePositions(Size(size.width.toFloat(), size.height.toFloat()), items.size)
                    val idx = pos.indices.minByOrNull { (pos[it] - off).getDistance() }
                    if (idx != null && (pos[idx] - off).getDistance() < 48f) onNodeClick(idx)
                }
            }
    ) {
        val pos = nodePositions(size, items.size)
        edges.forEach { (a, b) ->
            drawLine(primary.copy(alpha = 0.25f), pos[a], pos[b], strokeWidth = 2.5f)
        }
        pos.forEachIndexed { i, p ->
            val r = 12f + degree[i] * 5f
            val color = if (i == selectedIndex) secondary else primary
            if (i == selectedIndex) drawCircle(secondary.copy(alpha = 0.25f), r + 10f, p)
            drawCircle(color, r, p)
            drawCircle(outline.copy(alpha = 0.15f), r, p, style = Stroke(width = 1.5f))
        }
    }
}
androidApp/src/main/kotlin/com/learnagent/ui/Language.kt (0.7KB)
package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue

/**
 * 桌面语言状态：默认 English；设置页切换即时生效（全部文案经 [t] 读取）。
 */
object Language {
    var current by mutableStateOf("en")
}

/** 取文案：读 Language 状态（变更触发重组）+ 填充 {1} {2} 占位。 */
fun t(key: String, arg1: String? = null, arg2: String? = null): String {
    val lang = Language.current
    var s = Strings.get(key, lang)
    if (arg1 != null) s = s.replace("{1}", arg1)
    if (arg2 != null) s = s.replace("{2}", arg2)
    return s
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import kotlin.math.hypot

/**
 * 内部 Logo（V3 缺口曲线版）：三个不同大小的圆、非对称排列，
 * 连接曲线在每段中点留一个缺口——"知识永不闭合"。
 * 桌面与 Android 共用同一绘制。
 */
@Composable
fun LearnAgentLogo(size: Int = 48) {
    val primary = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    val secondary = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size(size.dp)) {
        val w = this.size.width
        val h = this.size.height
        val n1 = Offset(w * 0.30f, h * 0.28f)
        val n2 = Offset(w * 0.74f, h * 0.38f)
        val n3 = Offset(w * 0.46f, h * 0.76f)
        val sw = w * 0.028f

        fun gapLink(a: Offset, b: Offset, gapStart: Float, alpha: Float) {
            val mid = Offset((a.x + b.x) / 2, (a.y + b.y) / 2)
            val dx = b.x - a.x
            val dy = b.y - a.y
            val len = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(1f)
            val ctrl = Offset(mid.x - dy / len * len * 0.14f, mid.y + dx / len * len * 0.14f)
            val steps = 26
            for (k in 0 until steps) {
                val t0 = k / steps.toFloat()
                val t1 = (k + 1) / steps.toFloat()
                if (t0 in gapStart..gapStart + 0.16f) continue
                val u0 = 1f - t0
                val u1 = 1f - t1
                val p0 = Offset(u0 * u0 * a.x + 2 * u0 * t0 * ctrl.x + t0 * t0 * b.x, u0 * u0 * a.y + 2 * u0 * t0 * ctrl.y + t0 * t0 * b.y)
                val p1 = Offset(u1 * u1 * a.x + 2 * u1 * t1 * ctrl.x + t1 * t1 * b.x, u1 * u1 * a.y + 2 * u1 * t1 * ctrl.y + t1 * t1 * b.y)
                drawLine(primary.copy(alpha = alpha), p0, p1, sw)
            }
        }
        gapLink(n1, n2, 0.32f, 0.55f)
        gapLink(n2, n3, 0.58f, 0.45f)
        gapLink(n1, n3, 0.74f, 0.40f)

        drawCircle(primary, radius = w * 0.105f, center = n1)
        drawCircle(primary, radius = w * 0.070f, center = n2)
        drawCircle(secondary, radius = w * 0.135f, center = n3)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File

/**
 * 模型下载宿主（独立于 TaskHost）：
 *  - 下载 Whisper 模型不再占用全局单任务槽 → 不会被"解析/画面描述"等长任务卡死；
 *  - 应用级作用域 → 切换页面不中断；
 *  - 自带进度/阶段/结果状态，设置页实时显示。
 */
object ModelHost {
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main)
    private var job: Job? = null

    var busy: Boolean by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    var stage: String by mutableStateOf("")
        private set
    var progress: Float by mutableStateOf(-1f)
        private set
    var message: String? by mutableStateOf(null)
        private set

    fun cancel() {
        job?.cancel()
        job = null
        busy = false
        stage = "已取消（已下载部分不会浪费，重新下载会校验后替换）"
    }

    /** 下载 SenseVoice 模型（228MB，hf-mirror）。 */
    fun downloadSenseVoice(filesDir: File) {
        if (busy) return
        busy = true
        message = null
        progress = -1f
        stage = "连接镜像…"
        job = scope.launch {
            try {
                val ok = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    com.learnagent.asr.SenseVoiceEngine.download(filesDir) { name, d, t ->
                        if (t > 0) {
                            progress = (d.toFloat() / t).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                            stage = "$name " + (d * 100 / t) + "%"
                        } else {
                            stage = "$name ${d / 1048576}MB"
                        }
                    }
                }
                message = if (ok) "SenseVoice 模型下载完成（中文最准，离线可用）" else "下载失败：检查网络后重试"
            } catch (e: CancellationException) {
                throw e
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                message = "下载失败：${e.message ?: e.javaClass.simpleName}"
            } finally {
                busy = false
                job = null
            }
        }
    }

}

    )

androidApp/src/main/kotlin/com/learnagent/ui/Net.kt (1.6KB)
package com.learnagent.ui

import android.content.Context
import android.net.ConnectivityManager
import android.net.NetworkCapabilities

/** 是否有可用网络（用于在线问答/辩论快速失败，避免无网时长时间等待）。 */
fun isOnline(context: Context): Boolean {
    return runCatching {
        val cm = context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE) as ConnectivityManager
        val network = cm.activeNetwork ?: return false
        val caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(network) ?: return false
        caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET)
    }.getOrDefault(false)
}

private var nimCache: Pair<Long, Boolean>? = null

/**
 * NVIDIA NIM 连通性预检（带 30 秒缓存）。
 * 用于区分"设备有网但连不上 NIM"（被墙/代理/防火墙）——能下载模型 ≠ 能连 NIM。
 */
suspend fun nimReachable(apiKey: String, force: Boolean = false): Boolean {
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    nimCache?.let { if (!force && now - it.first < 30_000) return it.second }
    val ok = kotlinx.coroutines.withContext(kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers.IO) {
        runCatching {
            val conn = java.net.URL("https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models").openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection
            conn.connectTimeout = 8000
            conn.readTimeout = 8000
            conn.requestMethod = "GET"
            conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            val code = conn.responseCode
            conn.disconnect()
            code in 200..299
        }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
    nimCache = now to ok
    return ok
}

/** mm:ss。 */
internal fun formatTime(seconds: Double): String {
    val t = seconds.toInt()
    fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
    return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
}

/** 时间戳 chip。 */
@Composable

    Surface(color = Phantom.copy(alpha = 0.16f), shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)) {
        Text(
            text,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
            color = Phantom
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun ChatPanel(
    videoId: String?,
    timeline: List<TimelineItem>,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    apiKey: String = "",
    model: String = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val prefs = remember { context.getSharedPreferences("mentara", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE) }
    var answerMode by remember { mutableStateOf(prefs.getString("answerMode", "expert") ?: "expert") }
    val tavilyKey = prefs.getString("tavilyApiKey", "") ?: ""
    val bochaKey = prefs.getString("bochaApiKey", "") ?: ""
    val anysKey = prefs.getString("anysearchApiKey", "") ?: ""
    val skillText = remember(videoId) {
        runCatching {
            val rootDir = java.io.File(context.filesDir, com.learnagent.data.ResultsDir.RESULTS_ROOT)
            val sb = StringBuilder()
            videoId?.let { vid ->
                val dir = java.io.File(rootDir, vid)
                java.io.File(dir, "skill.md").takeIf { it.isFile }?.let { sb.append("【当前视频：").append(vid).append("】\n").append(it.readText()).append("\n\n") }
                java.io.File(dir, "notes.md").takeIf { it.isFile }?.let { sb.append("【当前视频·学习笔记】\n").append(it.readText().take(4000)).append("\n\n") }
            }
            rootDir.listFiles().orEmpty().filter { it.isDirectory }.forEach { dir ->
                if (dir.name == videoId) return@forEach
                java.io.File(dir, "skill.md").takeIf { it.isFile }?.let {
                    sb.append("【已学视频：").append(dir.name).append("（摘要）】\n").append(it.readText().take(3000)).append("\n\n")
                }
            }
            sb.toString().trim().take(16000)
        }.getOrDefault("")
    }
    val engine = remember(timeline, apiKey, model, tavilyKey, bochaKey, anysKey) {
        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(timeline)
        val search: suspend (String, Int) -> List<TimelineItem> = { q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) }
        if (apiKey.isBlank()) LocalQaEngine(allItems = { timeline }, search = search)
        else RemoteQaEngine(
            search, AndroidNimClient(apiKey, model),
            fallbackAll = { timeline },
            mode = { if (answerMode == "expert") com.learnagent.core.AnswerMode.EXPERT else com.learnagent.core.AnswerMode.STRICT },
            webSearch = when {
                anysKey.isNotBlank() -> com.learnagent.llm.AndroidAnySearcher(anysKey)
                bochaKey.isNotBlank() -> com.learnagent.llm.AndroidBochaSearcher(bochaKey)
                tavilyKey.isNotBlank() -> com.learnagent.llm.AndroidTavilySearcher(tavilyKey)
                else -> com.learnagent.llm.AndroidAnySearcher("") // 匿名免费（低限流），失败自动回落必应
            },
            extraContext = { skillText }
        )
    }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var question by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var busy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var streamText by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var reasoningText by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var showReasoning by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val chatFile = remember(videoId) {
        videoId?.let { vid ->
            java.io.File(java.io.File(java.io.File(context.filesDir, com.learnagent.data.ResultsDir.RESULTS_ROOT), vid), "chat.json")
        }
    }
    val messages = remember(videoId) { mutableStateListOf<Pair<String, QaAnswer>>() }
    LaunchedEffect(videoId) {
        messages.clear()
        runCatching {
            chatFile?.takeIf { it.isFile }?.let { f ->
                chatJson.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(ChatEntry.serializer()), f.readText()).forEach {
                    messages.add(it.q to QaAnswer(it.answer, it.citations))
                }
            }
        }
    }
    fun persistChat() {
        runCatching {
            chatFile?.let { f ->
                f.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                f.writeText(chatJson.encodeToString(ListSerializer(ChatEntry.serializer()), messages.map { (q, a) -> ChatEntry(q, a.answer, a.citations) }))
            }
        }
    }

    // ---- Developer Mode：回答 chips + 记录决策 ----
    val devStore = remember { TechStore() }
    val knownTechCards = remember(devStore) { devStore.getAllTechCards() }
    var selectedTech by remember { mutableStateOf<TechCard?>(null) }
    var decisionOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var decisionPrefill by remember { mutableStateOf("") }

    var lastBusy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var burstTick by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    LaunchedEffect(busy) {
        if (!busy && lastBusy) burstTick++
        lastBusy = busy
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(12.dp)) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            Text(t("qa_title"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
            listOf("严谨" to "strict", "专家" to "expert").forEach { (label, v) ->
                Surface(
                    color = if (answerMode == v) Accent.copy(alpha = 0.18f) else Mist.copy(alpha = 0.3f),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.clickable { AudioFx.tap(); answerMode = v; prefs.edit().putString("answerMode", v).apply() }
                ) {
                    Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = if (answerMode == v) Accent else TextMid, modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp))
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))

            if (messages.isNotEmpty()) {
                Surface(
                    color = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.3f), shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.clickable { AudioFx.tap(); messages.clear(); runCatching { chatFile?.delete() } }
                ) { Text("清空", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = TextMid, modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 4.dp)) }
                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
            }
            Text(
                if (videoId == null) t("qa_unselected") else if (apiKey.isBlank()) t("qa_offline") else model,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = MoonSilver
            )
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        Box(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
            if (messages.isEmpty() && busy && streamText.isEmpty() && reasoningText.isEmpty()) {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {

                }
            } else if (messages.isEmpty()) {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                        Text(t("qa_ask_hint"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, color = TextMid)
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))

                            if (timeline.isEmpty()) t("qa_empty_retrieval") else t("qa_ready"),

                            color = TextLow
                        )
                    }
                }
            } else {
                LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                    items(messages) { (q, a) ->
                        Column {
                            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End) {
                                Surface(
                                    color = Phantom,
                                    shape = CardShapes.userBubble(),
                                    modifier = Modifier.graphicsLayer { rotationZ = 0.8f }
                                ) {
                                    Text(
                                        q,
                                        Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),

                                        color = Color(0xFF0B0710)

                                }

                                color = Veil.copy(alpha = 0.72f),

            }
        }

                    unfocusedIndicatorColor = Mist,

                        AudioFx.tap(); Haptics.tap(context)

                                QaAnswer("当前无网络连接：在线问答需要联网，请连网后重试。", emptyList())
                            else if (apiKey.isNotBlank() && !com.learnagent.ui.nimReachable(apiKey))
                                QaAnswer("连不上 NVIDIA NIM（模型服务）：设备有网但到 NIM 不通（代理/防火墙/运营商拦截）。请换网络后重试。", emptyList())
                            else runCatching {
                                if (engine is RemoteQaEngine)
                                    engine.askStream(q, videoId, onToken = { streamText += it }, onReasoning = { reasoningText += it })
                                else engine.ask(q)
                            }.getOrElse { QaAnswer("错误：${it.message ?: it.javaClass.simpleName}", emptyList()) }
                            messages.add(q to ans)
                            persistChat()
                            com.learnagent.voice.MentaraVoice.speak(ans.answer)
                            streamText = ""; reasoningText = ""
                            busy = false
                        }
                    }
            ) {
                Text(
                    if (busy) "..." else t("btn_send"),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge,
                    color = if (question.isNotBlank() && !busy) TextHigh else TextMid,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp)
                )
            }
            if (messages.isNotEmpty()) {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                Surface(
                    color = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                        AudioFx.tap()
                        decisionPrefill = messages.last().first
                        decisionOpen = true
                    }
                ) {
                    Text(
                        "[ 记录决策 ]",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
                        color = TextHigh,
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
    selectedTech?.let { TechCardCompactDialogAndroid(it, devStore) { selectedTech = null } }
    if (decisionOpen) {
        RecordDecisionDialogAndroid(devStore, decisionPrefill) { decisionOpen = false }
    }
}

//  四轮辩论面板（自定义议题 + 流式轮次 + 一致性渐变条 + 折叠批判 + 取消）

@Composable
fun DebatePanel(
    videoId: String?,
    timeline: List<TimelineItem>,
    apiKey: String,
    debateModelA: String,
    debateModelB: String,
    debateModelC: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val online = apiKey.isNotBlank()
    val onThisVideo = DebateHost.videoId == videoId
    val result = if (onThisVideo) DebateHost.result else null
    val busy = onThisVideo && DebateHost.busy
    val phase = if (busy) DebateHost.phase else 0
    var topic by remember(videoId) { mutableStateOf(t("debate_topic_default", videoId ?: "")) }
    var tick by remember { mutableStateOf(0L) }
    LaunchedEffect(busy) {
        while (busy) { tick = System.currentTimeMillis(); kotlinx.coroutines.delay(1000) }
    }
    val elapsedSec = if (busy && DebateHost.startedAt > 0L) ((tick - DebateHost.startedAt).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 1000L else 0L

    fun cancel() { DebateHost.cancel() }

    fun start(t: String) {
        if (busy || timeline.isEmpty()) return
        AudioFx.tap(); Haptics.tap(context)
        DebateHost.start(videoId, t, timeline, apiKey, debateModelA, debateModelB, debateModelC, isOnline(context))
    }

    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(12.dp)) {
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            DebateIcon(24)
            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
            Text(t("debate_title"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, color = TextHigh, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
            Text(
                if (online) "NIM" else t("debate_offline"),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = MoonSilver
            )
            if (busy) {
                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Text(
                    when (phase) { 1 -> t("debate_short_1"); 2 -> t("debate_short_2"); else -> t("debate_short_3") } +
                        " · " + "已用 %d:%02d".format(elapsedSec / 60, elapsedSec % 60),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                    color = Phantom
                )
            }
        }
        if (busy) {
            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(2.dp).background(Mist.copy(alpha = 0.5f), RoundedCornerShape(1.dp))) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth((phase.coerceIn(0, 3) / 3f).coerceIn(0.05f, 1f))
                        .height(2.dp)
                        .background(Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(Phantom, Aureate)), RoundedCornerShape(1.dp))
                )
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
        if (busy || result != null) {
            Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                listOf(1 to "① 提案", 2 to "② 交叉批判", 3 to "③ 中立裁决").forEach { (ph, label) ->
                    val done = !busy && result != null || phase > ph
                    val cur = busy && phase == ph
                    Text(
                        (if (done) "✓ " else if (cur) "● " else "○ ") + label,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = if (done) SuccessGreen else if (cur) Aureate else MoonSilver
                    )
                }
            }
        }
        // 议题行
        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            TextField(
                value = topic,
                onValueChange = { topic = it },
                singleLine = true,
                placeholder = { Text(t("debate_topic_ph"), color = MoonSilver.copy(alpha = 0.6f)) },
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
                    focusedContainerColor = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                    unfocusedContainerColor = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.22f),
                    focusedIndicatorColor = Phantom,
                    unfocusedIndicatorColor = Mist,
                    cursorColor = Phantom
                ),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
            Surface(
                color = if (busy) Coral.copy(alpha = 0.16f) else Phantom.copy(alpha = 0.14f),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                    if (busy) cancel() else if (timeline.isNotEmpty()) start(topic) else { AudioFx.error() }
                }
            ) {
                Text(
                    if (busy) t("debate_cancel") else t("debate_rerun"),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge,
                    color = if (busy) Coral else Phantom,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
                )
            }
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))

        val r = result
        if (r == null && !busy) {
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                    RotatingLogo(size = 130.dp, alpha = 0.35f)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
                    Text(
                        if (onThisVideo && DebateHost.error != null) DebateHost.error!! else t("debate_waiting_title"),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = if (onThisVideo && DebateHost.error != null) Coral else MoonSilver
                    )
                }
            }
        } else if (r != null) {
            LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)) {
                item {
                    Text(t("debate_phase_1"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall, color = TextHigh)
                }
                val proposals = listOf(r.proposerA, r.proposerB, r.proposerC)
                val names = if (online) listOf("Kimi K3", "DeepSeek V4.1", "GLM 5.3") else listOf("Kimi K3（本地）", "DeepSeek V4.1（本地）", "GLM 5.3（本地）")
                val avatars = listOf(Phantom, Aureate, Coral)
                items(proposals.indices.toList()) { i ->
                    Row(
                        Modifier
                            .floatIn(delayMillis = i * 60, distanceDp = 12.dp)
                            .background(Veil.copy(alpha = 0.6f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                            .padding(12.dp)
                    ) {
                        Canvas(Modifier.size(14.dp)) {
                            drawCircle(avatars[i].copy(alpha = 0.35f), radius = size.minDimension / 2f)
                            drawCircle(avatars[i], radius = size.minDimension / 3.4f, center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f))
                        }
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Column {
                            Text(names[i], style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = MoonSilver)
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                            Text(proposals[i], style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (r.agreement >= 0.0) {
                    item {
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Text(t("debate_agreement"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge, color = TextHigh)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            Box(Modifier.weight(1f).height(6.dp).background(Mist.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(3.dp))) {
                                val frac = r.agreement.toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f)
                                val color = when {
                                    r.agreement > 0.66 -> SuccessGreen
                                    r.agreement >= 0.40 -> Aureate
                                    else -> Coral
                                }
                                Box(
                                    Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth(frac)
                                        .height(6.dp)
                                        .background(color, RoundedCornerShape(3.dp))
                                )
                            }
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            Text(
                                "${(r.agreement * 100).toInt()}%",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                                color = when {
                                    r.agreement > 0.66 -> SuccessGreen
                                    r.agreement >= 0.40 -> Aureate
                                    else -> Coral
                                }
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (r.critiques.isNotEmpty()) {
                    item {

                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,

                            Text(t("debate_phase_2"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall, color = TextHigh)

                }

    }

@Composable
fun TimelineCardAndroid(item: TimelineItem, keyTag: String? = null, sideTag: String? = null) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    var expanded by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var noted by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val text = (item.speech + " " + item.screenText).trim()
    val importance = remember(item) { (3 + (text.length / 20)).coerceIn(3, 5) }
    val importanceColor = when (importance) {
        5 -> Coral
        4 -> Aureate
        else -> Phantom
    }
    GlowBox(
        glow = importanceColor,
        intensity = if (expanded) 0.9f else 0.32f,
        radius = 150.dp,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
    ) {
        Surface(
            color = Veil.copy(alpha = 0.62f),
            shape = CardShapes.learningUnitCard(),
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.padding(20.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    TimeChip("${formatTime(item.start)} - ${formatTime(item.end)}")
                    StarRating(importance = importance, sizeDp = 18)
                    Text(
                        if (item.speech.isNotBlank()) t("chip_speech") else t("chip_screen"),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = TextMid
                    )
                }
                if (keyTag != null) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Surface(color = Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.18f), shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)) {
                        Text(
                            "★ 必学 · $keyTag",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = Aureate,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
                if (sideTag != null) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    Surface(color = MoonSilver.copy(alpha = 0.16f), shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)) {
                        Text(
                            "⤼ $sideTag",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                            color = MoonSilver,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Text(
                    item.speech.ifBlank { item.screenText }.ifBlank { t("card_no_content") },
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    color = TextHigh
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Surface(
                        color = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                            AudioFx.tap()
                            expanded = !expanded
                        }
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            if (expanded) "收起原文" else "展开原文",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
                            color = TextHigh,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                        )
                    }
                    Surface(
                        color = if (noted) Phantom.copy(alpha = 0.2f) else Mist.copy(alpha = 0.4f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                            noted = !noted
                            if (noted) { AudioFx.success(); Haptics.success(context) }
                        }
                    ) {
                        Text(if (noted) t("btn_noted") else t("btn_note"),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
                            color = if (noted) Phantom else TextHigh,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
                if (expanded) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                    MistDivider()
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                    if (item.speech.isNotBlank()) {
                        Text(t("card_speech", item.speech), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextMid, maxLines = 6, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    }
                    if (item.screenText.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(4.dp))
                        Text(t("card_screen", item.screenText), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextMid, maxLines = 6, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
