package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment

/**
 * 桌面端可测试的检索逻辑。
 *
 * 先用 Merger 把"语音 + 画面"融合成时间线，再用 shared 的 Indexer 做关键词检索。
 * UI 只负责渲染，所有逻辑放在这里以便单元测试。
 */
object VideoIndex {

    /**
     * 构造一个代表"视频内容"的时间线（30-40 秒的课程片段）。
     * 这是本地示例数据，用于在未接入真实转写/OCR 前驱动 UI。
     */
    fun sampleTimeline(): List<TimelineItem> {
        val transcript = listOf(
            TranscriptSegment(start = 0.0, end = 10.0, text = "这节课我们讲梯度下降", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 10.0, end = 20.0, text = "它是优化算法里的基础方法", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 20.0, end = 30.0, text = "接下来讲反向传播", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 30.0, end = 40.0, text = "最后讲卷积神经网络处理图像", speaker = null)
        )
        val frames = listOf(
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 2.0, text = "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", imagePath = "frame_001.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 12.0, text = "学习率控制步长", imagePath = "frame_002.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 22.0, text = "反向传播计算梯度", imagePath = "frame_003.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 32.0, text = "CNN 用于图像识别", imagePath = "frame_004.jpg")
        )
        return merge(transcript, frames)
    }

    /** 在给定时间线上按关键词检索，返回按相关性排序的条目。 */
    fun search(items: List<TimelineItem>, query: String, topK: Int = 5): List<TimelineItem> {
        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(items)
        return indexer.search(query, topK)
    }

    /** 把秒数格式化成 mm:ss。 */
    fun formatTime(seconds: Double): String {
        val total = seconds.toInt()
        val m = total / 60
        val s = total % 60
        return "%02d:%02d".format(m, s)
    }

    /** 把一条时间线渲染成可读文本，包含时间戳与内容。 */
    fun format(item: TimelineItem): String {
        val range = "[${formatTime(item.start)} - ${formatTime(item.end)}]"
        val speech = item.speech.ifBlank { "（无语音）" }
        val screen = item.screenText.ifBlank { "（无画面文字）" }
        return "$range 语音: $speech | 画面: $screen"
    }
}
desktopApp/src/main/kotlin/com/learnagent/VoskTest.kt (1.5KB)
package com.learnagent

import org.vosk.LibVosk
import org.vosk.LogLevel
import org.vosk.Model
import org.vosk.Recognizer
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream

fun main() {
    LibVosk.setLogLevel(LogLevel.WARNINGS)

    val modelPath = "C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Documents\\Default Project\\learnagent\\vosk-model\\vosk-model-small-cn-0.22"
    val audioPath = "C:\\Users\\Administrator\\Documents\\Default Project\\learnagent\\test_audio.wav"

    if (!File(modelPath).exists()) {
        println("模型不存在: $modelPath")
        return
    }
    if (!File(audioPath).exists()) {
        println("音频不存在: $audioPath")
        return
    }

    println("加载模型...")
    val model = Model(modelPath)
    val recognizer = Recognizer(model, 16000.0f)

    println("开始识别...")
    val fis = FileInputStream(audioPath)
    val buffer = ByteArray(4096)
    var bytesRead: Int
    var allText = ""

    while (fis.read(buffer).also { bytesRead = it } >= 0) {
        if (recognizer.acceptWaveForm(buffer, bytesRead)) {
            val result = recognizer.result
            println("中间结果: $result")
            allText += result
        } else {
            val partial = recognizer.partialResult
            if (partial.length > 20) println("partial: $partial")
        }
    }

    val finalResult = recognizer.finalResult
    println("最终结果: $finalResult")
    allText += finalResult

    println("=== 完整识别文本 ===")
    println(allText)

    fis.close()
    recognizer.close()
    model.close()
}
desktopApp/src/main/kotlin/com/learnagent/app/ReviewTracker.kt (2KB)
package com.learnagent.app

import com.learnagent.config.ConfigStore
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.MapSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.serializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * 复习历史：记录每个视频最后一次查看时间，用于"主动提醒"。
 * 存储于 ~/.learnagent/review_history.json。
 */
object ReviewTracker {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; prettyPrint = true; isLenient = true }
    private val file: File get() = File(ConfigStore.baseDir, "review_history.json")

    private fun load(): MutableMap<String, Long> = try {
        if (file.isFile) {
            val parsed = json.decodeFromString<Map<String, Long>>(file.readText())
            LinkedHashMap(parsed)
        } else {
            LinkedHashMap()
        }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        LinkedHashMap()
    }

    private fun save(map: Map<String, Long>) {
        ConfigStore.baseDir.mkdirs()
        file.writeText(json.encodeToString(MapSerializer(String.serializer(), Long.serializer()), map))
    }

    fun markViewed(videoId: String) {
        val m = load()
        m[videoId] = System.currentTimeMillis()
        save(m)
    }

    /** 距离上次查看的天数；无记录返回 null。 */
    fun daysSince(videoId: String): Long? {
        val last = load()[videoId] ?: return null
        return (System.currentTimeMillis() - last) / 86_400_000L
    }

    /** 超过 [days] 天未查看的视频（从未查看的不算）。 */
    fun staleVideos(days: Long = 7): List<Pair<String, Long>> =
        load().mapNotNull { (id, last) ->
            val d = (System.currentTimeMillis() - last) / 86_400_000L
            if (d >= days) id to d else null
        }.sortedByDescending { it.second }

    /** 供"学习报告"使用的最近查看记录。 */
    fun recentViews(sinceMillis: Long): List<Pair<String, Long>> =
        load().filterValues { it >= sinceMillis }.map { it.key to it.value }.sortedByDescending { it.second }
}

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * 学习工具：闪卡、学习报告、概念对比、知识导出。
 */
object StudyTools {

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private fun stamp(seconds: Double): String {
        val t = seconds.toInt()
        fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
        return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
    }

    private fun conceptOf(text: String): String {
        val token = text.split(Regex("[\\s,，。、！？；：\"'`()（）]+"))
            .filter { it.length >= 2 }
            .maxByOrNull { it.length }
        return token ?: text.take(8)
    }

    // ---------- 功能 4：闪卡 ----------

    fun generateFlashcards(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): List<Pair<String, String>> =
        timeline.filter { it.speech.isNotBlank() }.map { item ->
            "视频里讲的「${conceptOf(item.speech)}」是什么？" to item.speech
        }

    fun flashcardsCsv(cards: List<Pair<String, String>>): String {
        fun esc(s: String) = "\"" + s.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\""
        return buildString {
            append("question,answer\n")
            cards.forEach { (q, a) -> append(esc(q)).append(',').append(esc(a)).append('\n') }
        }
    }

    fun exportFlashcards(config: AppConfig, videoId: String, timeline: List<TimelineItem>): File {
        val dir = File(ConfigStore.resultsDir(config), videoId).apply { mkdirs() }
        val out = File(dir, "flashcards.csv")
        out.writeText(flashcardsCsv(generateFlashcards(timeline)))
        return out
    }

    // ---------- 功能 5：学习报告 ----------

    fun buildWeeklyReportMarkdown(config: AppConfig, allTimelines: Map<String, List<TimelineItem>>): String {
        val since = System.currentTimeMillis() - 7L * 86_400_000L
        val views = ReviewTracker.recentViews(since)
        val viewedIds = if (views.isEmpty()) allTimelines.keys.toList() else views.map { it.first }

        var segments = 0
        var seconds = 0.0
        val keywordCount = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
        for (id in viewedIds) {
            val items = allTimelines[id] ?: continue
            segments += items.size
            seconds += items.sumOf { (it.end - it.start).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
            items.forEach { item ->
                com.learnagent.ui.extractKeywords(item.speech + " " + item.screenText)
                    .forEach { keywordCount[it] = (keywordCount[it] ?: 0) + 1 }
            }
        }
        val minutes = (seconds / 60.0)
        val top = keywordCount.entries.sortedByDescending { it.value }.take(8).map { it.key }

        val statsBlock = buildString {
            append("## 本周学习统计\n\n")
            append("- 学习视频：").append(viewedIds.size).append(" 个\n")
            append("- 时间线片段：").append(segments).append(" 段\n")
            append("- 覆盖时长：约 ").append(String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", minutes)).append(" 分钟\n")
            append("- 高频概念：").append(if (top.isEmpty()) "（暂无）" else top.joinToString("、")).append("\n")
        }

        val aiSummary = if (config.nvidiaApiKey.isNotBlank()) {
            try {
                runBlocking {
                    NvidiaLlmClient(config.nvidiaApiKey, model = config.model).generateResponse(
                        "根据以下学习数据，用中文写一段 3-4 句的周报总结，指出主要领域并给出复习建议：\n$statsBlock",
                        com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", "")
                    )
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                "（AI 总结失败：${e.message}）"
            }
        } else {
            "（未配置 NVIDIA API Key，以下为本地统计）本周你处理了 ${viewedIds.size} 个视频、约 ${
                String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", minutes)
            } 分钟内容，主要涉及：${if (top.isEmpty()) "暂无" else top.take(5).joinToString("、")}。建议优先复习以上高频概念。"
        }

        return "# LearnAgent 学习周报\n\n> 生成时间：${
            SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.US).format(Date())
        }\n\n## 总结\n\n$aiSummary\n\n$statsBlock"
    }

    fun exportReport(config: AppConfig, markdown: String): File {
        val dir = File(ConfigStore.resultsDir(config), "_reports").apply { mkdirs() }
        val name = "weekly-" + SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmm", Locale.US).format(Date()) + ".md"
        val out = File(dir, name)
        out.writeText(markdown)
        return out
    }

    // ---------- 功能 7：概念对比 ----------

    fun compareMarkdown(config: AppConfig, x: String, y: String, timeline: List<TimelineItem>): String {
        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(timeline)
        val xs = indexer.search(x, 4)
        val ys = indexer.search(y, 4)

        fun block(items: List<TimelineItem>): String =
            if (items.isEmpty()) "- （未找到相关内容）"
            else items.joinToString("\n") { "- [${stamp(it.start)}] ${it.speech.ifBlank { it.screenText }}" }

        if (config.nvidiaApiKey.isNotBlank()) {
            val prompt = buildString {
                append("请用 Markdown 表格对比「$x」与「$y」，只依据给定内容。\n\n")
                append("### $x 相关内容\n").append(block(xs)).append("\n\n")
                append("### $y 相关内容\n").append(block(ys)).append("\n\n")
                append("输出两列表格：维度 | $x | $y")
            }
            return try {
                runBlocking {
                    NvidiaLlmClient(config.nvidiaApiKey, model = config.model)
                        .generateResponse(prompt, com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                "（AI 对比失败：${e.message}）\n\n" + localCompare(x, y, block(xs), block(ys))
            }
        }
        return localCompare(x, y, block(xs), block(ys))
    }

    private fun localCompare(x: String, y: String, xs: String, ys: String): String =
        buildString {
            append("### $x\n").append(xs).append("\n\n")
            append("### $y\n").append(ys).append("\n\n")
            append("| 维度 | $x | $y |\n|---|---|---|\n")
            append("| 命中片段 | ${xs.lines().size} | ${ys.lines().size} |\n")
            append("| 说明 | 见上方时间戳 | 见上方时间戳 |\n")
        }

    // ---------- 功能 12：知识导出 ----------

    fun exportMarkdown(file: File, videoId: String, timeline: List<TimelineItem>) {
        val md = buildString {
            append("# $videoId\n\n")
            timeline.forEach { item ->
                append("## [${stamp(item.start)} - ${stamp(item.end)}]\n\n")
                if (item.speech.isNotBlank()) append("- 语音：").append(item.speech).append('\n')
                if (item.screenText.isNotBlank()) append("- 画面：").append(item.screenText).append('\n')
                if (item.framePath.isNotBlank()) append("- 关键帧：").append(item.framePath).append('\n')
                append('\n')
            }
        }
        file.writeText(md)
    }

    fun exportJson(file: File, timeline: List<TimelineItem>) {
        file.writeText(json.encodeToString(timeline))
    }

    fun exportCsv(file: File, timeline: List<TimelineItem>) {
        file.writeText(flashcardsCsv(generateFlashcards(timeline)))
    }
}

package com.learnagent.app

import com.learnagent.asr.WindowsTranscriber
import com.learnagent.config.AppConfig
import com.learnagent.config.ConfigStore
import com.learnagent.core.ContextAnalyzer
import com.learnagent.core.PolishedTranscript
import com.learnagent.core.TranscriptPolisher
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import com.learnagent.core.DebateModels
import com.learnagent.core.DeepDigestEngine
import com.learnagent.core.DeepDigestReport
import com.learnagent.core.DigestProgress
import com.learnagent.llm.NvidiaLlmClient
import com.learnagent.media.VideoFrameExtractor
import com.learnagent.media.VideoToWav
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * 对已导入视频执行真实处理，并把结果写入 results/<videoId>/。
 * 结果文件与 Android/桌面共享同一数据格式（transcript.json / frames.json）。
 */
object VideoActions {

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private fun videoDir(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): File =
        File(ConfigStore.resultsDir(config), videoId).apply { mkdirs() }

    /** 语音转写：视频 → WAV → 文本 → transcript.json。 */
    fun transcribe(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): String {
        val source = ConfigStore.sourceFile(config, videoId) ?: return "找不到源文件（请重新导入）"
        val wav = if (VideoToWav.isWav(source)) {
            source
        } else {
            val tmp = File.createTempFile("learnagent_audio", ".wav")
            if (!VideoToWav.extractAudio(source, tmp)) {
                tmp.delete()
                return "音频提取失败（无音轨或格式不支持）"
            }
            tmp
        }
        return try {
            val segments = WindowsTranscriber.transcribe(wav)
            File(videoDir(config, videoId), "transcript.json").writeText(json.encodeToString(segments))
            "转写完成：${segments.size} 段"
        } finally {
            if (wav != source) wav.delete()
        }
    }

    /** 抽帧 + OCR：视频 → 代表帧 → 文字 → frames.json。 */
    fun ocrFrames(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): String {
        val source = ConfigStore.sourceFile(config, videoId) ?: return "找不到源文件（请重新导入）"
        val frames = VideoFrameExtractor.extractAndOcr(source, videoDir(config, videoId))
        return "抽帧 OCR 完成：${frames.size} 帧"
    }

    /**
     * 三模型深度整理（批次 A）：
     * 逐段三模型独立整理 → 交叉校对 N 轮 → 共识/分歧；产出 deep_digest.json + deep_digest.md。
     */
    suspend fun deepDigest(
        config: AppConfig,
        videoId: String,
        onProgress: (DigestProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): String {
        val key = config.nvidiaApiKey.trim()
        if (key.isBlank()) return "未配置 NVIDIA API Key（设置页填写）"
        val timeline = ConfigStore.loadTimeline(config, videoId)
        if (timeline.isEmpty()) return "当前视频没有内容（先转写/抽帧）"
        onProgress(DigestProgress(0, timeline.size, "分析学习单元…"))
        val units = ContextAnalyzer(null).analyze(timeline, videoId)

        fun client(model: String) = NvidiaLlmClient(key, model = model)
        val engine = DeepDigestEngine(
            seats = listOf(
                // A 席：Kimi K3，超时/失败自动换 K2.6
                Triple("Kimi K3", client(DebateModels.DEFAULT_A), client("moonshotai/kimi-k2.6")),
                Triple("DeepSeek V4.1", client(DebateModels.DEFAULT_B), null),
                Triple("GLM 5.3", client(DebateModels.DEFAULT_C), null)
            ),
            callTimeoutMs = 180_000,
            retries = 2,
            maxRounds = 3
        )
        val report: DeepDigestReport = engine.digest(videoId, units, onProgress)
        val dir = videoDir(config, videoId)
        File(dir, "deep_digest.json").writeText(json.encodeToString(DeepDigestReport.serializer(), report))
        File(dir, "deep_digest.md").writeText(renderMarkdown(report))
        return "深度整理完成：${report.segments.size} 段，共识 ${report.consensus.size} 条，分歧 ${report.divergences.size} 条"
    }

    /** 转写纠错（三模型共识，带出处）。 */
    suspend fun polishTranscript(config: AppConfig, videoId: String, onProgress: (Int, Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }): String {
        val key = config.nvidiaApiKey.trim()
        if (key.isBlank()) return "未配置 NVIDIA API Key"
        val f = File(videoDir(config, videoId), "transcript.json")
        if (!f.isFile) return "没有转写文件（请先转写）"
        val segs = json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), f.readText())
        fun c(m: String) = NvidiaLlmClient(key, model = m)
        val polisher = TranscriptPolisher(
            listOf(
                "GLM 5.3" to c(DebateModels.DEFAULT_C),
                "DeepSeek V4.1" to c(DebateModels.DEFAULT_B),
                "Kimi K3" to c(DebateModels.DEFAULT_A)
            ),
            timeoutMs = 120_000, retries = 1
        )
        val r = polisher.polish(videoId, segs, onProgress)
        File(videoDir(config, videoId), "transcript_polished.json")
            .writeText(json.encodeToString(PolishedTranscript.serializer(), r))
        File(videoDir(config, videoId), "transcript_polished.md").writeText(polisher.markdown(r))
        return "纠错完成：${r.segments.size} 句 · 高置信 ${r.segments.count { it.confidence >= 1f }}"
    }

    private fun renderMarkdown(r: DeepDigestReport): String {
        fun ts(sec: Double): String {
            val t = sec.toInt(); fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
            return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
        }
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("# 深度整理：").append(r.videoId).append("\n\n")
        sb.append("模型：").append(r.models.joinToString(" / ")).append("；交叉校对 ").append(r.rounds).append(" 轮\n\n")
        sb.append("## 全局共识（必学知识点）\n")
        r.consensus.forEach { sb.append("- ").append(it).append('\n') }
        sb.append("\n## 全局分歧\n")
        r.divergences.forEach { d ->
            sb.append("- 主题：").append(d.topic).append('\n')
            d.views.forEach { v -> sb.append("  - ").append(v).append('\n') }
        }
        sb.append("\n## 分段明细\n")
        r.segments.forEach { s ->
            sb.append("\n### [").append(ts(s.start)).append(" - ").append(ts(s.end)).append("]\n")
            if (s.degraded) sb.append("（三模型均不可用，已降级）\n")
            sb.append("**共识**\n"); s.consensus.forEach { sb.append("- ").append(it).append('\n') }
            if (s.divergences.isNotEmpty()) {
                sb.append("**分歧**\n")
                s.divergences.forEach { d ->
                    sb.append("- ").append(d.topic).append("：").append(d.views.joinToString("；")).append('\n')
                }
            }
            s.perModel.forEach { (m, txt) ->
                sb.append("\n**").append(m).append(" 定稿（原文）**\n\n").append(txt).append('\n')
            }
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.asr

import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * 基于 Windows 内置语音识别（System.Speech）的本地转写实现。
 *
 * 通过随包附带的 `transcribe.ps1` 调用 zh-CN 识别引擎，对 WAV 音频做离线转写。
 * 无需 Python / Vosk / Whisper，也无需下载模型。
 */
object WindowsTranscriber {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    fun isWindows(): Boolean =
        System.getProperty("os.name").orEmpty().lowercase().contains("windows")

    private fun powershellPath(): String {
        val root = System.getenv("SystemRoot") ?: "C:\\Windows"
        val full = File(root, "System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe")
        return if (full.isFile) full.absolutePath else "powershell.exe"
    }

    /**
     * 启动 PowerShell。Windows 在短时间内密集创建进程时会偶发
     * CreateProcess error=5（拒绝访问），此处做有限重试。
     */
    private fun startProcess(args: List<String>): Process {
        var last: java.io.IOException? = null
        for (attempt in 0 until 3) {
            try {
                return ProcessBuilder(args).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                last = e
                Thread.sleep(300L * (attempt + 1))
            }
        }
        throw last!!
    }

    /**
     * 转写一个 WAV 音频文件（16kHz/单声道效果最佳）。
     *
     * @return 转录片段列表（含 start/end 秒与文本）
     */
    fun transcribe(wav: File, culture: String = "zh-CN"): List<TranscriptSegment> {
        require(wav.isFile) { "音频不存在: ${wav.absolutePath}" }
        check(isWindows()) { "WindowsTranscriber 仅支持 Windows 平台" }

        val scriptFile = File.createTempFile("learnagent_transcribe", ".ps1")
        val outFile = File.createTempFile("learnagent_transcribe_out", ".json")
        try {
            val script = WindowsTranscriber::class.java.getResourceAsStream("/transcribe.ps1")
                ?: error("classpath 缺少 transcribe.ps1")
            script.use { input -> scriptFile.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }

            val process = startProcess(
                listOf(
                    powershellPath(), "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                    "-File", scriptFile.absolutePath,
                    "-Wav", wav.absolutePath,
                    "-Out", outFile.absolutePath,
                    "-Culture", culture
                )
            )

            val log = process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
            val exit = process.waitFor()
            if (exit != 0) error("转写进程失败 exit=$exit\n$log")

            val text = outFile.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
            if (text.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
            return json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(TranscriptSegment.serializer()), text)
        } finally {
            scriptFile.delete()
            outFile.delete()
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.audio

import javax.sound.sampled.AudioFormat
import javax.sound.sampled.AudioSystem
import javax.sound.sampled.SourceDataLine

/**
 * 桌面播放层：合成已下沉到共享 PcmSynth（三端同音色），
 * 本对象只保留 SourceDataLine 声线池（预热 / 异步 / 可叠加 / 空闲自动关闭）。
 */
object SoundSynth {

    @Volatile
    var enabled: Boolean = true

    private val format = AudioFormat(PcmSynth.SAMPLE_RATE.toFloat(), 16, 1, true, false)
    private val cache = HashMap<PcmSynth.Sound, ByteArray>()

    private class Voice {
        val queue = java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<ByteArray>(8)
    }

    private val voices: List<Voice> = List(3) { Voice() }
    private val voicesStarted = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)

    /** 预热播放线程（在后台线程调用，不阻塞 UI）。 */
    fun warmUp() {
        if (!enabled) return
        if (!voicesStarted.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        voices.forEach { voice ->
            val thread = Thread {
                while (true) {
                    var chunk = runCatching { voice.queue.take() }.getOrNull() ?: return@Thread
                    runCatching {
                        var line: SourceDataLine? = null
                        try {
                            line = AudioSystem.getSourceDataLine(format)
                            line.open(format)
                            line.start()
                            while (chunk != null) {
                                line.write(chunk, 0, chunk.size)
                                chunk = voice.queue.poll(2400, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                            }
                            line.drain()
                        } finally {
                            line?.runCatching {
                                stop()
                                close()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            thread.isDaemon = true
            thread.name = "mentara-voice"
            thread.start()
        }
    }

    /** 播放（异步，可叠加）。[volumeScale] 用于 Splash 中的渐变音量。 */
    fun play(sound: PcmSynth.Sound, volumeScale: Float = 1f) {
        if (!enabled) return
        val pcm = synchronized(cache) {
            cache.getOrPut(sound) { PcmSynth.render(sound) }
        }
        start(if (volumeScale == 1f) pcm else PcmSynth.scale(pcm, volumeScale))
    }

    /** 预生成 PCM 到内存（SoundPool 语义）+ 预热声线。 */
    fun preload(vararg sounds: PcmSynth.Sound) {
        synchronized(cache) {
            sounds.forEach { cache.getOrPut(it) { PcmSynth.render(it) } }
        }
        warmUp()
    }

    private fun start(pcm: ByteArray) {
        if (!voicesStarted.get()) warmUp()
        val voice = voices.minByOrNull { it.queue.size } ?: return
        voice.queue.offer(pcm)
    }
}
desktopApp/src/main/kotlin/com/learnagent/config/ConfigStore.kt (5.7KB)
package com.learnagent.config

import com.learnagent.core.DebateResult
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import com.learnagent.data.VideoMeta
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

@Serializable
data class AppConfig(
    val nvidiaApiKey: String = "",
    val model: String = "deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
    val resultsDir: String = "",
    val themeMode: String = "system", // system | light | dark
    val soundEnabled: Boolean = true,
    /** 辩论三模型（空 = 用 DebateModels 内置默认，NIM 实测存在） */
    val debateModelA: String = "",
    val debateModelB: String = "",
    val debateModelC: String = "",
    /** UI 语言：en（默认）/ zh */
    val language: String = "en"
)

/**
 * 本地配置与结果目录。
 *
 * 全部位于 `~/.learnagent/`：
 *  - config.json       配置（API Key / 主题 / results 路径）
 *  - last_selected.txt 上次选中的视频
 *  - results/          每个视频一个子目录（videoId）
 */
object ConfigStore {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; prettyPrint = true; isLenient = true }

    val baseDir: File = File(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".mentara").also { migrateFromLegacy(it) }

    /** 旧目录 ~/.learnagent 存在且新目录不存在时，迁移过去。 */
    private fun migrateFromLegacy(target: File) {
        val legacy = File(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".learnagent")
        if (legacy.isDirectory && !target.exists()) {
            runCatching { legacy.copyRecursively(target, overwrite = false) }
        }
    }

    fun resultsDir(config: AppConfig): File {
        val custom = config.resultsDir.trim()
        val dir = if (custom.isNotEmpty()) File(custom) else File(baseDir, "results")
        dir.mkdirs()
        return dir
    }

    private val configFile: File get() = File(baseDir, "config.json")
    private val lastSelectedFile: File get() = File(baseDir, "last_selected.txt")

    fun load(): AppConfig = try {
        if (configFile.isFile) json.decodeFromString(configFile.readText()) else AppConfig()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        AppConfig()
    }

    fun save(config: AppConfig) {
        baseDir.mkdirs()
        configFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(config))
    }

    fun loadLastSelected(): String? = try {
        if (lastSelectedFile.isFile) lastSelectedFile.readText().trim().ifBlank { null } else null
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        null
    }

    fun saveLastSelected(videoId: String) {
        baseDir.mkdirs()
        lastSelectedFile.writeText(videoId)
    }

    /** 扫描 results 目录下的所有视频子目录。 */
    fun listVideos(config: AppConfig): List<String> {
        val dir = resultsDir(config)
        return dir.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory }?.map { it.name }?.sorted().orEmpty()
    }

    /** 导入一个真实视频：在 results 下按文件名建立目录并写入真实 meta.json。 */
    fun importVideo(config: AppConfig, file: File): String {
        val dir = resultsDir(config)
        val base = file.nameWithoutExtension
            .replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]"), "_")
            .take(40)
            .ifBlank { "video" }
        val suffix = Integer.toHexString(file.absolutePath.hashCode())
        val id = "$base-$suffix"
        val videoDir = File(dir, id)
        videoDir.mkdirs()

        val meta = VideoMeta(
            videoId = id,
            deviceId = "desktop",
            lastModified = file.lastModified(),
            schemaVersion = 1,
            title = file.name,
            duration = 0.0
        )
        File(videoDir, "meta.json").writeText(json.encodeToString(meta))
        File(videoDir, "source.txt").writeText(file.absolutePath)
        return id
    }

    /** 读取某个视频的源文件路径（导入时记录）。 */
    fun sourceFile(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): File? {
        val f = File(resultsDir(config), "$videoId/source.txt")
        if (!f.isFile) return null
        return try {
            File(f.readText().trim()).takeIf { it.isFile }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    /** 读取某个视频的结果并融合成时间线（无结果则返回空）。 */
    fun loadTimeline(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): List<TimelineItem> {
        val dir = File(resultsDir(config), videoId)
        val transcript = readList<TranscriptSegment>(File(dir, "transcript.json"))
        val frames = readList<FrameOcr>(File(dir, "frames.json"))
        if (transcript.isEmpty() && frames.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return merge(transcript, frames)
    }

    fun hasResults(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): Boolean {
        val dir = File(resultsDir(config), videoId)
        return File(dir, "transcript.json").isFile || File(dir, "frames.json").isFile
    }

    /** 辩论结果持久化：results/<videoId>/debate.json */
    fun saveDebate(config: AppConfig, videoId: String, result: DebateResult) {
        val dir = File(resultsDir(config), videoId)
        dir.mkdirs()
        File(dir, "debate.json").writeText(json.encodeToString(result))
    }

    fun loadDebate(config: AppConfig, videoId: String): DebateResult? = try {
        val f = File(resultsDir(config), "$videoId/debate.json")
        if (f.isFile) json.decodeFromString<DebateResult>(f.readText()) else null
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        null
    }

    private inline fun <reified T> readList(file: File): List<T> = try {
        if (file.isFile) json.decodeFromString(file.readText()) else emptyList()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        emptyList()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.llm

import com.learnagent.core.LlmClient
import com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.addJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
import kotlinx.serialization.json.putJsonArray
import java.net.URI
import java.net.http.HttpClient
import java.net.http.HttpRequest
import java.net.http.HttpResponse
import java.time.Duration

/**
 * NVIDIA NIM（build.nvidia.com）的大模型客户端，BYOK。
 *
 * 调用 `{baseUrl}/chat/completions`，默认模型为 `meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct`。
 */
class NvidiaLlmClient(
    private val apiKey: String,
    private val baseUrl: String = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1",
    private val model: String = "deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
) : LlmClient {

    private val http: HttpClient = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
        .build()

    override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String {
        val payload = buildJsonObject {
            put("model", model)
            putJsonArray("messages") {
                if (config.system.isNotBlank()) {
                    addJsonObject {
                        put("role", "system")
                        put("content", config.system)
                    }
                }
                addJsonObject {
                    put("role", "user")
                    put("content", prompt)
                }
            }
            put("temperature", config.temperature)
            put("max_tokens", config.maxTokens)
            put("stream", false)
        }.toString()

        val request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("$baseUrl/chat/completions"))
            .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(120))
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer $apiKey")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .header("Accept", "application/json")
            .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(payload))
            .build()

        val response = http.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString())
        if (response.statusCode() !in 200..299) {
            throw IllegalStateException("NVIDIA NIM 返回 HTTP ${response.statusCode()}: ${response.body().take(300)}")
        }

        val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(response.body()).jsonObject
        val message = root["choices"]?.jsonArray?.firstOrNull()
            ?.jsonObject?.get("message")
            ?.jsonObject
        val content = message?.get("content")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
        val reasoning = message?.get("reasoning_content")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
        return (content?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: reasoning ?: "").trim()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.media

import com.learnagent.core.Atmosphere
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.ocr.WindowsOcr
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * 桌面端视频抽帧 + OCR。
 *
 * 在无 ffmpeg 的环境下，用 Windows 内置 `StorageFile.GetThumbnailAsync` 抽取代表帧，
 * 再交给 [WindowsOcr]（Windows.Media.Ocr）做文字识别，产出 [FrameOcr] 列表。
 *
 * 说明：受平台互操作限制，目前每个视频抽取 1 张代表帧。
 */
object VideoFrameExtractor {

    @Serializable
    private data class FrameRef(val timestamp: Double, val imagePath: String)

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    fun isWindows(): Boolean =
        System.getProperty("os.name").orEmpty().lowercase().contains("windows")

    private fun powershellPath(): String {
        val root = System.getenv("SystemRoot") ?: "C:\\Windows"
        val full = File(root, "System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe")
        return if (full.isFile) full.absolutePath else "powershell.exe"
    }

    private fun startProcess(args: List<String>): Process {
        var last: java.io.IOException? = null
        for (attempt in 0 until 3) {
            try {
                return ProcessBuilder(args).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                last = e
                Thread.sleep(300L * (attempt + 1))
            }
        }
        throw last!!
    }

    private fun extractResource(resource: String, dest: File) {
        val stream = VideoFrameExtractor::class.java.getResourceAsStream(resource)
            ?: error("classpath 缺少 $resource")
        stream.use { input -> dest.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }
    }

    private fun runScript(scriptFile: File, args: List<String>) {
        val process = startProcess(
            listOf(
                powershellPath(), "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                "-File", scriptFile.absolutePath
            ) + args
        )
        process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
        val exit = process.waitFor()
        if (exit != 0) error("脚本执行失败 exit=$exit")
    }

    /**
     * 抽取视频代表帧并逐帧 OCR。
     *
     * @return [FrameOcr] 列表（timestamp/text/imagePath）
     */
    fun extractAndOcr(video: File, outDir: File): List<FrameOcr> {
        require(video.isFile) { "视频不存在: ${video.absolutePath}" }
        check(isWindows()) { "VideoFrameExtractor 仅支持 Windows 平台" }
        outDir.mkdirs()

        // 释放脚本 + 自研 Media Foundation 抽帧器（多帧优先），执行后清理
        val tmpDir = File.createTempFile("learnagent_", "").apply { delete(); mkdirs() }
        try {
            val ps1 = File(tmpDir, "extract_frames.ps1")
            val cs = File(tmpDir, "mfframegrab.cs")
            extractResource("/extract_frames.ps1", ps1)
            extractResource("/mfframegrab.cs", cs)
            runScript(
                ps1,
                listOf(
                    "-Video", video.absolutePath, "-OutDir", outDir.absolutePath,
                    "-Width", "1280", "-Count", "12", "-Fps", "20", "-CsPath", cs.absolutePath
                )
            )
        } finally {
            tmpDir.deleteRecursively()
        }

        val framesJson = File(outDir, "frames.json")
        if (!framesJson.isFile) return emptyList()
        val refs = json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameRef.serializer()), framesJson.readText())

        return refs.map { ref ->
            val img = File(ref.imagePath)
            var text = try {
                WindowsOcr.ocr(img)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                ""
            }
            // 镜像源容错：OCR 结果过少时尝试水平镜像，取识别字符更多的一侧
            if (text.count { it.isLetterOrDigit() } < 3) {
                val flipped = File(img.parentFile, img.nameWithoutExtension + "_flip.png")
                try {
                    flipHorizontal(img, flipped)
                    val t2 = WindowsOcr.ocr(flipped)
                    if (t2.count { it.isLetterOrDigit() } > text.count { it.isLetterOrDigit() }) text = t2
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    // 忽略
                }
            }
            val mood = runCatching { moodOf(img) }.getOrDefault("")
            FrameOcr(timestamp = ref.timestamp, text = text, imagePath = img.absolutePath, mood = mood)
        }
    }

    /** 生成连续帧（密集 20fps、宽 640 JPEG）到 outDir/dense；返回帧数。 */
    fun extractDense(video: File, outDir: File, fps: Int = 20, width: Int = 640): Int {
        require(video.isFile) { "视频不存在：${video.absolutePath}" }
        check(isWindows()) { "VideoFrameExtractor 仅支持 Windows 平台" }
        val denseDir = File(outDir, "dense").apply { mkdirs() }
        val tmpDir = File.createTempFile("learnagent_", "").apply { delete(); mkdirs() }
        return try {
            val ps1 = File(tmpDir, "extract_frames.ps1")
            val cs = File(tmpDir, "mfframegrab.cs")
            extractResource("/extract_frames.ps1", ps1)
            extractResource("/mfframegrab.cs", cs)
            runScript(
                ps1,
                listOf(
                    "-Video", video.absolutePath, "-OutDir", denseDir.absolutePath,
                    "-Mode", "dense", "-Fps", fps.toString(), "-DenseWidth", width.toString(),
                    "-CsPath", cs.absolutePath
                )
            )
            val fj = File(denseDir, "frames.json")
            if (!fj.isFile) 0 else json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(FrameRef.serializer()), fj.readText()).size
        } finally {
            tmpDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

    /** 画面氛围（量化）：采样像素算 亮度/饱和/色温/对比。 */
    private fun moodOf(file: File): String {
        val img = javax.imageio.ImageIO.read(file) ?: return ""
        var r = 0L; var g = 0L; var b = 0L; var n = 0L; var minL = 255f; var maxL = 0f
        val sx = (img.width / 24).coerceAtLeast(1); val sy = (img.height / 24).coerceAtLeast(1)
        var y = 0
        while (y < img.height) {
            var x = 0
            while (x < img.width) {
                val c = img.getRGB(x, y)
                val rr = (c shr 16) and 0xFF; val gg = (c shr 8) and 0xFF; val bb = c and 0xFF
                r += rr; g += gg; b += bb; n++
                val l = 0.299f * rr + 0.587f * gg + 0.114f * bb
                if (l < minL) minL = l; if (l > maxL) maxL = l
                x += sx
            }
            y += sy
        }
        if (n == 0L) return ""
        return Atmosphere.label(Atmosphere.fromAverages(r.toFloat() / n, g.toFloat() / n, b.toFloat() / n, minL, maxL))
    }

    /** 水平镜像（用于纠正镜像源视频的 OCR）。 */
    private fun flipHorizontal(src: File, dst: File) {
        val img = javax.imageio.ImageIO.read(src) ?: return
        val out = java.awt.image.BufferedImage(img.width, img.height, java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB)
        val g = out.createGraphics()
        g.drawImage(img, img.width, 0, -img.width, img.height, null)
        g.dispose()
        javax.imageio.ImageIO.write(out, "png", dst)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.media

import java.io.File

/**
 * 视频 → WAV（音频提取）。
 *
 * 离线环境下没有 ffmpeg，改用 Windows 内置 MediaTranscoder（WinRT）把视频音轨
 * 转成 16kHz / 单声道 / 16-bit PCM WAV，供 [com.learnagent.asr.WindowsTranscriber] 转写。
 */
object VideoToWav {

    private val VIDEO_EXTENSIONS =
        setOf("mp4", "mkv", "mov", "avi", "wmv", "m4v", "webm", "flv", "ts", "3gp")

    fun isWindows(): Boolean =
        System.getProperty("os.name").orEmpty().lowercase().contains("windows")

    fun isVideo(file: File): Boolean = file.extension.lowercase() in VIDEO_EXTENSIONS

    fun isWav(file: File): Boolean = file.extension.equals("wav", ignoreCase = true)

    private fun powershellPath(): String {
        val root = System.getenv("SystemRoot") ?: "C:\\Windows"
        val full = File(root, "System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe")
        return if (full.isFile) full.absolutePath else "powershell.exe"
    }

    private fun startProcess(args: List<String>): Process {
        var last: java.io.IOException? = null
        for (attempt in 0 until 3) {
            try {
                return ProcessBuilder(args).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                last = e
                Thread.sleep(300L * (attempt + 1))
            }
        }
        throw last!!
    }

    /**
     * 从 [video] 提取音频到 [wav]。
     * @return 是否成功（成功标准：进程退出码 0 且输出 WAV 已生成）
     */
    fun extractAudio(video: File, wav: File): Boolean {
        require(video.isFile) { "视频不存在: ${video.absolutePath}" }
        check(isWindows()) { "VideoToWav 仅支持 Windows 平台" }

        val scriptFile = File.createTempFile("learnagent_v2w", ".ps1")
        try {
            val resource = VideoToWav::class.java.getResourceAsStream("/video_to_wav.ps1")
                ?: error("classpath 缺少 video_to_wav.ps1")
            resource.use { input -> scriptFile.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }

            val process = startProcess(
                listOf(
                    powershellPath(), "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                    "-File", scriptFile.absolutePath,
                    "-Video", video.absolutePath,
                    "-Wav", wav.absolutePath
                )
            )
            val log = process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
            val exit = process.waitFor()
            return exit == 0 && wav.isFile && wav.length() > 44L
        } finally {
            scriptFile.delete()
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ocr

import java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment
import java.awt.Robot
import java.io.File
import javax.imageio.ImageIO

/**
 * 屏幕抽帧器（伪"关键帧"）：
 *
 * 在缺少 ffmpeg 的离线环境下，用 java.awt.Robot 抓取当前屏幕作为一帧，
 * 落盘为 PNG，随后可交给 [WindowsOcr] 识别。
 */
object ScreenCapturer {

    /** 抓取主屏为一张临时 PNG，返回文件。 */
    fun captureToFile(): File {
        val robot = Robot()
        val bounds = GraphicsEnvironment
            .getLocalGraphicsEnvironment()
            .defaultScreenDevice
            .defaultConfiguration
            .bounds
        val image = robot.createScreenCapture(bounds)
        val file = File.createTempFile("learnagent_frame", ".png")
        ImageIO.write(image, "png", file)
        return file
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ocr

import java.io.File

/**
 * 基于 Windows 内置 OCR 引擎（Windows.Media.Ocr）的本地识别实现。
 *
 * 通过调用系统 PowerShell 运行随包附带 `ocr.ps1`，把图片识别为文本。
 * 全程离线，无需 tesseract / MLKit。
 */
object WindowsOcr {

    fun isWindows(): Boolean =
        System.getProperty("os.name").orEmpty().lowercase().contains("windows")

    private fun powershellPath(): String {
        val systemRoot = System.getenv("SystemRoot") ?: "C:\\Windows"
        val full = File(systemRoot, "System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe")
        return if (full.isFile) full.absolutePath else "powershell.exe"
    }

    private fun startProcess(args: List<String>): Process {
        var last: java.io.IOException? = null
        for (attempt in 0 until 3) {
            try {
                return ProcessBuilder(args).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                last = e
                Thread.sleep(300L * (attempt + 1))
            }
        }
        throw last!!
    }

    /**
     * 识别图片中的文字。
     *
     * @param image 待识别的图片文件（PNG/JPG）
     * @return 识别出的文本（可能为空字符串）
     */
    fun ocr(image: File): String {
        require(image.isFile) { "图片不存在: ${image.absolutePath}" }
        check(isWindows()) { "WindowsOcr 仅支持 Windows 平台" }

        val scriptFile = File.createTempFile("learnagent_ocr", ".ps1")
        val outFile = File.createTempFile("learnagent_ocr_out", ".txt")
        try {
            val script = WindowsOcr::class.java.getResourceAsStream("/ocr.ps1")
                ?: error("classpath 缺少 ocr.ps1")
            script.use { input -> scriptFile.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }

            val process = startProcess(
                listOf(
                    powershellPath(), "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                    "-File", scriptFile.absolutePath,
                    "-Path", image.absolutePath,
                    "-Out", outFile.absolutePath
                )
            )

            val log = process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
            val exit = process.waitFor()
            if (exit != 0) error("OCR 进程失败 exit=$exit\n$log")

            return outFile.readText(Charsets.UTF_8).trim()
        } finally {
            scriptFile.delete()
            outFile.delete()
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import com.learnagent.ambience.AmbienceCore

/**
 * 桌面人为因素薄封装：纯逻辑在共享 AmbienceCore（与 Android 同源），
 * 这里只持有 Compose 状态，公共 API 与行为和旧版完全一致。
 */
object Ambience {

    var particleCount by mutableStateOf(36)
        private set
    var speedFactor by mutableStateOf(1f)
        private set
    var sleeping by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    var nightMode by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set
    var breakNotice by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set

    init {
        AmbienceCore.start(System.currentTimeMillis())
    }

    fun noteInteraction() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        AmbienceCore.noteInteraction(now)
        if (sleeping) sleeping = false
    }

    fun dismissBreakNotice() {
        breakNotice = false
    }

    fun updateContentVolume(videoCount: Int) {
        particleCount = AmbienceCore.particleCount(videoCount)
    }

    /** 由主界面每秒调用一次。 */
    fun tick() {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        speedFactor = AmbienceCore.speedFactor(now)
        sleeping = AmbienceCore.isSleeping(now)
        nightMode = AmbienceCore.isNightMode(now)
        if (AmbienceCore.shouldShowBreakNotice(now)) breakNotice = true
    }

    /** 测试/预览辅助：直接设定粒子数（不影响业务）。 */
    fun previewParticles(count: Int) {
        particleCount = count.coerceIn(20, 80)
    }

    internal fun resetSessionForTest(now: Long) {
        AmbienceCore.start(now)
        speedFactor = 1f
        sleeping = false
        nightMode = false
        breakNotice = false
    }

    internal fun ageMinutesForTest(minutes: Long) {
        AmbienceCore.rewindSession(System.currentTimeMillis(), kotlin.math.abs(minutes) * 60_000)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ImageBitmap
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.painter.Painter
import androidx.compose.ui.res.loadImageBitmap
import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource

/**
 * 美术资源加载：优先加载 resources/art 目录下的 PNG（程序化生成），
 * 文件不存在时返回 null，调用方自动回退到 Canvas 程序化绘制。
 */

private object ArtAnchor

private val artClassLoader: ClassLoader?
    get() = Thread.currentThread().contextClassLoader ?: ArtAnchor::class.java.classLoader

fun artExists(path: String): Boolean =
    runCatching { artClassLoader?.getResource(path) != null }.getOrDefault(false)

@Composable
fun artPainter(path: String): Painter? =
    if (artExists(path)) runCatching { painterResource(path) }.getOrNull() else null

@Composable
fun artImage(path: String): ImageBitmap? =
    remember(path) {
        if (!artExists(path)) {
            null
        } else {
            runCatching {
                artClassLoader?.getResourceAsStream(path)?.use { loadImageBitmap(it) }
            }.getOrNull()
        }
    }

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.GenericShape
import androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Outline
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Path
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shape
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Density
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.LayoutDirection
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

/**
 * 高端异形卡片形状（替代标准 16dp 全圆角）。
 * 每类内容一种形状：斜切角 / 弧顶 / 双层 / 不对称气泡 / 标签切角 / 缺口。
 */
object CardShapes {

    /** 视频卡：左上 + 右下大圆角，右上 + 左下直角（被光斜切）。 */
    fun videoCard(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = 24.dp,
        topEnd = 0.dp,
        bottomEnd = 24.dp,
        bottomStart = 0.dp
    )

    /** 学习单元卡：弧顶（曲线）+ 左右 20dp 过渡 + 底部直角。 */
    fun learningUnitCard(): Shape = GenericShape { size, _ ->
        val radius = 20f * 2f
        moveTo(0f, size.height)
        lineTo(0f, 40f)
        quadraticBezierTo(size.width / 2f, 0f, size.width, 40f)
        lineTo(size.width, size.height)
        lineTo(radius.coerceAtMost(size.width / 2f), size.height)
        close()
    }

    /** 技术卡：16dp（双层玻璃由使用处叠"影子卡片"实现）。 */
    fun techCard(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)

    /** 用户气泡：右下角 4dp，其余 20dp。 */
    fun userBubble(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = 20.dp, topEnd = 20.dp, bottomEnd = 4.dp, bottomStart = 20.dp
    )

    /** AI 气泡：左下角 4dp，其余 20dp。 */
    fun aiBubble(): Shape = RoundedCornerShape(
        topStart = 20.dp, topEnd = 20.dp, bottomEnd = 20.dp, bottomStart = 4.dp
    )

    /** 决策卡：右上斜切 24dp（文件夹标签角）+ 其余三角 12dp 圆角。 */
    fun decisionCard(): Shape = object : Shape {
        override fun createOutline(size: Size, layoutDirection: LayoutDirection, density: Density): Outline {
            val r = 12f * density.density
            val cut = 24f * density.density
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            val path = Path().apply {
                moveTo(r, 0f)
                lineTo(w - cut, 0f)
                lineTo(w, cut)
                lineTo(w, h - r)
                quadraticBezierTo(w, h, w - r, h)
                lineTo(r, h)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, h, 0f, h - r)
                lineTo(0f, r)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, 0f, r, 0f)
                close()
            }
            return Outline.Generic(path)
        }
    }

    /** 导入课程卡：四角 32dp 大圆角 + 左侧中间半圆缺口（被咬一口的饼干）。 */
    fun importCard(): Shape = object : Shape {
        override fun createOutline(size: Size, layoutDirection: LayoutDirection, density: Density): Outline {
            val r = 32f * density.density
            val notch = 14f * density.density
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            val path = Path().apply {
                moveTo(r, 0f)
                lineTo(w - r, 0f)
                quadraticBezierTo(w, 0f, w, r)
                lineTo(w, h - r)
                quadraticBezierTo(w, h, w - r, h)
                lineTo(r, h)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, h, 0f, h - r)
                lineTo(0f, h / 2f + notch)
                quadraticBezierTo(notch * 1.6f, h / 2f, 0f, h / 2f - notch)
                lineTo(0f, r)
                quadraticBezierTo(0f, 0f, r, 0f)
                close()
            }
            return Outline.Generic(path)
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke

// ============================================================
//  电影质感基建：光源 / 光晕 / 暗角 / 虚线 / 代码高亮
// ============================================================

/**
 * 主光源：从右上 30° 照射的柔和高光。
 * 卡片内部 drawBehind 使用——右上角亮，左下角暗。
 */
fun Modifier.cinematicLight(intensity: Float = 0.08f): Modifier = drawBehind {
    val w = size.width
    val h = size.height
    drawRect(
        Brush.linearGradient(
            colors = listOf(
                Color(0xFF0F1419),  // Abyss Blue
                Color(0xFF0A0E14),  // Deep Void
            ),
            start = Offset(w * 0.8f, h * 0.1f),
            end = Offset(w * 0.2f, h * 0.9f)
        )
    )
    // 暖光源（右上 30°）
    drawCircle(
        brush = Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(
                Aureate.copy(alpha = intensity),
                Color.Transparent
            ),
            center = Offset(w * 0.85f, h * 0.1f),
            radius = w * 0.5f
        ),
        radius = w * 0.5f,
        center = Offset(w * 0.85f, h * 0.1f)
    )
}

/**
 * 暗角：四角变暗（vignette effect）。
 */
fun Modifier.vignette(strength: Float = 0.3f): Modifier = drawBehind {
    val c = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f)
    val r = size.maxDimension * 0.7f
    drawCircle(
        brush = Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(
                Color.Transparent,
                Color.Transparent,
                DeepVoid.copy(alpha = strength)
            ),
            center = c,
            radius = r
        ),
        radius = r,
        center = c
    )
}

/**
 * 光晕：元素背后的柔和 radial gradient。
 * 用 drawBehind 画在文字/缩略图后面。
 */
fun Modifier.haloGlow(color: Color, radiusPx: Float = 80f, alpha: Float = 0.15f): Modifier = drawBehind {
    val c = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f)
    drawCircle(
        brush = Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(color.copy(alpha = alpha), Color.Transparent),
            center = c,
            radius = radiusPx
        ),
        radius = radiusPx,
        center = c
    )
}

/**
 * 暖色调覆盖：0.05 透明度的暖色全卡片覆盖。
 */
fun Modifier.warmOverlay(): Modifier = drawBehind {
    drawRect(
        Brush.radialGradient(
            colors = listOf(
                Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.03f),
                Color.Transparent
            ),
            center = Offset(size.width * 0.6f, size.height * 0.3f),
            radius = size.maxDimension * 0.8f
        )
    )
}

/**
 * 虚线分隔（不是实线——电影字幕风格）。
 */
@Composable
fun CinematicDivider(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, color: Color = TextLow.copy(alpha = 0.3f)) {
    Canvas(
        modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(1.dp)
    ) {
        val path = Path().apply {
            moveTo(0f, size.height / 2)
            lineTo(size.width, size.height / 2)
        }
        drawPath(
            path,
            color,
            style = Stroke(
                width = 1f,
                pathEffect = PathEffect.dashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(8f, 6f))
            )
        )
    }
}

/**
 * 金色短线：标题下方的装饰性渐变横线。
 */
@Composable
fun GoldUnderline(width: Dp = 48.dp, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Canvas(
        modifier
            .height(2.dp)
            .padding(bottom = 0.dp)
    ) {
        drawRect(
            Brush.horizontalGradient(
                colors = listOf(Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.7f), Aureate.copy(alpha = 0.1f), Color.Transparent),
                startX = 0f,
                endX = width.toPx()
            ),
            size = Size(width.toPx(), 2.dp.toPx())
        )
    }
}

// ============================================================
//  电影级文字样式（速查）
// ============================================================

/** 主角标题：24sp Thin + 金色 + 光晕感 */
val HeroTitle = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Thin,
    fontSize = 24.sp,
    letterSpacing = 4.sp
)

/** 副角标题：18sp Light + 冷银 */
val SupportingTitle = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Light,
    fontSize = 18.sp,
    letterSpacing = 1.sp
)

/** 标签：11sp Medium 全大写 3sp 字距 */
val CinematicTag = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
    fontSize = 11.sp,
    letterSpacing = 3.sp
)

/** 微标数字：Mono 11sp */
val MicroMono = TextStyle(

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.animation.core.Animatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.FastOutSlowInEasing
import androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateDpAsState
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloat
import androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.blur
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.graphicsLayer
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

/**
 * 电影级运镜（8 种镜头）：
 * dollyIn / dollyOut / parallax / rackFocus / rotation3D / breathing / shake / panTransition。
 * 协调规则：每次只用一种镜头；时长 300-500ms；缓动 FastOutSlowIn / Spring。
 *
 * 性能保护：帧率低时 parallax 幅度 0.08 → 0.04，关闭 blur（rackFocus 直接清零）。
 */
object PerfGuard {
    /** 由性能采样置位（帧率 < 50fps 时 true）。 */
    var lowFps: Boolean = false
    val parallaxScale: Float get() = if (lowFps) 0.04f else 0.08f
    fun shouldUseBlur(): Boolean = !lowFps
}

/** 镜头 1：推进（进入详情页）scale 1.0 → 1.08，400ms。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.dollyIn(active: Boolean = true): Modifier {
    val scale = remember { Animatable(1f) }
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        scale.animateTo(
            targetValue = if (active) 1.08f else 1f,
            animationSpec = tween(if (active) 400 else 350, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)
        )
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale.value
        scaleY = scale.value
    }
}

/** 镜头 2：拉远（返回列表）scale 1.08 → 1.0，350ms。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.dollyOut(active: Boolean): Modifier {
    val scale = remember { Animatable(1.08f) }
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        scale.animateTo(
            targetValue = if (active) 1f else 1.08f,
            animationSpec = tween(350, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing)
        )
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale.value
        scaleY = scale.value
    }
}

/** 镜头 4：视差（鼠标 ±100px → 图层 ±8px；低帧率降为 ±4px）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.parallax(mouseX: Float, centerX: Float): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer {
        translationX = (mouseX - centerX) * PerfGuard.parallaxScale
    }

/** 镜头 5：景深（focused=false 时 blur 0 → 4dp，500ms；低帧率关闭）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.rackFocus(focused: Boolean): Modifier {
    val blurDp by animateDpAsState(
        targetValue = if (focused || !PerfGuard.shouldUseBlur()) 0.dp else 4.dp,
        animationSpec = tween(500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
        label = "rackFocus"
    )
    return if (blurDp.value > 0f) this.blur(blurDp) else this
}

/** 镜头 6：3D 旋转（卡片翻面）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.rotation3D(angle: Float): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer {
        rotationY = angle
        cameraDistance = 12f * density
    }

/** 镜头 7：呼吸（空状态/加载态，scale 1.0 → 1.02，周期 3s）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.breathing(): Modifier {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "breathing")
    val scale by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 1f,
        targetValue = 1.02f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(1500, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "breathingScale"
    )
    return this.graphicsLayer {
        scaleX = scale
        scaleY = scale
    }
}

/** 镜头 8：抖动（错误提示 -4 → +4 → -4 → 0，300ms）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.shake(active: Boolean): Modifier {
    val tx = remember { Animatable(0f) }
    LaunchedEffect(active) {
        if (active) {
            tx.animateTo(-4f, tween(60, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
            tx.animateTo(4f, tween(60, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
            tx.animateTo(-4f, tween(60, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
            tx.animateTo(0f, tween(120, easing = FastOutSlowInEasing))
        }
    }
    return this.graphicsLayer { translationX = tx.value }
}

/** 镜头 3：平移（Tab/页面切换的位移量）。 */
@Composable
fun Modifier.panTransition(offset: Float): Modifier =
    this.graphicsLayer { translationX = offset }

package com.learnagent.ui

import androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility

import com.learnagent.core.DebateResult

private val debateAvatars = listOf(Phantom, Aureate, Coral)

private fun agreementColor(a: Double): Color = when {
    a > 0.66 -> SuccessGreen
    a >= 0.40 -> Aureate
    else -> Coral
}

/**
 * 四轮辩论可视化：
 *  - 议题行：可编辑议题 + 重新辩论 / 取消辩论
 *  - 流式：onRound 部分结果逐轮滑入（提案 → 交叉批判 → 中立裁决），每节 floatIn
 *  - 第 1 轮 三栏提案（彩色头像 + 模型名）
 *  - 三方一致性渐变条（绿 >66% · 金 40~66% · 珊瑚 <40%）
 *  - 第 2 轮 交叉批判 3 条（注明"谁批谁"，默认折叠）
 *  - 第 3 轮 中立裁判全文
 *  - 少数派报告（平均相似度最低方，自动产生）
 */
@Composable
fun DebatePanel(
    result: DebateResult?,
    busy: Boolean,
    phase: Int,
    modelNames: Triple<String, String, String>,
    online: Boolean,
    topic: String,
    onTopicChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onRerun: () -> Unit,
    onCancel: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    GlowBox(
        glow = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
        intensity = if (busy) 0.9f else 0.35f,
        radius = 260.dp,
        modifier = modifier.fillMaxSize()
    ) {
        Surface(
            color = Veil.copy(alpha = 0.55f),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(20.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        ) {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp)) {
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    DebateIcon(26)
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Text(t("debate_title"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge, color = TextHigh)
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Text(
                        if (online) "NIM · DeepSeek / Llama / Mistral" else t("debate_offline"),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = MoonSilver
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.weight(1f))
                    if (busy) {
                        Text(
                            when (phase) {
                                1 -> t("debate_short_1")
                                2 -> t("debate_short_2")
                                else -> t("debate_short_3")
                            },
                            style = SubtitleStyle,
                            color = MoonSilver
                        )
                    }
                }

                if (busy) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(14.dp))
                    Box(
                        Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .height(2.dp)
                            .background(Mist.copy(alpha = 0.5f), RoundedCornerShape(1.dp))
                    ) {
                        val progress by animateFloatAsState(
                            targetValue = (phase.coerceIn(0, 3) / 3f).coerceIn(0.05f, 1f),
                            animationSpec = Motion.standard,
                            label = "debateProgress"
                        )
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth(progress)
                                .fillMaxHeight()
                                .background(
                                    Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(Phantom, Aureate)),
                                    RoundedCornerShape(1.dp)
                                )
                        )
                    }
                }

                // ---- 议题行：自定义议题 + 重新辩论 / 取消 ----
                Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Box(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        TextField(
                            value = topic,
                            onValueChange = onTopicChange,
                            singleLine = true,
                            placeholder = { Text(t("debate_topic_ph"), color = MoonSilver.copy(alpha = 0.6f)) },
                            shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                            colors = TextFieldDefaults.colors(
                                focusedContainerColor = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                                unfocusedContainerColor = Mist.copy(alpha = 0.22f),
                                focusedIndicatorColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                                unfocusedIndicatorColor = Mist,
                                cursorColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                            ),
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                    Surface(
                        color = if (busy) Coral.copy(alpha = 0.16f) else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.14f),
                        shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable { if (busy) onCancel() else onRerun() }
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            if (busy) t("debate_cancel") else t("debate_rerun"),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge,
                            color = if (busy) Coral else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))

                if (result == null && !busy) {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                            RotatingLogo(size = 140.dp, alpha = 0.35f)
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(24.dp))
                            Text(t("debate_waiting_title"), style = SubtitleStyle, color = MoonSilver)
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                            Text(
                                t("debate_waiting_sub"),
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                                color = TextMid
                            )
                        }
                    }
                } else if (result != null) {
                    // ---- 第 1 轮：提案（三栏，流式滑入） ----
                    Text(
                        t("debate_phase_1"),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                        color = TextHigh,
                        modifier = Modifier.floatIn(distanceDp = 12.dp)
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                        val proposals = listOf(result.proposerA, result.proposerB, result.proposerC)
                        val names = listOf(modelNames.first, modelNames.second, modelNames.third)
                        proposals.forEachIndexed { i, proposal ->
                            Box(
                                Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .floatIn(delayMillis = i * 60, distanceDp = 12.dp)
                                    .background(Veil.copy(alpha = 0.6f), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                                    .padding(14.dp)
                            ) {
                                Column {
                                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                        Canvas(Modifier.size(14.dp)) {
                                            drawCircle(
                                                debateAvatars[i].copy(alpha = 0.35f),
                                                radius = size.minDimension / 2f
                                            )
                                            drawCircle(
                                                debateAvatars[i],
                                                radius = size.minDimension / 3.4f,
                                                center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f)
                                            )
                                        }
                                        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                                        Text(names[i], style = TimestampStyle, color = MoonSilver)
                                    }
                                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                                    Text(proposal, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // ---- 三方一致性（连续值渐变条） ----
                    if (result.agreement >= 0.0) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Text(t("debate_agreement"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall, color = TextHigh)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                            Box(
                                Modifier
                                    .weight(1f)
                                    .height(6.dp)
                                    .background(Mist.copy(alpha = 0.4f), RoundedCornerShape(3.dp))
                            ) {
                                val frac by animateFloatAsState(
                                    targetValue = result.agreement.toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f),
                                    animationSpec = Motion.standard,
                                    label = "agreementBar"
                                )
                                Box(
                                    Modifier
                                        .fillMaxWidth(frac)
                                        .fillMaxHeight()
                                        .background(
                                            Brush.horizontalGradient(
                                                listOf(
                                    agreementColor(result.agreement).copy(alpha = 0.5f),
                                                    agreementColor(result.agreement)
                                                )
                                            ),
                                            RoundedCornerShape(3.dp)
                                        )
                                )
                            }
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(10.dp))
                            Text(
                                "${(result.agreement * 100).toInt()}%",
                                style = TimestampStyle,
                                color = agreementColor(result.agreement)
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    // ---- 第 2 轮：交叉批判（3 条，默认折叠） ----
                    if (result.critiques.isNotEmpty()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                        var showCritiques by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
                        Row(
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                            modifier = Modifier
                                .floatIn(distanceDp = 10.dp)
                                .clickable { showCritiques = !showCritiques; Feedback.tap() }
                        ) {
                            Text(t("debate_phase_2"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, color = TextHigh)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                            Text(
                                if (showCritiques) t("debate_collapse") else t("debate_expand"),
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                            )
                        }
                        AnimatedVisibility(
                            visible = showCritiques,
                            enter = expandVertically() + fadeIn(),
                            exit = shrinkVertically() + fadeOut()
                        ) {
                            Column(
                                Modifier.padding(top = 10.dp),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)
                            ) {
                                result.critiques.forEachIndexed { i, critique ->
                                    Box(
                                        Modifier
                                            .fillMaxWidth()
                                            .floatIn(delayMillis = i * 60, distanceDp = 8.dp)
                                            .background(Veil.copy(alpha = 0.5f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                            .padding(12.dp)
                                    ) {
                                        Text(critique, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextMid)
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // ---- 第 3 轮：中立裁决 ----
                    if (result.judge.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                        Text(
                            t("debate_phase_3"),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                            color = TextHigh,
                            modifier = Modifier.floatIn(distanceDp = 10.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .fillMaxWidth()
                                .floatIn(distanceDp = 12.dp)
                                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.copy(alpha = 0.08f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                .padding(14.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(result.judge, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)
                        }
                    }

                    // ---- 少数派报告 ----
                    if (result.minorityReport.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(12.dp))
                        Text(
                            t("debate_minority"),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall,
                            color = Coral,
                            modifier = Modifier.floatIn(distanceDp = 8.dp)
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(6.dp))
                        Box(
                            Modifier
                                .floatIn(distanceDp = 10.dp)
                                .background(Coral.copy(alpha = 0.10f), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                                .padding(12.dp)
                        ) {
                            Text(result.minorityReport, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextMid)
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    // busy 且尚无任何结果
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally) {
                            BreathingOrb(size = 96.dp)
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(18.dp))
                            Text(t("debate_running"), style = SubtitleStyle, color = MoonSilver)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

//  Developer Mode 第 2 批 UI（桌面）：
//  技术地图 / 周报 / 决策日志 + 回访 / 记录决策表单 / 召回块 / 技术 chips

private fun relativeTime(ts: Long): String {
    if (ts <= 0L) return ""
    val diff = currentTimeMillis() - ts
    return when {
        diff < 60_000 -> "刚刚"
        diff < 3_600_000 -> "${diff / 60_000} 分钟前"
        diff < 86_400_000 -> "${diff / 3_600_000} 小时前"
        else -> "${diff / 86_400_000} 天前"
    }
}

private fun formatDate(ts: Long): String =
    if (ts <= 0L) "—" else SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(ts))

/** 紧凑技术卡：3 秒可读完；打开时 seenCount +1。 */

        Surface(shape = CardShapes.techCard(), color = Veil.copy(alpha = 0.98f)) {
            Column(Modifier.width(460.dp).padding(22.dp)) {

                        color = Phantom,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .border(1.dp, Mist, RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))

                    )
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(10.dp))
                Text(card.whatItIs, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = TextHigh)

                }
                if (card.whenToUse.isNotBlank()) {
