    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFStartup(uint version, uint flags);
    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFShutdown();
    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFCreateAttributes(out IMFAttributes attrs, uint count);
    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFCreateMediaType(out IMFMediaType type);
    [DllImport("mfreadwrite.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    static extern int MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(string url, IMFAttributes attrs, out IMFSourceReader reader);

    /// <summary>从视频按时间均匀抽 count 帧到 outDir（PNG），返回实际帧数。</summary>
    public static int Grab(string video, string outDir, int count, int fps = 0)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(outDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
        int hr = MFStartup(MF_VERSION, 0);
        if (hr < 0) throw new Exception("MFStartup 0x" + hr.ToString("X8"));
        IMFAttributes attrs = null; IMFSourceReader reader = null;
        try
        {
            if (MFCreateAttributes(out attrs, 1) < 0) throw new Exception("MFCreateAttributes");
            attrs.SetUINT32(ref MF_SOURCE_READER_ENABLE_VIDEO_PROCESSING, 1);
            if (MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(video, attrs, out reader) < 0) throw new Exception("MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL");

            uint videoIndex = MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM;
            try { reader.SetStreamSelection(MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, false); } catch { }
            for (uint i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                IMFMediaType t;
                if (reader.GetCurrentMediaType(i, out t) < 0 || t == null) continue;
                Guid major;
                hr = t.GetMajorType(out major);
                bool isVideo = hr >= 0 && major.Data1 == MFMediaType_Video.Data1 &&
                    major.Data2 == MFMediaType_Video.Data2 && major.Data3 == MFMediaType_Video.Data3 &&
                    major.B0 == MFMediaType_Video.B0 && major.B1 == MFMediaType_Video.B1 &&
                    major.B2 == MFMediaType_Video.B2 && major.B3 == MFMediaType_Video.B3;
                if (isVideo) { videoIndex = i; break; }
            }
            if (videoIndex == MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM) throw new Exception("未找到视频流");
            reader.SetStreamSelection(videoIndex, true);

            IMFMediaType outType;
            MFCreateMediaType(out outType);
            var vguid = MFMediaType_Video; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, ref vguid);
            var rguid = MFVideoFormat_RGB32; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_SUBTYPE, ref rguid);
            hr = reader.SetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, IntPtr.Zero, outType);
            if (hr < 0) throw new Exception("SetCurrentMediaType(RGB32) 0x" + hr.ToString("X8"));

            IMFMediaType cur;
            reader.GetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, out cur);
            ulong frameSize;
            cur.GetUINT64(ref MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, out frameSize);
            int width = (int)(frameSize >> 32);
            int height = (int)(frameSize & 0xFFFFFFFF);
            if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new Exception("取帧尺寸失败");
            uint rot = 0; try { cur.GetUINT32(ref MF_MT_VIDEO_ROTATION, out rot); } catch { rot = 0; }

            PropVariant durPv;
            reader.GetPresentationAttribute(MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, ref MF_PD_DURATION, out durPv);
            double total = (durPv.vt == 20 || durPv.vt == 21) ? durPv.uhVal / 1e7 : 0.0;
            if (total <= 0.05)
            {
                // 时长属性不可用时：跳到远端读到最后样本的最大时间戳
                try
                {
                    var farPos = new PropVariant { vt = VT_I8, hVal = (long)(3600.0 * 1e7) };
                    var ng = new Guid();
                    reader.SetCurrentPosition(ref ng, ref farPos);
                    reader.Flush(videoIndex);
                    long maxTs = 0;
                    for (int g = 0; g < 5000; g++)
                    {
                        uint ai, sf; long ts; IMFSample s;
                        if (reader.ReadSample(videoIndex, 0, out ai, out sf, out ts, out s) < 0) break;
                        if (s == null) { if ((sf & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM) != 0) break; else continue; }
                        if (ts > maxTs) maxTs = ts;
                        Marshal.ReleaseComObject(s);
                    }
                    if (maxTs > 0) total = maxTs / 1e7;
                }
                catch { }
            }
            if (total <= 0.05) total = 60.0;

            int n = fps > 0 ? Math.Max(2, (int)Math.Round(total * fps)) : Math.Max(2, count);
            if (n > 4000) n = 4000;
            int saved = 0;
            var entries = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            {
                double sec = total * i / (n + 1.0);
                long target = (long)(sec * 1e7);
                var pos = new PropVariant { vt = VT_I8, hVal = target };
                var nullGuid = new Guid();
                reader.SetCurrentPosition(ref nullGuid, ref pos);
                reader.Flush(videoIndex);

                IMFSample sample = null; long ts = 0;
                for (int guard = 0; guard < 200; guard++)
                {
                    uint ai, sf; IMFSample s;
                    hr = reader.ReadSample(videoIndex, 0, out ai, out sf, out ts, out s);
                    if (hr < 0) break;
                    if (s == null)
                    {
                        if ((sf & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM) != 0) break;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (ts + 200000 >= target) { sample = s; break; }
                    // 否则丢弃，继续找 >= target 的帧
                }
                if (sample == null) continue;

                IMFMediaBuffer buf;
                sample.ConvertToContiguousBuffer(out buf);
                IntPtr ptr; int maxLen, curLen;
                buf.Lock(out ptr, out maxLen, out curLen);
                var bmp = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
                var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
                int rowBytes = width * 4;
                // MF RGB32 为自底向上：逐行翻转拷贝（末尾不足一行的按可用长度截断）
                for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
                {
                    IntPtr src = IntPtr.Add(ptr, (height - 1 - y) * rowBytes);
                    long offset = (long)(height - 1 - y) * rowBytes;
                    if (offset + rowBytes > curLen) break;
                    IntPtr dst = IntPtr.Add(bd.Scan0, y * bd.Stride);
                    CopyMemory(dst, src, rowBytes);
                }
                bmp.UnlockBits(bd);
                buf.Unlock();
                if (rot == 180) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone);
                else if (rot == 90) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipNone);
                else if (rot == 270) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone);
                string outPath = Path.Combine(outDir, "frame_" + i.ToString("D3") + ".png");
                bmp.Save(outPath, ImageFormat.Png);
                bmp.Dispose();
                entries.Add("{\"timestamp\":" + sec.ToString("0.###", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ",\"imagePath\":\"" + outPath.Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"}");
                saved++;
            }
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outDir, "frames.json"), "[" + string.Join(",", entries) + "]", new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
            return saved;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (reader != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(reader);
            if (attrs != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(attrs);
            MFShutdown();
        }
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", EntryPoint = "RtlMoveMemory")]
    static extern void CopyMemory(IntPtr dest, IntPtr src, int count);

    // Scene-keyframe extraction: sequential decode at fps; keep only changed frames.
    public static int GrabScenes(string video, string outDir, int fps, int diffBits = 8, int outWidth = 0)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(outDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
        int hr = MFStartup(MF_VERSION, 0);
        if (hr < 0) throw new Exception("MFStartup fail");
        IMFAttributes attrs = null; IMFSourceReader reader = null;
        try
        {
            MFCreateAttributes(out attrs, 1);
            attrs.SetUINT32(ref MF_SOURCE_READER_ENABLE_VIDEO_PROCESSING, 1);
            if (MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(video, attrs, out reader) < 0) throw new Exception("reader fail");
            uint videoIndex = MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM;
            try { reader.SetStreamSelection(MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, false); } catch { }
            for (uint i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                IMFMediaType t;
                if (reader.GetCurrentMediaType(i, out t) < 0 || t == null) continue;
                Guid major; if (t.GetMajorType(out major) >= 0 && SameGuid(major, MFMediaType_Video)) { videoIndex = i; break; }
            }
            if (videoIndex == MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM) throw new Exception("no video stream");
            reader.SetStreamSelection(videoIndex, true);
            IMFMediaType outType; MFCreateMediaType(out outType);
            var vg = MFMediaType_Video; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, ref vg);
            var rg = MFVideoFormat_RGB32; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_SUBTYPE, ref rg);
            if (reader.SetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, IntPtr.Zero, outType) < 0) throw new Exception("RGB32 fail");
            IMFMediaType cur; reader.GetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, out cur);
            ulong fs; cur.GetUINT64(ref MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, out fs);
            int width = (int)(fs >> 32), height = (int)(fs & 0xFFFFFFFF);
            uint rot = 0; try { cur.GetUINT32(ref MF_MT_VIDEO_ROTATION, out rot); } catch { rot = 0; }

            double step = 1e7 / Math.Max(1, fps);
            long lastSample = long.MinValue;
            ulong prevHash = 0;
            int saved = 0;
            var entries = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            var inv = System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

            for (int guard = 0; guard < 5000000; guard++)
            {
                uint ai, sf; long ts; IMFSample s;
                if (reader.ReadSample(videoIndex, 0, out ai, out sf, out ts, out s) < 0) break;
                if (s == null) { if ((sf & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM) != 0) break; else continue; }
                if (lastSample == long.MinValue || ts - lastSample >= (long)step)
                {
                    lastSample = ts;
                    IMFMediaBuffer buf; s.ConvertToContiguousBuffer(out buf);
                    IntPtr ptr; int maxLen, curLen; buf.Lock(out ptr, out maxLen, out curLen);
                    ulong h = HashFrame(ptr, curLen, width, height);
                    bool changed = diffBits < 0 || prevHash == 0 || Hamming(h, prevHash) > diffBits;
                    if (changed)
                    {
                        prevHash = h;
                        bool ok; var bmp = BuildBitmap(ptr, curLen, width, height, rot, out ok);
                        if (ok)
                        {
                            string outPath = Path.Combine(outDir, "frame_" + (saved + 1).ToString("D4") + ".jpg");
                            if (outWidth > 0 && outWidth < width) { var sb = Scale(bmp, outWidth); bmp.Dispose(); SaveJpeg(sb, outPath); sb.Dispose(); }
                            else { SaveJpeg(bmp, outPath); bmp.Dispose(); }
                            double sec = ts / 1e7;
                            entries.Add("{\"timestamp\":" + sec.ToString("0.###", inv) + ",\"imagePath\":\"" + outPath.Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"}");
                            saved++;
                        }
                    }
                    buf.Unlock(); Marshal.ReleaseComObject(buf);
                }
                Marshal.ReleaseComObject(s);
            }
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outDir, "frames.json"), "[" + string.Join(",", entries) + "]", new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
            return saved;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (reader != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(reader);
            if (attrs != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(attrs);
            MFShutdown();
        }
    }

    static bool SameGuid(Guid a, Guid b) { return a.Data1 == b.Data1 && a.Data2 == b.Data2 && a.Data3 == b.Data3 && a.B0 == b.B0 && a.B1 == b.B1 && a.B2 == b.B2 && a.B3 == b.B3; }

    static int Hamming(ulong a, ulong b) { ulong x = a ^ b; int c = 0; while (x != 0) { c += (int)(x & 1); x >>= 1; } return c; }

    static ulong HashFrame(IntPtr ptr, int len, int width, int height)
    {
        int rowBytes = width * 4;
        ulong hash = 0;
        long sum = 0; var cell = new long[64];
        for (int cy = 0; cy < 8; cy++)
            for (int cx = 0; cx < 8; cx++)
            {
                int x0 = cx * width / 8, x1 = Math.Max(x0 + 1, (cx + 1) * width / 8);
                int y0 = cy * height / 8, y1 = Math.Max(y0 + 1, (cy + 1) * height / 8);
                long acc = 0; int n = 0;
                for (int y = y0; y < y1; y += 2)
                    for (int x = x0; x < x1; x += 2)
                    {
                        long off = (long)(height - 1 - y) * rowBytes + x * 4;
                        if (off + 3 >= len) continue;
                        byte bb = Marshal.ReadByte(ptr, (int)off);
                        byte gg = Marshal.ReadByte(ptr, (int)(off + 1));
                        byte rr = Marshal.ReadByte(ptr, (int)(off + 2));
                        acc += (rr * 3 + gg * 6 + bb) / 10; n++;
                    }
                cell[cy * 8 + cx] = n > 0 ? acc / n : 0; sum += cell[cy * 8 + cx];
            }
        long mean = sum / 64;
        for (int k = 0; k < 64; k++) if (cell[k] >= mean) hash |= (1UL << k);
        return hash;
    }

    static Bitmap BuildBitmap(IntPtr ptr, int curLen, int width, int height, uint rot, out bool ok)
    {
        ok = false;
        int rowBytes = width * 4;
        if (curLen < rowBytes) return null;
        var bmp = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
        var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
        {
            long off = (long)(height - 1 - y) * rowBytes;
            if (off + rowBytes > curLen) break;
            CopyMemory(IntPtr.Add(bd.Scan0, y * bd.Stride), IntPtr.Add(ptr, (int)off), rowBytes);
        }
        bmp.UnlockBits(bd);
        if (rot == 180) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone);
        else if (rot == 90) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipNone);
        else if (rot == 270) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone);
        ok = true;
        return bmp;
    }

    static Bitmap Scale(Bitmap src, int w)
    {
        int h = Math.Max(1, src.Height * w / src.Width);
        var dst = new Bitmap(w, h);
        using (var g = Graphics.FromImage(dst))
        {
            g.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.HighQualityBilinear;
            g.DrawImage(src, 0, 0, w, h);
        }
        return dst;
    }

    static void SaveJpeg(Bitmap bmp, string path)
    {
        var codec = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageEncoders().First(c => c.FormatID == ImageFormat.Jpeg.Guid);
        using (var ep = new EncoderParameters(1))
        {
            ep.Param[0] = new EncoderParameter(Encoder.Quality, 85L);
            bmp.Save(path, codec, ep);
        }
    }
}

param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path, [string]$Out)

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime | Out-Null

$asTaskGeneric = ([System.WindowsRuntimeSystemExtensions].GetMethods() | Where-Object {
    $_.Name -eq 'AsTask' -and $_.GetParameters().Count -eq 1 -and $_.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType.Name -eq 'IAsyncOperation`1'
})[0]

function Await($WinRtTask, $ResultType) {
    $asTask = $asTaskGeneric.MakeGenericMethod($ResultType)
    $netTask = $asTask.Invoke($null, @($WinRtTask))
    $netTask.Wait(-1) | Out-Null
    $netTask.Result
}

[Windows.Storage.StorageFile, Windows.Storage, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Graphics.Imaging.BitmapDecoder, Windows.Graphics.Imaging, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.Ocr.OcrEngine, Windows.Foundation, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null

$file = Await ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile]::GetFileFromPathAsync($Path)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile])
$stream = Await ($file.OpenAsync([Windows.Storage.FileAccessMode]::Read)) ([Windows.Storage.Streams.IRandomAccessStream])
$decoder = Await ([Windows.Graphics.Imaging.BitmapDecoder]::CreateAsync($stream)) ([Windows.Graphics.Imaging.BitmapDecoder])
$bitmap = Await ($decoder.GetSoftwareBitmapAsync()) ([Windows.Graphics.Imaging.SoftwareBitmap])

$engine = [Windows.Media.Ocr.OcrEngine]::TryCreateFromUserProfileLanguages()
if ($null -eq $engine) {
    $lang = New-Object Windows.Globalization.Language "zh-Hans-CN"
    $engine = [Windows.Media.Ocr.OcrEngine]::TryCreateFromLanguage($lang)
}
if ($null -eq $engine) { Write-Output "__OCR_NO_ENGINE__"; exit 2 }

$result = Await ($engine.RecognizeAsync($bitmap)) ([Windows.Media.Ocr.OcrResult])
if ($Out) {
    $utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Out, $result.Text, $utf8NoBom)
} else {
    Write-Output $result.Text
}
desktopApp/src/main/resources/transcribe.ps1 (3.4KB)
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Wav,
    [string]$Out,
    [string]$Culture = "zh-CN"
)

# 使用 Windows 内置语音识别（System.Speech）进行本地转写，全程离线。
# 自行解析 WAV 的 fmt/data 块并以原始 PCM 喂给识别引擎，兼容带 JUNK 等额外块的 WAV。
# 输出：List<TranscriptSegment> 的 JSON，字段 start/end/text/speaker。

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech

if (-not (Test-Path $Wav)) {
    Write-Error "WAV not found: $Wav"
    exit 2
}

$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Wav)
if ($bytes.Length -lt 44) {
    Write-Error "WAV too small: $Wav"
    exit 2
}

$pos = 12
$audioFormat = $null
$channels = 0
$sampleRate = 0
$bitsPerSample = 0
$dataOffset = -1
$dataLength = 0

while ($pos -le $bytes.Length - 8) {
    $id = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes, $pos, 4)
    $size = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, $pos + 4)
    if ($id -eq 'fmt ') {
        $audioFormat = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, $pos + 8)
        $channels = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, $pos + 10)
        $sampleRate = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, $pos + 12)
        $bitsPerSample = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, $pos + 22)
    } elseif ($id -eq 'data') {
        $dataOffset = $pos + 8
        $dataLength = $size
        break
    }
    $pos += 8 + $size + ($size % 2)
}

if ($null -eq $audioFormat -or $dataOffset -lt 0) {
    Write-Error "WAV missing fmt/data chunk: $Wav"
    exit 2
}
if ($audioFormat -ne 1) {
    Write-Error ("Unsupported audio format " + $audioFormat + " (only PCM). Convert to 16kHz mono PCM WAV.")
    exit 3
}

$bitsEnum = if ($bitsPerSample -eq 8) { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioBitsPerSample]::Eight } else { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioBitsPerSample]::Sixteen }
$chEnum = if ($channels -eq 1) { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioChannel]::Mono } else { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioChannel]::Stereo }
$audioFormatInfo = New-Object System.Speech.AudioFormat.SpeechAudioFormatInfo($sampleRate, $bitsEnum, $chEnum)

$data = New-Object byte[] $dataLength
[Array]::Copy($bytes, $dataOffset, $data, 0, $dataLength)
$stream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
$stream.Write($data, 0, $data.Length)
$stream.Position = 0

$ci = New-Object System.Globalization.CultureInfo($Culture)
try {
    $engine = New-Object System.Speech.Recognition.SpeechRecognitionEngine($ci)
} catch {
    Write-Error "No System.Speech recognizer for culture '$Culture': $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 4
}

$engine.LoadGrammar((New-Object System.Speech.Recognition.DictationGrammar))
$engine.SetInputToAudioStream($stream, $audioFormatInfo)

$segments = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$cursor = 0.0
$i = 0
while ($i -lt 10000) {
    $r = $null
    try { $r = $engine.Recognize() } catch { break }
    if ($null -eq $r) { break }

    $dur = 0.0
    try { $dur = $r.Audio.Duration.TotalSeconds } catch { }

    $null = $segments.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        start   = $cursor
        end     = $cursor + $dur
        text    = $r.Text
        speaker = $null
    })
    $cursor += $dur
    $i++
}
$engine.Dispose()
$stream.Dispose()

$json = if ($segments.Count -eq 0) { "[]" } else { $segments | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 }
if (-not $json.TrimStart().StartsWith("[")) { $json = "[$json]" }

$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
if ($Out) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Out, $json, $utf8NoBom)
} else {
    Write-Output $json
}
desktopApp/src/main/resources/video_to_wav.ps1 (2.8KB)
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Video,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Wav
)

# 用 Windows 内置 MediaTranscoder（WinRT）把视频音轨提取为
# 16kHz / 单声道 / 16-bit PCM WAV，供 System.Speech 转写。
# 全程离线，无需 ffmpeg。

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime | Out-Null

$asTaskGeneric = ([System.WindowsRuntimeSystemExtensions].GetMethods() | Where-Object {
    $_.Name -eq 'AsTask' -and $_.GetParameters().Count -eq 1 -and $_.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType.Name -eq 'IAsyncOperation`1'
})[0]
$asTaskActionProgress = ([System.WindowsRuntimeSystemExtensions].GetMethods() | Where-Object {
    $_.Name -eq 'AsTask' -and $_.GetParameters().Count -eq 1 -and $_.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType.Name -eq 'IAsyncActionWithProgress`1'
})[0]

function AwaitOp($op, $t) {
    $task = $asTaskGeneric.MakeGenericMethod($t).Invoke($null, @($op))
    $task.Wait(-1) | Out-Null
    $task.Result
}
function AwaitActionProgress($act, $t) {
    $task = $asTaskActionProgress.MakeGenericMethod($t).Invoke($null, @($act))
    $task.Wait(-1) | Out-Null
}

[Windows.Storage.StorageFile, Windows.Storage, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Storage.StorageFolder, Windows.Storage, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.Transcoding.MediaTranscoder, Windows.Media.Transcoding, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.MediaProperties.MediaEncodingProfile, Windows.Media.MediaProperties, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.MediaProperties.AudioEncodingProperties, Windows.Media.MediaProperties, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null

if (-not (Test-Path $Video)) {
    Write-Error "Video not found: $Video"
    exit 2
}

$inFile = AwaitOp ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile]::GetFileFromPathAsync($Video)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile])
$wavDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Wav)
$wavName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Wav)
$folder = AwaitOp ([Windows.Storage.StorageFolder]::GetFolderFromPathAsync($wavDir)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFolder])
$outFile = AwaitOp ($folder.CreateFileAsync($wavName, [Windows.Storage.CreationCollisionOption]::ReplaceExisting)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile])

$profile = [Windows.Media.MediaProperties.MediaEncodingProfile]::CreateWav([Windows.Media.MediaProperties.AudioEncodingQuality]::Medium)
$pcm = [Windows.Media.MediaProperties.AudioEncodingProperties]::CreatePcm(16000, 1, 16)
$profile.Audio = $pcm

$transcoder = [Windows.Media.Transcoding.MediaTranscoder]::new()
$prep = AwaitOp ($transcoder.PrepareFileTranscodeAsync($inFile, $outFile, $profile)) ([Windows.Media.Transcoding.PrepareTranscodeResult])

if (-not $prep.CanTranscode) {
    Write-Output ("CANNOT_TRANSCODE reason=" + $prep.FailureReason)
    exit 3
}

AwaitActionProgress ($prep.TranscodeAsync()) ([Double])
Write-Output ("WAV_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $Wav).Length)

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.media.VideoFrameExtractor
import java.io.File
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/**
 * 验证视频抽帧 + OCR（Windows 内置）。
 * 若系统拒绝 Java 创建 PowerShell 进程，则跳过（环境限制）。

class VideoFrameExtractorTest {

    @Test
    fun testExtractFrameAndOcr() {
        if (!VideoFrameExtractor.isWindows()) return
        val resource = javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/sample_av.mp4") ?: return
        val mp4 = File.createTempFile("learnagent_vfe", ".mp4")
        val outDir = File(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir"), "learnagent_frames_${System.nanoTime()}")
        try {
            resource.use { input -> mp4.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }
            val frames = try {
                VideoFrameExtractor.extractAndOcr(mp4, outDir)
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                println("SKIP_ENV: 系统拒绝 Java 创建 PowerShell 进程，跳过抽帧测试: ${e.message}")

            } catch (e: IllegalStateException) {

                return

            assertTrue(frames.all { File(it.imagePath).isFile }, "每帧图片都应存在")
            println("FRAME_OCR=" + frames.joinToString { "[${it.timestamp}] '${it.text}'" })
        } finally {
            mp4.delete()
            outDir.deleteRecursively()
        }
    }

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.media.VideoToWav
import java.io.File
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/**
 * 验证离线视频→WAV 提取（Windows MediaTranscoder）。
 * 测试用视频来自 src/test/resources/sample_av.mp4（含音轨）。
 */
class VideoToWavTest {

    @Test
    fun testExtractAudioFromMp4() {
        if (!VideoToWav.isWindows()) return
        val resource = javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/sample_av.mp4") ?: return
        val mp4 = File.createTempFile("learnagent_sample", ".mp4")
        val wav = File.createTempFile("learnagent_sample", ".wav")
        try {
            resource.use { input -> mp4.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }
            assertTrue(VideoToWav.isVideo(mp4), "应识别为视频")
            val ok = try {
                VideoToWav.extractAudio(mp4, wav)
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                println("SKIP_ENV: 系统拒绝 Java 创建 PowerShell 进程，跳过视频抽音频测试: ${e.message}")
                return
            }
            assertTrue(ok, "应成功提取音频")

            val bytes = wav.readBytes()
            assertEquals("RIFF", String(bytes.copyOfRange(0, 4)), "应为 RIFF WAV")
            assertEquals("WAVE", String(bytes.copyOfRange(8, 12)), "应为 WAVE")

            // 解析 fmt 块，断言 1ch / 16000 / 16bit
            var pos = 12
            var channels = -1
            var sampleRate = -1
            var bits = -1
            while (pos <= bytes.size - 8) {
                val id = String(bytes.copyOfRange(pos, pos + 4))
                val size = leInt(bytes, pos + 4)
                if (id == "fmt ") {
                    channels = leShort(bytes, pos + 10)
                    sampleRate = leInt(bytes, pos + 12)
                    bits = leShort(bytes, pos + 22)
                }
                if (id == "data") break
                pos += 8 + size + (size % 2)
            }
            assertEquals(1, channels, "应为单声道")
            assertEquals(16000, sampleRate, "应为 16kHz")
            assertEquals(16, bits, "应为 16-bit")
            println("VIDEO_TO_WAV bytes=${wav.length()} ch=$channels sr=$sampleRate bits=$bits")
        } finally {
            mp4.delete()
            wav.delete()
        }
    }

    private fun leShort(b: ByteArray, o: Int): Int =
        (b[o].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((b[o + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8)

    private fun leInt(b: ByteArray, o: Int): Int =
        (b[o].toInt() and 0xFF) or ((b[o + 1].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 8) or
            ((b[o + 2].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 16) or ((b[o + 3].toInt() and 0xFF) shl 24)
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.asr.WindowsTranscriber
import java.io.File
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/**
 * 端到端验证真实语音转写：
 * 用系统 TTS 合成一段中文语音，再用 WindowsTranscriber 离线识别，
 * 断言产生了带时间段的转写结果。
 *
 * 说明：若当前系统策略禁止 Java 创建 PowerShell 子进程（CreateProcess error=5），
 * 则跳过该集成测试（不影响单元测试套件的通过）。
 */
class WindowsTranscriberTest {

    private fun powershellPath(): String {
        val root = System.getenv("SystemRoot") ?: "C:\\Windows"
        val full = File(root, "System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe")
        return if (full.isFile) full.absolutePath else "powershell.exe"
    }

    private fun startWithRetry(args: List<String>): Process {
        var last: java.io.IOException? = null
        for (attempt in 0 until 3) {
            try {
                return ProcessBuilder(args).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
            } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
                last = e
                Thread.sleep(300L * (attempt + 1))
            }
        }
        throw last!!
    }

    private fun synthesize(text: String): File {
        val wav = File.createTempFile("learnagent_tts", ".wav")
        val script = File.createTempFile("learnagent_tts", ".ps1")
        val resource = javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/tts.ps1") ?: error("缺少 tts.ps1")
        resource.use { input -> script.outputStream().use { input.copyTo(it) } }

        val process = startWithRetry(
            listOf(
                powershellPath(), "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
                "-File", script.absolutePath, "-Out", wav.absolutePath, "-Text", text
            )
        )
        val log = process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
        val exit = process.waitFor()
        script.delete()
        check(exit == 0) { "TTS 失败: $log" }
        return wav
    }

    @Test
    fun testTranscribeSynthesizedSpeech() {
        if (!WindowsTranscriber.isWindows()) return
        val wav = try {
            synthesize("今天天气很好")
        } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
            println("SKIP_ENV: 系统拒绝 Java 创建 PowerShell 进程，跳过转写集成测试: ${e.message}")
            return
        }
        try {
            val segments = WindowsTranscriber.transcribe(wav)
            assertTrue(segments.isNotEmpty(), "应至少转写出一段")
            assertTrue(segments.any { it.end > it.start }, "应包含有效时间段")
            assertTrue(segments.any { it.text.isNotBlank() }, "转写文本不应为空")
            println("TRANSCRIBE_RESULT=" + segments.joinToString { "[${it.start}-${it.end}]${it.text}" })
        } catch (e: java.io.IOException) {
            println("SKIP_ENV: 系统拒绝 Java 创建 PowerShell 进程，跳过转写集成测试: ${e.message}")
        } finally {
            wav.delete()
        }
    }
}

<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Mentara — 仓库预览（离线）</title></head><body style="background:#0d1117;color:#e6edf3;font-family:Segoe UI,Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif;max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:32px;line-height:1.7"><div align="center">

<h1>Mentara
</h1>

<b>Turn any lecture video into clean, cited study notes — on mobile & desktop.</b>
<b>把任何网课视频变成干净、可溯源的学习笔记 —— 手机 + 桌面双端。</b>

<span style="display:inline-block;background:#21262d;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px;margin:2px">Build</span>
<span style="display:inline-block;background:#21262d;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px;margin:2px">License</span>
<span style="display:inline-block;background:#21262d;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px;margin:2px">Platform</span>
<span style="display:inline-block;background:#21262d;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px;margin:2px">Kotlin</span>
<span style="display:inline-block;background:#21262d;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:12px;margin:2px">PRs</span>

</div>

---

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Demo
</h2>

<blockquote style="border-left:3px solid #30363d;padding-left:12px;color:#8b949e">Screenshots coming — placeholders for the first release.
</blockquote>

| Parse & Timeline | Debate (3 models) | Notes output |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| <img src="demo-1.png" alt="demo-1" style="max-width:48%;margin:4px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #30363d"> | <img src="demo-2.png" alt="demo-2" style="max-width:48%;margin:4px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #30363d"> | <img src="demo-3.png" alt="demo-3" style="max-width:48%;margin:4px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #30363d"> |

---

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Features
</h2>

<div>• <b>Ingest everything, everywhere</b> — Import a lecture video (mp4/mkv/…), Mentara extracts 16 kHz mono audio and slices frames on-device.
</div>
<div>• <b>1 fps + perceptual dedup</b> — Frames are compared via a 32×32 grayscale signature; ≥90 % similar frames skip OCR entirely. Slide decks stop burning your CPU.
</div>
<div>• <b>Multimodal parse pipeline</b> — Speech (SenseVoice) and screen text (ML Kit OCR) are merged into one timeline <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">[mm:ss] speech | screen</code>.
</div>
<div>• <b>SenseVoice, offline & bundled</b> — Chinese ASR (CER ≈ 5 % class) runs fully on-device via <a href="https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx" style="color:#58a6ff"><code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">sherpa-onnx</code></a>. No account, no cloud, no heat.
</div>
<div>• <b>Garbage-in firewall</b> — Regex pre-filters strip OCR garbage (player overlays, <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">TTTT</code> repeats, <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">TRACE</code>-style noise) and ASR hallucinations (<code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">my when when when</code>) *before* any LLM sees them.
</div>
<div>• <b>Vision proofreading (see-the-picture, fix-the-words)</b> — A VLM re-reads each screenshot and corrects the OCR text against what is *actually* on screen.
</div>
<div>• <b>Consensus correction, chunked</b> — A second pass rewrites the merged transcript in 2 500-char chunks (no timeouts): typos fixed, repetition removed, Simplified-Chinese-only enforced, "no inventing" enforced.
</div>
<div>• <b>Timeline as first-class UI</b> — The video and its parsed timeline live in the same pane; tap any line to jump and keep playing.
</div>
<div>• <b>Permanent knowledge base</b> — Every parse writes <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">skill.md</code> (full archive) + notes; later Q&A answers with *your own video* as context, across videos.
</div>
<div>• <b>3-model debate, background-proof</b> — Kimi / DeepSeek / GLM debate with per-seat fallback, phase checkmarks, elapsed timer; leaves the foreground without cancelling.
</div>
<div>• <b>Built to be left alone</b> — Foreground service + wake-lock keep long parses alive with the screen off; screen stays on during parsing if you prefer.
</div>
<div>• <b>Dual-platform, one core</b> — All domain logic lives in <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">shared/</code> (Kotlin Multiplatform). Android and Windows are thin UI shells.
</div>

---

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Architecture
</h2>

<pre style="background:#161b22;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;overflow:auto">shared/       Kotlin Multiplatform core — parser, ASR routing, OCR firewall,
              merge, consensus correction, debate engine, storage contracts
androidApp/   Jetpack Compose UI + sherpa-onnx (SenseVoice) + ML Kit OCR
desktopApp/   Compose Desktop UI + Windows media/OCR toolchain
</pre>

<blockquote style="border-left:3px solid #30363d;padding-left:12px;color:#8b949e">Why not <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">/android</code> and <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">/windows</code> side-by-side folders? Because every line of
</blockquote>
<blockquote style="border-left:3px solid #30363d;padding-left:12px;color:#8b949e">domain logic is shared through KMP — duplicating it per platform would be an
</blockquote>
<blockquote style="border-left:3px solid #30363d;padding-left:12px;color:#8b949e">anti-pattern. This three-module monorepo is the industry-standard layout for
</blockquote>
<blockquote style="border-left:3px solid #30363d;padding-left:12px;color:#8b949e">dual-platform Kotlin projects.
</blockquote>

---

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Build
</h2>

<b>Requirements</b>: JDK 17+, Android SDK (compileSdk 35), NDK 25.2+, CMake 3.22+

<pre style="background:#161b22;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;overflow:auto"># 1) fetch the on-device ASR model once (~228 MB, hf-mirror)
powershell -File scripts/fetch-sensevoice-model.ps1

<h1>2) Android APK
</h1>
./gradlew :androidApp:assembleDebug

<h1>3) Windows desktop
</h1>
./gradlew :desktopApp:build

<h1>4) tests
</h1>
./gradlew :shared:jvmTest
</pre>

<h3>Configuration
</h3>

Runtime configuration (API keys, model choice) is entered <b>inside the app</b> —
nothing is hard-coded, nothing is committed. Local machine paths live in
<code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">local.properties</code> (git-ignored).

---

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Known Issues
</h2>

We ship honesty with the code:

<div>• <b>OCR garbage in extreme scenes</b> — heavy subtitle burn-in, low-contrast text
</div>
  and rapid scene cuts can still yield artifacts. The regex firewall and VLM
  proofreading reduce this heavily, but are not (yet) bulletproof.
<div>• <b>High-concurrency parsing is limited</b> — the on-device pipeline processes one
</div>
  video at a time by design; parallel Whisper/SenseVoice long-form inference is
  out of scope for phone-class hardware.
<div>• <b>First-run install cost</b> — the bundled SenseVoice model adds ~210 MB to the
</div>
  APK and a one-time ~600 MB free-space requirement during install.
<div>• <b>Long lectures are slow on low-end devices</b> — a 78-minute lecture with full
</div>
  VLM proofreading is measured in tens of minutes.

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Roadmap
</h2>

<div>&#9744; Stronger garbage regex bank + per-frame UI-region detection
</div>
<div>&#9744; Obsidian plugin / vault sync (notes with <code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">[[links]]</code> and timestamps)
</div>
<div>&#9744; Abstract the dual-platform cores behind a single interface layer
</div>
<div>&#9744; Subtitle burn-in export (<code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px">.srt</code> from ASR timeline)
</div>
<div>&#9744; Batch queue: learn a whole course overnight
</div>

---

<h2 style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;padding-bottom:6px">Join Us
</h2>

<blockquote style="border-left:3px solid #30363d;padding-left:12px;color:#8b949e">I am a 17-year-old independent developer. 这是我从 0 到 1 的探索。代码可能不够完美，但双端同步的架构正在快速迭代。Issues and PRs are welcome.
</blockquote>

Working on something adjacent — on-device ASR, multimodal parsing, learning tools? Open an Issue. I read everything, and the code is the resume.

# 评测体系（eval）

## 黄金测试集

- 位置：`shared/src/jvmTest/resources/golden_set.json`（同时保存于 `eval/golden_set.json`）
- 共 **20 题**，每题：`question` + `expect`（答案中应出现的关键词；无匹配题期望“未提及”）

覆盖：语音命中、画面文字命中（OCR）、以及无匹配。

## 运行评测

```bash
gradle-dist/gradle-8.10/bin/gradle.bat :shared:jvmTest --offline --no-daemon --tests "com.learnagent.EvaluationTest"
```

用例 `com.learnagent.EvaluationTest#testGoldenSetAccuracy`，逐题结果与 `EVAL_ACCURACY`
见 `shared/build/test-results/jvmTest/TEST-com.learnagent.EvaluationTest.xml` 的 `system-out`。

## 备注

LocalQaEngine 同时拼接语音与画面文字，因此仅存在于 OCR 文本中的关键词
（如“学习率”“图像识别”“负梯度”“CNN”）也能被正确回答。

# Mentara V3 Benchmark Report

- 日期：2026-10-05 21:01:27
- 设备：Windows 10 专业版 10.0.19045 | CPU: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2676 v3 @ 2.40GHz | GPU: AMD Radeon RX 580 2048SP | JVM 21.0.5 (jdk-temp) | Compose Desktop/Skia

## 结果

| 项目 | 分数 | 达标 | 数据来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 启动耗时 | 2132 ms | PASS（< 3000 ms） | 实跑 session A（main → 首帧 withFrameNanos） |
| 平均帧时间 | 17.45 ms（57.3 fps） | **MISS**（目标 < 16.7 ms） | 60 秒 withFrameNanos 采样，如实记录 |
| 粒子 80 压测 | 57.8 fps | PASS（> 50 fps） | 实跑 session B（80 粒子，测后已改回默认） |
| ASR WER | SKIP | — | 缺少真实英文音频测试集（eval/benchmark/asr 不存在，仓库无音频样本） |
| OCR CER | SKIP | — | 缺少真实英文图片测试集（eval/benchmark/ocr 不存在） |
| 语义识别准确率 | 100%（20/20） | PASS（> 90%） | eval/golden_set.json 黄金集 20 题，实跑 EvaluationTest（本地检索引擎，离线） |
| 语境识别准确率 | SKIP | — | 缺少语境分类测试集（20 段“定义/例子/推导/结论”标注不存在） |

## 跑分闸门（本轮由用户指示跳过闸门，仅如实记录）

- 识别类 4 项：1 项实测达标（语义）+ 3 项 SKIP → 未满足“至少 2 项达标”（不编造）
- 性能类 3 项：2 项达标（启动、粒子 80）+ 1 项未达标（平均帧 17.45ms）→ 满足“至少 2 项达标”

## 环境限制说明

1. 无真实英文音频/图片/语境标注数据集，ASR / OCR / 语境跑分无法执行，标 SKIP 而非编造。
2. 语义跑分为本地关键词检索引擎（LocalQaEngine，无 LLM、无网络），非大模型语义理解；配置 NVIDIA API Key 后可复跑 RemoteQaEngine 版本。
3. 帧采样在窗口空闲动画（DynamicBackground 常驻动画）下进行，60 秒窗口；未做 GPU 层细分。
4. 粒子压测通过临时开关强制 80 粒子完成，已改回默认（随内容量变化，基准 36）。

package com.learnagent.mcp

import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.LocalQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.ExperienceStore
import com.learnagent.core.ProblemOrientedSearch
import com.learnagent.core.ProblemParser
import com.learnagent.core.TechDecisionService
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.CodeSnippet
import com.learnagent.data.Decision
import com.learnagent.data.Experience
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put
import kotlinx.serialization.json.putJsonObject
import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.InputStreamReader
import java.io.PrintStream

/**
 * 最小 MCP server（stdio，JSON-RPC 2.0，无第三方依赖）。
 *
 * 暴露两个工具：
 *  - search_video(query) -> 相关时间线片段
 *  - ask_question(question) -> 本地问答答案 + 时间戳引用
 *
 * 数据源为内置示例时间线（后续可替换为真实 results 目录）。
 */
private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }
private val indexer = Indexer()
private val techStore = TechStore()

private fun sampleTimeline(): List<TimelineItem> = merge(
    listOf(
        TranscriptSegment(0.0, 10.0, "这节课我们讲梯度下降", null),
        TranscriptSegment(10.0, 20.0, "它是优化算法里的基础方法", null),
        TranscriptSegment(20.0, 30.0, "接下来讲反向传播", null),
        TranscriptSegment(30.0, 40.0, "最后讲卷积神经网络处理图像", null)
    ),
    listOf(
        FrameOcr(2.0, "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", "frame_001.jpg"),
        FrameOcr(12.0, "学习率控制步长", "frame_002.jpg"),
        FrameOcr(22.0, "反向传播计算梯度", "frame_003.jpg"),
        FrameOcr(32.0, "CNN 用于图像识别", "frame_004.jpg")
    )
)

private fun formatStamp(seconds: Double): String {
    val t = seconds.toInt()
    fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
    return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
}

private fun formatItem(item: TimelineItem): String {
    val parts = listOf(item.speech, item.screenText).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
    return "[${formatStamp(item.start)}-${formatStamp(item.end)}] " + parts.joinToString(" | ")
}

private fun resultText(id: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement?, text: String): String {
    val obj = buildJsonObject {
        put("jsonrpc", "2.0")
        if (id != null) put("id", id)
        putJsonObject("result") {
            put("content", buildJsonArray {
                add(buildJsonObject {
                    put("type", "text")
                    put("text", text)
                })
            })
        }
    }
    return obj.toString()
}

private fun errorResponse(id: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement?, code: Int, message: String): String =
    buildJsonObject {
        put("jsonrpc", "2.0")
        if (id != null) put("id", id)
        putJsonObject("error") {
            put("code", code)
            put("message", message)
        }
    }.toString()

private fun rawResult(id: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement?, resultJson: String): String =
    buildJsonObject {
        put("jsonrpc", "2.0")
        if (id != null) put("id", id)
        put("result", json.parseToJsonElement(resultJson))
    }.toString()

fun main() {
    indexer.index(sampleTimeline())
    val qaEngine = LocalQaEngine { q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) }
    val out = PrintStream(System.out, true, "UTF-8")
    val reader: BufferedReader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(System.`in`, Charsets.UTF_8))

    while (true) {
        val line = reader.readLine() ?: break
        if (line.isBlank()) continue
        val msg = try {
            json.parseToJsonElement(line).jsonObject
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            continue
        }
        val id = msg["id"]
        val method = msg["method"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull

        when (method) {
            "initialize" -> out.println(rawResult(id, """{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{"tools":{}},"serverInfo":{"name":"mentara","version":"1.0.0"}}"""))
            "notifications/initialized" -> {}
            "tools/list" -> out.println(
                rawResult(
                    id,
                    """{"tools":[
{"name":"search_video","description":"按关键词检索视频时间线","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}},"required":["query"]}},
{"name":"ask_question","description":"基于视频内容回答问题并给出时间戳","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"question":{"type":"string"}},"required":["question"]}},
{"name":"record_experience","description":"记录一次场景经验","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"scenarioId":{"type":"string"},"choice":{"type":"string"},"result":{"type":"string"},"lesson":{"type":"string"}},"required":["lesson"]}},
{"name":"search_experience","description":"检索经验库","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"}},"required":["query"]}},
{"name":"search_technology","description":"问题导向的技术方案检索（本地 TechCard/Decision/CodeSnippet，LLM 不可用时降级）","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"problem":{"type":"string"}},"required":["problem"]}},
{"name":"get_decision_history","description":"查询历史决策记录","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"problem":{"type":"string"},"topN":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["problem"]}},
{"name":"get_code_snippet","description":"按用途查询代码片段","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"purpose":{"type":"string"},"language":{"type":"string"}},"required":["purpose"]}},
{"name":"record_decision","description":"记录一个技术决策（同步更新使用痕迹）","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"problem":{"type":"string"},"chosen":{"type":"string"},"reason":{"type":"string"},"options":{"type":"string"},"constraints":{"type":"string"}},"required":["problem","chosen","reason"]}}
]}"""
                )
            )
            "tools/call" -> {
                val params = msg["params"]?.jsonObject
                val name = params?.get("name")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
                val args = params?.get("arguments")?.jsonObject
                fun arg(k: String) = args?.get(k)?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
                val answer = when (name) {
                    "search_video" -> {
                        val q = arg("query")
                        val hits = indexer.search(q, 5)
                        if (hits.isEmpty()) "未检索到与 '$q' 相关的片段" else hits.joinToString("\n") { formatItem(it) }
                    }
                    "ask_question" -> {
                        val q = arg("question")
                        runBlocking { qaEngine.ask(q) }.let {
                            it.answer + if (it.citations.isEmpty()) "" else "\n引用: " + it.citations.joinToString()
                        }
                    }
                    "record_experience" -> {
                        val id = "exp_" + System.currentTimeMillis().toString(16)
                        ExperienceStore.saveExperience(
                            Experience(
                                id = id,
                                scenarioId = arg("scenarioId"),
                                choice = arg("choice"),
                                result = arg("result"),
                                lesson = arg("lesson"),
                                recordedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                            )
                        )
                        "已记录经验 $id"
                    }
                    "search_experience" -> {
                        val list = ExperienceStore.searchExperiences(arg("query"))
                        if (list.isEmpty()) "没有匹配的经验"
                        else list.joinToString("\n") { "- " + it.lesson.ifBlank { it.choice } }
                    }
                    "search_technology" -> {
                        val p = arg("problem")
                        runBlocking { ProblemOrientedSearch(null, techStore).search(p) }
                            .let { json.encodeToString(com.learnagent.core.ProblemSolution.serializer(), it) }
                    }
                    "get_decision_history" -> {
                        val p = arg("problem")
                        val topN = args?.get("topN")?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull?.toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(1, 20) ?: 5
                        val keywords = ProblemParser(null).parseWithDictionary(p).keywords
                        val hits = techStore.getAllDecisions().filter { d ->
                            keywords.any { k -> d.problem.contains(k, true) || d.chosen.contains(k, true) || d.reason.contains(k, true) }
                        }.take(topN)
                        json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(Decision.serializer()), hits)
                    }
                    "get_code_snippet" -> {
                        val purpose = arg("purpose")
                        val language = arg("language")
                        val hits = techStore.getAllCodeSnippets().filter { s ->
                            (language.isBlank() || s.language.equals(language, true)) &&
                                (purpose.isBlank() || s.purpose.contains(purpose, true) ||
                                    s.code.contains(purpose, true) || s.tags.any { it.contains(purpose, true) })
                        }.take(10)
                        json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(CodeSnippet.serializer()), hits)
                    }
                    "record_decision" -> {
                        fun splitList(v: String) = v.split(',', '，', ';', '；').map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
                        val d = TechDecisionService.record(
                            techStore, arg("problem"), arg("chosen"), arg("reason"),
                            options = splitList(arg("options")), constraints = splitList(arg("constraints"))
                        )
                        "已记录决策 ${d.id}"
                    }
                    else -> "未知工具: $name"
                }
                out.println(resultText(id, answer))
            }
            "ping" -> out.println(rawResult(id, "\"pong\""))
            else -> if (id != null) out.println(errorResponse(id, -32601, "Method not found: $method"))
        }
    }
}
scripts/capture_ui.ps1 (7.9KB)
# Mentara UI 截图脚本（项目内唯一截图脚本，替代旧 capture_live / capture_splash）
#
# 用法：
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\capture_ui.ps1
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\capture_ui.ps1 -Attach        # 捕获已运行的实例
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\capture_ui.ps1 -KeepRunning   # 截完不关闭应用
#
# 产物（项目根目录）：
#   ui_mentara_splash.png / ui_mentara_main.png / ui_mentara_content.png
#   ui_mentara_graph.png  / ui_mentara_qa.png

param(
    [string]$ProjectRoot = "C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Default Project\learnagent",
    [switch]$Attach,
    [switch]$KeepRunning
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms

Add-Type -Namespace WinMentara -Name Native -MemberDefinition @'
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool GetWindowRect(System.IntPtr hWnd, out RECT lpRect);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetCursorPos(int X, int Y);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern void mouse_event(uint dwFlags, uint dx, uint dy, uint dwData, System.UIntPtr dwExtraInfo);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool SetForegroundWindow(System.IntPtr hWnd);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool ShowWindow(System.IntPtr hWnd, int nCmdShow);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool BringWindowToTop(System.IntPtr hWnd);
[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern System.IntPtr GetForegroundWindow();
public struct RECT { public int Left; public int Top; public int Right; public int Bottom; }
'@

function Get-ReadyWindow {
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 15; $i++) {
        $p = Get-MentaraProcess
        if ($p -eq $null) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; continue }
        $h = $p.MainWindowHandle
        [void][WinMentara.Native]::ShowWindow($h, 6)   # minimize
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
        [void][WinMentara.Native]::ShowWindow($h, 9)   # restore
        [void][WinMentara.Native]::BringWindowToTop($h)
        [void][WinMentara.Native]::SetForegroundWindow($h)
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900
        $r = New-Object WinMentara.Native+RECT
        [void][WinMentara.Native]::GetWindowRect($h, [ref]$r)
        $w = $r.Right - $r.Left
        $hh = $r.Bottom - $r.Top
        $fg = [WinMentara.Native]::GetForegroundWindow()
        if ($w -ge 800 -and $hh -ge 500 -and $fg -eq $h) {
            return @{ H = $h; L = $r.Left; T = $r.Top; R = $r.Right; B = $r.Bottom }
        }
    }
    return $null
}

function Get-MentaraProcess {
    Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -eq "Mentara" } | Select-Object -First 1
}

function Test-Blank([System.Drawing.Bitmap]$bmp) {
    $first = $bmp.GetPixel(12, 12)
    for ($x = 12; $x -lt $bmp.Width; $x += 64) {
        for ($y = 12; $y -lt $bmp.Height; $y += 64) {
            $c = $bmp.GetPixel($x, $y)
            if ([math]::Abs($c.R - $first.R) + [math]::Abs($c.G - $first.G) + [math]::Abs($c.B - $first.B) -gt 14) { return $false }
        }
    }
    return $true
}

function Wake-Screen {
    try {
        $pos = [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position
        [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position = New-Object System.Drawing.Point(($pos.X + 1), $pos.Y)
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 50
        [System.Windows.Forms.Cursor]::Position = $pos
    } catch { }
}

function Capture-Window([IntPtr]$handle, [string]$path) {
    for ($attempt = 0; $attempt -lt 6; $attempt++) {
        Wake-Screen
        $r = New-Object WinMentara.Native+RECT
        [void][WinMentara.Native]::GetWindowRect($handle, [ref]$r)
        $w = $r.Right - $r.Left
        $h = $r.Bottom - $r.Top
        $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $h)
        $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
        $g.CopyFromScreen($r.Left, $r.Top, 0, 0, (New-Object System.Drawing.Size($w, $h)))
        $g.Dispose()
        if (-not (Test-Blank $bmp)) {
            $bmp.Save($path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
            $bmp.Dispose()
            return
        }
        $bmp.Dispose()
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700
    }
    Write-Output ("CAPTURE_BLANK: " + $path)
}

function Click-At([int]$x, [int]$y) {
    [void][WinMentara.Native]::SetCursorPos($x, $y)
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 150
    [WinMentara.Native]::mouse_event(0x0002, 0, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 70
    [WinMentara.Native]::mouse_event(0x0004, 0, 0, 0, [UIntPtr]::Zero)
}

# 临时备份并清空 last_selected（让应用从首页开始，截完自动还原）
$userHome = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile')
if (-not $userHome) { $userHome = $HOME }
if (-not $userHome) { $userHome = "$env:SystemDrive\Users\Administrator" }
$lsPath = Join-Path $userHome ".mentara\last_selected.txt"
Write-Output ("HOMECHECK: " + $lsPath + " exists=" + (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lsPath))
$lsBackup = $null
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $lsPath) {
    $lsBackup = Get-Content -LiteralPath $lsPath -Raw
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $lsPath -Force
}

if (-not $Attach) {
    Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -eq "Mentara" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
    $gradle = Join-Path $ProjectRoot "gradle-dist\gradle-8.10\bin\gradle.bat"
    $log = Join-Path $env:TEMP "mentara_capture_run.log"
    Start-Process -FilePath $gradle -ArgumentList ":desktopApp:run --offline --no-daemon" -WorkingDirectory $ProjectRoot -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $log -RedirectStandardError ($log + ".err") | Out-Null
    $proc = $null
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 120; $i++) {
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
        $proc = Get-MentaraProcess
        if ($proc -ne $null) { break }
    }
} else {
    $proc = Get-MentaraProcess
}

if ($proc -eq $null) { Write-Output "WINDOW_NOT_FOUND"; exit 1 }

$win = Get-ReadyWindow
if ($win -eq $null) { Write-Output "WINDOW_NOT_READY"; exit 1 }
$proc = Get-MentaraProcess
$L = $win.L; $T = $win.T; $R = $win.R
Write-Output "WINDOW: $L,$T $($R-$L)x$($win.B-$T)"

# ---- Splash 密集连拍（Compose 起动晚于窗口出现，需覆盖 0-14s）----
if (-not $Attach) {
    $burst = Join-Path $env:TEMP "mentara_burst"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $burst | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem $burst -File | Remove-Item -Force
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 22; $i++) {
        Capture-Window $proc.MainWindowHandle (Join-Path $burst ("splash_" + $i.ToString("00") + ".png"))
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
}

# ---- 回到首页（App 启动即自动选中第一个视频 → 点 ← 返回 HomeGrid）----
$modeY = $T + 151
Click-At ($L + 52) $modeY
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500

# ---- 主界面 ----
Capture-Window $proc.MainWindowHandle (Join-Path $ProjectRoot "ui_mentara_main.png")
Write-Output "MAIN"

# ---- 选中视频卡片（已在专注页时此点击无害）----
Click-At ($L + 160) ($T + 311)
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500
Capture-Window $proc.MainWindowHandle (Join-Path $ProjectRoot "ui_mentara_content.png")
Write-Output "CONTENT"

# ---- 图谱页 / 辩论页 / 问答页（专注页右上四个模式按钮：时间线 R-200 · 图谱 R-148 · 问答 R-96 · 辩论 R-44）----
$modeY = $T + 151
Click-At ($R - 148) $modeY
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1800
Capture-Window $proc.MainWindowHandle (Join-Path $ProjectRoot "ui_mentara_graph.png")
Write-Output "GRAPH"

Click-At ($R - 44) $modeY
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1800
Capture-Window $proc.MainWindowHandle (Join-Path $ProjectRoot "ui_mentara_debate.png")
Write-Output "DEBATE"

Click-At ($R - 96) $modeY
Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1800
Capture-Window $proc.MainWindowHandle (Join-Path $ProjectRoot "ui_mentara_qa.png")
Write-Output "QA"

if (-not $KeepRunning) {
    Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -eq "Mentara" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

# 还原 last_selected
if ($lsBackup -ne $null) {
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $lsPath -Value $lsBackup -NoNewline
}

Write-Output "DONE"
scripts/extract_frames.ps1 (4.9KB)
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Video,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$OutDir,
    [int]$Width = 1280,
    [int]$Count = 12,
    [int]$Fps = 4,
    [string]$Mode = "scene",
    [int]$DenseWidth = 640,
    [string]$CsPath = ""
)

# 视频抽帧（多帧优先）：
#   1) Media Foundation 软件解码（自研 C#，零外部依赖）→ 全片均匀抽 Count 帧
#   2) ffmpeg（PATH 或 <项目>/tools/ffmpeg.exe）
#   3) 回退：StorageFile.GetThumbnailAsync → 1 张代表帧
# 输出 frames.json：[{ timestamp, imagePath }, ...]

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime | Out-Null
if (-not (Test-Path $OutDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null }
$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
$framesJson = Join-Path $OutDir "frames.json"

# ---------- 1) Media Foundation 多帧（首选） ----------
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($CsPath)) {
    $cand = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "mfframegrab.cs"
    if (Test-Path $cand) { $CsPath = $cand }
}
if ((Test-Path $CsPath) -and (Test-Path $Video)) {
    try {
        Add-Type -Path $CsPath -ReferencedAssemblies System.Drawing -ErrorAction Stop
        $n = if ($Mode -eq "dense") { [MfFrameGrab]::GrabScenes($Video, $OutDir, $Fps, -1, $DenseWidth) }
                  elseif ($Fps -gt 0) { [MfFrameGrab]::GrabScenes($Video, $OutDir, $Fps, 8) }
                  else { [MfFrameGrab]::Grab($Video, $OutDir, $Count, $Fps) }
        if ((Test-Path $framesJson) -and $n -gt 0) {
            Write-Output "DECODER=media-foundation"
            Write-Output ("FRAMES=" + $n)
            exit 0
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Output ("MF_ERROR: " + $_.Exception.Message)
    }
}

# ---------- 2) ffmpeg 多帧 ----------
$ff = (Get-Command ffmpeg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $ff) {
    $cand = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) "tools\ffmpeg.exe"
    if (Test-Path $cand) { $ff = $cand }
}
if ($ff -and (Test-Path $Video)) {
    $items = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
    $dur = 0.0
    $info = & $ff -hide_banner -i $Video 2>&1 | Out-String
    $m = [regex]::Match($info, "Duration:\s*(\d+):(\d+):([\d.]+)")
    if ($m.Success) {
        $dur = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value * 3600 + [int]$m.Groups[2].Value * 60 +
            [double]::Parse($m.Groups[3].Value, [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
    }
    if ($dur -le 0) { $dur = 60.0 }
    $n = [Math]::Max(2, $Count)
    for ($i = 1; $i -le $n; $i++) {
        $sec = [Math]::Round($dur * $i / ($n + 1), 3)
        $path = Join-Path $OutDir ("frame_{0:D3}.jpg" -f $i)
        & $ff -hide_banner -loglevel error -ss $sec -i $Video -frames:v 1 -q:v 2 -y $path 2>$null
        if (Test-Path $path) { $null = $items.Add([pscustomobject]@{ timestamp = $sec; imagePath = $path }) }
    }
    $json = if ($items.Count -eq 0) { "[]" } else { $items | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 }
    if (-not $json.TrimStart().StartsWith("[")) { $json = "[$json]" }
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($framesJson, $json, $utf8NoBom)
    Write-Output "DECODER=ffmpeg"
    Write-Output ("FRAMES=" + $items.Count)
    exit 0
}

# ---------- 3) 回退：单张代表帧 ----------
[Windows.Storage.StorageFile, Windows.Storage, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Storage.FileProperties.ThumbnailMode, Windows.Storage.FileProperties, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Storage.FileProperties.StorageItemThumbnail, Windows.Storage.FileProperties, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null

$asTaskGeneric = ([System.WindowsRuntimeSystemExtensions].GetMethods() | Where-Object {
    $_.Name -eq 'AsTask' -and $_.GetParameters().Count -eq 1 -and $_.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType.Name -eq 'IAsyncOperation`1'
})[0]
function AwaitOp($op, $t) {
    $task = $asTaskGeneric.MakeGenericMethod($t).Invoke($null, @($op))
    $task.Wait(-1) | Out-Null
    $task.Result
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Video)) { Write-Error "Video not found: $Video"; exit 2 }

$file = AwaitOp ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile]::GetFileFromPathAsync($Video)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile])
$items = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
try {
    $thumb = AwaitOp ($file.GetThumbnailAsync([Windows.Storage.FileProperties.ThumbnailMode]::VideosView, $Width)) ([Windows.Storage.FileProperties.StorageItemThumbnail])
    $path = Join-Path $OutDir "frame_000.bmp"
    $net = [System.IO.WindowsRuntimeStreamExtensions]::AsStreamForRead($thumb)
    $fs = [System.IO.File]::Create($path)
    $net.CopyTo($fs)
    $fs.Dispose(); $net.Dispose(); $thumb.Dispose()
    $null = $items.Add([pscustomobject]@{ timestamp = 0.0; imagePath = $path })
} catch {
    Write-Output ("FRAME_ERROR: " + $_.Exception.Message)
}
$json = if ($items.Count -eq 0) { "[]" } else { $items | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 }
if (-not $json.TrimStart().StartsWith("[")) { $json = "[$json]" }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($framesJson, $json, $utf8NoBom)
Write-Output "DECODER=winrt-thumbnail"
Write-Output ("FRAMES=" + $items.Count)

# 获取 SenseVoice 模型（228MB + tokens），放入 Android assets（构建前执行一次）
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$dst = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\androidApp\src\main\assets\sensevoice"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
$base = "https://hf-mirror.com/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17/resolve/main/"
foreach ($f in @("model.int8.onnx", "tokens.txt")) {

scripts/generate_art.ps1 (10.3KB)
# Mentara 幻域美术资源 · 程序化生成
# 使用 System.Drawing (GDI+) 生成 PNG，无任何外部下载。
# 输出：desktopApp/src/main/resources/art/ + androidApp/src/main/res/drawable/

param(
    [string]$ProjectRoot = "C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Default Project\learnagent"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$code = @'
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;
using System.Drawing.Imaging;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

public static class MentaraArt
{
    public static string Report = "";

    public static void Generate(string dir)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);
        Save(SplashBg(2048), Path.Combine(dir, "splash_bg.png"));
        Save(MainBg(1600, 900), Path.Combine(dir, "main_bg.png"));
        Save(LogoMark(512), Path.Combine(dir, "logo_mark.png"));
        Save(EmptyOrb(1024), Path.Combine(dir, "empty_orb.png"));
        Save(Noise(512), Path.Combine(dir, "noise.png"));
    }

    static void Save(Bitmap b, string p)
    {
        b.Save(p, ImageFormat.Png);
        FileInfo fi = new FileInfo(p);
        Report += p + " " + fi.Length + "\n";
        b.Dispose();
    }

    static int Clamp(int v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : (v > 255 ? 255 : v); }

    static Color Lerp(Color a, Color b, float t)
    {
        if (t < 0) t = 0; if (t > 1) t = 1;
        return Color.FromArgb(
            (int)(a.A + (b.A - a.A) * t),
            (int)(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * t),
            (int)(a.G + (b.G - a.G) * t),
            (int)(a.B + (b.B - a.B) * t));
    }

    static Bitmap FromFunc(int w, int h, Func<int, int, Color> f)
    {
        Bitmap bmp = new Bitmap(w, h, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
        BitmapData data = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, w, h), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
        byte[] bytes = new byte[w * h * 4];
        int i = 0;
        for (int y = 0; y < h; y++)
        {
            for (int x = 0; x < w; x++)
            {
                Color c = f(x, y);
                bytes[i++] = c.B; bytes[i++] = c.G; bytes[i++] = c.R; bytes[i++] = c.A;
            }
        }
        Marshal.Copy(bytes, 0, data.Scan0, bytes.Length);
        bmp.UnlockBits(data);
        return bmp;
    }

    static void AddGlow(Graphics g, float cx, float cy, float radius, Color c, int steps)
    {
        for (int i = steps; i >= 1; i--)
        {
            float r = radius * i / steps;
            float k = 1f - (float)i / steps;
            int a = (int)(c.A * k * k * 2.2f);
            if (a <= 0) continue;
            if (a > 255) a = 255;
            using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(a, c.R, c.G, c.B)))
                g.FillEllipse(b, cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);
        }
    }

    static Bitmap SplashBg(int s)
    {
        float cx = s * 0.5f, cy = s * 0.44f;
        float maxR = s * 0.80f;
        Bitmap bmp = FromFunc(s, s, delegate(int x, int y)
        {
            float dx = x - cx, dy = y - cy;
            float d = (float)Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / maxR;
            float t = d > 1 ? 1 : d;
            t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
            Color center = Color.FromArgb(255, 15, 10, 24);
            Color mid = Color.FromArgb(255, 11, 7, 16);
            Color edge = Color.FromArgb(255, 6, 3, 8);
            Color c = t < 0.5f ? Lerp(center, mid, t * 2f) : Lerp(mid, edge, (t - 0.5f) * 2f);
            int n = ((x * 7349 + y * 9151) % 7) - 3;
            return Color.FromArgb(255, Clamp(c.R + n), Clamp(c.G + n), Clamp(c.B + n));
        });
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp))
        {
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            AddGlow(g, cx, cy, s * 0.44f, Color.FromArgb(90, 201, 168, 255), 70);
            AddGlow(g, s * 0.74f, s * 0.28f, s * 0.20f, Color.FromArgb(46, 232, 200, 122), 46);
            AddGlow(g, s * 0.26f, s * 0.70f, s * 0.22f, Color.FromArgb(40, 168, 128, 255), 46);
            Random rnd = new Random(1234);
            for (int i = 0; i < 280; i++)
            {
                float x = (float)rnd.NextDouble() * s;
                float y = (float)rnd.NextDouble() * s;
                float r = 1.2f + (float)rnd.NextDouble() * 2.6f;
                bool gold = i % 2 == 1;
                Color c = gold ? Color.FromArgb(190, 232, 200, 122) : Color.FromArgb(200, 201, 168, 255);
                AddGlow(g, x, y, r * 6f, Color.FromArgb(58, c.R, c.G, c.B), 22);
                using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(c))
                    g.FillEllipse(b, x - r / 2, y - r / 2, r, r);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 90; i++)
            {
                float x = (float)rnd.NextDouble() * s;
                float y = (float)rnd.NextDouble() * s;
                using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(14, 240, 234, 245)))
                    g.FillEllipse(b, x, y, 1.4f, 1.4f);
            }
        }
        return bmp;
    }

    static Bitmap MainBg(int w, int h)
    {
        float cx = w * 0.5f, cy = h * 0.42f;
        float rx = w * 0.78f, ry = h * 0.95f;
        Bitmap bmp = FromFunc(w, h, delegate(int x, int y)
        {
            float dx = (x - cx) / rx, dy = (y - cy) / ry;
            float d = (float)Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
            float t = d > 1 ? 1 : d;
            t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
            Color center = Color.FromArgb(255, 15, 10, 24);
            Color edge = Color.FromArgb(255, 6, 3, 8);
            Color c = Lerp(center, edge, t);
            int n = ((x * 6749 + y * 3251) % 7) - 3;
            return Color.FromArgb(255, Clamp(c.R + n), Clamp(c.G + n), Clamp(c.B + n));
        });
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp))
        {
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            AddGlow(g, w * 0.30f, h * 0.36f, w * 0.26f, Color.FromArgb(34, 201, 168, 255), 60);
            AddGlow(g, w * 0.78f, h * 0.62f, w * 0.22f, Color.FromArgb(26, 232, 200, 122), 52);
            AddGlow(g, w * 0.55f, h * 0.85f, w * 0.20f, Color.FromArgb(22, 168, 128, 255), 48);
        }
        return bmp;
    }

    static Bitmap LogoMark(int s)
    {
        Bitmap bmp = new Bitmap(s, s, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp))
        {
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            float cx = s * 0.5f;
            PointF n1 = new PointF(s * 0.5f, s * 0.24f);
            PointF n2 = new PointF(s * 0.26f, s * 0.64f);
            PointF n3 = new PointF(s * 0.74f, s * 0.64f);
            AddGlow(g, cx, s * 0.5f, s * 0.46f, Color.FromArgb(52, 201, 168, 255), 60);
            using (LinearGradientBrush lb = new LinearGradientBrush(
                new PointF(s * 0.2f, s * 0.2f), new PointF(s * 0.8f, s * 0.8f),
                Color.FromArgb(150, 201, 168, 255), Color.FromArgb(150, 232, 200, 122)))
            using (Pen pen = new Pen(lb, s * 0.014f))
            {
                pen.StartCap = LineCap.Round; pen.EndCap = LineCap.Round;
                g.DrawLine(pen, n1, n2);
                g.DrawLine(pen, n2, n3);
                g.DrawLine(pen, n3, n1);
            }
            DrawNode(g, n1, s * 0.062f, Color.FromArgb(235, 201, 168, 255));
            DrawNode(g, n2, s * 0.052f, Color.FromArgb(220, 201, 168, 255));
            DrawNode(g, n3, s * 0.075f, Color.FromArgb(240, 232, 200, 122));
        }
        return bmp;
    }

    static void DrawNode(Graphics g, PointF p, float r, Color c)
    {
        AddGlow(g, p.X, p.Y, r * 4.2f, Color.FromArgb(70, c.R, c.G, c.B), 26);
        using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(90, c.R, c.G, c.B)))
            g.FillEllipse(b, p.X - r * 1.7f, p.Y - r * 1.7f, r * 3.4f, r * 3.4f);
        using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(c))
            g.FillEllipse(b, p.X - r, p.Y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
    }

    static Bitmap EmptyOrb(int s)
    {
        Bitmap bmp = new Bitmap(s, s, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp))
        {
            g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
            float cx = s / 2f, cy = s / 2f;
            AddGlow(g, cx, cy, s * 0.40f, Color.FromArgb(80, 201, 168, 255), 80);
            using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(60, 201, 168, 255)))
                g.FillEllipse(b, cx - s * 0.16f, cy - s * 0.16f, s * 0.32f, s * 0.32f);
            using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(120, 216, 190, 255)))
                g.FillEllipse(b, cx - s * 0.10f, cy - s * 0.10f, s * 0.20f, s * 0.20f);
            using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(Color.FromArgb(200, 240, 234, 245)))
                g.FillEllipse(b, cx - s * 0.045f, cy - s * 0.045f, s * 0.09f, s * 0.09f);
            using (Pen ring = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(70, 168, 176, 192), s * 0.006f))
            {
                ring.DashStyle = DashStyle.Dash;
                g.DrawEllipse(ring, cx - s * 0.30f, cy - s * 0.22f, s * 0.60f, s * 0.44f);
            }
            using (Pen ring = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(46, 201, 168, 255), s * 0.004f))
            {
                g.DrawEllipse(ring, cx - s * 0.38f, cy - s * 0.30f, s * 0.76f, s * 0.60f);
            }
            Random rnd = new Random(77);
            for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++)
            {
                double ang = rnd.NextDouble() * Math.PI * 2;
                float rad = s * (0.20f + (float)rnd.NextDouble() * 0.22f);
                float x = cx + (float)Math.Cos(ang) * rad;
                float y = cy + (float)Math.Sin(ang) * rad * 0.7f;
                float r = 1.5f + (float)rnd.NextDouble() * 2.5f;
                bool gold = i % 3 == 0;
                Color c = gold ? Color.FromArgb(190, 232, 200, 122) : Color.FromArgb(180, 201, 168, 255);
                using (SolidBrush b = new SolidBrush(c))
                    g.FillEllipse(b, x - r / 2, y - r / 2, r, r);
            }
        }
        return bmp;
    }

    static Bitmap Noise(int s)
    {
        Random rnd = new Random(99);
        return FromFunc(s, s, delegate(int x, int y)
        {
            int a = rnd.Next(0, 7);
            return Color.FromArgb(a, 255, 255, 255);
        });
    }
}
