scripts/generate_icon.ps1 (4KB)
param(
    [string]$Root = "C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Default Project\learnagent"
)

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$cs = @'
using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Drawing.Drawing2D;

public class IconGen {
    public static void Generate(string path, int size) {
        var bmp = new Bitmap(size, size);
        var g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp);
        g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;

        var rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, size, size);
        var bgBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(rect,
            Color.FromArgb(45, 91, 255),
            Color.FromArgb(0, 184, 169),
            LinearGradientMode.ForwardDiagonal);
        g.FillPath(bgBrush, RoundedRect(rect, (int)(size * 0.22f)));

        var white = new SolidBrush(Color.White);
        var pen = new Pen(Color.FromArgb(210, 255, 255, 255), size * 0.031f);
        pen.StartCap = LineCap.Round;
        pen.EndCap = LineCap.Round;

        var n1 = new PointF(size * 0.32f, size * 0.35f);
        var n2 = new PointF(size * 0.68f, size * 0.42f);
        var n3 = new PointF(size * 0.50f, size * 0.72f);

        g.DrawLine(pen, n1, n2);
        g.DrawLine(pen, n2, n3);
        g.DrawLine(pen, n1, n3);

        g.FillEllipse(white, n1.X - size * 0.0625f, n1.Y - size * 0.0625f, size * 0.125f, size * 0.125f);
        g.FillEllipse(white, n2.X - size * 0.0625f, n2.Y - size * 0.0625f, size * 0.125f, size * 0.125f);
        g.FillEllipse(white, n3.X - size * 0.078f, n3.Y - size * 0.078f, size * 0.156f, size * 0.156f);

        g.Dispose();
        bmp.Save(path, System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat.Png);
        bmp.Dispose();
    }

    public static void Resize(string src, string dst, int size) {
        var img = Image.FromFile(src);
        var bmp = new Bitmap(size, size);
        var g = Graphics.FromImage(bmp);
        g.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.HighQualityBicubic;
        g.SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.AntiAlias;
        g.DrawImage(img, 0, 0, size, size);
        bmp.Save(dst, System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat.Png);
        g.Dispose(); bmp.Dispose(); img.Dispose();
    }

    static GraphicsPath RoundedRect(Rectangle bounds, int radius) {
        var path = new GraphicsPath();
        int d = radius * 2;
        path.AddArc(bounds.X, bounds.Y, d, d, 180, 90);
        path.AddArc(bounds.Right - d, bounds.Y, d, d, 270, 90);
        path.AddArc(bounds.Right - d, bounds.Bottom - d, d, d, 0, 90);
        path.AddArc(bounds.X, bounds.Bottom - d, d, d, 90, 90);
        path.CloseFigure();
        return path;
    }
}
'@

Add-Type -TypeDefinition $cs -ReferencedAssemblies System.Drawing | Out-Null

$resDir = Join-Path $Root "desktopApp\src\main\resources"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $resDir | Out-Null
$png = Join-Path $resDir "icon.png"
[IconGen]::Generate($png, 256)
Write-Output ("ICON_PNG_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $png).Length)

# PNG -> ICO (ICO with embedded PNG, Vista+)
$pngBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($png)
$ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
$bw = New-Object System.IO.BinaryWriter($ms)
$bw.Write([UInt16]0); $bw.Write([UInt16]1); $bw.Write([UInt16]1)      # reserved, type=icon, count=1
$bw.Write([Byte]0); $bw.Write([Byte]0); $bw.Write([Byte]0); $bw.Write([Byte]0)  # 256x256
$bw.Write([UInt16]1); $bw.Write([UInt16]32)                            # planes, bpp
$bw.Write([UInt32]$pngBytes.Length)                                    # size
$bw.Write([UInt32]22)                                                  # offset
$bw.Write($pngBytes)
$bw.Flush()
$ico = Join-Path $resDir "icon.ico"
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($ico, $ms.ToArray())
$bw.Dispose(); $ms.Dispose()
Write-Output ("ICON_ICO_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $ico).Length)

# Android mipmaps
$mip = @{ "mdpi" = 48; "hdpi" = 72; "xhdpi" = 96; "xxhdpi" = 144; "xxxhdpi" = 192 }
foreach ($k in $mip.Keys) {
    $d = Join-Path $Root ("androidApp\src\main\res\mipmap-" + $k)
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null
    $dst = Join-Path $d "ic_launcher.png"
    [IconGen]::Resize($png, $dst, $mip[$k])
    Write-Output ("MIPMAP_" + $k + "=" + (Get-Item $dst).Length)
}
scripts/transcribe.ps1 (3.4KB)
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Wav,
    [string]$Out,
    [string]$Culture = "zh-CN"
)

# 使用 Windows 内置语音识别（System.Speech）进行本地转写，全程离线。
# 自行解析 WAV 的 fmt/data 块并以原始 PCM 喂给识别引擎，兼容带 JUNK 等额外块的 WAV。
# 输出：List<TranscriptSegment> 的 JSON，字段 start/end/text/speaker。

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech

if (-not (Test-Path $Wav)) {
    Write-Error "WAV not found: $Wav"
    exit 2
}

$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Wav)
if ($bytes.Length -lt 44) {
    Write-Error "WAV too small: $Wav"
    exit 2
}

$pos = 12
$audioFormat = $null
$channels = 0
$sampleRate = 0
$bitsPerSample = 0
$dataOffset = -1
$dataLength = 0

while ($pos -le $bytes.Length - 8) {
    $id = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bytes, $pos, 4)
    $size = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, $pos + 4)
    if ($id -eq 'fmt ') {
        $audioFormat = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, $pos + 8)
        $channels = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, $pos + 10)
        $sampleRate = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, $pos + 12)
        $bitsPerSample = [BitConverter]::ToInt16($bytes, $pos + 22)
    } elseif ($id -eq 'data') {
        $dataOffset = $pos + 8
        $dataLength = $size
        break
    }
    $pos += 8 + $size + ($size % 2)
}

if ($null -eq $audioFormat -or $dataOffset -lt 0) {
    Write-Error "WAV missing fmt/data chunk: $Wav"
    exit 2
}
if ($audioFormat -ne 1) {
    Write-Error ("Unsupported audio format " + $audioFormat + " (only PCM). Convert to 16kHz mono PCM WAV.")
    exit 3
}

$bitsEnum = if ($bitsPerSample -eq 8) { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioBitsPerSample]::Eight } else { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioBitsPerSample]::Sixteen }
$chEnum = if ($channels -eq 1) { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioChannel]::Mono } else { [System.Speech.AudioFormat.AudioChannel]::Stereo }
$audioFormatInfo = New-Object System.Speech.AudioFormat.SpeechAudioFormatInfo($sampleRate, $bitsEnum, $chEnum)

$data = New-Object byte[] $dataLength
[Array]::Copy($bytes, $dataOffset, $data, 0, $dataLength)
$stream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
$stream.Write($data, 0, $data.Length)
$stream.Position = 0

$ci = New-Object System.Globalization.CultureInfo($Culture)
try {
    $engine = New-Object System.Speech.Recognition.SpeechRecognitionEngine($ci)
} catch {
    Write-Error "No System.Speech recognizer for culture '$Culture': $($_.Exception.Message)"
    exit 4
}

$engine.LoadGrammar((New-Object System.Speech.Recognition.DictationGrammar))
$engine.SetInputToAudioStream($stream, $audioFormatInfo)

$segments = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
$cursor = 0.0
$i = 0
while ($i -lt 10000) {
    $r = $null
    try { $r = $engine.Recognize() } catch { break }
    if ($null -eq $r) { break }

    $dur = 0.0
    try { $dur = $r.Audio.Duration.TotalSeconds } catch { }

    $null = $segments.Add([pscustomobject]@{
        start   = $cursor
        end     = $cursor + $dur
        text    = $r.Text
        speaker = $null
    })
    $cursor += $dur
    $i++
}
$engine.Dispose()
$stream.Dispose()

$json = if ($segments.Count -eq 0) { "[]" } else { $segments | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 }
if (-not $json.TrimStart().StartsWith("[")) { $json = "[$json]" }

$utf8NoBom = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding $false
if ($Out) {
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Out, $json, $utf8NoBom)
} else {
    Write-Output $json
}
scripts/video_to_wav.ps1 (2.8KB)
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Video,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Wav
)

# 用 Windows 内置 MediaTranscoder（WinRT）把视频音轨提取为
# 16kHz / 单声道 / 16-bit PCM WAV，供 System.Speech 转写。
# 全程离线，无需 ffmpeg。

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime | Out-Null

$asTaskGeneric = ([System.WindowsRuntimeSystemExtensions].GetMethods() | Where-Object {
    $_.Name -eq 'AsTask' -and $_.GetParameters().Count -eq 1 -and $_.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType.Name -eq 'IAsyncOperation`1'
})[0]
$asTaskActionProgress = ([System.WindowsRuntimeSystemExtensions].GetMethods() | Where-Object {
    $_.Name -eq 'AsTask' -and $_.GetParameters().Count -eq 1 -and $_.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType.Name -eq 'IAsyncActionWithProgress`1'
})[0]

function AwaitOp($op, $t) {
    $task = $asTaskGeneric.MakeGenericMethod($t).Invoke($null, @($op))
    $task.Wait(-1) | Out-Null
    $task.Result
}
function AwaitActionProgress($act, $t) {
    $task = $asTaskActionProgress.MakeGenericMethod($t).Invoke($null, @($act))
    $task.Wait(-1) | Out-Null
}

[Windows.Storage.StorageFile, Windows.Storage, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Storage.StorageFolder, Windows.Storage, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.Transcoding.MediaTranscoder, Windows.Media.Transcoding, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.MediaProperties.MediaEncodingProfile, Windows.Media.MediaProperties, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Media.MediaProperties.AudioEncodingProperties, Windows.Media.MediaProperties, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null

if (-not (Test-Path $Video)) {
    Write-Error "Video not found: $Video"
    exit 2
}

$inFile = AwaitOp ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile]::GetFileFromPathAsync($Video)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile])
$wavDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($Wav)
$wavName = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($Wav)
$folder = AwaitOp ([Windows.Storage.StorageFolder]::GetFolderFromPathAsync($wavDir)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFolder])
$outFile = AwaitOp ($folder.CreateFileAsync($wavName, [Windows.Storage.CreationCollisionOption]::ReplaceExisting)) ([Windows.Storage.StorageFile])

$profile = [Windows.Media.MediaProperties.MediaEncodingProfile]::CreateWav([Windows.Media.MediaProperties.AudioEncodingQuality]::Medium)
$pcm = [Windows.Media.MediaProperties.AudioEncodingProperties]::CreatePcm(16000, 1, 16)
$profile.Audio = $pcm

$transcoder = [Windows.Media.Transcoding.MediaTranscoder]::new()
$prep = AwaitOp ($transcoder.PrepareFileTranscodeAsync($inFile, $outFile, $profile)) ([Windows.Media.Transcoding.PrepareTranscodeResult])

if (-not $prep.CanTranscode) {
    Write-Output ("CANNOT_TRANSCODE reason=" + $prep.FailureReason)
    exit 3
}

AwaitActionProgress ($prep.TranscodeAsync()) ([Double])
Write-Output ("WAV_BYTES=" + (Get-Item $Wav).Length)

package com.learnagent.core

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.speech.RecognitionListener
import android.speech.RecognizerIntent
import android.speech.SpeechRecognizer
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import java.io.File

/**
 * Android 骞冲彴鐨勮闊宠瘑鍒櫒銆? *
 * 浣跨敤绯荤粺鍐呯疆鐨?[SpeechRecognizer]锛堟棤闇€涓嬭浇妯″瀷锛屾敮鎸佺绾夸紭鍏堬級銆? * - API 31+ 鍙敤 [RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE] 璇嗗埆 WAV 鏂囦欢锛? * - 浣庣増鏈洖閫€鍒伴害鍏嬮杈撳叆銆? *
 * 绯荤粺璇嗗埆鍣ㄤ笉杩斿洖閫愯瘝鏃堕棿鎴筹紝鍥犳姣忔浠ユ暣鍙ュ舰寮忚繑鍥炪€? * 閲囩敤鍥炶皟寮?API锛岄伩鍏嶄负 shared 妯″潡寮曞叆鍗忕▼渚濊禆銆? */
class AndroidSpeechTranscriber(private val context: Context) {

    companion object {
        /** 最近一次识别失败原因（空=无错误），供上层显示。 */
        var lastError: String = ""

        fun messageOf(error: Int): String = when (error) {
            1 -> "网络超时"
            2 -> "网络错误（需联网或装离线语音包）"
            3 -> "音频录制错误"
            4 -> "无匹配结果"
            5 -> "识别器客户端错误"
            6 -> "语音超时，未检测到说话"
            7 -> "无匹配结果（可能没有说话/音质差）"
            8 -> "识别器忙"
            9 -> "缺少麦克风权限（RECORD_AUDIO）"
            else -> "识别失败(code=$error)"
        }
    }

    fun isAvailable(): Boolean = SpeechRecognizer.isRecognitionAvailable(context)

    /**
     * 璇嗗埆涓€涓?WAV 闊抽鏂囦欢锛?6kHz 鍗曞０閬撴晥鏋滄渶浣筹級銆?     *
     * 闇€鍦ㄥ叿澶?RECORD_AUDIO 鏉冮檺鏃惰皟鐢紱API 31+ 涓旀彁渚涙枃浠舵椂浼樺厛绂荤嚎璇嗗埆璇ユ枃浠躲€?     * 缁撴灉閫氳繃 [onResult] 鍥炶皟杩斿洖锛堥敊璇垨鏃犵粨鏋滄椂杩斿洖绌哄垪琛級銆?     */
    @Suppress("MissingPermission")
    fun transcribe(wavPath: String, onResult: (List<TranscriptSegment>) -> Unit) {
        val recognizer = SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer(context)

        val intent = Intent(RecognizerIntent.ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH).apply {
            putExtra(
                RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE_MODEL,
                RecognizerIntent.LANGUAGE_MODEL_FREE_FORM
            )
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE, "zh-CN")
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PREFER_OFFLINE, false)
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PARTIAL_RESULTS, false)
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_MAX_RESULTS, 1)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
                val file = File(wavPath)
                if (file.isFile) {
                    val pfd = ParcelFileDescriptor.open(file, ParcelFileDescriptor.MODE_READ_ONLY)
                    putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_AUDIO_SOURCE, pfd)
                }
            }
        }

        recognizer.setRecognitionListener(object : RecognitionListener {
            override fun onResults(results: Bundle?) {
                val texts = results
                    ?.getStringArrayList(SpeechRecognizer.RESULTS_RECOGNITION)
                    .orEmpty()
                val primary = texts.firstOrNull().orEmpty()
                val segments = if (primary.isBlank()) {
                    lastError = "识别器返回空结果（可能无网或未装离线语音包）"
                    emptyList()
                } else {
                    lastError = ""
                    listOf(TranscriptSegment(start = 0.0, end = 0.0, text = primary, speaker = null))
                }
                runCatching { recognizer.destroy() }
                onResult(segments)
            }

            override fun onError(error: Int) {
                lastError = messageOf(error)
                runCatching { recognizer.destroy() }
                onResult(emptyList())
            }

            override fun onReadyForSpeech(params: Bundle?) {}
            override fun onBeginningOfSpeech() {}
            override fun onRmsChanged(rmsdB: Float) {}
            override fun onBufferReceived(buffer: ByteArray?) {}
            override fun onEndOfSpeech() {}
            override fun onPartialResults(partialResults: Bundle?) {}
            override fun onEvent(eventType: Int, params: Bundle?) {}
        })

        recognizer.startListening(intent)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.Experience
import com.learnagent.data.Scenario
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * Android 实现：默认 context.filesDir/experience/。
 * 由 App 启动时调用 [init] 传入 filesDir 路径。
 */
actual object ExperienceStore {

    private var baseDir: String = ""

    fun init(filesDirPath: String) {
        baseDir = filesDirPath
    }

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private val dir: File
        get() {
            val root = if (baseDir.isBlank()) File(".") else File(baseDir)
            return File(root, "experience").apply { mkdirs() }
        }

    private val scenariosFile: File get() = File(dir, "scenarios.json")
    private val experiencesFile: File get() = File(dir, "experiences.json")

    private fun readScenarios(): MutableList<Scenario> = try {
        if (scenariosFile.isFile) {
            json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(Scenario.serializer()), scenariosFile.readText()).toMutableList()
        } else mutableListOf()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        mutableListOf()
    }

    private fun readExperiences(): MutableList<Experience> = try {
        if (experiencesFile.isFile) {
            json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(Experience.serializer()), experiencesFile.readText()).toMutableList()
        } else mutableListOf()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        mutableListOf()
    }

    actual fun saveScenario(scenario: Scenario) {
        val list = readScenarios()
        list.removeAll { it.id == scenario.id }
        list.add(scenario)
        scenariosFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(Scenario.serializer()), list))
    }

    actual fun saveExperience(experience: Experience) {
        val list = readExperiences()
        list.removeAll { it.id == experience.id }
        list.add(experience)
        experiencesFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(Experience.serializer()), list))
    }

    actual fun getAllScenarios(): List<Scenario> = readScenarios()

    actual fun getAllExperiences(): List<Experience> = readExperiences()

    actual fun searchExperiences(query: String): List<Experience> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val q = query.lowercase()
        return readExperiences().filter {
            it.choice.lowercase().contains(q) || it.result.lowercase().contains(q) || it.lesson.lowercase().contains(q)
        }
    }

    actual fun getPendingFollowUps(nowMillis: Long): List<Experience> =
        readExperiences().filter { !it.followUpDone && it.followUpAt in 1..nowMillis }
}

package com.learnagent.data

import android.content.Context
import java.io.File

/**
 * Android 平台的存储实现。
 *
 * 实现 commonMain 的 [Storage] 接口，使用应用外部私有目录存放 results。
 */
class AndroidStorage(private val context: Context) : Storage {

    override fun getResultsDir(): String {
        val externalDir = context.getExternalFilesDir(null) ?: context.filesDir
        return File(externalDir, ResultsDir.RESULTS_ROOT).absolutePath
    }

    override fun writeJson(path: String, content: String) {
        val file = File(path)
        file.parentFile?.mkdirs()
        file.writeText(content)
    }

    override fun readJson(path: String): String? {
        val file = File(path)
        return if (file.exists()) file.readText() else null
    }

    override fun listVideoIds(): List<String> {
        val dir = File(getResultsDir())
        if (!dir.exists()) return emptyList()
        return dir.listFiles { f -> f.isDirectory }?.map { it.name } ?: emptyList()
    }

    override fun ensureVideoDir(videoId: String): String {
        val dir = File(getResultsDir(), videoId)
        dir.mkdirs()
        return dir.absolutePath
    }

    override fun deleteVideoDir(videoId: String) {
        File(getResultsDir(), videoId).deleteRecursively()
    }

    override fun fileExists(path: String): Boolean = File(path).exists()

    override fun deleteFile(path: String) {
        val f = File(path)
        if (f.exists()) f.delete()
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromContext(context: Context): AndroidStorage =
            AndroidStorage(context.applicationContext)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.platform

import com.learnagent.data.CodeSnippet
import com.learnagent.data.Decision
import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechUsage
import kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * Android 实现：<filesDir>/{tech_cards,tech_usage,decisions,snippets,mastery}/。
 * 与 jvm 同构（每个实体一个 JSON 文件）。
 * App 启动时调用 [init] 传入 context.filesDir.path；未初始化时退回当前目录。
 */
actual class TechStore actual constructor() {

    companion object {
        private var baseDirPath: String = ""

        /** App 启动时调用一次：TechStore.init(applicationContext.filesDir.path) */
        fun init(filesDirPath: String) {
            baseDirPath = filesDirPath
        }
    }

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private val rootDir: File
        get() = (if (baseDirPath.isBlank()) File(".") else File(baseDirPath)).apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun dir(name: String): File = File(rootDir, name).apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun safeName(id: String): String =
        id.replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-\\u4e00-\\u9fa5.]"), "_").take(80).ifBlank { "unnamed" }

    private fun <T> readAll(dirName: String, serializer: KSerializer<T>): List<T> {
        val files = dir(dirName).listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".json") } ?: return emptyList()
        return files.mapNotNull { f ->
            try {
                json.decodeFromString(serializer, f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun <T> write(dirName: String, id: String, serializer: KSerializer<T>, value: T) {
        File(dir(dirName), safeName(id) + ".json").writeText(json.encodeToString(serializer, value), Charsets.UTF_8)
    }

    actual fun saveTechCard(card: TechCard) = write("tech_cards", card.id, TechCard.serializer(), card)

    actual fun getAllTechCards(): List<TechCard> = readAll("tech_cards", TechCard.serializer())

    actual fun saveTechUsage(usage: TechUsage) = write("tech_usage", usage.techName, TechUsage.serializer(), usage)

    actual fun getAllTechUsage(): List<TechUsage> = readAll("tech_usage", TechUsage.serializer())

    actual fun saveDecision(decision: Decision) = write("decisions", decision.id, Decision.serializer(), decision)

    actual fun getAllDecisions(): List<Decision> = readAll("decisions", Decision.serializer())

    actual fun saveCodeSnippet(snippet: CodeSnippet) = write("snippets", snippet.id, CodeSnippet.serializer(), snippet)

    actual fun getAllCodeSnippets(): List<CodeSnippet> = readAll("snippets", CodeSnippet.serializer())

    actual fun saveMastery(mastery: KnowledgeMastery) = write("mastery", mastery.pointId, KnowledgeMastery.serializer(), mastery)

    actual fun getAllMastery(): List<KnowledgeMastery> = readAll("mastery", KnowledgeMastery.serializer())

    actual fun saveMeta(key: String, value: String) {
        File(dir("meta"), safeName(key) + ".txt").writeText(value, Charsets.UTF_8)
    }

    actual fun getMeta(key: String): String? {
        val f = File(dir("meta"), safeName(key) + ".txt")
        return if (f.isFile) f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) else null
    }
}

package com.learnagent.ambience

import com.learnagent.design.DesignTokens

/**
 * 人为因素纯逻辑（三端共享，无 Compose / 无平台依赖）。
 * 桌面 Ambience 与 Android AmbienceState 都是它的薄封装——行为完全一致。
 *
 *  - 时间段 accent：06-12 暖紫 / 12-18 幻紫 / 18-06 深紫
 *  - 近 60 秒操作频率 → 速度 ±20%
 *  - 空闲 30 秒 → 沉睡
 *  - 使用 >1h → 休息提醒；>3h → 夜读模式
 *  - 内容量 → 粒子数 36~80
 */
object AmbienceCore {

    private val tapTimes = ArrayDeque<Long>()
    private var startedAt = 0L
    private var lastInteractionAt = 0L
    private var lastBreakNoticeAt = 0L

    /** 会话起点（各端包装层启动时调用）。 */
    fun start(now: Long) {
        startedAt = now
        lastInteractionAt = now
        synchronized(tapTimes) { tapTimes.clear() }
    }

    fun noteInteraction(now: Long) {
        lastInteractionAt = now
        synchronized(tapTimes) {
            tapTimes.addLast(now)
            while (tapTimes.isNotEmpty() && now - tapTimes.first() > 60_000) tapTimes.removeFirst()
        }
    }

    private fun tapRate(now: Long): Int = synchronized(tapTimes) {
        tapTimes.count { now - it <= 60_000 }
    }

    /** 快 +20% / 慢 −20% / 基准 1.0。 */
    fun speedFactor(now: Long): Float {
        val rate = tapRate(now)
        return when {
            rate >= 10 -> 1.2f
            rate <= 2 -> 0.8f
            else -> 1.0f
        }
    }

    /** 空闲 30 秒 → 沉睡。 */
    fun isSleeping(now: Long): Boolean = now - lastInteractionAt > 30_000

    fun sessionMinutes(now: Long): Long = if (startedAt == 0L) 0 else (now - startedAt) / 60_000

    /** >3 小时 → 夜读模式。 */
    fun isNightMode(now: Long): Boolean = sessionMinutes(now) >= 180

    /** >1h 且距上次提醒 >10min → 触发一次休息提醒。 */
    fun shouldShowBreakNotice(now: Long): Boolean {
        if (sessionMinutes(now) >= 60 && now - lastBreakNoticeAt > 10 * 60_000) {
            lastBreakNoticeAt = now
            return true
        }
        return false
    }

    /** 粒子数：36 基础，随内容量增长，上限 80。 */
    fun particleCount(videoCount: Int): Int = (36 + videoCount * 4).coerceIn(36, 80)

    /** 时间段 accent 的 ARGB 原始值（V3 晨雾紫 / 睡莲绿 / 深海蓝，DesignTokens 同源）。 */
    fun accentRaw(hour: Int): Long = when (hour) {
        in 6..11 -> DesignTokens.ColorMorningPurple
        in 12..17 -> DesignTokens.ColorLilyGreen
        else -> DesignTokens.ColorNightPurple
    }

    // ---------- 测试 / 预览辅助（跨模块需 public） ----------
    fun rewindSession(now: Long, byMillis: Long) {
        startedAt = now - kotlin.math.abs(byMillis)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.audio

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.random.Random

/**
 * 程序化 PCM 音效合成（三端共享，44100Hz / 16-bit signed / 单声道 / 小端）。
 *
 * 由桌面 SoundSynth 下沉而来，纯函数、无平台依赖：
 * 技术：Karplus-Strong 拨弦、FM 钟声、ADSR / 指数包络、20–50ms 延迟混响模拟。
 * 播放层由各端实现（桌面 SourceDataLine / Android AudioTrack）。
 */
object PcmSynth {

    const val SAMPLE_RATE = 44100

    enum class Sound {
        HOVER, TAP, SUCCESS, ERROR, OPEN, CLOSE, SPLASH_TONE,
        /** 环境音：默认关闭，永不自动播放，仅保留供用户手动开启的路径。 */
        AMBIENT,
        CHIME, DRONE, WHOOSH, REST
    }

    private val cache = HashMap<Sound, ByteArray>()

    /** 渲染（带内存缓存）。 */
    fun render(sound: Sound): ByteArray = synchronized(cache) {
        cache.getOrPut(sound) { encode(raw(sound)) }
    }

    /** 音量缩放（Splash 渐变音量用）。 */
    fun scale(pcm: ByteArray, factor: Float): ByteArray {
        val out = ByteArray(pcm.size)
        for (i in pcm.indices step 2) {
            val v = ((pcm[i + 1].toInt() shl 8) or (pcm[i].toInt() and 0xFF)).toShort().toInt()
            val s = (v * factor).toInt().coerceIn(-32768, 32767)
            out[i] = (s and 0xFF).toByte()
            out[i + 1] = ((s shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        }
        return out
    }

    // ============================================================
    //  合成核心（与桌面音色完全一致）
    // ============================================================

    private fun raw(sound: Sound): FloatArray = when (sound) {
        Sound.HOVER -> withReverb(
            sine(880.0, 0.025, 0.15, attack = 0.002, decayTau = 0.010), 0.10f
        )
        Sound.TAP -> withReverb(
            mix(
                pluck(523.25, 0.08, 0.30),
                sine(659.25, 0.08, 0.26, attack = 0.003, decayTau = 0.030)
            ), 0.25f
        )
        Sound.SUCCESS -> withReverb(
            arpeggio(doubleArrayOf(523.25, 659.25, 783.99), step = 0.08, note = 0.20, volume = 0.25), 0.28f
        )
        Sound.ERROR -> withReverb(
            mix(
                square(220.0, 0.20, 0.20, attack = 0.004, decayTau = 0.085),
                sine(110.0, 0.20, 0.20, attack = 0.004, decayTau = 0.100)
            ), 0.15f
        )
        Sound.OPEN -> withReverb(sweep(300.0, 800.0, 0.15, 0.20), 0.18f)
        Sound.CLOSE -> withReverb(sweep(800.0, 300.0, 0.12, 0.15), 0.15f)
        Sound.SPLASH_TONE -> splashTone()
        Sound.AMBIENT -> withReverb(
            mix(
                sine(60.0, 2.0, 0.03, attack = 0.20, decayTau = 4.0),
                sine(90.0, 2.0, 0.03, attack = 0.20, decayTau = 4.0)
            ), 0.08f
        )
        Sound.CHIME -> withReverb(fmBell(880.0, 0.9, 0.18), 0.35f)
        Sound.DRONE -> withReverb(
            mix(
                sine(110.0, 1.6, 0.08, attack = 0.50, decayTau = 2.5),
                sine(165.0, 1.6, 0.05, attack = 0.50, decayTau = 2.2)
            ), 0.25f
        )
        Sound.WHOOSH -> withReverb(noiseSweep(0.6, 0.10), 0.20f)
        Sound.REST -> withReverb(
            arpeggio(doubleArrayOf(392.0, 523.25), step = 0.14, note = 0.42, volume = 0.12), 0.30f
        )
    }

    /** 指数衰减 + 线性起音包络。 */
    private fun env(t: Double, volume: Double, attack: Double, decayTau: Double): Double {
        val a = if (attack <= 0.0) 1.0 else (t / attack).coerceAtMost(1.0)
        return volume * a * exp(-t / decayTau)
    }

    private fun sine(
        freq: Double,
        seconds: Double,
        volume: Double,
        attack: Double = 0.004,
        decayTau: Double = seconds * 0.40
    ): FloatArray {
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        return FloatArray(n) { i ->
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            (sin(2.0 * PI * freq * t) * env(t, volume, attack, decayTau)).toFloat()
        }
    }

    private fun square(
        freq: Double,
        seconds: Double,
        volume: Double,
        attack: Double = 0.005,
        decayTau: Double = seconds * 0.40
    ): FloatArray {
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        return FloatArray(n) { i ->
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            val s = if (sin(2.0 * PI * freq * t) >= 0.0) 1.0 else -1.0
            (s * env(t, volume, attack, decayTau)).toFloat()
        }
    }

    /** 频率扫掠（相位积分保证连续）。 */
    private fun sweep(f0: Double, f1: Double, seconds: Double, volume: Double): FloatArray {
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        return FloatArray(n) { i ->
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            val phase = 2.0 * PI * (f0 * t + (f1 - f0) * t * t / (2.0 * seconds))
            (sin(phase) * env(t, volume, 0.010, seconds * 0.60)).toFloat()
        }
    }

    /** Karplus-Strong 拨弦：噪声激励 + 延迟线平均滤波。 */
    private fun pluck(freq: Double, seconds: Double, volume: Double, decay: Double = 0.996): FloatArray {
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        val period = (SAMPLE_RATE / freq).toInt().coerceAtLeast(2)
        val rnd = Random(freq.toInt())
        val buf = FloatArray(period) { rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f }
        val out = FloatArray(n)
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val idx = i % period
            val cur = buf[idx]
            val next = buf[(idx + 1) % period]
            out[i] = cur
            buf[idx] = ((cur + next) * 0.5f * decay).toFloat()
        }
        for (i in out.indices) {
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            out[i] = (out[i] * env(t, volume, 0.002, seconds * 0.35)).toFloat()
        }
        return out
    }

    /** FM 钟声：载波 + 指数衰减调制指数。 */
    private fun fmBell(freq: Double, seconds: Double, volume: Double): FloatArray {
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        val modRatio = 1.414
        return FloatArray(n) { i ->
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            val index = 5.0 * exp(-t / 0.18)
            val s = sin(2.0 * PI * freq * t + index * sin(2.0 * PI * freq * modRatio * t))
            (s * env(t, volume, 0.002, seconds * 0.42)).toFloat()
        }
    }

    /** 带通噪声音扫：模拟气息（"呼"）。 */
    private fun noiseSweep(seconds: Double, volume: Double): FloatArray {
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        val out = FloatArray(n)
        val rnd = Random(7)
        var lp = 0f
        var bp = 0f
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            val k = t / seconds
            val cutoff = (0.02 + 0.18 * sin(PI * k)).toFloat()
            val white = rnd.nextFloat() * 2f - 1f
            lp += cutoff * (white - lp)
            bp += cutoff * (lp - bp)
            out[i] = (bp * env(t, volume, 0.08, seconds * 0.45)).toFloat()
        }
        return out
    }

    /** C5→E5→G5 琶音（Karplus-Strong 音符叠加）。 */
    private fun arpeggio(freqs: DoubleArray, step: Double, note: Double, volume: Double): FloatArray {
        val total = (freqs.size - 1) * step + note
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * total).toInt()
        val out = FloatArray(n)
        freqs.forEachIndexed { idx, f ->
            val start = (idx * step * SAMPLE_RATE).toInt()
            val noteArr = pluck(f, note, volume)
            for (i in noteArr.indices) {
                val j = start + i
                if (j < n) out[j] += noteArr[i]
            }
        }
        for (i in out.indices) out[i] = out[i].coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
        return out
    }

    /** Splash 主题音：220Hz 基频 + 440/660/880 泛音，2 秒缓慢衰减。 */
    private fun splashTone(): FloatArray {
        val seconds = 2.0
        val n = (SAMPLE_RATE * seconds).toInt()
        val partials = doubleArrayOf(220.0, 440.0, 660.0, 880.0)
        val gains = doubleArrayOf(1.0, 0.5, 0.28, 0.16)
        val out = FloatArray(n)
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val t = i.toDouble() / SAMPLE_RATE
            var s = 0.0
            for (p in partials.indices) {
                s += gains[p] * sin(2.0 * PI * partials[p] * t + 0.4 * sin(2.0 * PI * 0.6 * t))
            }
            val attack = (t / 0.18).coerceAtMost(1.0)
            out[i] = (s / 1.94 * 0.25 * attack * exp(-t / 0.95)).toFloat()
        }
        return withReverb(out, 0.30f)
    }

    /** 混响模拟：23ms / 41ms 两路延迟叠加。 */
    private fun withReverb(src: FloatArray, mix: Float): FloatArray {
        val out = src.copyOf()
        val d1 = (SAMPLE_RATE * 0.023).toInt()
        val d2 = (SAMPLE_RATE * 0.041).toInt()
        for (i in d2 until out.size) {
            out[i] += src[i - d1] * mix + src[i - d2] * (mix * 0.55f)
        }
        for (i in out.indices) out[i] = out[i].coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
        return out
    }

    private fun mix(vararg parts: FloatArray): FloatArray {
        val n = parts.maxOfOrNull { it.size } ?: 0
        val out = FloatArray(n)
        parts.forEach { p -> for (i in p.indices) out[i] += p[i] }
        for (i in out.indices) out[i] = (out[i] * 0.85f).coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
        return out
    }

    private fun encode(samples: FloatArray): ByteArray {
        val bytes = ByteArray(samples.size * 2)
        for (i in samples.indices) {
            val v = (samples[i].coerceIn(-1f, 1f) * 32767f).toInt()
            bytes[i * 2] = (v and 0xFF).toByte()
            bytes[i * 2 + 1] = ((v shr 8) and 0xFF).toByte()
        }
        return bytes
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/ActiveRecallEngine.kt (3.4KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

data class RecallCard(
    val id: String,
    val pointId: String,
    val question: String,
    val hint: String = "",
    val answer: String,
    val explanation: String,
    val difficulty: Difficulty,
    val sourceUnitId: String,
    val sourceTimestamp: Double
)

enum class Difficulty { EASY, MEDIUM, HARD }

/**
 * 主动回忆卡生成：问题必须让用户主动提取、不暗示答案。
 * LLM 不可用 → 模板："请解释 X 是什么"，answer = definition。
 */
class ActiveRecallEngine(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun generateRecall(point: KnowledgePoint, unit: LearningUnit): RecallCard {
        if (llm != null) {
            try {
                return parse(point, unit, callLlm(point))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // 降级
            }
        }
        return fallback(point, unit)
    }

    private suspend fun callLlm(point: KnowledgePoint): String {
        val client = llm ?: return ""
        val prompt = """
为知识点生成一张主动回忆卡（不要暗示答案，不要"是不是 X"的提问）。
知识点：${point.name}
定义：${point.definition}

要求：
- 问题让用户主动提取（如"请解释/请对比/请举例"）
- 难度：EASY=直接复述，MEDIUM=用自己的话，HARD=举例/对比

只输出 JSON：
{"question":"...","hint":"...","answer":"...","explanation":"...","difficulty":"MEDIUM"}
""".trimIndent()
        return client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
    }

    private fun parse(point: KnowledgePoint, unit: LearningUnit, raw: String): RecallCard {
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun str(key: String, def: String = ""): String = (o[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: def
        val question = str("question").ifBlank { "请解释 ${point.name} 是什么。" }
        val difficulty = runCatching { Difficulty.valueOf(str("difficulty", "MEDIUM").uppercase()) }
            .getOrDefault(Difficulty.MEDIUM)
        return RecallCard(
            id = "recall_" + point.id,
            pointId = point.id,
            question = question,
            hint = str("hint"),
            answer = str("answer", point.definition),
            explanation = str("explanation"),
            difficulty = difficulty,
            sourceUnitId = unit.id,
            sourceTimestamp = unit.start
        )
    }

    private fun fallback(point: KnowledgePoint, unit: LearningUnit): RecallCard = RecallCard(
        id = "recall_" + point.id,
        pointId = point.id,
        question = "请解释 ${point.name} 是什么。",
        hint = "先回忆定义，再想一个使用场景。",
        answer = point.definition,
        explanation = "本地启发式：来自内容定义（${unit.videoId} @ ${unit.start}）",
        difficulty = Difficulty.EASY,
        sourceUnitId = unit.id,
        sourceTimestamp = unit.start
    )
}

        subject == "物理" && type == QuestionType.CALCULATION -> PHYSICS_CALCULATION
        subject == "物理" -> PHYSICS_EXPERIMENT
        subject == "化学" && type == QuestionType.FILL_BLANK -> CHEMISTRY_EQUATION
        subject == "化学" -> CHEMISTRY_CALCULATION
        subject == "语文" && type == QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER -> CHINESE_READING
        subject == "英语" && type == QuestionType.SINGLE_CHOICE -> ENGLISH_CLOZE
        subject == "英语" -> ENGLISH_WRITING
        else -> null
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/AnswerStandardTeacher.kt (10.3KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.AnswerStandard
import com.learnagent.data.AnswerStep
import com.learnagent.data.QuestionType
import com.learnagent.data.ScoringPoint
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

data class StandardGradingResult(
    val score: Int,                      // 实际得分
    val maxScore: Int,
    val missingRequired: List<AnswerStep>,
    val extraOptional: List<AnswerStep>,
    val forbidden: List<String>,
    val orderCorrect: Boolean,
    val feedback: String
)

/**
 * 规范答题老师：
 * - analyzeStandardAnswer：LLM 解析标准答案 → AnswerStandard；失败按学科内置库兜底
 * - gradeWithStandard：关键词匹配为基线；LLM 可用时做语义评分
 * - LLM 不可用 → 只做关键词匹配，不判断顺序，feedback 标注"本地启发式"
 */
class AnswerStandardTeacher(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun analyzeStandardAnswer(question: String, standardAnswer: String, subject: String): AnswerStandard {
        if (llm != null) {
            try {
                return parseStandard(subject, callLlm(question, standardAnswer, subject))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // 降级
            }
        }
        return fallbackStandard(standardAnswer, subject)
    }

    suspend fun gradeWithStandard(standard: AnswerStandard, userAnswer: String): StandardGradingResult {
        val keyword = keywordGrade(standard, userAnswer)
        if (llm == null) {
            return keyword.copy(feedback = "本地启发式：${keyword.feedback}")
        }
        return try {
            llmGrade(standard, userAnswer, keyword)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            keyword.copy(feedback = "本地启发式：${keyword.feedback}")
        }
    }

    // ---------- 关键词基线 ----------

    fun keywordGrade(standard: AnswerStandard, userAnswer: String): StandardGradingResult {
        val missing = standard.requiredSteps.filter { matchPosition(it.content, userAnswer) < 0 }
        val optionalHit = standard.optionalSteps.filter { matchPosition(it.content, userAnswer) >= 0 }
        val forbidden = standard.forbiddenSteps.filter { userAnswer.contains(it) }

        val points = standard.scoringPoints
        val maxScore = if (points.isNotEmpty()) points.sumOf { it.score }
        else standard.requiredSteps.sumOf { it.scoreIfMissing }.coerceAtLeast(1)
        val earned = if (points.isNotEmpty()) {
            points.filter { it.mustAppear && matchPosition(it.point, userAnswer) >= 0 }.sumOf { it.score }
        } else {
            maxScore - missing.sumOf { it.scoreIfMissing }
        }
        val score = earned.coerceIn(0, maxScore)

        // 顺序检查：命中步骤的首个位置应单调不减
        val positions = standard.requiredSteps
            .map { matchPosition(it.content, userAnswer) }
            .filter { it >= 0 }
        val orderCorrect = positions.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a <= b }

        val feedback = buildString {
            append("得分 $score/$maxScore。")
            if (missing.isNotEmpty()) append("缺失步骤：").append(missing.joinToString("；") { it.content }).append("。")
            if (forbidden.isNotEmpty()) append("出现禁止项：").append(forbidden.joinToString("；")).append("。")
            if (!orderCorrect) append("步骤顺序有误。")
            if (missing.isEmpty() && forbidden.isEmpty() && orderCorrect) append("步骤完整，顺序正确。")
        }
        return StandardGradingResult(score, maxScore, missing, optionalHit, forbidden, orderCorrect, feedback)
    }

    /** 步骤文本在答案中的命中位置（整串优先，2-gram 兜底）。 */
    fun matchPosition(stepContent: String, userAnswer: String): Int {
        val cleaned = clean(stepContent)
        if (cleaned.isBlank()) return -1
        if (userAnswer.contains(cleaned)) return userAnswer.indexOf(cleaned)
        return grams(cleaned).firstNotNullOfOrNull { g -> userAnswer.indexOf(g).takeIf { it >= 0 } } ?: -1
    }

    private fun clean(s: String): String = s.replace(Regex("[^\\u4e00-\\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]"), "")

    private fun grams(cleaned: String): List<String> {
        if (cleaned.length <= 2) return listOf(cleaned).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        return (0..cleaned.length - 2).map { cleaned.substring(it, it + 2) }
    }

    // ---------- LLM ----------

    private suspend fun callLlm(question: String, standardAnswer: String, subject: String): String {
        val client = llm ?: return ""
        val prompt = """
你是阅卷组长。把标准答案解析成结构化答题规范，只输出 JSON：
{"questionType":"SHORT_ANSWER","requiredSteps":[{"order":1,"content":"...","reason":"...","scoreIfMissing":2}],
 "optionalSteps":[],"forbiddenSteps":[],"scoringPoints":[{"point":"...","score":2,"mustAppear":true}],
 "standardTemplate":"..."}

学科：$subject
题目：$question
标准答案：$standardAnswer
""".trimIndent()
        return client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
    }

    private fun parseStandard(subject: String, raw: String): AnswerStandard {
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun str(key: String, def: String = ""): String = (o[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: def
        val steps = (o["requiredSteps"] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { el ->
            val obj = el as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val content = (obj["content"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: return@mapNotNull null
            AnswerStep(
                order = (obj["order"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                content = content,
                reason = (obj["reason"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull.orEmpty(),
                scoreIfMissing = (obj["scoreIfMissing"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toIntOrNull() ?: 1
            )
        } ?: emptyList()
        val points = (o["scoringPoints"] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { el ->
            val obj = el as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val point = (obj["point"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: return@mapNotNull null
            ScoringPoint(
                point = point,
                score = (obj["score"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toIntOrNull() ?: 1,
                mustAppear = (obj["mustAppear"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toBooleanStrictOrNull() ?: true
            )
        } ?: emptyList()
        val type = runCatching { QuestionType.valueOf(str("questionType", "SHORT_ANSWER").uppercase()) }
            .getOrDefault(QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER)
        return AnswerStandard(
            id = "std_" + subject,
            questionType = type,
            subject = subject,
            requiredSteps = steps,
            scoringPoints = points,
            standardTemplate = str("standardTemplate")
        )
    }

    private suspend fun llmGrade(
        standard: AnswerStandard,
        userAnswer: String,
        baseline: StandardGradingResult
    ): StandardGradingResult {
        val client = llm ?: return baseline
        val standardText = buildString {
            append("解题步骤：").append(standard.requiredSteps.joinToString("；") { "${it.order}.${it.content}" }).append("\n")
            if (standard.forbiddenSteps.isNotEmpty()) append("禁止：").append(standard.forbiddenSteps.joinToString("；")).append("\n")
            if (standard.scoringPoints.isNotEmpty()) append("采分点：").append(standard.scoringPoints.joinToString("；") { "${it.point}(${it.score}分)" })
        }
        val prompt = """
严格按规范评分，只输出 JSON：
{"score":0,"maxScore":${baseline.maxScore},"missingRequired":["步骤"],"forbidden":["..."],"orderCorrect":true,"feedback":"..."}

规范：
$standardText

学生答案：$userAnswer
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun str(key: String, def: String = ""): String = (o[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: def
        val missingTexts = (o["missingRequired"] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: emptyList()
        val missing = if (missingTexts.isEmpty()) baseline.missingRequired
        else standard.requiredSteps.filter { st -> missingTexts.any { t -> st.content.contains(t) || t.contains(st.content) } }
        val forbidden = (o["forbidden"] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: baseline.forbidden
        val orderCorrect = (o["orderCorrect"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toBooleanStrictOrNull() ?: baseline.orderCorrect
        return baseline.copy(
            score = str("score").toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(0, baseline.maxScore) ?: baseline.score,
            missingRequired = missing,
            forbidden = forbidden,
            orderCorrect = orderCorrect,
            feedback = str("feedback", baseline.feedback)
        )
    }

    private fun fallbackStandard(standardAnswer: String, subject: String): AnswerStandard {
        val lib = AnswerStandardLibrary.get(subject, QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER)
            ?: AnswerStandardLibrary.all.firstOrNull { it.subject == subject }
        if (lib != null) return lib.copy(standardTemplate = standardAnswer)
        val points = standardAnswer.split(Regex("[。；;\\n]+"))
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.length >= 3 }
            .take(5)
            .mapIndexed { i, text -> ScoringPoint("步骤${i + 1}：${text.take(20)}", 1, true) }
        return AnswerStandard(
            id = "std_generic",
            questionType = QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER,
            subject = subject,
            scoringPoints = points,
            standardTemplate = standardAnswer
        )
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

/** 画面氛围量化结果（值均为 0..1 或 -1..1，可复算，不依赖模型）。 */
data class FrameMood(
    val brightness: Float,   // 0..1
    val saturation: Float,   // 0..1
    val warmth: Float,       // -1(冷) .. +1(暖)
    val contrast: Float,     // 0..1
    val labels: List<String>
)

/**
 * 画面氛围判定（确定性规则，非生成式，避免幻觉）：
 * 由平台层从像素算出 brightness/saturation/warmth/contrast，这里只做阈值分类。
 */
object Atmosphere {
    fun classify(brightness: Float, saturation: Float, warmth: Float, contrast: Float): FrameMood {
        val labels = ArrayList<String>(4)
        labels += when {
            brightness < 0.28f -> "昏暗"
            brightness > 0.68f -> "明亮"
            else -> "中等亮度"
        }
        labels += when {
            saturation < 0.18f -> "低饱和"
            saturation > 0.45f -> "鲜艳"
            else -> "自然色"
        }
        labels += when {
            warmth > 0.12f -> "暖调"
            warmth < -0.12f -> "冷调"
            else -> "中性色温"
        }
        labels += when {
            contrast < 0.16f -> "柔和"
            contrast > 0.33f -> "高对比"
            else -> "均衡对比"
        }
        return FrameMood(brightness, saturation, warmth, contrast, labels)
    }

    fun label(mood: FrameMood): String = mood.labels.joinToString("·")

    /** 由 RGB(0..255) 像素均值区域计算指标。 */
    fun fromAverages(rAvg: Float, gAvg: Float, bAvg: Float, minLuma: Float, maxLuma: Float): FrameMood {
        val r = rAvg / 255f; val g = gAvg / 255f; val b = bAvg / 255f
        val brightness = (0.299f * r + 0.587f * g + 0.114f * b).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val maxc = maxOf(r, g, b); val minc = minOf(r, g, b)
        val saturation = if (maxc <= 0f) 0f else ((maxc - minc) / maxc).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val warmth = (r - b).coerceIn(-1f, 1f)
        val contrast = ((maxLuma - minLuma) / 255f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        return classify(brightness, saturation, warmth, contrast)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import kotlin.math.ln

/** 同义词表（22 组，中英互扩）。 */
val TECH_SYNONYMS: Map<String, List<String>> = linkedMapOf(
    "分布式锁" to listOf("distributed lock", "redlock", "zookeeper lock"),
    "缓存" to listOf("cache", "redis", "memcached"),
    "消息队列" to listOf("message queue", "kafka", "rabbitmq", "rocketmq"),
    "负载均衡" to listOf("load balancing", "nginx", "lvs"),
    "数据库索引" to listOf("db index", "b+ tree", "innodb"),
    "并发" to listOf("concurrency", "parallel", "thread"),
    "容器" to listOf("container", "docker", "kubernetes", "k8s"),
    "微服务" to listOf("microservice", "service mesh"),
    "限流" to listOf("rate limit", "throttle"),
    "熔断" to listOf("circuit breaker", "hystrix"),
    "一致性" to listOf("consistency", "raft", "paxos", "cap"),
    "数据库事务" to listOf("transaction", "acid", "isolation"),
    "分库分表" to listOf("sharding", "partition"),
    "反向代理" to listOf("reverse proxy", "nginx"),
    "垃圾回收" to listOf("gc", "garbage collection"),
    "线程池" to listOf("thread pool", "executor"),
    "设计模式" to listOf("design pattern", "singleton", "factory"),
    "接口" to listOf("api", "interface"),
    "部署" to listOf("deploy", "deployment", "release"),
    "监控" to listOf("monitoring", "prometheus", "grafana"),
    "加密" to listOf("encryption", "aes", "rsa"),
    "机器学习" to listOf("machine learning", "ml", "deep learning")
)

/** 索引文档：tokens 为分词结果；avgLen 为可选全局平均长度（0 = 由 index() 计算）。 */
data class IndexedDoc(
    val id: String,
    val tokens: List<String>,
    val avgLen: Float = 0f
)

data class ScoredDoc(val docId: String, val score: Float)

/**
 * BM25-lite 检索：
 * score(q,d) = Σ IDF(t) × (tf·(k1+1)) / (tf + k1·(1 − b + b·|d|/avgdl))
 * IDF(t) = ln((N − df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1)
 * 默认 k1=1.2，b=0.75。
 */
class Bm25Indexer(
    private val k1: Float = 1.2f,
    private val b: Float = 0.75f
) {

    private var docs: List<IndexedDoc> = emptyList()
    private var df: Map<String, Int> = emptyMap()
    private var avgdl: Float = 0f

    fun index(docs: List<IndexedDoc>) {
        this.docs = docs
        val dfMap = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
        docs.forEach { doc -> doc.tokens.toSet().forEach { t -> dfMap[t] = (dfMap[t] ?: 0) + 1 } }
        df = dfMap
        val providedAvg = docs.firstOrNull { it.avgLen > 0f }?.avgLen ?: 0f
        avgdl = if (providedAvg > 0f) providedAvg
        else if (docs.isEmpty()) 0f
        else docs.map { it.tokens.size }.average().toFloat()
    }

    fun search(query: String, topK: Int = 10): List<ScoredDoc> {
        val tokens = expandQuery(tokenize(query))
        if (tokens.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return docs
            .map { ScoredDoc(it.id, scoreTokens(tokens, it.id)) }
            .filter { it.score > 0f }
            .sortedByDescending { it.score }
            .take(topK)
    }

    /** 指定 query tokens 对某文档的 BM25 分数（供精确断言使用）。 */
    fun scoreTokens(queryTokens: List<String>, docId: String): Float {
        val doc = docs.firstOrNull { it.id == docId } ?: return 0f
        if (docs.isEmpty() || avgdl <= 0f || doc.tokens.isEmpty()) return 0f
        val tfMap = doc.tokens.groupingBy { it }.eachCount()
        val n = docs.size.toFloat()
        val dlen = doc.tokens.size.toFloat()
        var score = 0f
        queryTokens.distinct().forEach { t ->
            val tf = (tfMap[t] ?: 0).toFloat()
            if (tf > 0f) {
                val dft = (df[t] ?: 0).toFloat()
                val idf = ln((n - dft + 0.5f) / (dft + 0.5f) + 1f)
                score += idf * (tf * (k1 + 1f)) / (tf + k1 * (1f - b + b * dlen / avgdl))
            }
        }
        return score
    }

    /** 分词：小写化 → 非字母数字切分 → CJK 长词补 2-gram。 */
    fun tokenize(text: String): List<String> {
        val raw = text.lowercase().split(Regex("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}+#]+")).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        val out = LinkedHashSet<String>()
        raw.forEach { token ->
            out.add(token)
            if (token.length > 2 && token.any { it.code > 0x2E80 }) {
                for (i in 0..token.length - 2) out.add(token.substring(i, i + 2))
            }
        }
        return out.toList()
    }

    /** 同义词双向扩展。 */
    fun expandQuery(tokens: List<String>): List<String> {
        val out = LinkedHashSet(tokens)
        TECH_SYNONYMS.forEach { (key, synonyms) ->
            val synonymTokens = synonyms.flatMap { tokenize(it) }.toSet()
            val hit = tokens.any { t -> t == key || tokenize(key).contains(t) || synonymTokens.contains(t) }
            if (hit) {
                out.add(key)
                out.addAll(tokenize(key))
                synonyms.forEach { out.add(it); out.addAll(tokenize(it)) }
            }
        }
        return out.toList()
    }
}

/** 时间窗口融合：命中片段附带前后各 1 段（相邻时间戳的 LearningUnit）。 */
data class RetrievalWithContext(
    val hit: ScoredDoc,
    val before: LearningUnit?,
    val after: LearningUnit?
)

class TimeWindowRetriever(
    private val units: List<LearningUnit>,
    private val idOf: (LearningUnit) -> String = { it.id }
) {

    fun fuse(hits: List<ScoredDoc>): List<RetrievalWithContext> = hits.map { hit ->
        val index = units.indexOfFirst { idOf(it) == hit.docId }
        RetrievalWithContext(
            hit = hit,
            before = if (index > 0) units[index - 1] else null,
            after = if (index in 0 until units.size - 1) units[index + 1] else null
        )
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.CodeSnippet
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit

/**
 * 代码片段提取器（规则版，不依赖 LLM）：
 * 1. 识别 ``` 包裹的代码块（可带语言标注）
 * 2. 识别连续 4 空格 / Tab 缩进的行
 * 3. 按语言特征识别语言；注释用规则生成一句话
 */
class CodeSnippetExtractor {

    fun extract(unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String): List<CodeSnippet> {
        val text = unit.screenText.ifBlank { unit.speech }
        if (text.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val blocks = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>() // code to language hint
        FENCED.findAll(text).forEach { m ->
            val hint = m.groupValues[1].trim()
            val code = m.groupValues[2].trim('\n', '\r')
            if (code.isNotBlank()) blocks.add(code to hint)
        }
        if (blocks.isEmpty()) {
            indentedBlock(text)?.let { blocks.add(it to "") }
        }

        return blocks.mapIndexed { i, (code, hint) ->
            val language = detectLanguage(code, hint)
            CodeSnippet(
                id = "${videoId}_snippet_${unit.start.toInt()}_$i",
                language = language,
                purpose = "代码片段（$language）",
                code = code,
                comment = oneLineComment(code),
                sourceVideoId = videoId,
                sourceTimestamp = unit.start,
                tags = unit.keywords.take(5)
            )
        }
    }

    /** 连续 ≥2 行以 4 空格或 Tab 开头（允许空行间隔）时，取为一个代码块。 */
    private fun indentedBlock(text: String): String? {
        val lines = text.lines()
        val collected = mutableListOf<String>()
        var current = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (line in lines) {
            val isIndented = (line.startsWith("    ") || line.startsWith("\t")) && line.trim().isNotEmpty()
            if (isIndented) {
                current.add(line)
            } else {
                if (current.size >= 2) collected.addAll(current)
                current = mutableListOf()
            }
        }
        if (current.size >= 2) collected.addAll(current)
        if (collected.size < 2) return null
        return collected.joinToString("\n").trim()
    }

    private fun detectLanguage(code: String, hint: String): String {
        val h = hint.lowercase().trim()
        if (h.isNotBlank()) return h
        return when {
            Regex("(?m)^\\s*def\\s+\\w+.*:").containsMatchIn(code) -> "python"
            Regex("(?m)^\\s*(public|private|protected)\\s+(class|void|static)").containsMatchIn(code) ||
                code.contains("System.out.println") -> "java"
            Regex("(?m)^\\s*fun\\s+\\w+").containsMatchIn(code) ||
                (code.contains("val ") && code.contains("fun ")) -> "kotlin"
            Regex("(?i)\\b(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE\\s+TABLE)\\b").containsMatchIn(code) -> "sql"
            code.contains("function ") || code.contains("const ") || code.contains("=>") -> "javascript"
            code.contains("#include") || code.contains("int main") -> "c"
            else -> "text"
        }
    }

    private fun oneLineComment(code: String): String {
        val first = code.lines().firstOrNull { it.trim().isNotEmpty() }?.trim().orEmpty()
        return if (first.isBlank()) "OCR 提取的代码片段" else "首行：${first.take(60)}"
    }

    private companion object {
        val FENCED = Regex("```([A-Za-z0-9+#]*)[ \\t]*\\n([\\s\\S]*?)```")
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.Emotion
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.data.Pace
import com.learnagent.data.SemanticType
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.Tone
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive

/**
 * 上下文分析：每 [batchSize] 条 TimelineItem 一批，带前 [before] / 后 [after] 条上下文，
 * 交给 LLM 输出结构化 JSON。解析失败或无 LLM → 降级（oneLineSummary = speech.take(50)）。
 */
class ContextAnalyzer(private val llm: LlmClient? = null) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun analyze(
        items: List<TimelineItem>,
        videoId: String,
        batchSize: Int = 5,
        before: Int = 3,
        after: Int = 5
    ): List<LearningUnit> {
        val result = mutableListOf<LearningUnit>()
        var i = 0
        while (i < items.size) {
            val end = minOf(i + batchSize, items.size)
            val ctxBefore = items.subList(maxOf(0, i - before), i).joinToString(" ") { it.speech }
            val ctxAfter = items.subList(end, minOf(end + after, items.size)).joinToString(" ") { it.speech }
            for (item in items.subList(i, end)) {
                result.add(analyzeOne(item, videoId, ctxBefore, ctxAfter))
            }
            i = end
        }
        return result
    }

    private suspend fun analyzeOne(
        item: TimelineItem,
        videoId: String,
        before: String,
        after: String
    ): LearningUnit {
        val base = baseOf(item, videoId)
        val client = llm ?: return base
        return try {
            val prompt = buildString {
                append("分析以下视频片段，只输出 JSON（不要解释）：\n")
                append("{\"semanticType\":\"DEFINITION|EXAMPLE|DERIVATION|CONCLUSION|COMPARISON|WARNING|BACKGROUND|UNKNOWN\",")
                append("\"emotion\":\"NEUTRAL|EXCITED|CALM|CONFUSED|EMPHATIC|HUMOROUS\",")
                append("\"tone\":\"NORMAL|DEFINITION|EXAMPLE|EMPHASIS|TRANSITION|SUMMARY|WARNING\",")
                append("\"pace\":\"NORMAL|FAST|SLOW|PAUSE\",\"importance\":1-5,")
                append("\"keywords\":[...],\"oneLineSummary\":\"...\",\"intuition\":\"...\",\"whenToUse\":\"...\",\"commonPitfalls\":\"...\"}\n\n")
                append("上文：").append(before).append("\n")
                append("本段：").append(item.speech).append("\n画面：").append(item.screenText).append("\n")
                append("下文：").append(after)
            }
            parse(base, client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", "")))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            base
        }
    }

    private fun baseOf(item: TimelineItem, videoId: String) = LearningUnit(
        id = videoId + "_" + item.start.toInt(),
        videoId = videoId,
        start = item.start,
        end = item.end,
        speech = item.speech,
        screenText = item.screenText,
        framePath = item.framePath,
        oneLineSummary = item.speech.take(50)
    )

    private fun parse(base: LearningUnit, text: String): LearningUnit = try {
        val start = text.indexOf('{')
        val endIdx = text.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (start < 0 || endIdx <= start) base
        else {
            val o = json.parseToJsonElement(text.substring(start, endIdx + 1)).jsonObject
            fun str(k: String, d: String) = o[k]?.jsonPrimitive?.content ?: d
            base.copy(
                semanticType = runCatching { SemanticType.valueOf(str("semanticType", "UNKNOWN")) }.getOrDefault(SemanticType.UNKNOWN),
                emotion = runCatching { Emotion.valueOf(str("emotion", "NEUTRAL")) }.getOrDefault(Emotion.NEUTRAL),
                tone = runCatching { Tone.valueOf(str("tone", "NORMAL")) }.getOrDefault(Tone.NORMAL),
                pace = runCatching { Pace.valueOf(str("pace", "NORMAL")) }.getOrDefault(Pace.NORMAL),
                importance = (o["importance"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toIntOrNull() ?: 3).coerceIn(1, 5),
                oneLineSummary = str("oneLineSummary", base.oneLineSummary),
                intuition = str("intuition", ""),
                whenToUse = str("whenToUse", ""),
                commonPitfalls = str("commonPitfalls", "")
            )
        }
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        base
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore

/** 召回块：搜索/问答时主动浮现的历史相关记录。 */
data class RecallBlock(
    val type: String,        // "decision" / "tech_card" / "usage"
    val summary: String,     // 一句话摘要
    val timestamp: Long,
    val referenceId: String  // 关联的实体 id（decision.id / card.id / techName）
)

/**
 * 上下文召回（"反复遇见"机制）：
 * - Decision.problem/chosen/reason 相似
 * - TechCard.relatedConcepts / name 命中
 * - TechUsage.usedCount ≥ 3
 * 混合排序取 Top N；搜索 topN=5，回答 topN=3。
 */
class ContextualRecall(private val techStore: TechStore) {

    fun recallForSearch(query: String, topN: Int = 5): List<RecallBlock> = recall(query, topN)

    fun recallForAnswer(question: String, topN: Int = 3): List<RecallBlock> = recall(question, topN)

    private fun recall(query: String, topN: Int): List<RecallBlock> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val keywords = ProblemParser(null).parseWithDictionary(query).keywords
        if (keywords.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        fun hits(text: String): Int = keywords.count { text.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }

        val scored = mutableListOf<Pair<Int, RecallBlock>>()

        techStore.getAllDecisions().forEach { d ->
            val score = hits(d.problem) + hits(d.chosen) + hits(d.reason)
            if (score > 0) {
                scored.add(score to RecallBlock("decision", "决策：${d.problem} → ${d.chosen}", d.createdAt, d.id))
            }
        }

        val usageByName = techStore.getAllTechUsage().associateBy { it.techName }
        techStore.getAllTechCards().forEach { c ->
            val score = hits(c.name) * 2 + hits(c.relatedConcepts.joinToString(" ")) + hits(c.whatItSolves)
            if (score > 0) {
                val ts = usageByName[c.name]?.lastSeenAt ?: 0L
                scored.add(score to RecallBlock("tech_card", "技术卡：${c.name} —— ${c.whatItIs}", ts, c.id))
            }
        }

        techStore.getAllTechUsage().filter { it.usedCount >= 3 }.forEach { u ->
            if (hits(u.techName) > 0) {
                scored.add(2 to RecallBlock("usage", "反复使用：${u.techName}（${u.usedCount} 次 · ${u.status}）", u.lastSeenAt, u.techName))
            }
        }

        return scored
            .sortedWith(compareByDescending<Pair<Int, RecallBlock>> { it.first }.thenByDescending { it.second.timestamp })
            .map { it.second }
            .distinctBy { it.type + it.referenceId }
            .take(topN)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/** 跨视频连接：某个关键词在某个视频中出现的次数。 */
data class VideoConnection(
    val videoId: String,
    val keyword: String,
    val count: Int
)

/**
 * 跨视频索引：把多个视频的时间线放进同一个索引，支持查找
 * "某个概念在哪些视频里出现过"。
 */
class CrossVideoIndex {

    private val videos = linkedMapOf<String, List<TimelineItem>>()

    fun indexVideo(videoId: String, items: List<TimelineItem>) {
        videos[videoId] = items
    }

    fun clear() = videos.clear()

    /** 查询关键词在每个视频中的命中次数，按次数降序。 */
    fun findCrossVideoConnections(query: String): List<VideoConnection> {
        val keywords = query
            .lowercase()
            .split(Regex("[\\s,，。、/]+"))
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (keywords.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val result = mutableListOf<VideoConnection>()
        for ((videoId, items) in videos) {
            for (kw in keywords) {
                val count = items.count { item ->
                    item.speech.lowercase().contains(kw) || item.screenText.lowercase().contains(kw)
                }
                if (count > 0) result.add(VideoConnection(videoId, kw, count))
            }
        }
        return result.sortedByDescending { it.count }
    }

    /** 在所有视频中查找共享的关键词（出现在 >= n 个视频里）。 */
    fun sharedKeywords(minVideos: Int = 2, limit: Int = 20): Map<String, List<String>> {
        val keywordToVideos = mutableMapOf<String, MutableSet<String>>()
        for ((videoId, items) in videos) {
            val tokens = items.flatMap { tokenize(it.speech) + tokenize(it.screenText) }.toSet()
            for (t in tokens) keywordToVideos.getOrPut(t) { mutableSetOf() }.add(videoId)
        }
        return keywordToVideos
            .filter { it.value.size >= minVideos }
            .entries
            .sortedByDescending { it.value.size }
            .take(limit)
            .associate { it.key to it.value.toList() }
    }

    private fun tokenize(text: String): List<String> {
        val cleaned = text.lowercase()
            .replace(Regex("[\\s,，。、/！？；：\"'`()（）]"), " ")
        return cleaned.split(" ").filter { it.length >= 2 }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * 辩论默认模型 ID（V3：NVIDIA NIM 三模型）。
 * 设置里的 debateModelA/B/C 为空时回退到这里。
 * 端点由 NvidiaLlmClient / AndroidNimClient 固定为 https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1。
 */
object DebateModels {
    const val DEFAULT_A = "moonshotai/kimi-k3"
    const val DEFAULT_B = "deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
    const val DEFAULT_C = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"

    /** 快速兜底模型（当某一席超时/失败时接替，保证辩论不整体失败）。 */
    const val FAST_FALLBACK = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"

    fun resolve(configured: String, fallback: String): String =
        configured.trim().ifBlank { fallback }
}

/** 三席位的角色化 system prompt（拼接到用户 prompt 前）。 */
object DebateRoles {
    const val IDENTITY = "你是 Mentara（本应用内置 AI）的辩论席位，回答中自称「Mentara」。"
    const val A = IDENTITY + "侧重长上下文推理和 agentic 思维，关注长远视角、可扩展性、演化路径。"
    const val B = IDENTITY + "侧重工程严谨性，关注边界条件、失败模式、在什么条件下会失效。"
    const val C = IDENTITY + "侧重中文语境和实际落地，关注落地成本、团队接受度、真实工程中的使用方式。"

    fun prompt(role: String, text: String): String = "$role\n\n$text"
}

/**
 * 三模型辩论结果（四轮对抗协议）。
 *
 * 旧字段全部保留（StageATest 依赖 conclusion / divergent / confidence 的旧语义）；
 * 新字段全部带默认值：critiques（3 条交叉批判）、judge（中立裁判）、agreement（三方一致性 0~1）。
 */
@Serializable
data class DebateResult(
    // ---- 旧字段（一个不删） ----
    val conclusion: String,
    val critique: String,
    val response: String,
    val confidence: Double,
    val divergent: Boolean,
    val proposerA: String = "",
    val proposerB: String = "",
    val proposerC: String = "",
    val minorityReport: String = "",
    // ---- 四轮协议新字段 ----
    /** 3 条交叉批判，格式 "【B 批 A】…"（谁批谁在文本内注明）。 */
    val critiques: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** 中立裁判全文（最终结论 + 各提案可取之处 + 各提案问题）。 */
    val judge: String = "",
    /** 三方一致性 0~1（提案两两 bigram 相似度均值）；-1 表示未计算。 */
    val agreement: Double = -1.0
)

/**
 * DebateEngine（四轮真对抗）：
 *  第 1 轮 提案：A / B / C 各自独立给出结论（**并行**）
 *  第 2 轮 交叉批判：B 批 A → C 批 B → A 批 C（**并行**），产出 3 条批判
 *  第 3 轮 中立裁决：裁判综合 3 提案 + 3 批判（**与回应并行**）
 *  第 4 步 后处理：agreement = 提案两两相似度均值（连续 0~1）；最低者自动成为少数派
 *
 * 容错：任一模型超时/失败 → **自动回退到 [fallback]**（若提供），仍失败才显示占位文本；
 *       绝不整体抛出；协程取消原样传播（支持"取消辩论"）。
 */
class DebateEngine(
    private val llmA: LlmClient,
    private val llmB: LlmClient,
    private val llmC: LlmClient? = null,
    private val fallback: LlmClient? = null
) {

    suspend fun debate(
        topic: String,
        context: String,
        onPhase: (Int) -> Unit = {},
        onRound: (Int, DebateResult) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): DebateResult {
        val cfg = LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", "")
        val judgeLlm = llmC ?: llmB

        // 单席调用：先主模型，超时/失败自动回退快模型；都失败才给占位文本。
        suspend fun slot(client: LlmClient, who: String, prompt: String): String {
            suspend fun run(c: LlmClient): String? = try {
                withTimeoutOrNull(LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS) { c.generateResponse(prompt, cfg) }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                if (e::class.simpleName == "CancellationException") throw e
                null
            }
            val first = run(client)
            if (!first.isNullOrBlank()) return first
            if (fallback != null) {
                val fb = run(fallback)
                if (!fb.isNullOrBlank()) return fb
            }
            return "（$who 不可用/超时，已跳过）"
        }

        // ---- 第 1 轮：提案（并行） ----
        onPhase(1)
        val (conclusion, proposerB, proposerC) = coroutineScope {
            val pa = async { slot(llmA, "模型 A", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.A, "给出结论（只基于给定内容）：$topic\n$context")) }
            val pb = async { slot(llmB, "模型 B", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.B, "给出你的独立结论（只基于给定内容）：$topic\n$context")) }
            val pc = async {
                if (llmC != null) {
                    slot(llmC, "模型 C", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.C, "给出你的独立结论（只基于给定内容）：$topic\n$context"))
                } else {
                    slot(llmB, "模型 C", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.C, "换一个完全不同的角度给出结论（只基于给定内容）：$topic\n$context"))
                }
            }
            Triple(pa.await(), pb.await(), pc.await())
        }
        val round1 = DebateResult(
            conclusion = conclusion, critique = "", response = "",
            confidence = 0.0, divergent = false,
            proposerA = conclusion, proposerB = proposerB, proposerC = proposerC
        )
        onRound(1, round1)

        // ---- 第 2 轮：交叉批判（并行） ----
        onPhase(2)
        val (critBA, critCB, critAC) = coroutineScope {
            val cba = async { slot(llmB, "模型 B", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.B, "批判以下结论，指出问题或反例：\n$conclusion")) }
            val ccb = async {
                if (llmC != null) {
                    slot(llmC, "模型 C", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.C, "批判以下结论，指出问题或反例：\n$proposerB"))
                } else {
                    slot(llmB, "模型 C", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.C, "换一个角度批判以下结论，指出问题或反例：\n$proposerB"))
                }
            }
            val cac = async { slot(llmA, "模型 A", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.A, "批判以下结论，指出问题或反例：\n$proposerC")) }
            Triple(cba.await(), ccb.await(), cac.await())
        }
        val critiques = listOf(
            "【B 批 A】$critBA",
            "【C 批 B】$critCB",
            "【A 批 C】$critAC"
        )
        val round2 = round1.copy(critique = critBA, critiques = critiques)
        onRound(2, round2)

        // ---- 第 3 轮：中立裁决（与回应并行） ----
        onPhase(3)
        val judgePrompt = buildString {
            append("你是 Mentara 的中立裁判，回答中自称「Mentara」。三份提案与三条批判如下：\n")
            append("提案A：").append(conclusion).append('\n')
            append("提案B：").append(proposerB).append('\n')
            append("提案C：").append(proposerC).append('\n')
            critiques.forEach { append(it).append('\n') }
            append("请输出：1) 最终结论 2) 各提案的可取之处 3) 各提案的问题")
        }
        val (judge, response) = coroutineScope {
            val j = async { slot(judgeLlm, "中立裁判", judgePrompt) }
            val r = async { slot(llmA, "模型 A", DebateRoles.prompt(DebateRoles.A, "回应以下批判：\n$critBA")) }
            j.await() to r.await()
        }
        val round3 = round2.copy(response = response, judge = judge)
        onRound(3, round3)

        // ---- 第 4 步：后处理（连续一致性 + 少数派） ----
        val allFailed = listOf(conclusion, proposerB, proposerC)
            .all { it.contains("不可用") || it.contains("超时") }
        val simAB = similarity(conclusion, proposerB)
        val simBC = similarity(proposerB, proposerC)
        val simAC = similarity(conclusion, proposerC)
        val agreement = if (allFailed) -1.0 else (simAB + simBC + simAC) / 3.0
        val avgA = (simAB + simAC) / 2.0
        val avgB = (simAB + simBC) / 2.0
        val avgC = (simAC + simBC) / 2.0
        val minority = when {
            avgA <= avgB && avgA <= avgC -> conclusion
            avgB <= avgC -> proposerB
            else -> proposerC
        }

        // 旧语义保持：divergent 仍由"B 批 A 的否定词/重合度"启发式决定（StageATest 依赖）
        val divergent = if (allFailed) false else detectDivergence(conclusion, critBA)
        val confidence = if (allFailed) 0.0 else if (divergent) 0.5 else 0.8

        return round3.copy(
            divergent = divergent,
            confidence = confidence,
            minorityReport = minority,
            agreement = agreement
        )
    }

    /**
     * 字符 bigram 集合相似度（对中英文都友好）：
     * 交集大小 / 较小集合大小，0~1；空文本返回 0。
     */
    private fun similarity(a: String, b: String): Double {
        fun bigrams(s: String): Set<String> {
            val t = s.filter { !it.isWhitespace() }
            if (t.isEmpty()) return emptySet()
            if (t.length == 1) return setOf(t)
            return (0 until t.length - 1).map { t.substring(it, it + 2) }.toSet()
        }
        val ga = bigrams(a)
        val gb = bigrams(b)
        if (ga.isEmpty() || gb.isEmpty()) return 0.0
        return ga.intersect(gb).size.toDouble() / minOf(ga.size, gb.size)
    }

    /** 简单启发式：批判中出现否定词或与结论关键词重叠很低 → 视为分歧（旧语义保持）。 */
    private fun detectDivergence(conclusion: String, critique: String): Boolean {
        val negations = listOf("不", "错", "有误", "问题", "反驳", "然而", "但是", "不成立")
        if (negations.any { critique.contains(it) }) return true
        val a = conclusion.lowercase().replace(Regex("\\W"), "").toSet()
        val b = critique.lowercase().replace(Regex("\\W"), "").toSet()
        if (a.isEmpty() || b.isEmpty()) return false
        val overlap = a.intersect(b).size.toDouble() / minOf(a.size, b.size)
        return overlap < 0.2
    }

    companion object {
        /** 单模型单次调用超时（V5）：45 秒；手机网络到 NIM 可能偏慢，超时自动回退快模型，仍失败才跳过。 */
        const val LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000L
    }
}
