package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** 一个分歧点：主题 + 各方观点。 */
@Serializable
data class DigestDivergence(val topic: String, val views: List<String>)

/** 单段（时间区间）的三模型深度整理结果。 */
@Serializable
data class SegmentDigest(
    val start: Double,
    val end: Double,
    val consensus: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val divergences: List<DigestDivergence> = emptyList(),
    /** 模型名 → 该段最终稿（原生表达，无字数限制）。 */
    val perModel: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    /** 三模型都不可用时的降级标记。 */
    val degraded: Boolean = false
)

/** 全片深度整理报告。 */
@Serializable
data class DeepDigestReport(
    val videoId: String,
    val models: List<String>,
    val rounds: Int,
    val segments: List<SegmentDigest>,
    val consensus: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val divergences: List<DigestDivergence> = emptyList()
)

/** 进度（用于进度条）。 */
data class DigestProgress(val current: Int, val total: Int, val stage: String)

private data class Seat(val label: String, val primary: LlmClient?, val fallback: LlmClient?)

/**
 * 三模型深度整理引擎（批次 A）：
 *  1) 每段：三模型各自"一字不落"整理（保留全部技术名词/数字/公式/结论，去废话，不设字数限制、允许本体表达）
 *  2) 交叉校对 N 轮：每模型看到另两方稿件 + 自己的稿，融合补全并保留分歧
 *  3) 合成：共同观点 / 分歧点（各自立场）
 *  4) 鲁棒：单次调用超时 + 重试 + 备选模型接力；全失败则该段降级标记
 */
class DeepDigestEngine(
    seats: List<Triple<String, LlmClient?, LlmClient?>>,
    private val callTimeoutMs: Long = 180_000,
    private val retries: Int = 2,
    val maxRounds: Int = 3
) {
    private val seats = seats.map { Seat(it.first, it.second, it.third) }

    suspend fun digest(
        videoId: String,
        units: List<LearningUnit>,
        onProgress: (DigestProgress) -> Unit = {}
    ): DeepDigestReport {
        val segments = ArrayList<SegmentDigest>()
        units.forEachIndexed { i, u ->
            onProgress(DigestProgress(i, units.size, "第 ${i + 1}/${units.size} 段 · 三模型独立整理"))
            segments.add(digestSegment(u, onProgress))
        }
        onProgress(DigestProgress(units.size, units.size, "全局共识/分歧总结"))
        val pool = segments.flatMap { it.perModel.values }.joinToString("\n\n")
        val (cons, div) = synthesize(pool, "全片")
        return DeepDigestReport(videoId, seats.map { it.label }, maxRounds, segments, cons, div)
    }

    private suspend fun digestSegment(u: LearningUnit, onProgress: (DigestProgress) -> Unit): SegmentDigest {
        val base = buildString {
            append("课程片段（时间 ").append(fmt(u.start)).append(" - ").append(fmt(u.end)).append("）\n")
            append("语音：").append(u.speech).append('\n')
            append("画面文字：").append(u.screenText)
            if (u.visualDescription.isNotBlank()) append("\n画面描述：").append(u.visualDescription)
        }
        var drafts = LinkedHashMap<String, String>()
        seats.forEach { seat ->
            val r = call(seat, knowledgePrompt(seat.label, base))
            if (r != null) drafts[seat.label] = r
            else onProgress(DigestProgress(0, 0, "${seat.label} 超时/失败，已降级"))
        }
        if (drafts.isEmpty()) return SegmentDigest(u.start, u.end, degraded = true)

        var round = 0
        while (round < maxRounds && drafts.size >= 2) {
            round++
            val snapshot = drafts.toMap()
            val revised = LinkedHashMap<String, String>()
            seats.forEach { seat ->
                val mine = snapshot[seat.label] ?: return@forEach
                val others = snapshot.filterKeys { it != seat.label }
                if (others.isEmpty()) { revised[seat.label] = mine; return@forEach }
                val r = call(seat, reviewPrompt(seat.label, base, mine, others))
                revised[seat.label] = r ?: mine
            }
            drafts = revised
            onProgress(DigestProgress(0, 0, "交叉校对 $round/$maxRounds 完成"))
        }
        val (cons, div) = synthesize(drafts.values.joinToString("\n\n"), "本段 ${fmt(u.start)}-${fmt(u.end)}")
        return SegmentDigest(u.start, u.end, cons, div, drafts)
    }

    private suspend fun synthesize(text: String, scope: String): Pair<List<String>, List<DigestDivergence>> {
        if (text.isBlank()) return emptyList<String>() to emptyList()
        val seat = seats.firstOrNull { it.primary != null || it.fallback != null } ?: return emptyList<String>() to emptyList()
        val r = call(seat, synthPrompt(scope, text)) ?: return emptyList<String>() to emptyList()
        return parseSynth(r)
    }

    /** 超时 + 重试 + 备选接力；全失败返回 null。 */
    private suspend fun call(seat: Seat, prompt: String): String? {
        for (client in listOfNotNull(seat.primary, seat.fallback)) {
            repeat(retries + 1) {
                val r = withTimeoutOrNull(callTimeoutMs) {
                    runCatching { client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", "")) }.getOrNull()
                }
                if (!r.isNullOrBlank()) return r.trim()
                delay(400)
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun knowledgePrompt(label: String, base: String) = """
你是 $label。请对下面这段课程做"一字不落"的知识整理：
- 保留全部技术名词、定义、数字、公式、结论与前提条件；
- 去掉寒暄、口头禅、重复和废话；
- 用你本来的风格与判断表达，不要为了凑字数扩写，也不要为了简短删掉要点；
- 若语音与画面文字冲突，取并集，并注明冲突处；
- 只输出整理结果本身，不要客套。

$base
""".trimIndent()

    private fun reviewPrompt(label: String, base: String, mine: String, others: Map<String, String>) = buildString {
        append("你是 ").append(label).append("。下面是同一段课程的三份整理稿。\n")
        append("你的初稿：\n").append(mine).append("\n\n")
        others.forEach { (who, txt) -> append("$who 的初稿：\n").append(txt).append("\n\n") }
        append("请融合三份稿，补全所有遗漏的知识点，纠正错误；不要删减事实、不要硬凑字数。\n")
        append("最后用一行【分歧】列出你与另外两方仍不一致的地方（没有就写：无）。\n")
        append("只输出融合后的完整稿。\n\n原始内容：\n").append(base)
    }

    private fun synthPrompt(scope: String, text: String) = """
下面是三份（或多段）对同一内容的整理稿。请提炼出结构化结论，严格用两段输出：
【共同观点】
- （三方一致的核心知识点，尽量具体）
【分歧点】
- 主题：___；A：___；B：___；C：___

要求：只写有信息量的条目；共同观点优先写"必学知识点"；分歧点写清各自立场。
范围：$scope

$text
""".trimIndent()

    /** 解析【共同观点】/【分歧点】。 */
    fun parseSynth(raw: String): Pair<List<String>, List<DigestDivergence>> {
        val consensus = ArrayList<String>()
        val divergences = ArrayList<DigestDivergence>()
        var section = ""
        raw.lines().forEach { line ->
            val l = line.trim()
            when {
                l.contains("共同观点") -> section = "c"
                l.contains("分歧") -> section = "d"
                l.startsWith("-") || l.startsWith("•") -> {
                    val body = l.removePrefix("-").removePrefix("•").trim()
                    if (body.isBlank()) return@forEach
                    when (section) {
                        "c" -> consensus.add(body)
                        "d" -> {
                            val topic = Regex("主题[:：]([^；;]+)").find(body)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.trim()
                                ?: body.take(20)
                            val views = body.split('；', ';').map { it.trim() }
                                .filter { it.isNotBlank() && !it.startsWith("主题") }
                            divergences.add(DigestDivergence(topic, views))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return consensus to divergences
    }

    private fun fmt(sec: Double): String {
        val t = sec.toInt()
        fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
        return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/ErrorNotebook.kt (3.9KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.ErrorEntry
import com.learnagent.data.ErrorType
import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import com.learnagent.data.MasteryStatus
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis

/**
 * 错题本（内存态）：
 * - 同 pointId 错 3 次 → 高危
 * - 错题自动加入复习队列（nextReviewAt = 最后一次错误 + 1 天）
 * - 考前 3 天 → 可生成"错题冲刺卷"（sprintReviewQueue）
 */
class ErrorNotebook(private val now: () -> Long = { currentTimeMillis() }) {

    private val entries = mutableListOf<ErrorEntry>()

    fun all(): List<ErrorEntry> = entries.toList()

    fun record(
        questionId: String,
        knowledgePointId: String,
        userAnswer: String,
        correctAnswer: String,
        explanation: String,
        errorType: ErrorType
    ): ErrorEntry {
        val t = now()
        val idx = entries.indexOfFirst {
            it.knowledgePointId == knowledgePointId && it.questionId == questionId && !it.resolved
        }
        val entry = if (idx >= 0) {
            entries[idx].copy(
                errorCount = entries[idx].errorCount + 1,
                lastErrorAt = t,
                userAnswer = userAnswer,
                correctAnswer = correctAnswer,
                explanation = explanation,
                errorType = errorType
            )
        } else {
            ErrorEntry(
                id = "err_${t.toString(16)}_${entries.size}",
                questionId = questionId,
                knowledgePointId = knowledgePointId,
                userAnswer = userAnswer,
                correctAnswer = correctAnswer,
                explanation = explanation,
                errorType = errorType,
                errorCount = 1,
                lastErrorAt = t
            )
        }
        if (idx >= 0) entries[idx] = entry else entries.add(entry)
        return entry
    }

    /** 同 pointId 的累计错误次数（跨题目累计）。 */
    fun errorCount(pointId: String): Int =
        entries.filter { it.knowledgePointId == pointId && !it.resolved }.sumOf { it.errorCount }

    /** 错 ≥3 次的知识点 = 高危。 */
    fun highRiskPointIds(): List<String> =
        entries.filter { !it.resolved }.map { it.knowledgePointId }.distinct()
            .filter { errorCount(it) >= HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD }

    fun isHighRisk(pointId: String): Boolean = errorCount(pointId) >= HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD

    /** 错题复习队列：每知识点一条，nextReviewAt = 最后一次错误 + 1 天。 */
    fun reviewQueue(): List<KnowledgeMastery> =
        entries.filter { !it.resolved }
            .groupBy { it.knowledgePointId }
            .map { (pointId, list) ->
                val last = list.maxOf { it.lastErrorAt }
                KnowledgeMastery(
                    pointId = pointId,
                    status = MasteryStatus.LEARNED,
                    reviewCount = list.sumOf { it.errorCount },
                    correctCount = 0,
                    lastReviewAt = last,
                    nextReviewAt = last + 86_400_000L,
                    recallAccuracy = 0f
                )
            }
            .sortedBy { it.nextReviewAt }

    /** 考前 3 天内。 */
    fun isSprintTime(examAt: Long, now: Long = now()): Boolean =
        examAt - now in 0..THREE_DAYS_MS

    /** 错题冲刺卷：高危知识点的复习队列。 */
    fun sprintReviewQueue(examAt: Long, now: Long = now()): List<KnowledgeMastery> =
        if (isSprintTime(examAt, now)) reviewQueue().filter { highRiskPointIds().contains(it.pointId) } else emptyList()

    fun resolve(questionId: String) {
        val idx = entries.indexOfFirst { it.questionId == questionId }
        if (idx >= 0) entries[idx] = entries[idx].copy(resolved = true)
    }

    companion object {
        const val HIGH_RISK_THRESHOLD = 3
        const val THREE_DAYS_MS = 3 * 86_400_000L
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/**
 * 统一证据层：把「语音(转写) + 画面(OCR)」合并成给大模型的证据文本，
 * 并提供"两项是否齐全"的判定——所有大模型判定都要求音频与画面齐全后才进行。
 */
object Evidence {

    fun speechCount(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): Int = timeline.count { it.speech.isNotBlank() }
    fun screenCount(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): Int = timeline.count { it.screenText.isNotBlank() }

    /** 语音与画面是否都齐全（两项齐全才允许大模型判定）。 */
    fun ready(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): Boolean =
        speechCount(timeline) > 0 && screenCount(timeline) > 0

    fun fmt(seconds: Double): String {
        val t = seconds.toInt()
        fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
        return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
    }

    /** 合并渲染「语音 + 画面」证据文本（带时间戳）。 */
    fun render(timeline: List<TimelineItem>, maxChars: Int = 12000): String =
        timeline.joinToString("\n") { item ->
            val sp = item.speech.trim().replace("\n", " ")
            val sc = item.screenText.trim().replace("\n", " ")
            buildString {
                append("[").append(fmt(item.start)).append("]")
                if (sp.isNotEmpty()) append(" 语音：").append(sp.take(140))
                if (sc.isNotEmpty()) append(" ｜画面：").append(sc.take(100))
                if (item.caption.isNotBlank()) append(" ｜画面描述：").append(item.caption.take(80))
            }
        }.take(maxChars)

    /** 带编号版本（用于需要按序号回填的判定，如重点/题外话）。 */
    fun renderNumbered(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): String =
        renderNumbered(timeline, List(timeline.size) { it })

    /** 带编号版本（指定原始下标，采样后仍能准确回填到原位置）。 */
    fun renderNumbered(timeline: List<TimelineItem>, indices: List<Int>): String =
        indices.joinToString("\n") { i ->
            val item = timeline[i]
            val sp = item.speech.trim().replace("\n", " ")
            val sc = item.screenText.trim().replace("\n", " ")
            buildString {
                append("[").append(i).append("]")
                if (sp.isNotEmpty()) append(" 语音：").append(sp.take(120))
                if (sc.isNotEmpty()) append(" ｜画面：").append(sc.take(80))
                if (item.caption.isNotBlank()) append(" ｜画面描述：").append(item.caption.take(60))
            }
        }

    /** 全片均匀采样 [n] 条（保持顺序，时间从头到尾全覆盖，不再"只看开头"）。 */
    fun <T> spread(list: List<T>, n: Int): List<T> {
        if (n <= 0 || list.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        if (list.size <= n) return list
        val out = ArrayList<T>(n)
        val step = (list.size - 1).toDouble() / (n - 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
        var last = -1
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val idx = ((i * step).toInt()).coerceAtMost(list.size - 1)
            if (idx != last) { out.add(list[idx]); last = idx }
        }
        return out
    }

    /** 全片均匀采样的原始下标（采样后仍可精确回填）。 */
    fun spreadIndices(size: Int, n: Int): List<Int> {
        if (n <= 0 || size <= 0) return emptyList()
        if (size <= n) return List(size) { it }
        val out = ArrayList<Int>(n)
        val step = (size - 1).toDouble() / (n - 1).coerceAtLeast(1)
        var last = -1
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val idx = ((i * step).toInt()).coerceAtMost(size - 1)
            if (idx != last) { out.add(idx); last = idx }
        }
        return out
    }

    /**
     * AI 用的「全片摘要」：语音段优先（信息密度最高），数量不足再用画面帧均匀补齐，
     * 按时间排序后渲染 —— 保证模型"看得到整门课"，而不是只看开头几秒。
     */
    fun aiDigest(timeline: List<TimelineItem>, maxItems: Int = 120, maxChars: Int = 12000): String {
        if (timeline.isEmpty()) return ""
        val speech = timeline.filter { it.speech.isNotBlank() }
        val picked = if (speech.size >= maxItems) {
            spread(speech, maxItems)
        } else {
            val rest = timeline.filter { it.speech.isBlank() }
            val fillCount = (maxItems - speech.size).coerceAtMost(rest.size)
            (speech + spread(rest, fillCount)).sortedBy { it.start }
        }
        return render(picked, maxChars)
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/ExamGenerator.kt (8.9KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import com.learnagent.data.QuestionType
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

enum class ExamScope { SINGLE_VIDEO, MULTI_VIDEO, KNOWLEDGE_POINT, WEAK_POINTS }

data class ExamQuestion(
    val id: String,
    val type: QuestionType,
    val stem: String,
    val options: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val correctAnswer: String,
    val explanation: String = "",
    val knowledgePointId: String = "",
    val score: Int = 5,
    val subject: String = ""
)

data class Exam(
    val id: String,
    val scope: ExamScope,
    val difficulty: Difficulty,
    val questions: List<ExamQuestion>,
    val generatedAt: Long,
    val source: String
)

/**
 * 出卷引擎：
 * - 题型配比 单选40% / 多选15% / 填空15% / 简答20% / 计算证明10%
 * - 知识点不足 → 有几题出几题（不崩）
 * - LLM 不可用 → 模板生成（单选选项由同池其它定义充当干扰项）
 */
class ExamGenerator(
    private val llm: LlmClient?,
    private val points: List<KnowledgePoint> = emptyList()
) {

    suspend fun generate(
        scope: ExamScope,
        videoIds: List<String>,
        questionCount: Int,
        difficulty: Difficulty,
        interleaver: InterleavingEngine
    ): Exam {
        val pool = if (videoIds.isEmpty()) points else points.filter { it.sourceVideoId in videoIds }.ifEmpty { points }
        val selected = interleaver.interleave(pool, questionCount)
        val types = allocateTypes(selected.size)
        val examId = "exam_" + currentTimeMillis().toString(16)
        var usedLlm = false
        val questions = selected.mapIndexed { i, point ->
            val type = types.getOrElse(i) { QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER }
            val llmQuestion = if (llm != null) {
                runCatching { llmQuestion(point, type, difficulty, examId, i, pool) }.getOrNull()
            } else null
            if (llmQuestion != null) {
                usedLlm = true
                llmQuestion
            } else {
                templateQuestion(point, type, difficulty, pool, i, examId)
            }
        }
        return Exam(examId, scope, difficulty, questions, currentTimeMillis(), if (usedLlm) "LLM" else "本地启发式")
    }

    /** 按配比分配题型；总数恒等于 n。 */
    fun allocateTypes(n: Int): List<QuestionType> {
        if (n <= 0) return emptyList()
        val single = (n * 0.40f).roundToInt()
        val multiple = (n * 0.15f).roundToInt()
        val fill = (n * 0.15f).roundToInt()
        val short = (n * 0.20f).roundToInt()
        val calc = (n - single - multiple - fill - short).coerceAtLeast(0)
        return buildList {
            repeat(single) { add(QuestionType.SINGLE_CHOICE) }
            repeat(multiple) { add(QuestionType.MULTIPLE_CHOICE) }
            repeat(fill) { add(QuestionType.FILL_BLANK) }
            repeat(short) { add(QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER) }
            repeat(calc) { add(QuestionType.CALCULATION) }
        }.take(n)
    }

    private fun templateQuestion(
        point: KnowledgePoint,
        type: QuestionType,
        difficulty: Difficulty,
        pool: List<KnowledgePoint>,
        index: Int,
        examId: String
    ): ExamQuestion {
        val qid = "${examId}_q$index"
        val score = scoreFor(type, difficulty)
        return when (type) {
            QuestionType.SINGLE_CHOICE -> {
                val distractors = pool.filter { it.id != point.id }
                    .map { it.definition.take(40) }
                    .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
                    .distinct()
                    .take(3)
                val raw = listOf(point.definition) + distractors
                val rotate = if (raw.isEmpty()) 0 else index % raw.size
                val options = raw.drop(rotate) + raw.take(rotate)
                val correctIdx = options.indexOf(point.definition).coerceAtLeast(0)
                ExamQuestion(
                    id = qid, type = type,
                    stem = "关于「${point.name}」，下列说法正确的是？",
                    options = options,
                    correctAnswer = ('A' + correctIdx).toString(),
                    explanation = "正确项即标准定义：${point.definition}",
                    knowledgePointId = point.id, score = score
                )
            }
            QuestionType.MULTIPLE_CHOICE -> {
                val correct = listOf(
                    point.definition.take(40),
                    "${point.name} 属于本课程知识点"
                ).distinct()
                val others = pool.filter { it.id != point.id }.map { it.definition.take(30) }.take(2)
                val options = correct + others
                val letters = correct.map { c -> ('A' + options.indexOf(c)).toString() }.sorted()
                ExamQuestion(
                    id = qid, type = type,
                    stem = "关于「${point.name}」，下列说法正确的有？（多选）",
                    options = options,
                    correctAnswer = letters.joinToString(","),
                    explanation = "正确项来自标准定义与课程范围。",
                    knowledgePointId = point.id, score = score
                )
            }
            QuestionType.FILL_BLANK -> ExamQuestion(
                id = qid, type = type,
                stem = "填空：${point.name} 的定义是 ____。",
                correctAnswer = point.definition,
                explanation = "标准定义：${point.definition}",
                knowledgePointId = point.id, score = score
            )
            QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER, QuestionType.COMPARISON -> ExamQuestion(
                id = qid, type = type,
                stem = "请解释「${point.name}」是什么，并说明其作用。",
                correctAnswer = point.definition,
                explanation = "本地启发式模板题（LLM 不可用时生成）。",
                knowledgePointId = point.id, score = score
            )
            QuestionType.CALCULATION, QuestionType.PROOF -> ExamQuestion(
                id = qid, type = type,
                stem = "请针对「${point.name}」写出完整解题/推导步骤（含每一步依据）。",
                correctAnswer = "步骤1：明确已知（${point.definition.take(30)}）；步骤2：写出依据；步骤3：推导；步骤4：得出结论。",
                explanation = "按规范答题库的步骤评分。",
                knowledgePointId = point.id, score = score
            )
        }
    }

    private suspend fun llmQuestion(
        point: KnowledgePoint,
        type: QuestionType,
        difficulty: Difficulty,
        examId: String,
        index: Int,
        pool: List<KnowledgePoint>
    ): ExamQuestion? {
        val client = llm ?: return null
        val distractors = pool.filter { it.id != point.id }.map { it.definition.take(40) }.take(3)
        val prompt = """
出一道 $type 题目（难度 $difficulty），只输出 JSON：
{"stem":"...","options":["..."],"correctAnswer":"...","explanation":"..."}

知识点：${point.name}
定义：${point.definition}
干扰项素材：${distractors.joinToString("｜")}
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) return null
        val obj = (Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }
            .parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)) as? JsonObject) ?: return null
        fun str(key: String, def: String = ""): String =
            (obj[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: def
        val stem = str("stem").ifBlank { return null }
        val options = (obj["options"] as? JsonArray)
            ?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: emptyList()
        return ExamQuestion(
            id = "${examId}_q$index", type = type, stem = stem,
            options = options,
            correctAnswer = str("correctAnswer"),
            explanation = str("explanation"),
            knowledgePointId = point.id,
            score = scoreFor(type, difficulty)
        )
    }

    private fun scoreFor(type: QuestionType, difficulty: Difficulty): Int {
        val base = when (type) {
            QuestionType.SINGLE_CHOICE, QuestionType.FILL_BLANK -> 5
            QuestionType.MULTIPLE_CHOICE -> 6
            QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER, QuestionType.COMPARISON -> 8
            QuestionType.CALCULATION, QuestionType.PROOF -> 10
        }
        return when (difficulty) {
            Difficulty.EASY -> base
            Difficulty.MEDIUM -> base
            Difficulty.HARD -> (base * 1.2f).roundToInt()
        }
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/ExamGrader.kt (4.9KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.QuestionType
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

data class ExamGrade(
    val questionId: String,
    val score: Int,
    val maxScore: Int,
    val ratio: Float,
    val feedback: String,
    val source: String
)

data class ExamResult(
    val totalScore: Int,
    val maxScore: Int,
    val grades: List<ExamGrade>
)

/**
 * 批改引擎：
 * - 客观题：精确匹配（忽略大小写/空格；多选顺序无关）
 * - 主观题：LLM 严格评分（完全对 100% / 小错 70% / 半对 50% / 方向错 0% / 不规范额外扣 20%）
 * - LLM 不可用 → 关键词命中比例降级，feedback 标注"本地启发式"
 */
class ExamGrader(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    fun gradeObjective(question: ExamQuestion, userAnswer: String): ExamGrade {
        val ratio = when (question.type) {
            QuestionType.MULTIPLE_CHOICE ->
                if (normalizeChoice(question.correctAnswer) == normalizeChoice(userAnswer)) 1f else 0f
            else ->
                if (normalizeText(question.correctAnswer) == normalizeText(userAnswer)) 1f else 0f
        }
        val score = (question.score * ratio).roundToInt()
        return ExamGrade(
            question.id, score, question.score, ratio,
            if (ratio >= 1f) "正确。" else "不正确，正确答案：${question.correctAnswer}",
            "精确匹配"
        )
    }

    suspend fun gradeSubjective(question: ExamQuestion, userAnswer: String): ExamGrade {
        if (llm != null) {
            try {
                return llmGrade(question, userAnswer)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // 降级
            }
        }
        return localSubjective(question, userAnswer)
    }

    suspend fun grade(exam: Exam, answers: Map<String, String>): ExamResult {
        val grades = exam.questions.map { q ->
            when (q.type) {
                QuestionType.SINGLE_CHOICE, QuestionType.MULTIPLE_CHOICE, QuestionType.FILL_BLANK ->
                    gradeObjective(q, answers[q.id].orEmpty())
                else -> gradeSubjective(q, answers[q.id].orEmpty())
            }
        }
        return ExamResult(grades.sumOf { it.score }, grades.sumOf { it.maxScore }, grades)
    }

    private fun localSubjective(question: ExamQuestion, userAnswer: String): ExamGrade {
        val tokens = question.correctAnswer
            .split(Regex("[^\\u4e00-\\u9fa5A-Za-z0-9]+"))
            .filter { it.length >= 2 }
        val hit = tokens.count { userAnswer.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
        var ratio = when {
            tokens.isEmpty() -> 0f
            hit.toFloat() / tokens.size >= 0.9f -> 1f
            hit.toFloat() / tokens.size >= 0.6f -> 0.7f
            hit.toFloat() / tokens.size >= 0.3f -> 0.5f
            else -> 0f
        }
        val hasStandardForm = userAnswer.contains("解：") || userAnswer.contains("答：") ||
            Regex("(?m)^\\s*\\d+[.、]").containsMatchIn(userAnswer)
        if (ratio >= 0.7f && !hasStandardForm) ratio *= 0.8f   // 不规范额外扣 20%
        val score = (question.score * ratio).roundToInt()
        return ExamGrade(
            question.id, score, question.score, ratio,
            "本地启发式：命中 $hit/${tokens.size} 个关键点" +
                if (ratio >= 0.7f && !hasStandardForm) "（无解题格式，扣 20%）" else "",
            "本地启发式"
        )
    }

    private suspend fun llmGrade(question: ExamQuestion, userAnswer: String): ExamGrade {
        val client = llm ?: throw IllegalStateException("no llm")
        val prompt = """
严格批改主观题，只输出 JSON：
{"ratio":0.7,"feedback":"..."}

评分规则：完全对 1.0 / 小错 0.7 / 半对 0.5 / 方向错 0 / 不规范额外扣 20%（ratio × 0.8）

题目：${question.stem}
标准答案：${question.correctAnswer}
学生答案：$userAnswer
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val obj = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }
            .parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        val ratio = ((obj["ratio"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toFloatOrNull()
            ?: 0f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val feedback = (obj["feedback"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
        return ExamGrade(question.id, (question.score * ratio).roundToInt(), question.score, ratio, feedback, "LLM")
    }

    private fun normalizeText(s: String): String = s.trim().lowercase().replace(Regex("\\s+"), "")

    private fun normalizeChoice(s: String): String =
        s.uppercase().filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }.toCharArray().sorted().joinToString("")
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

data class FeynmanResult(
    val score: Int,                  // 0-10
    val accuracy: Int,               // 0-4
    val simplicity: Int,             // 0-3
    val completeness: Int,           // 0-3
    val passed: Boolean,             // score >= 6
    val feedback: String,
    val missingPoints: List<String>
)

/**
 * 费曼检查：准确性 4 + 简洁性 3 + 完整性 3，<6 不通过。
 * LLM 不可用 → 关键词匹配：命中定义 3 个以上关键词 = 通过。
 */
class FeynmanCheck(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun check(point: KnowledgePoint, userExplanation: String): FeynmanResult {
        if (userExplanation.isBlank()) {
            return FeynmanResult(0, 0, 0, 0, false, "没有内容可评分。", keywordsOf(point).take(3))
        }
        if (llm != null) {
            try {
                return parse(callLlm(point, userExplanation))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // 降级
            }
        }
        return fallback(point, userExplanation)
    }

    private suspend fun callLlm(point: KnowledgePoint, userExplanation: String): String {
        val client = llm ?: return ""
        val prompt = """
用费曼学习法检查学生的解释。
知识点：${point.name}
标准定义：${point.definition}
学生解释：$userExplanation

评分标准（总分 10）：
- 准确性 4 分：概念有没有讲错
- 简洁性 3 分：有没有用简单语言（像给 10 岁小孩讲）
- 完整性 3 分：有没有漏关键点
6 分以下 = 不通过

只输出 JSON：
{"score":7,"accuracy":3,"simplicity":2,"completeness":2,"feedback":"...","missingPoints":["..."]}
""".trimIndent()
        return client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
    }

    private fun parse(raw: String): FeynmanResult {
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun num(key: String): Int = (o[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        val accuracy = num("accuracy").coerceIn(0, 4)
        val simplicity = num("simplicity").coerceIn(0, 3)
        val completeness = num("completeness").coerceIn(0, 3)
        val score = num("score").coerceIn(0, 10).let { if (it == 0) accuracy + simplicity + completeness else it }
        val feedback = (o["feedback"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
        val missing = (o["missingPoints"] as? JsonArray)
            ?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: emptyList()
        return FeynmanResult(score, accuracy, simplicity, completeness, score >= 6, feedback, missing)
    }

    private fun fallback(point: KnowledgePoint, explanation: String): FeynmanResult {
        val keywords = keywordsOf(point)
        val hit = keywords.count { explanation.contains(it) } + if (explanation.contains(point.name)) 1 else 0
        val accuracy = hit.coerceAtMost(4)
        val simplicity = if (explanation.length in 10..200) 2 else 1
        val completeness = when {
            hit >= 3 -> 3
            hit == 2 -> 1
            else -> 0
        }
        val score = (accuracy + simplicity + completeness).coerceAtMost(10)
        val passed = score >= 6
        val missing = keywords.filterNot { explanation.contains(it) }.take(3)
        val feedback = if (passed) {
            "本地启发式：命中 $hit 个核心关键词，解释基本到位。"
        } else {
            "本地启发式：仅命中 $hit 个核心关键词（需 ≥3），建议补充定义中的关键概念。"
        }
        return FeynmanResult(score, accuracy, simplicity, completeness, passed, feedback, missing)
    }

    private fun keywordsOf(point: KnowledgePoint): List<String> =
        (point.definition + " " + point.name)
            .split(Regex("[\\s，。、；;,.!?：:（）()\\[\\]【】]+"))
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.length >= 2 }
            .distinct()
}

shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/GraphBuilder.kt (1.7KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/** 知识图谱节点。 */
data class GraphNode(
    val index: Int,
    val label: String,
    val degree: Int
)

/** 知识图谱边（两个片段共享的关键词）。 */
data class GraphEdge(
    val from: Int,
    val to: Int,
    val shared: List<String>
)

data class KnowledgeGraphData(
    val nodes: List<GraphNode>,
    val edges: List<GraphEdge>
)

/**
 * 知识图谱构建（纯逻辑，跨平台）。
 *
 * 每个 TimelineItem 是一个节点；共享关键词的节点之间连边；
 * 节点 degree = 与之共享关键词的节点数。
 */
object GraphBuilder {

    fun build(items: List<TimelineItem>): KnowledgeGraphData {
        val keywords = items.map { keywordsOf(it.speech + " " + it.screenText) }
        val edges = buildList {
            for (i in items.indices) {
                for (j in i + 1 until items.size) {
                    val shared = keywords[i].intersect(keywords[j])
                    if (shared.isNotEmpty()) add(GraphEdge(i, j, shared.toList().sorted()))
                }
            }
        }
        val degree = IntArray(items.size)
        edges.forEach { degree[it.from]++; degree[it.to]++ }
        val nodes = items.mapIndexed { i, item -> GraphNode(i, labelOf(item), degree[i]) }
        return KnowledgeGraphData(nodes, edges)
    }

    fun keywordsOf(text: String): Set<String> {
        val cleaned = text.lowercase()
            .replace(Regex("[\\s,，。、/！？；：\"'`()（）：]+"), " ")
        return cleaned.split(" ").filter { it.length >= 2 }.toSet()
    }

    private fun labelOf(item: TimelineItem): String {
        val text = item.speech.ifBlank { item.screenText }
        return text.take(16)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.Experience
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive

// ---------------- Harness 内核（阶段 A） ----------------

data class ToolSpec(
    val name: String,
    val description: String,
    val parameters: Map<String, String>
)

data class Tool(
    val spec: ToolSpec,
    val execute: suspend (Map<String, String>) -> String
)

/** 平台执行器：文件 / 命令 / 网络，由各端注入。 */
interface ToolRunner {
    suspend fun readFile(path: String): String
    suspend fun writeFile(path: String, content: String): String
    suspend fun listDir(path: String): String
    suspend fun runCommand(command: String): String
    suspend fun httpGet(url: String): String
}

object NoopToolRunner : ToolRunner {
    override suspend fun readFile(path: String) = "（当前平台未启用文件工具）"
    override suspend fun writeFile(path: String, content: String) = "（当前平台未启用文件工具）"
    override suspend fun listDir(path: String) = "（当前平台未启用文件工具）"
    override suspend fun runCommand(command: String) = "（当前平台未启用命令工具）"
    override suspend fun httpGet(url: String) = "（当前平台未启用网络工具）"
}

/** run_command 白名单。 */
object CommandWhitelist {
    private val allowed = listOf("dir", "type", "findstr", "echo")
    fun isAllowed(cmd: String): Boolean {
        val head = cmd.trim().lowercase().split(Regex("\\s+")).firstOrNull().orEmpty()
        return allowed.contains(head)
    }
    fun allowedNames(): List<String> = allowed
}

/** 10 个工具。 */
class ToolRegistry(
    private val search: suspend (String, Int) -> List<TimelineItem>,
    private val ask: suspend (String) -> QaAnswer,
    private val runner: ToolRunner = NoopToolRunner,
    private val httpEnabled: Boolean = false,
    private val projectRoot: String = "."
) {

    fun tools(): List<Tool> = listOf(
        Tool(ToolSpec("search_video", "按关键词检索视频时间线", mapOf("query" to "string"))) { a ->
            val q = a["query"].orEmpty()
            val hits = search(q, 5)
            if (hits.isEmpty()) "未找到相关片段"
            else hits.joinToString("\n") { "[${it.start.toInt()}] ${it.speech.ifBlank { it.screenText }}" }
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("ask_question", "基于视频内容回答问题", mapOf("question" to "string"))) { a ->
            ask(a["question"].orEmpty()).answer
        },
        Tool(
            ToolSpec(
                "record_experience",
                "记录一次场景经验",
                mapOf("scenarioId" to "string", "choice" to "string", "result" to "string", "lesson" to "string")
            )
        ) { a ->
            val id = "exp_" + currentTimeMillis().toString(16)
            ExperienceStore.saveExperience(
                Experience(
                    id = id,
                    scenarioId = a["scenarioId"].orEmpty(),
                    choice = a["choice"].orEmpty(),
                    result = a["result"].orEmpty(),
                    lesson = a["lesson"].orEmpty(),
                    recordedAt = currentTimeMillis()
                )
            )
            "已记录经验 $id"
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("search_experience", "检索经验库", mapOf("query" to "string"))) { a ->
            val list = ExperienceStore.searchExperiences(a["query"].orEmpty())
            if (list.isEmpty()) "没有匹配的经验"
            else list.joinToString("\n") { "- ${it.lesson.ifBlank { it.choice }}" }
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("read_file", "读取文本文件", mapOf("path" to "string"))) { a ->
            runner.readFile(a["path"].orEmpty())
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("write_file", "写入文本文件（限项目目录内）", mapOf("path" to "string", "content" to "string"))) { a ->
            val p = a["path"].orEmpty()
            if (!isInsideProject(p)) "拒绝：路径必须在项目目录内" else runner.writeFile(p, a["content"].orEmpty())
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("list_dir", "列出目录内容", mapOf("path" to "string"))) { a ->
            runner.listDir(a["path"].orEmpty())
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("run_command", "执行白名单命令（dir/type/findstr/echo）", mapOf("cmd" to "string"))) { a ->
            val cmd = a["cmd"].orEmpty()
            if (!CommandWhitelist.isAllowed(cmd)) "拒绝：命令不在白名单（${CommandWhitelist.allowedNames().joinToString("/")}）"
            else runner.runCommand(cmd)
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("search_code", "在项目中搜索代码", mapOf("pattern" to "string"))) { a ->
            val pattern = a["pattern"].orEmpty()
            runner.runCommand("findstr /s /i /m \"$pattern\" *.*")
        },
        Tool(ToolSpec("http_get", "HTTP GET（可关闭）", mapOf("url" to "string"))) { a ->
            if (!httpEnabled) "http_get 已禁用" else runner.httpGet(a["url"].orEmpty())
        }
    )

    /** 仅允许项目目录内、非绝对路径、无 .. 的路径。 */
    private fun isInsideProject(path: String): Boolean {
        if (path.isBlank()) return false
        if (path.contains("..")) return false
        if (path.startsWith("/") || path.startsWith("\\")) return false
        if (Regex("^[A-Za-z]:").containsMatchIn(path)) return false
        return true
    }
}

data class AgentStep(val thought: String, val action: String, val observation: String)
data class AgentResult(val steps: List<AgentStep>, val finished: Boolean, val output: String)

/**
 * ReAct 循环：思考 → 决策 → 执行 → 观察 → 循环（<= maxSteps）。
 * 停止：action=FINISH / 连续 2 次相同观察 / 超 maxSteps。
 * 超时由调用方用 withTimeout 包裹（commonMain 不引入协程）。
 */
class AgentLoop(
    private val llm: LlmClient,
    private val tools: List<Tool>,
    private val maxSteps: Int = 10
) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun run(goal: String): AgentResult {
        val steps = mutableListOf<AgentStep>()
        var lastObservation = ""
        var repeatCount = 0
        val toolList = tools.joinToString("\n") { "- ${it.spec.name}: ${it.spec.description}" }

        for (i in 0 until maxSteps) {
            val history = steps.joinToString("\n") { "思考:${it.thought} 动作:${it.action} 观察:${it.observation}" }
            val prompt = buildString {
                append("你是 Mentara Agent。目标：").append(goal).append("\n")
                append("可用工具：\n").append(toolList).append("\n")
                append("历史：\n").append(history).append("\n")
                append("只输出 JSON：{\"thought\":\"...\",\"action\":\"工具名或FINISH\",\"actionInput\":{...},\"answer\":\"action=FINISH 时的最终答案\"}")
            }
            val raw = try {
                llm.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                return AgentResult(steps, false, "LLM 失败：${e.message}")
            }

            val obj = runCatching {
                val s = raw.indexOf('{')
                val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
                json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
            }.getOrNull() ?: return AgentResult(steps, false, raw)

            val thought = obj["thought"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content ?: ""
            val action = obj["action"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content ?: "FINISH"
            if (action == "FINISH") {
                return AgentResult(steps, true, obj["answer"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content ?: raw)
            }

            val args = obj["actionInput"]?.jsonObject?.mapValues { it.value.jsonPrimitive.content } ?: emptyMap()
            val tool = tools.firstOrNull { it.spec.name == action }
            val observation = tool?.let {
                runCatching { it.execute(args) }.getOrElse { e -> "工具错误：${e.message}" }
            } ?: "未知工具：$action"

            steps.add(AgentStep(thought, action, observation))
            if (observation == lastObservation) repeatCount++ else repeatCount = 0
            lastObservation = observation
            if (repeatCount >= 1) break
        }
        return AgentResult(steps, false, steps.lastOrNull()?.observation ?: "")
    }
}

/** 上下文管理：> maxTurns 轮时把旧内容压缩成摘要。 */
class ContextManager(
    private val maxTurns: Int = 20,
    private val maxChars: Int = 8000
) {
    fun compress(history: List<String>): List<String> {
        if (history.size <= maxTurns) return history
        val keepCount = maxTurns / 2
        val keep = history.takeLast(keepCount)
        val old = history.dropLast(keepCount)
        val summary = "（较早对话摘要）" + old.joinToString("；") { it.take(40) }
        return listOf(summary.take(maxChars)) + keep
    }
}

enum class TaskType { SIMPLE_QA, COMPLEX_REASONING, CODE, DEBATE, TOOL_CALL }

/** 多模型路由。 */
object ModelRouter {
    fun modelFor(type: TaskType): String = when (type) {
        TaskType.SIMPLE_QA -> "qwen/qwen3-8b"
        TaskType.COMPLEX_REASONING -> "deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
        TaskType.CODE -> "deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct"
        TaskType.DEBATE -> "meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct"
        TaskType.TOOL_CALL -> "deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash"
    }

    fun route(question: String): TaskType {
        val q = question.lowercase()
        return when {
            q.contains("代码") || q.contains("code") || q.contains("函数") -> TaskType.CODE
            q.contains("辩论") || q.contains("对比") || q.contains("debate") -> TaskType.DEBATE
            q.contains("工具") || q.contains("tool") || q.contains("执行") -> TaskType.TOOL_CALL
            q.length > 40 || q.contains("为什么") || q.contains("推导") -> TaskType.COMPLEX_REASONING
            else -> TaskType.SIMPLE_QA
        }
    }
}

data class TestCase(val question: String, val expectedAnswer: String, val expectedTimeStamp: String? = null)
data class EvalReport(
    val totalTests: Int,
    val passed: Int,
    val failed: Int,
    val accuracy: Double,
    val failures: List<String>
)

/** 自动评估：跑黄金集，输出报告。 */
class Evaluator(private val engine: QaEngine) {
    suspend fun run(cases: List<TestCase>): EvalReport {
        var passed = 0
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (case in cases) {
            val answer = try {
                engine.ask(case.question).answer
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                ""
            }
            if (answer.contains(case.expectedAnswer)) passed++
            else failures.add("Q='${case.question}' 期望包含 '${case.expectedAnswer}'，实际 '${answer.take(60)}'")
        }
        val accuracy = if (cases.isEmpty()) 0.0 else passed.toDouble() / cases.size
        return EvalReport(cases.size, passed, cases.size - passed, accuracy, failures)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/** 批量导入状态。 */
data class ImportProgress(
    val currentIndex: Int,
    val total: Int,
    val currentFile: String,
    val state: ImportState,
    val doneCount: Int = 0,
    val failedCount: Int = 0
)

enum class ImportState { PENDING, DOWNLOADING, PROCESSING, DONE, FAILED, CANCELLED }

/**
 * 共享批量导入队列（桌面拖拽/文件夹、Android SAF 多选共用）。
 *
 * - [enqueue] 追加路径并自动开始串行处理
 * - [cancelAll] 取消剩余任务（已完成的保留）
 * - [progress] 状态流（PENDING/PROCESSING/DONE/FAILED/CANCELLED）
 *
 * processor 由平台注入（桌面 ConfigStore.importVideo / Android filesDir 复制）。
 */
class ImportQueue(
    private val processor: suspend (String) -> Unit = {}
) {

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    private val _progress = MutableStateFlow(ImportProgress(0, 0, "", ImportState.PENDING))
    val progress: Flow<ImportProgress> = _progress

    private val pending = ArrayDeque<String>()
    private var job: Job? = null
    private var doneCount = 0
    private var failedCount = 0
    private var total = 0

    @Synchronized
    fun enqueue(paths: List<String>) {
        val clean = paths.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (clean.isEmpty()) return
        clean.forEach { pending.addLast(it) }
        total += clean.size
        _progress.value = ImportProgress(
            currentIndex = doneCount + failedCount,
            total = total,
            currentFile = pending.firstOrNull().orEmpty(),
            state = ImportState.PENDING,
            doneCount = doneCount,
            failedCount = failedCount
        )
        start()
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun cancelAll() {
        job?.cancel()
        job = null
        pending.clear()
        _progress.value = ImportProgress(
            currentIndex = doneCount + failedCount,
            total = total,
            currentFile = "",
            state = ImportState.CANCELLED,
            doneCount = doneCount,
            failedCount = failedCount
        )
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun start() {
        if (job?.isActive == true) return
        job = scope.launch {
            while (true) {
                val path = synchronized(this@ImportQueue) {
                    if (pending.isEmpty()) null else pending.removeFirst()
                } ?: break
                val index = doneCount + failedCount
                _progress.value = ImportProgress(
                    index, total, path, ImportState.PROCESSING, doneCount, failedCount
                )
                try {
                    processor(path)
                    synchronized(this@ImportQueue) { doneCount++ }
                } catch (e: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
                    throw e
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    synchronized(this@ImportQueue) { failedCount++ }
                }
            }
            _progress.value = ImportProgress(
                doneCount + failedCount, total, "", ImportState.DONE, doneCount, failedCount
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.data.SemanticType

/**
 * 时间线索引器
 * 
 * 用于快速检索和查询时间线中的内容
 * 当前实现基于关键词匹配，后续会被向量检索替换
 */
class Indexer {
    
    private var indexedItems: List<TimelineItem> = emptyList()
    private var units: List<LearningUnit> = emptyList()
    
    /**
     * 索引时间线条目
     */
    fun index(items: List<TimelineItem>) {
        this.indexedItems = items
    }
    
    /**
     * 搜索关键词
     * 
     * @param query 搜索关键词
     * @param topK 返回最相关的 topK 条结果
     * @return 按相关性排序的 TimelineItem 列表
     */
    fun search(query: String, topK: Int = 5): List<TimelineItem> {
        if (query.isBlank()) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        
        if (indexedItems.isEmpty()) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        
        // 分词
        val keywords = tokenize(query)
        if (keywords.isEmpty()) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        
        // 计算每个条目的相关性分数
        val scoredItems = indexedItems.map { item ->
            val score = calculateScore(item, keywords)
            item to score
        }
        
        // 按分数降序排序，分数相同时按开始时间降序排序（最新的在前）
        val sortedItems = scoredItems
            .filter { it.second > 0 }
            .sortedByDescending { item -> item.second.toDouble() + item.first.start / 1000.0 }
            .take(topK)
            .map { it.first }
        
        return sortedItems
    }
    
    /**
     * 清空索引
     */
    fun clear() {
        this.indexedItems = emptyList()
        this.units = emptyList()
    }

    // ---------- LearningUnit 扩展（阶段 A） ----------

    /** 索引学习单元。 */
    fun indexUnits(items: List<LearningUnit>) {
        this.units = items
    }

    /** 按语义类型检索。 */
    fun searchBySemanticType(type: SemanticType, topK: Int = 5): List<LearningUnit> =
        units.filter { it.semanticType == type }.take(topK)

    /** 按重要度检索（>= minImportance，降序）。 */
    fun searchByImportance(minImportance: Int, topK: Int = 5): List<LearningUnit> =
        units.filter { it.importance >= minImportance }
            .sortedByDescending { it.importance }
            .take(topK)

    /** 在学习单元中做关键词检索（覆盖 speech/screenText/oneLineSummary/keywords）。 */
    fun searchUnits(query: String, topK: Int = 5): List<LearningUnit> {
        if (query.isBlank() || units.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val keywords = tokenize(query)
        if (keywords.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return units
            .map { unit ->
                val content = (unit.speech + " " + unit.screenText + " " + unit.oneLineSummary + " " +
                    unit.keywords.joinToString(" ")).lowercase()
                unit to keywords.count { content.contains(it) }
            }
            .filter { it.second > 0 }
            .sortedByDescending { it.second }
            .take(topK)
            .map { it.first }
    }
    
    /**
     * 分词
     * 按空格和标点符号切分
     */
    private fun tokenize(text: String): List<String> {
        val punctuation = charArrayOf(' ', '.', ',', '，', '。', '！', '？', '；', ':', '、', '"', '\'', '`')
        var cleaned = text.lowercase()
        
        // 替换标点符号为空格
        for (punct in punctuation) {
            cleaned = cleaned.replace(punct, ' ')
        }
        
        // 分割并过滤空字符串
        return cleaned
            .split("\\s+".toRegex())
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
    }
    
    /**
     * 计算相关性分数
     * 
     * @param item 时间线条目
     * @param keywords 关键词列表
     * @return 命中关键词数量
     */
    private fun calculateScore(item: TimelineItem, keywords: List<String>): Int {
        val content = "${item.speech} ${item.screenText}".lowercase()
        var score = 0
        
        for (keyword in keywords) {
            if (content.contains(keyword)) {
                score++
            }
        }
        
        return score
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/InterleavingEngine.kt (1KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint

/**
 * 交错学习：按 chapterId 分组后 Round-Robin 轮询，避免同章节连续。
 * 单章节 → 打乱返回（无交错可用）。
 */
class InterleavingEngine {

    fun interleave(points: List<KnowledgePoint>, count: Int): List<KnowledgePoint> {
        if (points.isEmpty() || count <= 0) return emptyList()
        val groups = points.groupBy { it.chapterId }.values.map { it.shuffled() }
        if (groups.size <= 1) return points.shuffled().take(count)

        val result = mutableListOf<KnowledgePoint>()
        var idx = 0
        while (result.size < count) {
            var added = false
            for (group in groups) {
                if (idx < group.size && result.size < count) {
                    result.add(group[idx])
                    added = true
                }
            }
            if (!added) break   // 所有组都抽完
            idx++
        }
        return result
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/**
 * 重点知识标注：纯启发式（无需联网即可用）。
 * 依据三类信号给每个片段打"必学"标签：
 *  1) 强调词（重点/必考/记住/易错…）
 *  2) PPT 标题式画面文字（短、无句读）
 *  3) 重复出现（同一句在片中多次讲到 → 讲师在强调）
 */
object KeyKnowledge {

    private val emphasis = listOf(
        "重点", "划重点", "必考", "考点", "核心", "关键", "总结", "易错",
        "一定要", "别忘了", "考试", "难点", "记住", "注意", "易混", "必学"
    )

    /** 返回与 [timeline] 等长的标签列表；null 表示非重点。 */
    fun tags(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): List<String?> {
        val norm = timeline.map { normalize(it.speech.ifBlank { it.screenText }) }
        val freq = HashMap<String, Int>()
        norm.forEach { n -> if (n.length >= 6) freq[n] = (freq[n] ?: 0) + 1 }
        return timeline.mapIndexed { i, item ->
            val speech = item.speech
            val screen = item.screenText
            when {
                emphasis.any { speech.contains(it) } -> "强调"
                isHeading(screen) -> "标题"
                norm[i].length >= 6 && (freq[norm[i]] ?: 0) >= 2 -> "重复"
                else -> null
            }
        }
    }

    fun isKey(timeline: List<TimelineItem>, index: Int): Boolean =
        tags(timeline).getOrNull(index) != null

    /** 短、无句读 → 视为画面标题（PPT 小标题）。 */
    fun isHeading(screen: String): Boolean {
        val s = screen.trim()
        if (s.length !in 2..16) return false
        if (s.endsWith("。") || s.endsWith("，") || s.endsWith("？") || s.endsWith("！") ||
            s.endsWith(".") || s.endsWith(",") || s.endsWith("?") || s.endsWith("!")
        ) return false
        if (s.contains("，") || s.contains("。")) return false
        return true
    }

    private fun normalize(s: String): String =
        s.replace(Regex("[\\s\\u3000，。、！？；：,.!?;:]"), "")
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.ExamLevel
import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.data.MasteryStatus

/**
 * 知识点提取器（规则版）：
 * 每个 LearningUnit 生成 1-3 个知识点；考纲等级由 importance 映射；掌握状态初始 NOT_LEARNED。
 */
class KnowledgePointExtractor {

    fun extract(unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String): List<KnowledgePoint> {
        val text = (unit.speech + "。" + unit.screenText).trim()
        if (text.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val names = LinkedHashSet<String>()
        unit.keywords.forEach { kw -> if (kw.isNotBlank()) names.add(kw.trim()) }
        PROPER_NOUN.findAll(text).forEach { m -> names.add(m.value) }
        if (names.isEmpty()) names.add(text.take(12))

        val examLevel = when {
            unit.importance >= 5 -> ExamLevel.MUST_KNOW
            unit.importance == 4 -> ExamLevel.OFTEN
            unit.importance == 3 -> ExamLevel.UNDERSTAND
            else -> ExamLevel.OPTIONAL
        }
        val definition = unit.oneLineSummary.ifBlank { text.take(50) }

        return names.take(3).mapIndexed { i, name ->
            KnowledgePoint(
                id = "${videoId}_kp_${unit.start.toInt()}_$i",
                name = name,
                definition = definition,
                sourceVideoId = videoId,
                sourceTimestamp = unit.start,
                examLevel = examLevel,
                masteryStatus = MasteryStatus.NOT_LEARNED,
                relatedIds = unit.relatedIds
            )
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        val PROPER_NOUN = Regex("\\b[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9+#._-]{1,}\\b")
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/**
 * 本地辩论启发式回退：未配置 API Key 时，
 * 用三种"视角"（概述 / 挑战 / 裁决→证据）对视频时间线做抽取式分析。
 * 所有输出明确标注"（本地启发式）"，绝不伪装成远程大模型的回答。
 */
class LocalDebater(
    private val role: String,
    private val timeline: List<TimelineItem>
) : LlmClient {

    override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String {
        val sentences = timeline
            .flatMap { (it.speech + "。" + it.screenText).split(Regex("[。；;\n]")) }
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.length >= 8 }
        if (sentences.isEmpty()) return "（本地启发式：时间线为空，无法分析）"

        val negMarkers = listOf("不", "错", "局限", "问题", "然而", "但是", "反例", "失败", "难")
        return when (role) {
            "挑战" -> {
                val found = sentences.filter { s -> negMarkers.any { s.contains(it) } }.take(2)
                (if (found.isEmpty()) {
                    listOf("现有内容没有找到明显反例；建议补充边界条件与失败场景验证。")
                } else found).joinToString("；") + "。（本地启发式）"
            }
            "裁决" -> {
                val best = sentences.maxByOrNull { it.length }
                "采纳主结论；并在适用范围上保持谨慎。" +
                    (best?.let { "关键证据：$it。" } ?: "") + "（本地启发式）"
            }
            else -> {
                sentences.sortedByDescending { it.length }.take(2).joinToString("；") + "。（本地启发式）"
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment

/**
 * 数据融合：transcript（语音）+ frames（画面 OCR / 氛围 / 画面描述）→ 统一时间线。
 *
 * 性能版：帧先按时间排序 + 二分定位（20fps 全量抽帧可达十万级，旧"逐段 filter"是 O(n·m) 会卡死）。
 * screenText 聚合时折叠「连续重复」的相同 OCR 文本（同一页 PPT 连续多帧只保留一份文字——不丢帧，只去重字）。
 * 输出按 start 排序，任何帧都不丢弃（无语音归属的帧独立成条）。
 */
fun merge(
    transcript: List<TranscriptSegment>,
    frames: List<FrameOcr>
): List<TimelineItem> {
    if (transcript.isEmpty() && frames.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

    val sorted = frames.sortedBy { it.timestamp }
    val ts = DoubleArray(sorted.size) { sorted[it].timestamp }
    val covered = BooleanArray(sorted.size)

    // 二分：第一个 >= x 的下标
    fun lowerBound(x: Double): Int {
        var lo = 0
        var hi = sorted.size
        while (lo < hi) {
            val mid = (lo + hi) ushr 1
            if (ts[mid] < x) lo = mid + 1 else hi = mid
        }
        return lo
    }

    val out = ArrayList<TimelineItem>(transcript.size + 64)

    for (segment in transcript) {
        val lo = lowerBound(segment.start)
        val rel = ArrayList<FrameOcr>()
        var j = lo
        while (j < sorted.size && ts[j] < segment.end + 2.5) { // 吸收邻近画面帧 → 语音+画面同屏
            rel.add(sorted[j])
            j++
        }
        // 覆盖标记（与旧语义一致：[start, end] 闭区间内的帧视为已有归属）
        var k = lo
        while (k < sorted.size && ts[k] <= segment.end + 2.5) {
            covered[k] = true
            k++
        }
        val screenText = rel.map { it.text }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            .fold(ArrayList<String>()) { acc, s -> if (acc.lastOrNull() != s) acc.add(s); acc }
            .joinToString(" ")
            .trim()
        out.add(
            TimelineItem(
                start = segment.start,
                end = segment.end,
                speech = segment.text,
                screenText = screenText,
                framePath = rel.firstOrNull()?.imagePath ?: "",
                caption = rel.map { it.caption }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct().joinToString(" ").take(200)
            )
        )
    }

    // 只有画面、没有语音归属的帧 → 独立条目；连续「完全重复」（OCR 文字一模一样）的帧折叠成一个时段，
    // 原始帧一帧不删，全部保留在 frames.json（后台留底给 Mentara）。
    var idx = 0
    while (idx < sorted.size) {
        if (covered[idx]) { idx++; continue }
        val first = sorted[idx]
        val text = first.text.trim()
        var last = idx
        while (last + 1 < sorted.size && !covered[last + 1] && sorted[last + 1].text.trim() == text) last++
        val dupCount = last - idx + 1
        out.add(
            TimelineItem(
                start = first.timestamp,
                end = sorted[last].timestamp + 5.0,
                speech = "",
                screenText = if (dupCount > 1) first.text + "（同画面连续 $dupCount 帧，已折叠）" else first.text,
                framePath = first.imagePath,
                caption = first.caption
            )
        )
        idx = last + 1
    }

    out.sortBy { it.start }
    return out
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.CodeSnippet
import com.learnagent.data.Decision
import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

@Serializable
data class Alternative(val name: String, val applicableWhen: String)

/** 问题导向的解决方案（不是"知识"，是"可执行的方案"）。 */
@Serializable
data class ProblemSolution(
    val problem: String,
    val primary: String,
    val alternatives: List<Alternative> = emptyList(),
    val codeSnippet: String? = null,
    val pitfalls: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val whenNotToUse: String? = null,
    val relatedDecisions: List<Decision> = emptyList(),
    val source: String
)

/**
 * 问题导向搜索：
 * 1. ProblemParser 解析
 * 2. 本地检索 TechCard / Decision / CodeSnippet
 * 3. 命中 ≥1 → 直接返回（source=本地）
 * 4. 不够 → LLM 补全（source=LLM）
 * 5. LLM 不可用/失败 → 返回本地结果并标注"本地启发式"
 */
class ProblemOrientedSearch(
    private val llm: LlmClient?,
    private val techStore: TechStore
) {
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun search(problem: String): ProblemSolution {
        val parsed = ProblemParser(llm).parse(problem)
        val cards = techStore.getAllTechCards().filter { cardMatches(it, parsed) }
        val decisions = techStore.getAllDecisions().filter { textMatches(it.problem, parsed) }
        val snippets = techStore.getAllCodeSnippets().filter { snippetMatches(it, parsed) }

        val enough = cards.isNotEmpty() || decisions.isNotEmpty() || snippets.isNotEmpty()
        if (enough) return localSolution(problem, cards, decisions, snippets, "本地")
        if (llm != null) {
            try {
                return llmSolution(problem, parsed, decisions)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // 降级
            }
        }
        return localSolution(problem, cards, decisions, snippets, "本地启发式")
    }

    private fun localSolution(
        problem: String,
        cards: List<TechCard>,
        decisions: List<Decision>,
        snippets: List<CodeSnippet>,
        source: String
    ): ProblemSolution {
        val topCard = cards.firstOrNull()
        val topDecision = decisions.firstOrNull()
        val topSnippet = snippets.firstOrNull()
        val primary = when {
            topCard != null -> "首选：${topCard.name} —— ${topCard.whatItSolves.ifBlank { topCard.whatItIs }}" +
                if (topCard.whenToUse.isNotBlank()) "（适用：${topCard.whenToUse}）" else ""
            topDecision != null -> "参考你之前的决策：${topDecision.chosen}（理由：${topDecision.reason}）" +
                if (topDecision.result.isNotBlank()) "｜结果：${topDecision.result}" else ""
            topSnippet != null -> "可直接复用代码片段：${topSnippet.purpose.ifBlank { topSnippet.language }}"
            else -> "本地库暂无匹配。建议先用关键词「${ProblemParser(null).parseWithDictionary(problem).keywords.take(3).joinToString(" ")}」在视频中检索；配置 LLM 后可生成完整方案。"
        }
        val alternatives = cards.drop(1).take(3).map { Alternative(it.name, it.whenToUse.ifBlank { it.whatItSolves }) }
        return ProblemSolution(
            problem = problem,
            primary = primary,
            alternatives = alternatives,
            codeSnippet = topCard?.codeSnippet?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: topSnippet?.code,
            pitfalls = cards.map { it.whenNotToUse }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.take(3),
            whenNotToUse = topCard?.whenNotToUse?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            relatedDecisions = decisions.take(5),
            source = source
        )
    }

    private suspend fun llmSolution(
        problem: String,
        parsed: ParsedProblem,
        decisions: List<Decision>
    ): ProblemSolution {
        val client = llm ?: throw IllegalStateException("no llm")
        val prompt = """
你是资深工程师。针对问题给出可执行方案，只输出 JSON：
{"primary":"首选方案+理由","alternatives":[{"name":"备选","applicableWhen":"何时用"}],
 "codeSnippet":"可复制代码或空串","pitfalls":["坑1","坑2"],"whenNotToUse":"什么时候不该用"}

问题：$problem
关键词：${parsed.keywords.joinToString()}
领域：${parsed.domain}
约束：${parsed.constraints.joinToString()}
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun str(key: String) = (o[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()
        val alts = (o["alternatives"] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { el ->
            val obj = el as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val name = (obj["name"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: return@mapNotNull null
            Alternative(name, (obj["applicableWhen"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull.orEmpty())
        } ?: emptyList()
        val pitfalls = (o["pitfalls"] as? JsonArray)
            ?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: emptyList()
        return ProblemSolution(
            problem = problem,
            primary = str("primary"),
            alternatives = alts,
            codeSnippet = str("codeSnippet").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            pitfalls = pitfalls,
            whenNotToUse = str("whenNotToUse").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            relatedDecisions = decisions.take(5),
            source = "LLM"
        )
    }

    private fun cardMatches(card: TechCard, parsed: ParsedProblem): Boolean {
        val text = listOf(card.name, card.whatItIs, card.whatItSolves, card.relatedConcepts.joinToString(" ")).joinToString(" ")
        return textMatches(text, parsed)
    }

    private fun snippetMatches(snippet: CodeSnippet, parsed: ParsedProblem): Boolean {
        val text = listOf(snippet.purpose, snippet.language, snippet.tags.joinToString(" "), snippet.code).joinToString(" ")
        return textMatches(text, parsed)
    }

    private fun textMatches(text: String, parsed: ParsedProblem): Boolean {
        if (text.isBlank()) return false
        val terms = parsed.keywords.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (terms.isEmpty()) return false
        return terms.any { text.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

/** 结构化问题：核心关键词 3-8 个 + 领域 + 约束。 */
@Serializable
data class ParsedProblem(
    val keywords: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val domain: String = "其他",
    val constraints: List<String> = emptyList()
)

/**
 * 问题解析（双路）：
 * - 主路：LLM 输出 JSON（keywords/domain/constraints），解析失败或不足 → 降级
 * - 降级路：本地词典（≈180 技术词 + 分类映射）+ 正则约束词
 * 所有降级结果不标注来源字段（由上层按 llm==null 判定），但保证可用。
 */
class ProblemParser(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun parse(problem: String): ParsedProblem {
        if (problem.isBlank()) return ParsedProblem()
        if (llm == null) return parseWithDictionary(problem)
        return try {
            val parsed = parseWithLlm(problem)
            if (parsed.keywords.size >= 2) parsed else parseWithDictionary(problem)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            parseWithDictionary(problem)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun parseWithLlm(problem: String): ParsedProblem {
        val client = llm ?: return parseWithDictionary(problem)
        val prompt = """
解析下面的技术问题，只输出 JSON：
{"keywords":["3-8 个核心技术关键词"],"domain":"分布式|并发|数据库|网络|安全|性能|架构|算法|框架|工具|其他","constraints":["高并发","低延迟","强一致"等]}

问题：$problem
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        return parseJson(raw)
    }

    private fun parseJson(raw: String): ParsedProblem {
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun strList(key: String): List<String> =
            (o[key] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: emptyList()
        val keywords = strList("keywords").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.take(8)
        val domain = (o["domain"] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull?.trim().orEmpty().ifBlank { "其他" }
        val constraints = strList("constraints").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.take(5)
        return ParsedProblem(keywords, domain, constraints)
    }

    /** 本地词典 + 正则。 */
    fun parseWithDictionary(problem: String): ParsedProblem {
        val keywords = LinkedHashSet<String>()
        var domain = "其他"

        // 词典命中（长词优先，避免"锁"先命中把"分布式锁"拆散）
        val sorted = DICTIONARY.sortedByDescending { it.canonical.length }
        val matched = mutableListOf<DictEntry>()
        for (entry in sorted) {
            val hit = entry.canonical.length >= 2 && problem.contains(entry.canonical, ignoreCase = true) ||
                entry.aliases.any { it.isNotBlank() && problem.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
            if (hit && matched.none { it.canonical == entry.canonical }) matched.add(entry)
        }
        matched.forEach { keywords.add(it.canonical) }
        if (matched.isNotEmpty()) domain = matched.first().domain

        // 约束词（验收要求：约束词也进入 keywords）
        val constraints = CONSTRAINTS.filter { problem.contains(it) }
        constraints.forEach { keywords.add(it) }

        // 英文/数字专有词
        Regex("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+#._-]{1,}").findAll(problem).forEach { m ->
            if (keywords.size < 8) keywords.add(m.value)
        }
        // 中文兜底：短句 + 滑窗（无标点长句也能切词）
        if (keywords.size < 3) {
            val segments = problem.split(Regex("[，。,.!?！？；;：:\\s]+")).map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            segments.forEach { seg ->
                if (keywords.size >= 8) return@forEach
                if (seg.length in 2..6) keywords.add(seg)
                if (seg.length > 4) {
                    for (n in listOf(2, 3)) {
                        var i = 0
                        while (i + n <= seg.length && keywords.size < 8) {
                            val piece = seg.substring(i, i + n)
                            if (piece.any { it.code > 0x2E80 }) keywords.add(piece)
                            i += n
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ParsedProblem(keywords.take(8).toList(), domain, constraints)
    }

    private data class DictEntry(val canonical: String, val domain: String, val aliases: List<String> = emptyList())

    private companion object {
        val CONSTRAINTS = listOf(
            "高并发", "低延迟", "强一致", "最终一致", "高可用", "高吞吐", "可扩展",
            "海量数据", "实时", "低内存", "低成本", "安全", "容错", "跨平台", "离线"
        )

        val DICTIONARY: List<DictEntry> = listOf(
            // 分布式
            DictEntry("分布式系统", "分布式", listOf("分布式")),
            DictEntry("分布式锁", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("一致性协议", "分布式", listOf("一致性", "共识")),
            DictEntry("选主", "分布式", listOf("leader 选举", "主节点")),
            DictEntry("Raft", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("Paxos", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("ZooKeeper", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("etcd", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("Consul", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("服务发现", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("注册中心", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("API 网关", "分布式", listOf("网关")),
            DictEntry("微服务", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("消息队列", "分布式", listOf("MQ")),
            DictEntry("Kafka", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("RabbitMQ", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("RocketMQ", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("分库分表", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("幂等", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("CAP", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("BASE", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("两阶段提交", "分布式", listOf("2PC")),
            DictEntry("TCC", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("熔断", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("限流", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("降级", "分布式"),
            DictEntry("负载均衡", "分布式"),
            // 并发
            DictEntry("并发编程", "并发", listOf("并发")),
            DictEntry("线程池", "并发"),
            DictEntry("线程", "并发"),
            DictEntry("死锁", "并发"),
            DictEntry("协程", "并发"),
            DictEntry("并行", "并发"),
            DictEntry("原子操作", "并发"),
            DictEntry("CAS", "并发"),
            DictEntry("内存屏障", "并发"),
            DictEntry("可见性", "并发"),
            DictEntry("线程安全", "并发"),
            DictEntry("生产者消费者", "并发"),
            DictEntry("信号量", "并发"),
            DictEntry("互斥锁", "并发"),
            DictEntry("读写锁", "并发"),
