package com.learnagent.core

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit

@Serializable
data class QaAnswer(
    val answer: String,
    val citations: List<String>
)

@Serializable
data class LlmConfig(
    val provider: String,
    val apiKey: String,
    val baseUrl: String,
    val model: String,
    /** 系统提示词（可为空）。 */
    val system: String = "",
    val temperature: Double = 0.6,
    val maxTokens: Int = 4096
)

/** 回答模式：严谨（只用视频、可溯源）/ 专家（允许通识+联网，质量优先）。 */
enum class AnswerMode { STRICT, EXPERT }

/** 联网检索结果。 */
data class WebResult(val title: String, val url: String, val content: String)

/** 联网搜索接口（注入实现，如 Tavily）。 */
fun interface WebSearch {
    suspend fun search(query: String): List<WebResult>
}

interface QaEngine {
    suspend fun ask(question: String, videoId: String? = null): QaAnswer
}

interface LlmClient {
    suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String
}

/** 支持流式输出（SSE）的客户端；同时可回传推理过程（reasoning_content）。 */
interface StreamingLlmClient {
    suspend fun streamResponse(
        prompt: String,
        config: LlmConfig,
        onToken: (String) -> Unit,
        onReasoning: (String) -> Unit
    ): String
}

class KeywordQaEngine(
    private val search: suspend (String, Int) -> List<TimelineItem>,
    private val llmClient: LlmClient? = null
) : QaEngine {
    
    override suspend fun ask(question: String, videoId: String?): QaAnswer {
        val searchResults = search(question, 10)
        
        if (searchResults.isEmpty()) {
            return QaAnswer(
                answer = "视频中未提及",
                citations = emptyList()
            )
        }
        
        if (llmClient == null) {
            return QaAnswer(
                answer = "未配置API Key",
                citations = searchResults.map { it.start.toString() }
            )
        }
        
        val context = searchResults.joinToString("\n") { 
            "时间点: , 内容: " 
        }
        
        val prompt = """
            问题: 
        
            相关视频内容:
            
        
            请基于以上视频内容回答问题，引用相关的时间点。
        """.trim()
        
        val answer = llmClient.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig(
            provider = "",
            apiKey = "",
            baseUrl = "",
            model = ""
        ))
        
        return QaAnswer(
            answer = answer,
            citations = searchResults.map { it.start.toString() }
        )
    }
}

/**
 * 纯本地的问答引擎（不依赖外部 LLM）。
 *
 * 用检索到的 [TimelineItem] 直接拼接答案，并返回时间戳引用。
 * 在未配置大模型时提供可用的问答能力。
 */
class LocalQaEngine(
    private val allItems: (() -> List<TimelineItem>)? = null,
    private val search: suspend (String, Int) -> List<TimelineItem>
) : QaEngine {

    override suspend fun ask(question: String, videoId: String?): QaAnswer {
        var prefix = ""
        var results = search(question, 5)

        if (results.isEmpty() && isGenericQuestion(question)) {
            val all = allItems?.invoke().orEmpty()
            if (all.isNotEmpty()) {
                prefix = "没有直接匹配，但以下是视频的核心内容：\n"
                results = all.take(5)
            }
        }

        if (results.isEmpty()) {
            return QaAnswer(answer = "视频中未提及相关内容。", citations = emptyList())
        }

        val answer = buildString {
            if (prefix.isNotEmpty()) append(prefix)
            append("根据视频内容，找到 ")
            append(results.size)
            append(" 条相关信息：\n")
            for (item in results) {
                val parts = listOf(item.speech, item.screenText).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
                val text = if (parts.isEmpty()) "（无内容）" else parts.joinToString(" | ")
                append("- [").append(formatStamp(item.start)).append("] ").append(text).append('\n')
            }
        }.trim()

        return QaAnswer(
            answer = answer,
            citations = results.map { formatStamp(it.start) }
        )
    }

    private fun formatStamp(seconds: Double): String {
        val total = seconds.toInt()
        return two(total / 60) + ":" + two(total % 60)
    }

    private fun two(value: Int): String = if (value < 10) "0$value" else value.toString()
}

/** 泛问检测：短句 + 无 ASCII 字母数字 + 命中"什么/讲了/内容/介绍/总结/重点/回顾"。 */
fun isGenericQuestion(q: String): Boolean {
    if (q.length >= 15) return false
    if (q.any { it.code < 128 && it.isLetterOrDigit() }) return false
    val markers = listOf("什么", "讲了", "内容", "介绍", "总结", "重点", "回顾", "聊")
    return markers.any { q.contains(it) }
}

private fun stampOf(seconds: Double): String {
    val t = seconds.toInt()
    fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
    return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
}

/**
 * 基于 [LearningUnit] 的问答引擎：
 * - 泛问 → 返回 importance>=4 的 top5
 * - 检索为空 → 降级返回 importance 最高的 top5
 * - 有 LLM → 用 LearningUnit 升华内容生成回答；失败/无 LLM → 本地拼接
 */
class LearningUnitQaEngine(
    private val units: () -> List<LearningUnit>,
    private val llmClient: LlmClient? = null
) : QaEngine {

    override suspend fun ask(question: String, videoId: String?): QaAnswer {
        val all = units()
        if (all.isEmpty()) return QaAnswer("视频中未提及相关内容。", emptyList())

        val generic = isGenericQuestion(question)
        val keywords = question.lowercase()
            .split(Regex("[\\s,，。、！？；：]+"))
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }

        val hits: List<LearningUnit> = when {
            generic -> all.filter { it.importance >= 4 }.sortedByDescending { it.importance }.take(5)
            else -> {
                val matched = all.filter { u ->
                    val content = (u.speech + " " + u.screenText + " " + u.oneLineSummary).lowercase()
                    keywords.any { content.contains(it) }
                }
                if (matched.isNotEmpty()) matched.take(5)
                else all.sortedByDescending { it.importance }.take(5)
            }
        }

        val fallbackPrefix = when {
            generic -> "以下是视频的核心内容：\n"
            hits.none { u -> keywords.any { (u.speech + u.screenText).lowercase().contains(it) } } ->
                "没有直接匹配，但以下是视频的核心内容：\n"
            else -> ""
        }

        fun local(): String = buildString {
            append(fallbackPrefix)
            hits.forEach { u ->
                val text = u.oneLineSummary.ifBlank { u.speech.ifBlank { u.screenText } }
                append("- [").append(stampOf(u.start)).append("] ").append(text).append('\n')
            }
        }.trim()

        val answer = if (llmClient != null) {
            val context = hits.joinToString("\n") { "[${stampOf(it.start)}] ${it.oneLineSummary.ifBlank { it.speech }}" }
            val prompt = "基于以下视频内容回答问题（只使用给定内容）：\n$context\n\n问题：$question"
            try {
                llmClient.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                local()
            }
        } else {
            local()
        }

        return QaAnswer(answer = answer, citations = hits.map { stampOf(it.start) })
    }
}

/**
 * 基于远程大模型（如 NVIDIA NIM）的问答引擎。
 *
 * 先用检索结果构造带时间戳的上下文，再交给 [LlmClient]（BYOK）生成回答，
 * 并把命中片段的时间戳作为引用返回。
 */
class RemoteQaEngine(
    private val search: suspend (String, Int) -> List<TimelineItem>,
    private val llmClient: LlmClient,
    private val topK: Int = 8,
    private val fallbackAll: (suspend () -> List<TimelineItem>)? = null,
    private val mode: () -> AnswerMode = { AnswerMode.EXPERT },
    private val webSearch: WebSearch? = null,
    private val extraContext: () -> String = { "" }
) : QaEngine {

    override suspend fun ask(question: String, videoId: String?): QaAnswer =
        askStream(question, videoId, {}, {})

    /** 流式问答：onToken 逐字回调；onReasoning 回传思考过程。 */
    suspend fun askStream(
        question: String,
        videoId: String?,
        onToken: (String) -> Unit,
        onReasoning: (String) -> Unit
    ): QaAnswer {
        var results = search(question, topK)
        if (results.size < 2 && fallbackAll != null) {
            // 全片均匀采样（语音段优先）：旧版 take(60) 在 20fps 下只等于"开头 3 秒"
            val all = fallbackAll()
            val speech = all.filter { it.speech.isNotBlank() }
            val picked = if (speech.size >= 2) Evidence.spread(speech, 60) else Evidence.spread(all, 60)
            if (picked.size > results.size) results = picked
        }
        val expert = mode() == AnswerMode.EXPERT
        // 不再拒答：没有命中也照常回答（视频内容 + 通识自由发挥）
        val context = results.joinToString("\n") { item ->
            buildString {
                append("[").append(formatStamp(item.start)).append("]")
                val sp = item.speech.trim()
                val sc = item.screenText.trim()
                if (sp.isNotEmpty()) append(" 语音：").append(sp)
                if (sc.isNotEmpty()) append(" ｜画面：").append(sc)
                if (sp.isEmpty() && sc.isEmpty()) append("（无内容）")
            }
        }

        // 专家模式：联网检索（若已接）
        val ws = webSearch
        val web = if (expert && ws != null) {
            runCatching { ws.search(question) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        } else emptyList()

        val skill = extraContext().trim()

        val system = if (expert)
            "你是 Mentara——本应用内置的 AI 学习助手，回答中自称「Mentara」。" +
                "像传统对话 AI 一样自由、自然地回答，不要轻易拒答；同时你拥有当前视频的完整内容作为额外知识，" +
                "优先结合视频内容并标注 [mm:ss]，视频没有的部分就用你自己的知识自由展开。能深入就深入，不要惜字。"
        else
            "你是 Mentara——本应用内置的 AI 学习助手，回答中自称「Mentara」。" +
                "像传统对话 AI 一样自由地回答；涉及视频内容时以视频为准并标注 [mm:ss]，不编造视频里没有的内容；" +
                "视频未涉及的部分可以用你的通识回答，不要拒答。"

        val prompt = buildString {
            append("【当前视频内容】\n")
            if (results.isNotEmpty()) append(context).append("\n\n")
            else append("（本视频未直接涉及该问题，可作为背景参考）\n\n")
            if (skill.isNotBlank()) {
                append("【Mentara 永久知识库（该视频完整档案，未删减）】\n")
                append(skill.take(16000)).append("\n\n")
            }
            if (web.isNotEmpty()) {
                append("【联网检索结果】\n")
                web.forEachIndexed { i, w ->
                    append("(").append(i + 1).append(") ").append(w.title).append(" — ").append(w.url).append("\n")
                    append(w.content.take(500)).append("\n")
                }
                append("\n")
            }
            append("问题：").append(question).append("\n\n")
            append(
                if (expert) "要求：用中文，先给核心结论，再多角度展开分析，尽量详实、深入，不要缩减内容；涉及视频内容处标注 [mm:ss]。"
                else "要求：用中文回答；引用视频内容处标注 [mm:ss]。"
            )
        }

        val cfg = LlmConfig(
            provider = "nvidia", apiKey = "", baseUrl = "", model = "",
            system = system,
            temperature = if (expert) 0.7 else 0.2,
            maxTokens = 4096
        )

        val answer = if (llmClient is StreamingLlmClient) {
            llmClient.streamResponse(prompt, cfg, onToken, onReasoning)
        } else {
            llmClient.generateResponse(prompt, cfg)
        }.ifBlank { "（模型未返回内容：请检查网络 / API Key，或稍后重试）" }

        return QaAnswer(answer = answer, citations = results.map { formatStamp(it.start) })
    }

    private fun formatStamp(seconds: Double): String {
        val total = seconds.toInt()
        return two(total / 60) + ":" + two(total % 60)
    }

    private fun two(value: Int): String = if (value < 10) "0$value" else value.toString()
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

/** 逆向学习树节点：level 0 = 目标，1/2/3 = 前置层级。 */
data class KnowledgeNode(
    val name: String,
    val level: Int,
    val mastered: Boolean,
    val children: List<KnowledgeNode> = emptyList()
)

/**
 * 逆向学习引擎（Petersson 方法）：
 * 从目标反推前置知识，最多 3 层；已掌握的不再展开。
 * LLM 拆解失败/离线 → 本地前置词典降级。
 */
class ReverseLearningEngine(
    private val llm: LlmClient?,
    private val techStore: TechStore
) {
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun analyze(goal: String): KnowledgeNode =
        KnowledgeNode(goal, 0, isMastered(goal), prerequisites(goal, 1, mutableSetOf(goal)))

    /** 文本学习路径（与设计示例同构）。 */
    fun learningPathText(root: KnowledgeNode): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("你的目标：").append(root.name).append("\n\n需要学：\n")
        val start = deepestUnmasteredLeaf(root)
        val children = root.children
        children.forEachIndexed { i, c -> render(sb, c, "  ", i == children.lastIndex, start) }
        sb.append("\n")
        sb.append(if (start != null) "建议从\"${start.name}\"开始。" else "目标相关前置已全部掌握，可直接实践。")
        return sb.toString()
    }

    private fun render(sb: StringBuilder, node: KnowledgeNode, indent: String, last: Boolean, start: KnowledgeNode?) {
        sb.append(indent).append(if (last) "└─ " else "├─ ").append(node.name)
            .append(if (node.mastered) "（已掌握）" else "（未掌握）")
        if (start != null && node.name == start.name && node.level == start.level) sb.append(" ← 先学这个")
        sb.append("\n")
        val children = node.children
        children.forEachIndexed { i, c -> render(sb, c, indent + "│   ", i == children.lastIndex, start) }
    }

    private fun deepestUnmasteredLeaf(root: KnowledgeNode): KnowledgeNode? {
        val leaves = mutableListOf<KnowledgeNode>()
        fun walk(n: KnowledgeNode) {
            if (n.children.isEmpty()) {
                if (!n.mastered) leaves.add(n)
            } else n.children.forEach { walk(it) }
        }
        walk(root)
        return leaves.maxByOrNull { it.level }
    }

    private suspend fun prerequisites(topic: String, level: Int, seen: MutableSet<String>): List<KnowledgeNode> {
        if (level > 3) return emptyList()
        val names = if (llm != null) {
            try {
                llmPrerequisites(topic)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                localPrerequisites(topic)
            }
        } else localPrerequisites(topic)
        return names.map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotBlank() && seen.add(it) }.take(5).map { name ->
            val mastered = isMastered(name)
            val children = if (!mastered) prerequisites(name, level + 1, seen) else emptyList()
            KnowledgeNode(name, level, mastered, children)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun llmPrerequisites(topic: String): List<String> {
        val client = llm ?: return localPrerequisites(topic)
        val prompt = """
列出掌握「$topic」所需的直接前置知识（最多 5 个，不要展开二级）。
只输出 JSON：{"prerequisites":["前置1","前置2"]}
若是基础概念无前置，输出 {"prerequisites":[]}
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        if (raw.contains("无前置") || raw.contains("基础概念")) return emptyList()
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        return (o["prerequisites"] as? JsonArray)
            ?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull }
            ?.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: emptyList()
    }

    /** TechUsage：usedCount ≥1 或状态 ≥ FAMILIAR 视为已掌握。 */
    private fun isMastered(name: String): Boolean =
        techStore.getAllTechUsage().any {
            it.techName.equals(name, ignoreCase = true) &&
                (it.usedCount >= 1 || it.status.ordinal >= com.learnagent.data.TechStatus.FAMILIAR.ordinal)
        }

    private fun localPrerequisites(topic: String): List<String> {
        val key = PREREQUISITES.keys.firstOrNull { topic.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
        return key?.let { PREREQUISITES[it].orEmpty() } ?: emptyList()
    }

    private companion object {
        val PREREQUISITES = linkedMapOf(
            "视频生成" to listOf("扩散模型", "深度学习", "PyTorch"),
            "扩散模型" to listOf("深度学习", "概率论", "U-Net"),
            "U-Net" to listOf("卷积神经网络", "残差连接"),
            "深度学习" to listOf("机器学习", "线性代数", "微积分"),
            "机器学习" to listOf("线性代数", "概率论", "Python"),
            "Transformer" to listOf("注意力机制", "深度学习"),
            "注意力机制" to listOf("深度学习", "向量运算"),
            "大模型" to listOf("Transformer", "分布式训练"),
            "RAG" to listOf("大模型", "向量数据库"),
            "分布式锁" to listOf("并发编程", "分布式系统"),
            "分布式系统" to listOf("网络基础", "一致性协议"),
            "一致性协议" to listOf("分布式系统"),
            "微服务" to listOf("分布式系统", "容器化"),
            "Kubernetes" to listOf("容器化", "网络基础")
        )
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/ScoreEstimator.kt (4.1KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

data class ScoreEstimate(
    val estimatedTotal: Int,           // 0-100
    val chapterScores: Map<String, Int>,
    val weakChapters: List<String>,
    val suggestedFocus: List<String>
)

/**
 * 分数估算：
 * 权重 MUST_KNOW ×3 / OFTEN ×2 / UNDERSTAND ×1 / OPTIONAL ×0.5；无考纲信息 → ×1。
 * 总分 = Σ(权重 × recallAccuracy) / Σ(权重) × 100。
 */
class ScoreEstimator {

    fun estimate(
        masteries: List<KnowledgeMastery>,
        points: List<KnowledgePoint>,
        syllabusInfo: Map<String, SyllabusInfo>
    ): ScoreEstimate {
        if (points.isEmpty()) return ScoreEstimate(0, emptyMap(), emptyList(), emptyList())
        val masteryByPoint = masteries.associateBy { it.pointId }
        var totalWeight = 0f
        var totalWeighted = 0f
        val chapterAgg = mutableMapOf<String, Pair<Float, Float>>()

        points.forEach { point ->
            val weight = syllabusInfo[point.id]?.let { levelWeight(it.level) } ?: 1f
            val rate = masteryByPoint[point.id]?.recallAccuracy ?: 0f
            totalWeight += weight
            totalWeighted += weight * rate
            val chapter = point.chapterId.ifBlank { point.sourceVideoId.ifBlank { "未分章" } }
            val (w, wr) = chapterAgg[chapter] ?: (0f to 0f)
            chapterAgg[chapter] = (w + weight) to (wr + weight * rate)
        }

        val total = if (totalWeight <= 0f) 0 else (totalWeighted / totalWeight * 100f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
        val chapterScores = chapterAgg.mapValues { (_, v) ->
            if (v.first <= 0f) 0 else (v.second / v.first * 100f).roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
        }
        val weakChapters = chapterScores.filter { it.value < WEAK_THRESHOLD }
            .entries.sortedBy { it.value }.map { it.key }.take(3)
        val focus = points
            .sortedByDescending { p ->
                val w = syllabusInfo[p.id]?.let { levelWeight(it.level) } ?: 1f
                w * (1f - (masteryByPoint[p.id]?.recallAccuracy ?: 0f))
            }
            .take(3)
            .map { it.name }
        return ScoreEstimate(total, chapterScores, weakChapters, focus)
    }

    companion object {
        const val WEAK_THRESHOLD = 60

        fun levelWeight(level: SyllabusLevel): Float = when (level) {
            SyllabusLevel.MUST_KNOW -> 3f
            SyllabusLevel.OFTEN -> 2f
            SyllabusLevel.UNDERSTAND -> 1f
            SyllabusLevel.OPTIONAL -> 0.5f
        }
    }
}

data class DailyReport(
    val newPointsCount: Int,
    val reviewAccuracy: Float,
    val estimatedScore: Int,
    val todayFocus: List<String>,
    val standardWarning: String?    // 规范答题错误率高时提示
)

/** 每日报告：聚合掌握度 + 估分 + 待复习焦点 + 规范警告。 */
class DailyReportGenerator(private val estimator: ScoreEstimator) {

    fun generate(
        masteries: List<KnowledgeMastery> = emptyList(),
        points: List<KnowledgePoint> = emptyList(),
        syllabusInfo: Map<String, SyllabusInfo> = emptyMap(),
        newPointsCount: Int = 0,
        standardErrorRate: Float = 0f,
        now: Long = currentTimeMillis()
    ): DailyReport {
        val reviewed = masteries.filter { it.reviewCount > 0 }
        val accuracy = if (reviewed.isEmpty()) 0f else reviewed.map { it.recallAccuracy }.average().toFloat()
        val estimate = estimator.estimate(masteries, points, syllabusInfo)
        val due = SpacedRepetitionEngine().getDueCards(masteries, now).take(5)
        val dueNames = due.mapNotNull { m -> points.firstOrNull { it.id == m.pointId }?.name }
        val focus = dueNames.ifEmpty { estimate.suggestedFocus }
        val warning = if (standardErrorRate > 0.5f) {
            "规范答题错误率偏高（${(standardErrorRate * 100).roundToInt()}%），建议先对齐答题模板。"
        } else null
        return DailyReport(newPointsCount, accuracy, estimate.estimatedTotal, focus, warning)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/**
 * 大模型语义重点判定：让 LLM 判断哪些片段是「重点必学」，并给简短理由。
 * 无 LLM / 失败 / 无法解析时，回退到 [KeyKnowledge] 的启发式结果（不丢标签、不联网也能用）。
 */
class SemanticKeyJudge(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    suspend fun judge(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): List<String?> {
        val heuristic = KeyKnowledge.tags(timeline)
        val client = llm ?: return heuristic
        if (timeline.isEmpty()) return heuristic

        val idxs = Evidence.spreadIndices(timeline.size, 300)
        val numbered = Evidence.renderNumbered(timeline, idxs)

        val prompt = buildString {
            append("下面是一门网课的视频证据：每段含【语音(讲师原话)】与【画面(PPT/板书文字)】，")
            append("已按时间顺序从整片均匀采样，编号 [序号] 对应原始时间线位置。\n")
            append("请综合【语音+画面】两项证据，判断哪些是「重点必学」，只依据给定内容，不要编造。\n")
            append("只输出 JSON 数组，元素形如 {\"i\":序号,\"why\":\"理由(≤6字)\"}；非重点不要输出，不要任何多余文字。\n\n")
            append(numbered)
        }

        val raw = runCatching {
            client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig(provider = "nvidia", apiKey = "", baseUrl = "", model = ""))
        }.getOrNull() ?: return heuristic

        val pairs = parse(raw)
        if (pairs.isEmpty()) return heuristic

        val out = heuristic.toMutableList()
        pairs.forEach { (i, why) ->
            if (i in out.indices) out[i] = why.ifBlank { "AI重点" }
        }
        return out
    }

    private fun parse(raw: String): List<Pair<Int, String>> {
        val objects = Regex("\\{[^{}]*\\}")
        val iRe = Regex("\"i\"\\s*:\\s*(\\d+)")
        val wRe = Regex("\"why\"\\s*:\\s*\"([^\"]*)\"")
        return objects.findAll(raw).mapNotNull { m ->
            val s = m.value
            val i = iRe.find(s)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toIntOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val why = wRe.find(s)?.groupValues?.get(1)?.trim() ?: ""
            i to why
        }.toList()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/**
 * 话题之外的"额外提醒/题外话"识别，方便跳着学习。
 * 纯启发式、本地可离线；命中标记为 「题外话·可跳」。
 */
object SideNote {

    private val markers = listOf(
        "题外话", "顺便", "插一句", "扯远", "说个题外", "打个广告", "广告",
        "关注我", "点赞", "投币", "一键三连", "公众号", "微信群", "加群",
        "下课", "休息一下", "下次课", "课后作业", "签到", "考试时间",
        "报名", "优惠", "私信", "别忘", "再见", "拜拜"
    )

    fun tags(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): List<String?> = timeline.map { item ->
        val t = item.speech + " " + item.screenText
        if (markers.any { t.contains(it) }) "题外话·可跳" else null
    }
}

/** 时间段概括工具：按 [from,to]（秒）截取片段。 */
object RangeSlice {
    fun slice(timeline: List<TimelineItem>, from: Double, to: Double): List<TimelineItem> {
        val lo = minOf(from, to)
        val hi = maxOf(from, to)
        return timeline.filter { it.start >= lo - 0.5 && it.start <= hi + 0.5 }
    }

    /** 解析时间：支持 "mm:ss" / "h:mm:ss" / 纯秒数 / "5分30" / "5分30秒" / "90s"；失败返回 null。 */
    fun parseStamp(s: String): Double? {
        var t = s.trim()
            .replace("，", ",")
            .replace(" ", "")
            .replace("秒", "")
            .replace("分", ":")
            .replace("时", ":")
        t = t.trimEnd('s', 'S', 'm', 'h', ':')
        if (t.isEmpty()) return null
        if (t.startsWith(":")) t = "0$t"
        if (t.endsWith(":")) return null
        val parts = t.split(':')
        return when (parts.size) {
            1 -> parts[0].toDoubleOrNull()
            2 -> {
                val m = parts[0].toDoubleOrNull() ?: return null
                val sec = parts[1].toDoubleOrNull() ?: return null
                m * 60 + sec
            }
            3 -> {
                val h = parts[0].toDoubleOrNull() ?: return null
                val m = parts[1].toDoubleOrNull() ?: return null
                val sec = parts[2].toDoubleOrNull() ?: return null
                h * 3600 + m * 60 + sec
            }
            else -> null
        }
    }

    fun fmt(seconds: Double): String {
        val t = seconds.toInt()
        fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
        return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import com.learnagent.data.MasteryStatus
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis

/**
 * SM-2 间隔重复引擎。
 *
 * q: 回忆质量 0-5（0-2 完全忘了 / 3 想起一部分 / 4 想起但有犹豫 / 5 瞬间想起）
 * EF 上限 2.6、下限 1.3（验收：q=5 ×5 收敛到 2.6；q=0 ×5 不低于 1.3）
 */
class SpacedRepetitionEngine {

    fun update(mastery: KnowledgeMastery, q: Int, now: Long = currentTimeMillis()): KnowledgeMastery {
        val quality = q.coerceIn(0, 5)
        // 1. 计算新 EF（含上下限）
        val newEF = (mastery.easeFactor + (0.1f - (5 - quality) * (0.08f + (5 - quality) * 0.02f)))
            .coerceIn(MIN_EF, MAX_EF)

        // 2. 计算新 interval
        val newInterval = when {
            quality < 3 -> 1                       // 答错，明天再来
            mastery.interval == 0 -> 1             // 第一次
            mastery.interval == 1 -> 6             // 第二次
            else -> (mastery.interval * newEF).toInt()
        }

        // 3. 防抖动：同一天内多次复习，只取最后一次 q（reviewCount 不增，更新 EF/interval）
        val lastReviewDay = mastery.lastReviewAt / 86_400_000L
        val today = now / 86_400_000L
        if (lastReviewDay == today && mastery.reviewCount > 0) {
            return mastery.copy(easeFactor = newEF, interval = newInterval)
        }

        return mastery.copy(
            easeFactor = newEF,
            interval = newInterval,
            reviewCount = mastery.reviewCount + 1,
            correctCount = if (quality >= 3) mastery.correctCount + 1 else mastery.correctCount,
            lastReviewAt = now,
            nextReviewAt = now + newInterval * 86_400_000L,
            recallAccuracy = mastery.correctCount.toFloat() / (mastery.reviewCount + 1),
            status = upgradeStatus(mastery, quality)
        )
    }

    private fun upgradeStatus(m: KnowledgeMastery, q: Int): MasteryStatus = when {
        q < 3 -> MasteryStatus.FAMILIAR
        m.correctCount >= 5 && m.interval >= 21 -> MasteryStatus.EXPERT
        m.correctCount >= 3 -> MasteryStatus.MASTERED
        else -> MasteryStatus.LEARNED
    }

    fun getDueCards(all: List<KnowledgeMastery>, now: Long = currentTimeMillis()): List<KnowledgeMastery> =
        all.filter { it.status != MasteryStatus.NOT_LEARNED && it.nextReviewAt in 1..now }
            .sortedBy { it.nextReviewAt }

    companion object {
        const val MIN_EF = 1.3f
        /** EF 上限：对应验收断言「连续 5 次 q=5 → EF ∈ [2.5, 2.7]」与间隔序列 1/6/15/39/101。 */
        const val MAX_EF = 2.6f
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/StandardPracticeEngine.kt (2.5KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.AnswerStandard

data class PracticeResult(
    val question: String,
    val userAnswer: String,
    val standardAnswer: String,
    val highlights: List<Highlight>,
    val suggestions: List<String>
)

data class Highlight(
    val text: String,
    val type: HighlightType,
    val position: IntRange
)

enum class HighlightType { MISSING_REQUIRED, WRONG_ORDER, GOOD, FORBIDDEN }

/** 规范练习：在批改结果上生成高亮（缺失/顺序/命中/禁止）与改进建议。 */
class StandardPracticeEngine(private val teacher: AnswerStandardTeacher) {

    suspend fun evaluate(question: String, standard: AnswerStandard, userAnswer: String): PracticeResult {
        val grading = teacher.gradeWithStandard(standard, userAnswer)
        val highlights = mutableListOf<Highlight>()

        standard.requiredSteps.forEach { step ->
            val pos = teacher.matchPosition(step.content, userAnswer)
            val missing = grading.missingRequired.any { it.order == step.order && it.content == step.content }
            when {
                missing -> highlights.add(Highlight(step.content, HighlightType.MISSING_REQUIRED, 0..0))
                pos >= 0 -> {
                    val cleaned = step.content.filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() }
                    val len = cleaned.length.coerceAtLeast(1)
                    highlights.add(Highlight(step.content, HighlightType.GOOD, pos until (pos + len).coerceAtMost(userAnswer.length)))
                }
            }
        }
        if (!grading.orderCorrect) {
            highlights.add(Highlight("步骤顺序需要调整", HighlightType.WRONG_ORDER, 0..0))
        }
        grading.forbidden.forEach { f ->
            val pos = userAnswer.indexOf(f)
            if (pos >= 0) highlights.add(Highlight(f, HighlightType.FORBIDDEN, pos until (pos + f.length)))
        }

        val suggestions = buildList {
            add(grading.feedback)
            grading.missingRequired.take(3).forEach { add("补上步骤：${it.content}（${it.reason}）") }
            if (!grading.orderCorrect) add("按标准顺序作答：${standard.requiredSteps.joinToString(" → ") { it.content }}")
            if (grading.forbidden.isNotEmpty()) add("去掉禁止内容：${grading.forbidden.joinToString("；")}")
            if (isEmpty()) add("作答规范完整。")
        }
        return PracticeResult(question, userAnswer, standard.standardTemplate, highlights, suggestions)
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/StudyKit.kt (5.1KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem

/** 学习报告统计（跨平台，纯数据）。 */
data class WeeklyStats(
    val videoCount: Int,
    val segmentCount: Int,
    val minutes: Double,
    val topKeywords: List<String>
)

/**
 * 学习工具内容生成（纯逻辑，跨平台）：
 * 闪卡 CSV、Markdown / JSON / CSV 导出、周报 Markdown、概念对比。
 */
object StudyKit {

    fun stamp(seconds: Double): String {
        val t = seconds.toInt()
        fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
        return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
    }

    private fun conceptOf(text: String): String {
        val token = text.split(Regex("[\\s,，。、！？；：\"'`()（）]+"))
            .filter { it.length >= 2 }
            .maxByOrNull { it.length }
        return token ?: text.take(8)
    }

    // ---------- 功能 4：闪卡 ----------

    fun generateFlashcards(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): List<Pair<String, String>> =
        timeline.filter { it.speech.isNotBlank() }.map { item ->
            "视频里讲的「${conceptOf(item.speech)}」是什么？" to item.speech
        }

    fun flashcardsCsv(cards: List<Pair<String, String>>): String {
        fun esc(s: String) = "\"" + s.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\""
        return buildString {
            append("question,answer\n")
            cards.forEach { (q, a) -> append(esc(q)).append(',').append(esc(a)).append('\n') }
        }
    }

    // ---------- 功能 5：学习报告 ----------

    fun weeklyReportMarkdown(stats: WeeklyStats, aiSummary: String? = null): String {
        val summary = aiSummary ?: (
            "本周你处理了 ${stats.videoCount} 个视频、约 " +
                formatMinutes(stats.minutes) + " 分钟内容，主要涉及：" +
                (if (stats.topKeywords.isEmpty()) "暂无" else stats.topKeywords.take(5).joinToString("、")) +
                "。建议优先复习以上高频概念。"
            )
        return buildString {
            append("# LearnAgent 学习周报\n\n")
            append("## 总结\n\n").append(summary).append("\n\n")
            append("## 本周学习统计\n\n")
            append("- 学习视频：").append(stats.videoCount).append(" 个\n")
            append("- 时间线片段：").append(stats.segmentCount).append(" 段\n")
            append("- 覆盖时长：约 ").append(formatMinutes(stats.minutes)).append(" 分钟\n")
            append("- 高频概念：").append(if (stats.topKeywords.isEmpty()) "（暂无）" else stats.topKeywords.joinToString("、")).append("\n")
        }
    }

    fun computeStats(timelines: Map<String, List<TimelineItem>>): WeeklyStats {
        var segments = 0
        var seconds = 0.0
        val keywordCount = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
        timelines.values.forEach { items ->
            segments += items.size
            seconds += items.sumOf { (it.end - it.start).coerceAtLeast(0.0) }
            items.forEach { item ->
                GraphBuilder.keywordsOf(item.speech + " " + item.screenText)
                    .forEach { keywordCount[it] = (keywordCount[it] ?: 0) + 1 }
            }
        }
        val top = keywordCount.entries.sortedByDescending { it.value }.take(8).map { it.key }
        return WeeklyStats(timelines.size, segments, seconds / 60.0, top)
    }

    private fun formatMinutes(minutes: Double): String {
        val whole = minutes.toInt()
        val frac = ((minutes - whole) * 10).toInt()
        return "$whole.$frac"
    }

    // ---------- 功能 7：概念对比 ----------

    fun compareMarkdown(x: String, y: String, xs: List<TimelineItem>, ys: List<TimelineItem>): String {
        fun block(items: List<TimelineItem>): String =
            if (items.isEmpty()) "- （未找到相关内容）"
            else items.joinToString("\n") { "- [${stamp(it.start)}] ${it.speech.ifBlank { it.screenText }}" }

        return buildString {
            append("### ").append(x).append("\n").append(block(xs)).append("\n\n")
            append("### ").append(y).append("\n").append(block(ys)).append("\n\n")
            append("| 维度 | ").append(x).append(" | ").append(y).append(" |\n")
            append("|---|---|---|\n")
            append("| 命中片段 | ").append(xs.size).append(" | ").append(ys.size).append(" |\n")
            append("| 说明 | 见上方时间戳 | 见上方时间戳 |\n")
        }
    }

    // ---------- 功能 12：知识导出 ----------

    fun toMarkdown(videoId: String, timeline: List<TimelineItem>): String = buildString {
        append("# ").append(videoId).append("\n\n")
        timeline.forEach { item ->
            append("## [").append(stamp(item.start)).append(" - ").append(stamp(item.end)).append("]\n\n")
            if (item.speech.isNotBlank()) append("- 语音：").append(item.speech).append('\n')
            if (item.screenText.isNotBlank()) append("- 画面：").append(item.screenText).append('\n')
            if (item.framePath.isNotBlank()) append("- 关键帧：").append(item.framePath).append('\n')
            append('\n')
        }
    }

    fun toCsv(timeline: List<TimelineItem>): String =
        flashcardsCsv(generateFlashcards(timeline))
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

/** 考纲等级（Study Mode 本地枚举，与 data.ExamLevel 同名值但独立）。 */
enum class SyllabusLevel { MUST_KNOW, OFTEN, UNDERSTAND, OPTIONAL }

data class SyllabusInfo(
    val pointId: String,
    val level: SyllabusLevel,
    val estimatedWeight: Float,            // 0.0-1.0，预估考试占比
    val commonQuestionTypes: List<String>  // ["单选", "简答", "计算"]
)

/**
 * 考纲对齐：LLM 判断等级/权重/常见题型；
 * LLM 不可用 → 全部 OFTEN / 0.05；无法确定 → UNDERSTAND。
 */
class SyllabusAligner(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun align(point: KnowledgePoint, unit: LearningUnit): SyllabusInfo {
        if (llm == null) return fallback(point)
        return try {
            parse(point, callLlm(point, unit))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            fallback(point)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun callLlm(point: KnowledgePoint, unit: LearningUnit): String {
        val client = llm ?: return ""
        val prompt = """
知识点：${point.name}
定义：${point.definition}
来源：${point.sourceVideoId} ${point.sourceTimestamp}

判断考纲等级：
- MUST_KNOW：近 5 年出现 3+ 次
- OFTEN：出现 1-2 次
- UNDERSTAND：了解即可
- OPTIONAL：选学

输出 JSON：
{
  "level": "MUST_KNOW",
  "estimatedWeight": 0.15,
  "commonQuestionTypes": ["单选", "简答"]
}
""".trimIndent()
        return client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
    }

    private fun parse(point: KnowledgePoint, raw: String): SyllabusInfo {
        val s = raw.indexOf('{')
        val e = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (s < 0 || e <= s) throw IllegalArgumentException("无 JSON")
        val o = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(s, e + 1)).jsonObject
        fun str(key: String, def: String = ""): String = (o[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: def
        val levelRaw = str("level")
        val level = if (levelRaw.isBlank()) SyllabusLevel.UNDERSTAND
        else runCatching { SyllabusLevel.valueOf(levelRaw.uppercase()) }.getOrDefault(SyllabusLevel.UNDERSTAND)
        val weight = str("estimatedWeight").toFloatOrNull()?.coerceIn(0f, 1f) ?: 0.05f
        val types = (o["commonQuestionTypes"] as? JsonArray)
            ?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull }
            ?.filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?: emptyList()
        return SyllabusInfo(point.id, level, weight, types.ifEmpty { listOf("单选", "简答") })
    }

    private fun fallback(point: KnowledgePoint) =
        SyllabusInfo(point.id, SyllabusLevel.OFTEN, 0.05f, listOf("单选", "简答"))
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/TechCardExtractor.kt (8.1KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechCategory
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.contentOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

/** LLM 超时（由 LlmClient 实现抛出）；提取器捕获后降级本地启发式，不崩溃。 */
class LlmTimeoutException(message: String = "LLM timeout") : Exception(message)

/**
 * 技术卡提取器。
 * 有 LLM → 调 LLM 解析 JSON；无 LLM / 非法 JSON / 超时 / 任何异常 → 本地启发式降级。
 * 单次最多 3 张卡。
 */
class TechCardExtractor(private val llm: LlmClient?) {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    suspend fun extract(unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String): List<TechCard> {
        if (llm == null) return extractWithHeuristic(unit, videoId)
        return try {
            val cards = extractWithLlm(unit, videoId)
            if (cards.isEmpty()) extractWithHeuristic(unit, videoId) else cards
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            extractWithHeuristic(unit, videoId)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun extractWithLlm(unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String): List<TechCard> {
        val client = llm ?: return extractWithHeuristic(unit, videoId)
        val prompt = """
从以下技术内容中，提取技术卡。

内容：${unit.speech}
画面：${unit.screenText}

对每个技术点，填写 JSON：
{
  "name": "ZooKeeper",
  "category": "DISTRIBUTED",
  "whatItIs": "分布式协调服务",
  "whatItSolves": "分布式锁、选主、配置管理",
  "whenToUse": "需要强一致性、QPS > 5000",
  "whenNotToUse": "不需要强一致性的简单场景",
  "howItWorks": "基于 ZAB 协议，通过 ZNode 树和 Watch 实现",
  "alternatives": ["etcd", "Consul"],
  "relatedConcepts": ["CAP", "Raft", "Paxos"],
  "codeSnippet": ""
}

规则：
- whatItIs 不超过 15 字
- whatItSolves 列 2-3 个核心场景
- howItWorks 只讲大概，不要展开
- 一次最多提取 3 个技术点
- 只输出 JSON 数组（0-3 个对象），不要解释
""".trimIndent()
        val raw = client.generateResponse(prompt, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", ""))
        return parseCards(raw, unit, videoId)
    }

    /** 解析 LLM 返回；无法解析时抛异常，由 [extract] 降级。 */
    private fun parseCards(raw: String, unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String): List<TechCard> {
        val arrStart = raw.indexOf('[')
        val arrEnd = raw.lastIndexOf(']')
        if (arrStart >= 0 && arrEnd > arrStart) {
            val arr = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(arrStart, arrEnd + 1)).jsonArray
            return arr.mapIndexedNotNull { i, el ->
                (el as? JsonObject)?.toTechCard(unit, videoId, i, source = "LLM")
            }.take(3)
        }
        // 容错：LLM 只返回单个对象
        val objStart = raw.indexOf('{')
        val objEnd = raw.lastIndexOf('}')
        if (objStart >= 0 && objEnd > objStart) {
            val obj = json.parseToJsonElement(raw.substring(objStart, objEnd + 1)).jsonObject
            return listOfNotNull(obj.toTechCard(unit, videoId, 0, source = "LLM"))
        }
        throw IllegalArgumentException("LLM 未返回有效 JSON")
    }

    private fun JsonObject.toTechCard(unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String, index: Int, source: String): TechCard? {
        fun str(key: String, default: String = ""): String =
            (this[key] as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull ?: default

        fun list(key: String): List<String> =
            (this[key] as? JsonArray)?.mapNotNull { (it as? JsonPrimitive)?.contentOrNull } ?: emptyList()

        val name = str("name").trim()
        if (name.isBlank()) return null
        return TechCard(
            id = cardId(videoId, unit, name, index),
            name = name,
            category = runCatching { TechCategory.valueOf(str("category", "OTHER").uppercase()) }
                .getOrDefault(TechCategory.OTHER),
            whatItIs = str("whatItIs").take(30),
            whatItSolves = str("whatItSolves"),
            whenToUse = str("whenToUse"),
            whenNotToUse = str("whenNotToUse"),
            howItWorks = str("howItWorks"),
            alternatives = list("alternatives"),
            relatedConcepts = list("relatedConcepts"),
            codeSnippet = str("codeSnippet"),
            sourceVideoId = videoId,
            sourceTimestamp = unit.start,
            source = source
        )
    }

    // ---------- 本地启发式降级 ----------

    private fun extractWithHeuristic(unit: LearningUnit, videoId: String): List<TechCard> {
        val text = (unit.speech + " " + unit.screenText + " " + unit.keywords.joinToString(" ")).trim()
        if (text.isBlank()) return emptyList()

        val names = LinkedHashSet<String>()
        PROPER_NOUN.findAll(text).forEach { m -> names.add(m.value) }
        KEYWORD_TECH.forEach { (kw, canonical) -> if (text.contains(kw)) names.add(canonical) }
        if (names.isEmpty()) names.add(text.take(12))

        return names.take(3).mapIndexed { i, name ->
            TechCard(
                id = cardId(videoId, unit, name, i),
                name = name,
                category = classify(text),
                whatItIs = text.take(15),
                whatItSolves = unit.oneLineSummary.ifBlank { text.take(30) },
                whenToUse = unit.whenToUse,
                whenNotToUse = "",
                howItWorks = unit.intuition,
                relatedConcepts = unit.keywords.take(5),
                sourceVideoId = videoId,
                sourceTimestamp = unit.start,
                source = "本地启发式"
            )
        }
    }

    private fun classify(text: String): TechCategory {
        val t = text.lowercase()
        return when {
            listOf("锁", "线程", "并发", "死锁", "async", "coroutine").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.CONCURRENCY
            listOf("分布式", "选主", "一致性", "raft", "paxos", "zookeeper", "etcd").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.DISTRIBUTED
            listOf("数据库", "索引", "事务", "sql", "mysql", "redis").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.DATABASE
            listOf("网络", "tcp", "http", "udp", "socket", "rpc").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.NETWORK
            listOf("安全", "加密", "认证", "token", "https").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.SECURITY
            listOf("性能", "优化", "缓存", "qps", "延迟").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.PERFORMANCE
            listOf("架构", "设计模式", "分层", "领域驱动").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.ARCHITECTURE
            listOf("算法", "排序", "复杂度", "动态规划").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.ALGORITHM
            listOf("框架", "spring", "react", "vue", "ktor").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.FRAMEWORK
            listOf("工具", "git", "docker", "gradle", "maven").any { t.contains(it) } -> TechCategory.TOOL
            else -> TechCategory.OTHER
        }
    }

    private fun cardId(videoId: String, unit: LearningUnit, name: String, index: Int): String =
        "${videoId}_${unit.start.toInt()}_${index}_${name.lowercase().hashCode()}"

    private companion object {
        /** 英文/大写开头专有名词，如 ZooKeeper / JVM / TCP。 */
        val PROPER_NOUN = Regex("\\b[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9+#._-]{1,}\\b")

        /** 中文技术关键词 → 规范技术名。 */
        val KEYWORD_TECH = linkedMapOf(
            "分布式" to "分布式系统",
            "一致性" to "一致性协议",
            "选主" to "选主",
            "分布式锁" to "分布式锁",
            "微服务" to "微服务",
            "缓存" to "缓存",
            "消息队列" to "消息队列",
            "数据库" to "数据库",
            "索引" to "索引",
            "事务" to "事务",
            "容器" to "容器化",
            "网关" to "API 网关"
        )
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.Decision
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis

/**
 * 决策服务：记录决策 + 回访。
 * 记录后同步使用痕迹：相关技术 decisionCount+1、usedCount+2。
 */
object TechDecisionService {

    const val MS_PER_DAY = 86_400_000L

    fun record(
        store: TechStore,
        problem: String,
        chosen: String,
        reason: String,
        options: List<String> = emptyList(),
        constraints: List<String> = emptyList(),
        followUpDays: Int = 7,
        now: Long = currentTimeMillis()
    ): Decision {
        val decision = Decision(
            id = "dec_" + now.toString(16),
            problem = problem,
            options = options,
            chosen = chosen,
            reason = reason,
            constraints = constraints,
            createdAt = now,
            followUpAt = now + followUpDays.coerceIn(1, 90) * MS_PER_DAY
        )
        store.saveDecision(decision)
        val tracker = TechUsageTracker(store) { now }
        tracker.onDecisionRecorded(techNamesIn(problem + " " + chosen, store))
        return decision
    }

    fun dueFollowUps(store: TechStore, now: Long = currentTimeMillis()): List<Decision> =
        store.getAllDecisions().filter { !it.followUpDone && it.followUpAt in 1..now }

    fun saveFollowUp(
        store: TechStore,
        decision: Decision,
        result: String,
        resultGood: Boolean?,
        now: Long = currentTimeMillis()
    ) {
        store.saveDecision(decision.copy(result = result, resultGood = resultGood, followUpDone = true, followUpAt = now))
    }

    /** 文本中出现的已知技术（TechCard 名 + TechUsage 名）。 */
    fun techNamesIn(text: String, store: TechStore): List<String> {
        if (text.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val known = (store.getAllTechCards().map { it.name } + store.getAllTechUsage().map { it.techName })
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            .distinct()
        return known.filter { text.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TechStatus
import com.learnagent.data.TechUsage
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis

/**
 * 使用痕迹状态机。
 *
 * 触发：打开 TechCard → seen+1；搜索点击 → used+1；
 * 记录 Decision → decisionCount+1 / usedCount+2；完成 Project → used+3（接口预留）。
 *
 * 升级（单向只升不降）：
 * DISCOVERED(seen≥1) → FAMILIAR(seen≥3 或 used≥1) → USED(used≥3) → FLUENT(used≥5) → EXPERT(used≥10)
 *
 * 防抖：同一技术 1 小时内重复 seen 只算 1 次。
 */
class TechUsageTracker(
    private val techStore: TechStore,
    private val now: () -> Long = { currentTimeMillis() }
) {

    fun onTechCardOpened(techName: String) = mutate(techName) { u, t ->
        if (t - u.lastSeenAt >= SEEN_DEDUPE_MS) u.copy(seenCount = u.seenCount + 1, lastSeenAt = t) else u
    }

    fun onTechCardUsed(techName: String) = mutate(techName) { u, t ->
        u.copy(usedCount = u.usedCount + 1, lastSeenAt = t)
    }

    fun onDecisionRecorded(techNames: List<String>) {
        techNames.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.forEach { name ->
            mutate(name) { u, t -> u.copy(decisionCount = u.decisionCount + 1, usedCount = u.usedCount + 2, lastSeenAt = t) }
        }
    }

    /** 完成 Project（预留接口，UI 尚未接入）。 */
    fun onProjectCompleted(techNames: List<String>) {
        techNames.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.forEach { name ->
            mutate(name) { u, t -> u.copy(usedCount = u.usedCount + 3, lastSeenAt = t) }
        }
    }

    fun statusOf(usage: TechUsage): TechStatus = when {
        usage.usedCount >= 10 -> TechStatus.EXPERT
        usage.usedCount >= 5 -> TechStatus.FLUENT
        usage.usedCount >= 3 -> TechStatus.USED
        usage.seenCount >= 3 || usage.usedCount >= 1 -> TechStatus.FAMILIAR
        else -> TechStatus.DISCOVERED
    }

    private fun mutate(name: String, f: (TechUsage, Long) -> TechUsage) {
        val t = now()
        val existing = techStore.getAllTechUsage().firstOrNull { it.techName == name }
        // 新建记录 lastSeenAt=0，保证首次 seen 一定计数（1h 去重只约束后续重复）
        val base = existing ?: TechUsage(techName = name, firstSeenAt = t, lastSeenAt = 0L)
        val updated = f(base, t)
        val candidate = statusOf(updated)
        val finalStatus = if (candidate.ordinal > updated.status.ordinal) candidate else updated.status
        techStore.saveTechUsage(updated.copy(status = finalStatus))
    }

    companion object {
        const val SEEN_DEDUPE_MS = 3_600_000L
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

/** 文本质量过滤：剔除 OCR 乱码/残影与 ASR 幻觉（在送入大模型前拦截）。 */
object TextQuality {

    /** OCR 乱码判定：有效字符过少、纯符号、重复字符连发、英文乱码（如 TRACE、t.tt記TTT）。 */
    fun isGarbageOcr(s: String): Boolean {
        val t = s.trim()
        if (t.length < 3) return true
        val cjk = t.count { it.code in 0x4E00..0x9FFF }
        if (cjk > 0) {
            if (cjk < 3) return true // 少于 3 个中文字符
            return Regex("(.)\\1{3,}").containsMatchIn(t) // TTTT/OOOO 连发
        }
        // 无中文：至少 2 个 ≥3 字母的单词，且字母占比 ≥60%，否则视为乱码
        val words = Regex("[A-Za-z]{3,}").findAll(t).count()
        if (words < 2) return true
        val letters = t.count { it.isLetter() }
        if (letters < t.length * 6 / 10) return true
        return Regex("(.)\\1{3,}").containsMatchIn(t)
    }

    /** ASR 幻觉判定：如 "my when when when"、整句高度重复、超短噪声。 */
    fun isHallucinatedAsr(s: String): Boolean {
        val t = s.trim()
        if (t.length < 2) return true
        val words = t.split(Regex("[\\s,，。！？;；]+")).filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (words.size >= 3 && words.toSet().size <= 2) return true // my when when when
        if (Regex("(\\S+)(\\s+\\1\\b){2,}").containsMatchIn(t)) return true // 同词连发≥3
        if (Regex("(.)\\1{5,}").containsMatchIn(t)) return true // 同字符连发≥6
        val u = t.replace(Regex("\\s"), "")
        if (u.length >= 8 && u.toSet().size <= 3) return true // 高度重复
        return false
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** 纠错后的一段：带出处处（时间戳）、最终文本、置信度、备选。 */
@Serializable
data class PolishedSegment(
    val index: Int,
    val start: Double,
    val end: Double,
    val original: String,
    val final: String,
    val confidence: Float,
    val alternatives: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val source: String = "三模型共识"
)

@Serializable
data class PolishedTranscript(
    val videoId: String,
    val models: List<String>,
    val segments: List<PolishedSegment>
)

/**
 * 转写纠错（去错别字 / 去 ASR 幻觉），三模型共识：
 *  - 每段让每个模型只做"修正"（改错别字、补明显漏字、删无意义插入），**禁止添加原文没有的信息**
 *  - 三模型一致 → 高置信；两票一致 → 中置信；全不一致 → 低置信并保留原始文本 + 备选
 *  - 每段保留 start/end（出处时间戳）
 */
class TranscriptPolisher(
    seats: List<Pair<String, LlmClient?>>,
    private val timeoutMs: Long = 120_000,
    private val retries: Int = 1
) {
    private val seats = seats.filter { it.second != null }

    suspend fun polish(
        videoId: String,
        segments: List<TranscriptSegment>,
        onProgress: (Int, Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }
    ): PolishedTranscript {
        val out = ArrayList<PolishedSegment>(segments.size)
        segments.forEachIndexed { i, seg ->
            onProgress(i, segments.size)
            val original = seg.text.trim()
            val variants = LinkedHashMap<String, String>() // model -> corrected
            seats.forEach { (label, llm) ->
                val r = call(llm!!, prompt(original))
                if (!r.isNullOrBlank()) variants[label] = r.lines().first().trim()
            }
            out += decide(i, seg, original, variants)
        }
        onProgress(segments.size, segments.size)
        return PolishedTranscript(videoId, seats.map { it.first }, out)
    }

    private fun decide(index: Int, seg: TranscriptSegment, original: String, variants: Map<String, String>): PolishedSegment {
        if (variants.isEmpty()) {
            return PolishedSegment(index, seg.start, seg.end, original, original, 0.2f, emptyList(), "无模型可用（原样保留）")
        }
        val groups = variants.values.groupingBy { norm(it) }.eachCount().entries.sortedByDescending { it.value }
        val top = groups.first()
        val topText = variants.values.first { norm(it) == top.key }
        return when {
            groups.size == 1 && variants.size >= 3 ->
                PolishedSegment(index, seg.start, seg.end, original, topText, 1.0f, emptyList())
            top.value >= 2 ->
                PolishedSegment(index, seg.start, seg.end, original, topText, 0.7f, variants.values.filter { norm(it) != top.key })
            else ->
                PolishedSegment(index, seg.start, seg.end, original, original, 0.3f, variants.values.toList(), "有分歧（保留原文）")
        }
    }

    private suspend fun call(llm: LlmClient, p: String): String? {
        repeat(retries + 1) {
            val r = withTimeoutOrNull(timeoutMs) {
                runCatching { llm.generateResponse(p, LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", "")) }.getOrNull()
            }
            if (!r.isNullOrBlank()) return r
            delay(300)
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun prompt(text: String) = """
这是视频语音转写的一句话，可能有同音错别字、漏字、或多出的无意义字（ASR 幻觉）。
请**只做修正**：改错别字、补明显漏字、删除明显无意义的插入。
**严禁添加原句没有的信息，严禁改写表达方式或措辞风格**。只输出修正后的一句话本身。

原句：$text
""".trimIndent()

    private fun norm(s: String) = s.replace(Regex("[\\s，。、；：,.!?！？;:\"'（）()]+"), "").lowercase()

    /** 生成带出处的 Markdown。 */
    fun markdown(r: PolishedTranscript): String {
        fun ts(sec: Double): String {
            val t = sec.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0); fun two(v: Int) = if (v < 10) "0$v" else "$v"
            return two(t / 60) + ":" + two(t % 60)
        }
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        sb.append("# 转写纠错（三模型共识）：").append(r.videoId).append("\n\n")
        sb.append("模型：").append(r.models.joinToString(" / ")).append("\n\n")
        r.segments.forEach { s ->
            sb.append("[").append(ts(s.start)).append(" - ").append(ts(s.end)).append("] ")
            sb.append("（置信 ").append((s.confidence * 100).toInt()).append("%")
            if (s.source.isNotBlank() && s.source != "三模型共识") sb.append(" · ").append(s.source)
            sb.append("）\n")
            sb.append(s.final).append("\n")
            if (s.final != s.original) sb.append("原文：").append(s.original).append("\n")
            if (s.alternatives.isNotEmpty()) sb.append("备选：").append(s.alternatives.joinToString(" ｜ ")).append("\n")
            sb.append("\n")
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment

/**
 * 单元融合：merge(transcript, frames) → TimelineItem → ContextAnalyzer → LearningUnit，
 * 并补充 visualDescription。
 */
class UnitFusion(
    private val analyzer: ContextAnalyzer = ContextAnalyzer(),
    private val visual: VisualAnalyzer = VisualAnalyzer()
) {

    suspend fun fuse(
        transcript: List<TranscriptSegment>,
        frames: List<FrameOcr>,
        videoId: String
    ): List<LearningUnit> {
        val timeline = merge(transcript, frames)
        val units = analyzer.analyze(timeline, videoId)
        return units.map { unit ->
            if (unit.screenText.isNotBlank() || unit.framePath.isNotBlank()) {
                unit.copy(visualDescription = visual.describe(unit.framePath, unit.screenText))
            } else {
                unit
            }
        }
    }
}
shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/VisualAnalyzer.kt (0.7KB)
package com.learnagent.core

/**
 * 画面分析：有 LLM → 生成场景描述；无 LLM → 直接返回 OCR 文字。
 */
class VisualAnalyzer(private val llm: LlmClient? = null) {

    suspend fun describe(framePath: String, ocrText: String): String {
        val client = llm ?: return ocrText
        if (ocrText.isBlank() && framePath.isBlank()) return ""
        return try {
            client.generateResponse(
                "用一句中文描述这个视频画面（已有 OCR 文字可参考，不要编造）：$ocrText",
                LlmConfig("nvidia", "", "", "")
            ).trim().ifBlank { ocrText }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            ocrText
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechUsage
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis

/** 周报数据聚合结果（打开应用时生成，不是推送）。 */
data class WeeklyReport(
    val weekStart: Long,
    val weekEnd: Long,
    val newTechsCount: Int,          // 本周新增的 DISCOVERED
    val activeUseCount: Int,         // 本周 usedCount 增加的总和（近似：本周活跃技术的当前 usedCount 之和）
    val newDecisionsCount: Int,      // 本周新增的 Decision
    val strongDomains: List<String>, // usedCount >= 3 的类别
    val weakDomains: List<String>,   // seenCount >= 3 但 usedCount = 0 的类别
    val focusTech: String?,          // 本周 usedCount 增长最多的（近似：本周活跃且 usedCount 最大）
    val suggestion: String
)

/**
 * 周报生成器（每周日 00:00 起的新一周，打开时按需生成）。
 * 周起点按 UTC 近似（commonMain 无时区 API）；已读状态存 TechStore.meta。
 */
class WeeklyReportGenerator(
    private val techStore: TechStore,
    private val nowMillis: Long = currentTimeMillis()
) {

    fun generate(): WeeklyReport {
        val start = weekStart(nowMillis)
        val end = start + MS_PER_WEEK
        val inWeek: (Long) -> Boolean = { it in start until end }

        val usages = techStore.getAllTechUsage()
        val decisions = techStore.getAllDecisions()
        val cards = techStore.getAllTechCards()

        val newTechsCount = usages.count { inWeek(it.firstSeenAt) }
        val weekActive = usages.filter { inWeek(it.lastSeenAt) }
        val activeUseCount = weekActive.sumOf { it.usedCount }
        val newDecisionsCount = decisions.count { inWeek(it.createdAt) }

        val nameToCategory: (String) -> String = { name ->
            cards.firstOrNull { it.name.equals(name, ignoreCase = true) }?.category?.name ?: "OTHER"
        }
        val strongDomains = usages.filter { it.usedCount >= 3 }.map { nameToCategory(it.techName) }.distinct()
        val weakDomains = usages.filter { it.seenCount >= 3 && it.usedCount == 0 }
            .map { nameToCategory(it.techName) }.distinct()

        val focusTech = weekActive.maxByOrNull { it.usedCount }?.techName
            ?: usages.maxByOrNull { it.usedCount }?.techName

        val suggestion = buildString {
            append(if (focusTech != null) "本周最活跃：$focusTech。" else "本周暂无使用痕迹。")
            if (strongDomains.isNotEmpty()) append("强项领域：${strongDomains.joinToString("/")}。")
            if (weakDomains.isNotEmpty()) append("「见过但没用过」：${weakDomains.joinToString("/")}，建议写一个最小实现练手。")
            if (newDecisionsCount > 0) append("本周记录了 $newDecisionsCount 个决策。")
        }

        return WeeklyReport(
            weekStart = start,
            weekEnd = end,
            newTechsCount = newTechsCount,
            activeUseCount = activeUseCount,
            newDecisionsCount = newDecisionsCount,
            strongDomains = strongDomains,
            weakDomains = weakDomains,
            focusTech = focusTech,
            suggestion = suggestion
        )
    }

    fun isUnread(): Boolean = techStore.getMeta(META_KEY) != weekKey(nowMillis)

    fun markRead() = techStore.saveMeta(META_KEY, weekKey(nowMillis))

    companion object {
        const val MS_PER_WEEK = 7 * 86_400_000L
        private const val META_KEY = "weekly_report_seen"

        /** 周日 00:00（UTC 近似）。 */
        fun weekStart(now: Long): Long {
            val day = now.floorDiv(86_400_000L)
            val offset = ((day - 3) % 7 + 7) % 7   // 1970-01-01 是周四，+3 对齐周日
            return (day - offset) * 86_400_000L
        }

        fun weekKey(now: Long): String = "w" + (weekStart(now) / 86_400_000L)
    }
}

    /**
     * 写入JSON文件
     * 
     * @param path 文件路径

    fun writeJson(path: String, content: String)
    
    /**
     * 读取JSON文件

    /**

    fun listVideoIds(): List<String>
    
    /**

    /**
     * 检查文件是否存在
     * 
     * @param path 文件路径
     * @return 文件是否存在
     */
    fun fileExists(path: String): Boolean
    
    /**
     * 删除文件
     * 
     * @param path 文件路径
     */
    fun deleteFile(path: String)
}

 * JSON配置对象

import kotlinx.serialization.SerialName
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * 技术使用记录：记录"反复遇见"，不做复习调度。
 * seenCount = 在视频/文档中遇见次数；usedCount = 实际使用次数；decisionCount = 相关决策数。
 */
@Serializable
data class TechUsage(
    @SerialName("techName") val techName: String,
    @SerialName("firstSeenAt") val firstSeenAt: Long,
    @SerialName("lastSeenAt") val lastSeenAt: Long,
    @SerialName("seenCount") val seenCount: Int = 0,
    @SerialName("usedCount") val usedCount: Int = 0,
    @SerialName("decisionCount") val decisionCount: Int = 0,
    @SerialName("status") val status: TechStatus = TechStatus.DISCOVERED
)

@Serializable
enum class TechStatus {
    DISCOVERED, FAMILIAR, USED, FLUENT, EXPERT
}

package com.learnagent.design

import kotlin.math.pow

/**
 * 对比度审计（三端共用纯函数）：WCAG 相对亮度对比度。
 * 前景色与背景色的 ARGB Long → 比率。
 */
object ContrastCheck {

    /** 相对亮度（WCAG 公式）。 */
    fun relativeLuminance(argb: Long): Double {
        val r = ((argb shr 16) and 0xFF) / 255.0
        val g = ((argb shr 8) and 0xFF) / 255.0
        val b = (argb and 0xFF) / 255.0
        fun linear(c: Double): Double = if (c <= 0.03928) c / 12.92 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055).pow(2.4)
        return 0.2126 * linear(r) + 0.7152 * linear(g) + 0.0722 * linear(b)
    }

    /** WCAG 对比度（1~21）。 */
    fun contrast(fg: Long, bg: Long): Double {
        val l1 = relativeLuminance(fg)
        val l2 = relativeLuminance(bg)
        val hi = maxOf(l1, l2)
        val lo = minOf(l1, l2)
        return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05)
    }
}

shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/platform/PlatformImpl.kt (0.8KB)
package com.learnagent.platform

/**
 * Platform implementation base class
 * 
 * Provides common functionality for platform implementations
 */
abstract class PlatformImpl : Platform {
    
    override fun supportsFeature(feature: String): Boolean {
        return getSupportedFeatures().contains(feature)
    }
    
    /**
     * Get list of supported features for this platform
     */
    protected abstract fun getSupportedFeatures(): Set<String>
    
    /**
     * Validate platform capabilities
     */
    fun validateCapabilities(): Boolean {
        return getRequiredFeatures().all { supportsFeature(it) }
    }
    
    /**
     * Get required features for the application
     */
    protected open fun getRequiredFeatures(): Set<String> {
        return setOf("audio_processing", "file_io", "network")
    }
}

package com.learnagent.sync

import com.learnagent.data.VideoMeta

/**
 * Synchronization protocol interface
 * 
 * Defines the contract for data synchronization between devices
 */
interface SyncProtocol {
    
    /**
     * Initialize the sync protocol
     */
    suspend fun initialize()
    
    /**
     * Register a video for synchronization
     */
    suspend fun registerVideo(video: VideoMeta): SyncResult
    
    /**
     * Sync video data with remote
     */
    suspend fun syncVideo(videoId: String): SyncResult
    
    /**
     * Get sync status for a specific video
     */
    suspend fun getSyncStatus(videoId: String): SyncStatus
    
    /**
     * Get all videos that need synchronization
     */
    suspend fun getPendingSyncVideos(): List<VideoMeta>
    
    /**
     * Cancel ongoing sync operation
     */
    suspend fun cancelSync(videoId: String): Boolean
    
    /**
     * Clean up sync data
     */
    suspend fun cleanup(): Boolean
}

package com.learnagent.sync

/**
 * Synchronization status enumeration
 * 
 * Represents the current state of synchronization operations
 */
enum class SyncStatus {
    /**
     * Synchronization is idle, not running
     */
    IDLE,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization is in progress
     */
    SYNCING,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization completed successfully
     */
    SUCCESS,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization failed with an error
     */
    ERROR,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization detected conflicts that need resolution
     */
    CONFLICT,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization is queued and waiting to start
     */
    QUEUED,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization was cancelled by user
     */
    CANCELLED,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization is waiting for network connectivity
     */
    WAITING_FOR_NETWORK,
    
    /**
     * Synchronization is waiting for storage space
     */
    WAITING_FOR_STORAGE
}

/**
 * Extended sync status with additional information
 */
data class SyncStatusInfo(
    val status: SyncStatus,
    val progress: Float = 0f,
    val message: String = "",
    val lastSyncTime: Long = 0L,
    val retryCount: Int = 0,
    val estimatedTimeRemaining: Long = 0L
)

package com.learnagent.ui

/** 自适应断点（dp）：手机 / 紧凑平板 / 全尺寸平板。 */
object LayoutBreakpoints {
    const val PHONE_MAX = 600
    const val TABLET_COMPACT_MAX = 900

    fun forWidth(dp: Int): LayoutMode = when {

}

package com.learnagent.ui

import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.sin

/**
 * 3D 轨道运动词汇（三端共享，Splash 三圆环与两端的背景轨道/游走光灵共用，视觉同源）。
 * 纯 Kotlin 数学，无 Compose / 平台依赖（shared 的 android 目标限制）。
 *
 * 设计目标：灵活、聪慧、不可测——
 *  - 多层正弦叠加伪噪声（无外部依赖）
 *  - 每个节点相位 / 频率 / 振幅 / 倾角全不同 → 永不同步
 *  - 时间本身带快慢起伏（easedTime）→ 永不匀速
 *  - 轨道叠加噪声扰动 → 永非正圆
 */
object OrbitMotion {

    /** Splash 轨道场边长（dp）。 */
    const val SPLASH_FIELD = 380

    /** Splash 场内归一化 → 像素缩放（x / y）。 */
    const val SPLASH_SCALE_X = 0.18f
    const val SPLASH_SCALE_Y = 0.16f

    /** 一维分层正弦伪噪声，输出约 [-1,1]，平滑但非严格周期。 */
    fun noise(x: Float): Float =
        sin(x * 1.7f) * 0.50f +
            sin(x * 2.31f + 1.7f) * 0.32f +
            sin(x * 0.73f + 3.1f) * 0.18f

    /** 非匀速时间：自带快慢节律（呼吸式时间流）。 */
    fun easedTime(t: Float): Float = t + 0.9f * sin(t * 0.23f)

    data class Orbit(
        val phase: Float,
        val freqX: Float,
        val freqY: Float,
        val freqZ: Float,
        val ax: Float,
        val ay: Float,
        val az: Float,
        val tilt: Float
    )

    /** 三条互不相干的轨道参数（相位 2.1 错开；频率与振幅逐节点递变）。 */
    val ORBITS: List<Orbit> = List(3) { i ->
        Orbit(
            phase = i * 2.1f,
            freqX = 0.37f + i * 0.09f,
            freqY = 0.53f + i * 0.11f,
            freqZ = 0.71f + i * 0.07f,
            ax = 1.00f + i * 0.25f,
            ay = 0.68f + i * 0.15f,
            az = 1.50f + i * 0.31f,
            tilt = ((15.0 + i * 10.0) * PI / 180.0).toFloat()
        )
    }

    /**
     * 不规则 3D 轨道位置（归一化输出，相对轨道中心）。
     * out[0]=x, out[1]=y, out[2]=z（z 为伪深度）。
     */
    fun position(i: Int, t: Float, out: FloatArray) {
        val o = ORBITS[i]
        val et = easedTime(t)
        var x = o.ax * sin(et * o.freqX + o.phase) * cos(o.tilt)
        var y = o.ay * cos(et * o.freqY + o.phase * 0.7f)
        var z = o.az * sin(et * o.freqZ + o.phase * 1.3f)
        x += noise(et * 0.5f + i) * 0.15f
        y += noise(et * 0.7f + i * 2f) * 0.15f
        z += noise(et * 0.9f + i * 3f) * 0.10f
        out[0] = x
        out[1] = y
        out[2] = z
    }

    /**
     * Splash 编舞位置：在 [position] 基础上叠加——
     *  - pop（入场进度）：从中心与深处"漂来"（0-2s 慢入）
     *  - 5-7s 高潮：三环短暂靠近又分开（converge 脉冲）
     */
    fun splashPosition(i: Int, t: Float, pop: Float, out: FloatArray) {
        position(i, t, out)
        val dx = t - 6f
        val converge = exp(-dx * dx / 1.7f)
        val amp = (1f - 0.45f * converge) * pop
        out[0] = out[0] * amp
        out[1] = out[1] * amp
        out[2] = out[2] * amp - (1f - pop) * 1.4f
    }
}

shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/learnagent/ui/TechMap.kt (4.6KB)
package com.learnagent.ui

import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechCategory
import com.learnagent.data.TechStatus
import com.learnagent.data.TechUsage
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * 技术地图布局算法（两端共用，纯 Kotlin，不依赖 Compose）：
 * - 按 TechCategory 分组，扇区大小 ∝ 组内节点数
 * - 组内节点沿扇区弧线圆形布局，半径随组大小变化
 * - 节点大小 = min(4 + usedCount*2, 20) dp；颜色按状态
 * - relatedConcepts 命中的节点之间连线
 * 平台层负责 Canvas 绘制、hover（桌面）/点击与 TechCard 弹层。
 */
data class TechMapNode(
    val name: String,
    val category: String,
    val status: TechStatus,
    val usedCount: Int,
    val x: Float,
    val y: Float,
    val radiusDp: Float,
    val colorArgb: Long,
    val glow: Boolean
)

data class TechMapEdge(val fromX: Float, val fromY: Float, val toX: Float, val toY: Float)

data class TechMapLayout(val nodes: List<TechMapNode>, val edges: List<TechMapEdge>)

object TechMapLayoutEngine {

    fun build(cards: List<TechCard>, usages: List<TechUsage>, width: Float, height: Float): TechMapLayout {
        if (cards.isEmpty() || width <= 0f || height <= 0f) return TechMapLayout(emptyList(), emptyList())
        val byCategory = cards.groupBy { it.category }
        val present = TechCategory.values().toList().filter { byCategory[it].orEmpty().isNotEmpty() }
        val total = cards.size.coerceAtLeast(1)
        val cx = width / 2f
        val cy = height / 2f
        val outerR = min(width, height) * 0.40f
        val nodes = mutableListOf<TechMapNode>()
        var angleStart = -PI / 2

        for (category in present) {
            val group = byCategory.getValue(category)
            val sweep = (2 * PI * group.size / total).toFloat()
            val mid = (angleStart + sweep / 2).toFloat()
            // 组内节点数越多，"环"越大
            val ringR = outerR * (0.55f + 0.35f * min(group.size, 8) / 8f)
            group.forEachIndexed { i, card ->
                val usage = usages.firstOrNull { it.techName.equals(card.name, ignoreCase = true) }
                val used = usage?.usedCount ?: 0
                val status = usage?.status ?: TechStatus.DISCOVERED
                val sub = if (group.size == 1) 0f else (i.toFloat() / (group.size - 1) - 0.5f)
                val angle = mid + sub * sweep * 0.85f
                val jitter = 0.75f + 0.25f * (((card.name.hashCode() and 0x7FFF) % 10) / 10f)
                val r = ringR * jitter
                nodes.add(
                    TechMapNode(
                        name = card.name,
                        category = category.name,
                        status = status,
                        usedCount = used,
                        x = cx + cos(angle) * r,
                        y = cy + sin(angle) * r,
                        radiusDp = min(4f + used * 2f, 20f),
                        colorArgb = statusColor(status),
                        glow = used >= 5
                    )
                )
            }
            angleStart += sweep
        }

        val nodeByName = nodes.associateBy { it.name }
        val edges = mutableListOf<TechMapEdge>()
        val seenPairs = mutableSetOf<String>()
        cards.forEach { card ->
            val a = nodeByName[card.name] ?: return@forEach
            card.relatedConcepts.forEach { concept ->
                val b = nodeByName[concept] ?: return@forEach
                val key = listOf(a.name.lowercase(), b.name.lowercase()).sorted().joinToString("|")
                if (seenPairs.add(key)) edges.add(TechMapEdge(a.x, a.y, b.x, b.y))
            }
        }
        return TechMapLayout(nodes, edges)
    }

    /** 命中测试（像素坐标；padPx 为额外容差）。 */
    fun hitTest(nodes: List<TechMapNode>, x: Float, y: Float, padPx: Float = 0f): TechMapNode? {
        var best: TechMapNode? = null
        var bestDist = Float.MAX_VALUE
        nodes.forEach { n ->
            val dx = n.x - x
            val dy = n.y - y
            val dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
            if (dist <= n.radiusDp + padPx && dist < bestDist) {
                bestDist = dist
                best = n
            }
        }
        return best
    }

    fun statusColor(status: TechStatus): Long = when (status) {
        TechStatus.DISCOVERED -> 0xFF4A5260
        TechStatus.FAMILIAR -> 0xFF4A7AB8
        TechStatus.USED -> 0xFF7FB89C
        TechStatus.FLUENT -> 0xFFE8C87A
        TechStatus.EXPERT -> 0xFFB8A8D4
    }
}
shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/com/learnagent/DataModelTest.kt (2.8KB)
package com.learnagent.data

import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

class DataModelTest {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; prettyPrint = true; isLenient = true }

    @Test
    fun testVideoMetaSerialization() {
        val video = VideoMeta(
            videoId = "v1",
            deviceId = "d1",
            lastModified = 0L,
            schemaVersion = 1,
            title = "Test",
            duration = 100.0
        )
        val text = json.encodeToString(video)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString<VideoMeta>(text)
        assertEquals(video.videoId, decoded.videoId)
        assertEquals(video.deviceId, decoded.deviceId)
        assertEquals(video.title, decoded.title)
        assertEquals(video.duration, decoded.duration)
    }

    @Test
    fun testTranscriptSegmentSerialization() {
        val seg = TranscriptSegment(
            start = 0.0,
            end = 5.0,
            text = "hello",
            speaker = null
        )
        val text = json.encodeToString(seg)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString<TranscriptSegment>(text)
        assertEquals(seg.start, decoded.start)
        assertEquals(seg.end, decoded.end)
        assertEquals(seg.text, decoded.text)
    }

    @Test
    fun testFrameOcrSerialization() {
        val frame = FrameOcr(
            timestamp = 1.5,
            text = "PPT Title",
            imagePath = "/path/frame.jpg"
        )
        val text = json.encodeToString(frame)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString<FrameOcr>(text)
        assertEquals(frame.timestamp, decoded.timestamp)
        assertEquals(frame.text, decoded.text)
        assertEquals(frame.imagePath, decoded.imagePath)
    }

    @Test
    fun testTimelineItemSerialization() {
        val timeline = TimelineItem(
            start = 0.0,
            end = 5.0,
            speech = "hello world",
            screenText = "PPT text",
            framePath = "/path/f.jpg"
        )
        val text = json.encodeToString(timeline)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString<TimelineItem>(text)
        assertEquals(timeline.start, decoded.start)
        assertEquals(timeline.end, decoded.end)
        assertEquals(timeline.speech, decoded.speech)
        assertEquals(timeline.screenText, decoded.screenText)
    }

    @Test
    fun testTimelineItemListSerialization() {
        val items = listOf(
            TimelineItem(start = 0.0, end = 5.0, speech = "a", screenText = "A", framePath = ""),
            TimelineItem(start = 5.0, end = 10.0, speech = "b", screenText = "B", framePath = "")
        )
        val text = json.encodeToString(items)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString<List<TimelineItem>>(text)
        assertEquals(items.size, decoded.size)
        assertEquals(items[0].speech, decoded[0].speech)
    }
}

package com.learnagent.data

import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class EndToEndTest {

    /**
     * 模拟一个真实场景：
     * 一个 30 秒的视频，讲了"梯度下降"和"反向传播"
     * 有 3 段语音 + 3 个画面
     * 期望：融合成 timeline，能被索引，能按关键词检索到正确时间戳
     */
    private fun buildSampleVideo() = Pair(
        // 语音
        listOf(
            TranscriptSegment(start = 0.0, end = 10.0, text = "这节课我们讲梯度下降", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 10.0, end = 20.0, text = "它是优化算法里的基础方法", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 20.0, end = 30.0, text = "接下来讲反向传播", speaker = null)
        ),
        // 画面
        listOf(
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 2.0, text = "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", imagePath = "frame_001.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 12.0, text = "学习率控制步长", imagePath = "frame_002.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(timestamp = 22.0, text = "反向传播计算梯度", imagePath = "frame_003.jpg")
        )
    )

    @Test
    fun testFullPipeline() {
        val (transcript, frames) = buildSampleVideo()

        // 1. 融合
        val timeline = merge(transcript, frames)
        assertTrue(timeline.isNotEmpty(), "融合结果不应为空")

        // 2. 索引
        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(timeline)

        // 3. 检索"梯度"
        val results = indexer.search("梯度", topK = 5)
        assertTrue(results.isNotEmpty(), "检索'梯度'应有结果")

        // 4. 检索"反向传播"
        val results2 = indexer.search("反向传播", topK = 5)
        assertTrue(results2.isNotEmpty(), "检索'反向传播'应有结果")

        // 5. 检索不存在的词
        val results3 = indexer.search("量子力学", topK = 5)
        assertEquals(0, results3.size, "检索'量子力学'不应有结果")
    }

    @Test
    fun testTimelineHasBothSpeechAndScreen() {
        val (transcript, frames) = buildSampleVideo()
        val timeline = merge(transcript, frames)

        // 至少有一条 timeline item 同时有 speech 和 screenText
        val hasBoth = timeline.any { it.speech.isNotBlank() && it.screenText.isNotBlank() }
        assertTrue(hasBoth, "至少一条应同时有语音和画面文字")
    }

    @Test
    fun testTimelineTimestampsMonotonic() {
        val (transcript, frames) = buildSampleVideo()
        val timeline = merge(transcript, frames)

        // 时间戳应该递增
        for (i in 1 until timeline.size) {
            assertTrue(
                timeline[i].start >= timeline[i - 1].start,
                "时间戳应该递增：${timeline[i-1].start} -> ${timeline[i].start}"
            )
        }
    }
}
