shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/Bm25IndexerTest.kt (3.5KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.ui.LayoutBreakpoints
import com.learnagent.ui.LayoutMode
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/** 平台补强 A 批：BM25 精确分数 / 同义词扩展 / 时间窗融合 / 断点。 */
class Bm25IndexerTest {

    /** 手工计算 BM25 断言（k1=1.2, b=0.75）。 */
    @Test
    fun testBm25Score() {
        val docs = listOf(
            IndexedDoc("d1", listOf("分布式", "锁", "redlock")),
            IndexedDoc("d2", listOf("分布式", "缓存")),
            IndexedDoc("d3", listOf("缓存", "redis"))
        )
        val indexer = Bm25Indexer(k1 = 1.2f, b = 0.75f)
        indexer.index(docs)

        // 手工计算：
        // N=3, df("分布式")=2, avgdl=(3+2+2)/3=2.3333, |d1|=3
        // idf = ln((3-2+0.5)/(2+0.5)+1) = ln(1.6) ≈ 0.470004
        // denom = 1 + 1.2*(1-0.75+0.75*3/2.3333) = 1 + 1.2*(0.25+0.964286) = 2.457143
        // score = 0.470004 * (1*2.2)/2.457143 ≈ 0.420825
        val expected = 0.470004f * (1f * 2.2f) / 2.457143f
        val actual = indexer.scoreTokens(listOf("分布式"), "d1")
        assertTrue(abs(expected - actual) < 1e-3f, "BM25 分数应一致：expected=$expected actual=$actual")

        // 不含查询词的文档得 0
        assertEquals(0f, indexer.scoreTokens(listOf("分布式"), "d3"))
    }

    /** 搜"分布式锁"能命中含 "redlock" 的文档（同义词扩展）。 */
    @Test
    fun testSynonymExpansion() {
        val docs = listOf(
            IndexedDoc("d1", listOf("caching", "redis")),
            IndexedDoc("d2", listOf("redlock", "zookeeper")),
            IndexedDoc("d3", listOf("sorting", "algorithm"))
        )
        val indexer = Bm25Indexer()
        indexer.index(docs)
        val hits = indexer.search("分布式锁", topK = 3)
        assertTrue(hits.isNotEmpty(), "同义词扩展后应有命中")
        assertEquals("d2", hits.first().docId, "应命中含 redlock 的文档")
        assertTrue(TECH_SYNONYMS.size >= 20, "同义词表至少 20 组，实际=${TECH_SYNONYMS.size}")
    }

    /** 时间窗：命中片段的 before/after 不为空。 */
    @Test
    fun testTimeWindow() {
        val units = listOf(
            unit("u0", 0.0, "第一段"),
            unit("u1", 10.0, "分布式锁使用 redlock"),
            unit("u2", 20.0, "第三段")
        )
        val hits = listOf(ScoredDoc("u1", 1.5f))
        val fused = TimeWindowRetriever(units).fuse(hits)
        assertEquals(1, fused.size)
        assertTrue(fused.first().before != null, "before 应不为空")
        assertTrue(fused.first().after != null, "after 应不为空")
        assertEquals("u0", fused.first().before?.id)
        assertEquals("u2", fused.first().after?.id)
    }

    private fun unit(id: String, start: Double, speech: String) = LearningUnit(
        id = id, videoId = "v1", start = start, end = start + 10.0, speech = speech
    )

    // ---------- 断点 ----------

    @Test
    fun testLayoutBreakpoints() {
        assertEquals(LayoutMode.PHONE, LayoutBreakpoints.forWidth(412))
        assertEquals(LayoutMode.PHONE, LayoutBreakpoints.forWidth(599))
        assertEquals(LayoutMode.TABLET_COMPACT, LayoutBreakpoints.forWidth(600))
        assertEquals(LayoutMode.TABLET_COMPACT, LayoutBreakpoints.forWidth(899))
        assertEquals(LayoutMode.TABLET_FULL, LayoutBreakpoints.forWidth(900))
        assertEquals(LayoutMode.TABLET_FULL, LayoutBreakpoints.forWidth(1200))
    }
}
shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/DeepDigestEngineTest.kt (3.4KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class DeepDigestEngineTest {

    private fun unit() = LearningUnit(
        id = "u1", videoId = "v1", start = 10.0, end = 20.0,
        speech = "梯度下降沿负梯度更新参数，学习率控制步长",
        screenText = "学习率 = 0.001"
    )

    private class Fake(private val behavior: (String) -> String) : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String = behavior(prompt)
    }

    private class Thrower : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String =
            throw IllegalStateException("boom")
    }

    private fun smartFake() = Fake { p ->
        when {
            p.contains("共同观点") ->
                "【共同观点】\n- 必学：梯度下降沿负梯度更新参数\n【分歧点】\n- 主题：学习率取值；A：固定 1e-3；B：自适应；C：经验值"
            p.contains("你的初稿") -> "融合稿：梯度下降 + 学习率控制步长"
            else -> "初稿：梯度下降要点、学习率 0.001"
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun digestProducesConsensusAndDivergence() = runBlocking {
        val engine = DeepDigestEngine(
            listOf(
                Triple("Kimi K3", smartFake(), null),
                Triple("DeepSeek V4.1", smartFake(), null),
                Triple("GLM 5.3", smartFake(), null)
            ),
            maxRounds = 1
        )
        val report = engine.digest("v1", listOf(unit()))
        assertEquals(1, report.segments.size)
        assertEquals(3, report.models.size)
        val seg = report.segments[0]
        assertTrue(seg.consensus.any { it.contains("梯度下降") }, "应解析出共同观点：${seg.consensus}")
        assertTrue(seg.divergences.isNotEmpty(), "应解析出分歧点")
        assertEquals("学习率取值", seg.divergences[0].topic)
        assertTrue(seg.divergences[0].views.size >= 2)
        assertFalse(seg.degraded)
        assertTrue(seg.perModel.containsKey("Kimi K3"))
    }

    @Test
    fun fallbackSeatRescuesWhenPrimaryFails() = runBlocking {
        val engine = DeepDigestEngine(
            listOf(
                Triple("Kimi K3", Thrower(), smartFake()),   // 主模型失败 → 备选接力
                Triple("DeepSeek V4.1", smartFake(), null),
                Triple("GLM 5.3", smartFake(), null)
            ),
            maxRounds = 1,
            callTimeoutMs = 5_000
        )
        val report = engine.digest("v1", listOf(unit()))
        val seg = report.segments[0]
        assertFalse(seg.degraded, "有备选接力不应降级")
        assertTrue(seg.perModel.containsKey("Kimi K3"), "备选接力后仍应有 A 席稿件")
    }

    @Test
    fun allModelsFailMarksDegraded() = runBlocking {
        val engine = DeepDigestEngine(
            listOf(
                Triple("A", Thrower(), null),
                Triple("B", Thrower(), null),
                Triple("C", Thrower(), null)
            ),
            maxRounds = 1,
            retries = 0,
            callTimeoutMs = 3_000
        )
        val report = engine.digest("v1", listOf(unit()))
        assertTrue(report.segments[0].degraded, "全部失败应标降级，不能崩")
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechCategory
import com.learnagent.data.TechStatus
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis
import com.learnagent.ui.TechMapLayoutEngine
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/** Developer Mode 第 2 批：解析 / 逆向 / 搜索 / 召回 / 痕迹 / 周报 / 技术地图。 */
class DeveloperMode2Test {

    /** 每个测试实例固定一个 stamp（getter 会导致同一测试内名字漂移）。 */
    private val stamp = currentTimeMillis()

    private class FakeLlm(private val reply: String, private val error: Exception? = null) : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String {
            error?.let { throw it }
            return reply
        }
    }

    // ---------- 1. ProblemParser ----------

    @Test
    fun parserDictionaryHitsKeywordsAndConstraint() {
        val parsed = ProblemParser(null).parseWithDictionary("我要解决高并发下的分布式锁")
        assertTrue(parsed.keywords.contains("分布式锁"), "应命中词典：分布式锁")
        assertTrue(parsed.keywords.contains("高并发"), "约束词应进入 keywords（验收要求）")
        assertEquals("分布式", parsed.domain)
        assertTrue(parsed.constraints.contains("高并发"))
    }

    @Test
    fun parserOfflineReturnsAtLeastThreeKeywords() = runBlocking {
        val parsed = ProblemParser(null).parse("视频生成模型怎么训练")
        assertTrue(parsed.keywords.size >= 3, "离线降级也要 ≥3 个关键词，实际=${parsed.keywords}")
    }

    @Test
    fun parserInvalidJsonFallsBack() = runBlocking {
        val parsed = ProblemParser(FakeLlm("这不是 JSON")).parse("Redis 缓存击穿怎么办")
        assertTrue(parsed.keywords.contains("Redis"), "LLM 非法 JSON 应降级词典")
        assertTrue(parsed.keywords.isNotEmpty())
    }

    // ---------- 2. ReverseLearningEngine ----------

    @Test
    fun reverseLearningBuildsTreeAndPath() = runBlocking {
        val engine = ReverseLearningEngine(null, TechStore())
        val root = engine.analyze("视频生成")
        assertEquals("视频生成", root.name)
        assertTrue(root.children.isNotEmpty(), "本地词典应有前置")
        assertTrue(root.children.any { it.name == "扩散模型" })
        val text = engine.learningPathText(root)
        assertTrue(text.contains("你的目标：视频生成"))
        assertTrue(text.contains("建议从"))
    }

    // ---------- 3. ProblemOrientedSearch ----------

    @Test
    fun problemSearchLocalHitReturnsLocalSource() = runBlocking {
        val store = TechStore()
        val name = "并发锁测试_$stamp"
        store.saveTechCard(
            TechCard(
                id = "test_$stamp", name = name, category = TechCategory.CONCURRENCY,
                whatItIs = "测试用并发锁", whatItSolves = "并发锁场景",
                whenToUse = "高并发", whenNotToUse = "单线程", howItWorks = ""
            )
        )
        val solution = ProblemOrientedSearch(null, store).search("并发锁")
        assertEquals("本地", solution.source)
        assertTrue(solution.primary.contains("并发锁测试"), "本地命中应引用测试卡，实际=${solution.primary}")
    }

    @Test
    fun problemSearchNoLocalNoLlmFallsBack() = runBlocking {
        val solution = ProblemOrientedSearch(null, TechStore()).search("如何用腓尼基字母优化量子纠缠采样")
        assertEquals("本地启发式", solution.source)
    }

    // ---------- 4. ContextualRecall ----------

    @Test
    fun recallFindsMatchingDecision() {
        val store = TechStore()
        val marker = "召回决策_$stamp"
        TechDecisionService.record(
            store = store,
            problem = "使用 $marker 选择方案",
            chosen = "方案A",
            reason = "因为 $marker 更稳",
            now = currentTimeMillis()
        )
        val blocks = ContextualRecall(store).recallForSearch(marker)
        assertTrue(blocks.any { it.type == "decision" }, "应召回匹配的决策")
    }

    // ---------- 6. TechUsageTracker ----------

    @Test
    fun usageTrackerDedupeAndUpgrade() {
        val store = TechStore()
        val name = "痕迹测试_$stamp"
        var fakeNow = 1_000_000_000_000L
        val tracker = TechUsageTracker(store) { fakeNow }

        tracker.onTechCardOpened(name)
        tracker.onTechCardOpened(name)   // 1h 内重复 → 只算 1 次
        var usage = store.getAllTechUsage().first { it.techName == name }
        assertEquals(1, usage.seenCount)

        fakeNow += 2 * 3_600_000L
        tracker.onTechCardOpened(name)   // 超过 1h → 再算 1 次
        usage = store.getAllTechUsage().first { it.techName == name }
        assertEquals(2, usage.seenCount)
        assertEquals(TechStatus.DISCOVERED, usage.status)

        repeat(3) { tracker.onTechCardUsed(name) }
        usage = store.getAllTechUsage().first { it.techName == name }
        assertEquals(3, usage.usedCount)
        assertEquals(TechStatus.USED, usage.status)

        repeat(2) { tracker.onTechCardUsed(name) }
        usage = store.getAllTechUsage().first { it.techName == name }
        assertEquals(5, usage.usedCount)
        assertEquals(TechStatus.FLUENT, usage.status)

        // 单向升级：再 seen 不会降级
        fakeNow += 2 * 3_600_000L
        tracker.onTechCardOpened(name)
        usage = store.getAllTechUsage().first { it.techName == name }
        assertEquals(TechStatus.FLUENT, usage.status)
    }

    // ---------- 8. WeeklyReport ----------

    @Test
    fun weeklyReportWeekStartsSundayAndGenerates() {
        // 1970-01-01 是周四 → 所在周从 1969-12-28（周日）开始
        assertEquals(-4L * 86_400_000L, WeeklyReportGenerator.weekStart(0L))

        val store = TechStore()
        val name = "周报测试_$stamp"
        val now = currentTimeMillis()
        val tracker = TechUsageTracker(store) { now }
        tracker.onTechCardUsed(name)
        val report = WeeklyReportGenerator(store, now).generate()
        assertNotNull(report)
        assertTrue(report.weekEnd > report.weekStart)
        assertTrue(report.suggestion.isNotBlank())
    }

    // ---------- 7. TechMap ----------

    @Test
    fun techMapBuildsNodesAndEdges() {
        val a = TechCard(
            id = "a_$stamp", name = "MapA_$stamp", category = TechCategory.DISTRIBUTED,
            whatItIs = "a", whatItSolves = "", whenToUse = "", whenNotToUse = "", howItWorks = "",
            relatedConcepts = listOf("MapB_$stamp")
        )
        val b = TechCard(
            id = "b_$stamp", name = "MapB_$stamp", category = TechCategory.NETWORK,
            whatItIs = "b", whatItSolves = "", whenToUse = "", whenNotToUse = "", howItWorks = ""
        )
        val layout = TechMapLayoutEngine.build(listOf(a, b), emptyList(), 800f, 600f)
        assertEquals(2, layout.nodes.size)
        assertEquals(1, layout.edges.size, "relatedConcepts 命中应连线")
        assertTrue(layout.nodes.all { it.x in 0f..800f && it.y in 0f..600f })
        assertEquals(0xFF4A5260, TechMapLayoutEngine.statusColor(TechStatus.DISCOVERED))
        assertEquals(0xFFB8A8D4, TechMapLayoutEngine.statusColor(TechStatus.EXPERT))
        assertNotNull(TechMapLayoutEngine.hitTest(layout.nodes, layout.nodes[0].x, layout.nodes[0].y))
    }
}
shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/ErrorNotebookTest.kt (2KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.ErrorType
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertFalse
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class ErrorNotebookTest {

    /** 同 pointId 错 3 次 → 标记高危。 */
    @Test
    fun testHighRiskMarking() {
        var t = 1_000_000L
        val notebook = ErrorNotebook { t }
        notebook.record("q1", "kp1", "错答", "对答", "解释", ErrorType.CONCEPT_ERROR)
        t += 1000
        notebook.record("q2", "kp1", "错答", "对答", "解释", ErrorType.CONCEPT_ERROR)
        t += 1000
        assertFalse(notebook.isHighRisk("kp1"), "错 2 次不算高危")
        notebook.record("q3", "kp1", "错答", "对答", "解释", ErrorType.MISUNDERSTANDING)
        assertTrue(notebook.isHighRisk("kp1"), "错 3 次应高危")
        assertTrue(notebook.highRiskPointIds().contains("kp1"))
    }

    /** 同一题重复错 3 次也累计（errorCount 累加）。 */
    @Test
    fun testSameQuestionCounts() {
        var t = 2_000_000L
        val notebook = ErrorNotebook { t }
        repeat(3) {
            notebook.record("q1", "kp2", "错答", "对答", "解释", ErrorType.CARELESS_ERROR)
            t += 1000
        }
        assertEquals(3, notebook.errorCount("kp2"))
        assertTrue(notebook.isHighRisk("kp2"))
    }

    /** 错题入队 → nextReviewAt = 最后错误 + 1 天。 */
    @Test
    fun testAddToReviewQueue() {
        val t = 5_000_000L
        val notebook = ErrorNotebook { t }
        notebook.record("q9", "kp9", "错答", "对答", "解释", ErrorType.CALCULATION_ERROR)
        val queued = notebook.reviewQueue().first { it.pointId == "kp9" }
        assertEquals(t + 86_400_000L, queued.nextReviewAt)
    }

    /** 考前 3 天内可生成错题冲刺卷。 */
    @Test
    fun testSprintTime() {
        val now = 10_000_000_000L
        val notebook = ErrorNotebook { now }
        assertTrue(notebook.isSprintTime(now + 2 * 86_400_000L, now))
        assertFalse(notebook.isSprintTime(now + 10 * 86_400_000L, now))
    }
}

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals

class ExamGeneratorTest {

    private fun kp(index: Int, chapter: Int = index % 5) = KnowledgePoint(
        id = "p_${chapter}_$index",

        definition = "这是第 $index 个知识点的定义，用于出卷测试",

    @Test
    fun testQuestionTypeRatio() = runBlocking {
        val points = (0 until 25).map { kp(it) }
        val exam = ExamGenerator(null, points).generate(
            scope = ExamScope.MULTI_VIDEO,
            videoIds = emptyList(),
            questionCount = 20,
            difficulty = Difficulty.MEDIUM,
            interleaver = InterleavingEngine()

        assertEquals(8, counts[QuestionType.SINGLE_CHOICE], "单选")
        assertEquals(3, counts[QuestionType.MULTIPLE_CHOICE], "多选")
        assertEquals(3, counts[QuestionType.FILL_BLANK], "填空")
        assertEquals(4, counts[QuestionType.SHORT_ANSWER], "简答")
        assertEquals(2, counts[QuestionType.CALCULATION], "计算")
        assertEquals("本地启发式", exam.source)
    }

    /** 只有 3 个知识点、出 10 题 → 返回 3 题不崩。 */
    @Test
    fun testInsufficientPoints() = runBlocking {
        val points = (0 until 3).map { kp(it) }
        val exam = ExamGenerator(null, points).generate(
            scope = ExamScope.SINGLE_VIDEO,
            videoIds = emptyList(),
            questionCount = 10,
            difficulty = Difficulty.EASY,
            interleaver = InterleavingEngine()
        )
        assertEquals(3, exam.questions.size)
        assertEquals(3, exam.questions.map { it.knowledgePointId }.distinct().size)
    }

    /** 配比函数自身：总数守恒。 */
    @Test
    fun testAllocateTypesTotal() {
        val gen = ExamGenerator(null)
        listOf(1, 2, 5, 10, 37).forEach { n ->
            val types = gen.allocateTypes(n)
            assertEquals(n, types.size, "n=$n 类型总数应守恒")
        }
    }

shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/InterleavingEngineTest.kt (1.3KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgePoint
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class InterleavingEngineTest {

    private fun kp(chapter: Int, index: Int) = KnowledgePoint(
        id = "p_${chapter}_$index",
        name = "点$chapter-$index",
        definition = "定义$chapter-$index",
        chapterId = "ch$chapter"
    )

    /** 3 章节 × 5 点，抽 9 → 每章节 3 点。 */
    @Test
    fun testInterleave() {
        val points = (0 until 3).flatMap { ch -> (0 until 5).map { i -> kp(ch, i) } }
        val picked = InterleavingEngine().interleave(points, 9)
        assertEquals(9, picked.size)
        val perChapter = picked.groupingBy { it.chapterId }.eachCount()
        assertEquals(3, perChapter.values.size)
        perChapter.values.forEach { assertEquals(3, it, "每章节应抽 3 个") }
    }

    /** 只有 1 章节 → 打乱返回（不崩）。 */
    @Test
    fun testSingleChapter() {
        val points = (0 until 5).map { kp(0, it) }
        val picked = InterleavingEngine().interleave(points, 4)
        assertEquals(4, picked.size)
        assertTrue(picked.all { points.contains(it) })
        // 抽满时内容等价
        assertEquals(points.toSet(), InterleavingEngine().interleave(points, 10).toSet())
    }
}
shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/com/learnagent/core/SpacedRepetitionEngineTest.kt (2.8KB)
package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class SpacedRepetitionEngineTest {

    private val engine = SpacedRepetitionEngine()
    private fun fresh() = KnowledgeMastery(pointId = "p1")

    /** q=5 连续 5 次（每天一次）→ EF 收敛在 [2.5, 2.7]。 */
    @Test
    fun testEFConvergence() {
        var m = fresh()
        var day = 10L * 86_400_000L
        repeat(5) {
            day += 86_400_000L + 1
            m = engine.update(m, 5, now = day)
        }
        assertTrue(m.easeFactor in 2.5f..2.7f, "EF 应收敛，实际=${m.easeFactor}")
    }

    /** q=0 连续 5 次 → EF 不低于 1.3（恰好 1.3）。 */
    @Test
    fun testEFLowerBound() {
        var m = fresh()
        var day = 10L * 86_400_000L
        repeat(5) {
            day += 86_400_000L + 1
            m = engine.update(m, 0, now = day)
        }
        assertEquals(1.3f, m.easeFactor)
    }

    /** q=5 时 interval 序列 = 1, 6, 15, 39, 101。 */
    @Test
    fun testIntervalSequence() {
        var m = fresh()
        val seq = mutableListOf<Int>()
        var day = 10L * 86_400_000L
        repeat(5) {
            day += 86_400_000L + 1
            m = engine.update(m, 5, now = day)
            seq.add(m.interval)
        }
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 6, 15, 39, 101), seq)
    }

    /** 同一天两次 q=5 → reviewCount 只 +1。 */
    @Test
    fun testSameDayDebounce() {
        val t0 = 1_700_000_000_000L
        var m = engine.update(fresh(), 5, now = t0)
        m = engine.update(m, 5, now = t0 + 60_000L)
        assertEquals(1, m.reviewCount)
    }

    /** 答错 q=0 → interval 重置为 1。 */
    @Test
    fun testWrongResetInterval() {
        var m = fresh()
        var day = 10L * 86_400_000L
        day += 86_400_000L + 1
        m = engine.update(m, 5, now = day)     // interval=1
        day += 86_400_000L + 1
        m = engine.update(m, 5, now = day)     // interval=6
        day += 86_400_000L + 1
        m = engine.update(m, 0, now = day)     // 答错
        assertEquals(1, m.interval)
    }

    /** getDueCards 只返回到期且非 NOT_LEARNED 的卡。 */
    @Test
    fun testDueCards() {
        val now = 1_700_000_000_000L
        val learned = KnowledgeMastery(pointId = "a", status = com.learnagent.data.MasteryStatus.LEARNED, nextReviewAt = now - 1)
        val future = KnowledgeMastery(pointId = "b", status = com.learnagent.data.MasteryStatus.LEARNED, nextReviewAt = now + 86_400_000L)
        val newbie = KnowledgeMastery(pointId = "c", status = com.learnagent.data.MasteryStatus.NOT_LEARNED, nextReviewAt = now - 1)
        val due = engine.getDueCards(listOf(learned, future, newbie), now)
        assertEquals(listOf("a"), due.map { it.pointId })
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class StudyPrecisionTest {

    @Test
    fun atmosphereClassifiesQuantitatively() {
        // 昏暗 / 冷调 / 低饱和
        val dark = Atmosphere.fromAverages(rAvg = 18f, gAvg = 22f, bAvg = 70f, minLuma = 8f, maxLuma = 60f)
        assertTrue(dark.labels.contains("昏暗"), "${dark.labels}")
        assertTrue(dark.labels.contains("冷调"), "${dark.labels}")

        // 明亮 / 暖调 / 鲜艳
        val bright = Atmosphere.fromAverages(rAvg = 230f, gAvg = 190f, bAvg = 90f, minLuma = 20f, maxLuma = 250f)
        assertTrue(bright.labels.contains("明亮"), "${bright.labels}")
        assertTrue(bright.labels.contains("暖调"), "${bright.labels}")
    }

    private class Fake(private val reply: String) : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String = reply
    }

    private fun seg(text: String) = TranscriptSegment(start = 12.0, end = 15.0, text = text, speaker = null)

    @Test
    fun polisherConsensusHighConfidence() = runBlocking {
        val p = TranscriptPolisher(
            listOf("A" to Fake("梯度下降"), "B" to Fake("梯度下降"), "C" to Fake("梯度下降"))
        )
        val r = p.polish("v1", listOf(seg("梯渡下降")))
        val s = r.segments[0]
        assertEquals("梯度下降", s.final)
        assertEquals(1.0f, s.confidence)
        assertEquals(12.0, s.start)
        assertEquals(15.0, s.end)
        assertTrue(p.markdown(r).contains("00:12"))
    }

    @Test
    fun polisherTwoVotesMediumConfidence() = runBlocking {
        val p = TranscriptPolisher(
            listOf("A" to Fake("梯度下降"), "B" to Fake("梯度下降"), "C" to Fake("剃度下降"))
        )
        val s = p.polish("v1", listOf(seg("梯渡下降"))).segments[0]
        assertEquals("梯度下降", s.final)
        assertEquals(0.7f, s.confidence)
        assertTrue(s.alternatives.contains("剃度下降"))
    }

    @Test
    fun polisherAllDisagreeKeepsOriginal() = runBlocking {
        val p = TranscriptPolisher(
            listOf("A" to Fake("甲"), "B" to Fake("乙"), "C" to Fake("丙"))
        )
        val s = p.polish("v1", listOf(seg("原句"))).segments[0]
        assertEquals("原句", s.final)
        assertEquals(0.3f, s.confidence)
        assertEquals(3, s.alternatives.size)
    }

    private fun item(start: Double, speech: String, screen: String = "") =
        com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem(start = start, end = start + 5, speech = speech, screenText = screen)

    @Test
    fun keyKnowledgeMarksEmphasisHeadingAndRepeat() {
        val timeline = listOf(
            item(0.0, "这节课的重点是反向传播"),
            item(10.0, "随便聊两句天气怎么样呢"),
            item(20.0, "", "梯度下降"),
            item(30.0, "梯度下降的直觉是沿着最陡方向走"),
            item(40.0, "梯度下降的直觉是沿着最陡方向走")
        )
        val tags = KeyKnowledge.tags(timeline)
        assertEquals("强调", tags[0])
        assertEquals(null, tags[1])
        assertEquals("标题", tags[2])
        assertEquals("重复", tags[3])
        assertEquals("重复", tags[4])
    }
}

/** 技术卡提取器：LLM 路径 + 三种降级路径。 */
class TechCardExtractorTest {

    private class FakeLlm(
        private val reply: String = "",
        private val error: Exception? = null
    ) : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String {
            error?.let { throw it }
            return reply
        }
    }

    private fun unit() = LearningUnit(
        id = "v1_0",
        videoId = "v1",
        start = 0.0,
        end = 10.0,
        speech = "ZooKeeper 是一个分布式协调服务，用于分布式锁和选主",
        screenText = "",
        keywords = listOf("ZooKeeper", "分布式锁")
    )

    private val llmReply = """
[
  {"name":"ZooKeeper","category":"DISTRIBUTED","whatItIs":"分布式协调服务",
   "whatItSolves":"分布式锁、选主","whenToUse":"强一致场景","whenNotToUse":"单机",
   "howItWorks":"ZAB 协议","alternatives":["etcd"],"relatedConcepts":["CAP"],"codeSnippet":""},
  {"name":"etcd","category":"DISTRIBUTED","whatItIs":"键值存储",
   "whatItSolves":"配置管理、服务发现","whenToUse":"云原生","whenNotToUse":"关系型需求",
   "howItWorks":"Raft","alternatives":["ZooKeeper"],"relatedConcepts":["Raft"],"codeSnippet":""}
]
""".trimIndent()

    @Test
    fun llmAvailableReturnsTwoCards() = runBlocking {
        val cards = TechCardExtractor(FakeLlm(llmReply)).extract(unit(), "v1")
        assertEquals(2, cards.size)
        assertTrue(cards.all { it.source == "LLM" })
        assertTrue(cards.all { it.sourceVideoId == "v1" })
    }

    @Test
    fun noLlmFallsBackToHeuristic() = runBlocking {
        val cards = TechCardExtractor(null).extract(unit(), "v1")
        assertTrue(cards.isNotEmpty(), "启发式至少产出 1 张")
        assertTrue(cards.all { it.source == "本地启发式" })
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidJsonFallsBackToHeuristic() = runBlocking {
        val cards = TechCardExtractor(FakeLlm("这不是 JSON")).extract(unit(), "v1")
        assertTrue(cards.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(cards.all { it.source == "本地启发式" })
    }

    @Test
    fun llmTimeoutFallsBackToHeuristic() = runBlocking {
        val cards = TechCardExtractor(FakeLlm(error = LlmTimeoutException())).extract(unit(), "v1")
        assertTrue(cards.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(cards.all { it.source == "本地启发式" })
    }
}

package com.learnagent.data

import java.io.File
import java.io.FileInputStream
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.io.IOException

/**
 * 桌面平台的存储实现
 * 
 * 使用本地文件系统进行数据存储
 */
actual class Storage {
    
    actual fun getResultsDir(): String {
        val homeDir = System.getProperty("user.home")
        return File(homeDir, ".learnagent/results").absolutePath
    }
    
    actual fun writeJson(path: String, content: String) {
        try {
            val file = File(path)
            file.parentFile?.mkdirs()
            
            FileOutputStream(file).use { outputStream ->
                outputStream.write(content.toByteArray())
            }
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            throw IOException("Failed to write JSON to $path", e)
        }
    }
    
    actual fun readJson(path: String): String? {
        return try {
            val file = File(path)
            if (!file.exists()) return null
            
            FileInputStream(file).use { inputStream ->
                inputStream.readBytes().toString()
            }
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            throw IOException("Failed to read JSON from $path", e)
        }
    }
    
    actual fun listVideoIds(): List<String> {
        val resultsDir = File(getResultsDir())
        if (!resultsDir.exists()) return emptyList()
        
        return resultsDir.listFiles { file ->
            file.isDirectory && file.name != "."
        }?.map { it.name } ?: emptyList()
    }
    
    actual fun ensureVideoDir(videoId: String): String {
        val videoDir = File(getResultsDir(), videoId)
        videoDir.mkdirs()
        return videoDir.absolutePath
    }
    
    actual fun deleteVideoDir(videoId: String) {
        val videoDir = File(getResultsDir(), videoId)
        deleteRecursively(videoDir)
    }
    
    actual fun fileExists(path: String): Boolean {
        return File(path).exists()
    }
    
    actual fun deleteFile(path: String) {
        val file = File(path)
        if (file.exists()) {
            file.delete()
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * 递归删除目录及其内容
     */
    private fun deleteRecursively(file: File) {
        if (file.isDirectory) {
            file.listFiles()?.forEach { deleteRecursively(it) }
        }
        file.delete()
    }
}

package com.learnagent.core

import com.learnagent.data.Experience
import com.learnagent.data.Scenario
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/** 桌面实现：~/.mentara/experience/。 */
actual object ExperienceStore {

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private val dir: File
        get() = File(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".mentara/experience").apply { mkdirs() }

    private val scenariosFile: File get() = File(dir, "scenarios.json")
    private val experiencesFile: File get() = File(dir, "experiences.json")

    private fun readScenarios(): MutableList<Scenario> = try {
        if (scenariosFile.isFile) {
            json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(Scenario.serializer()), scenariosFile.readText()).toMutableList()
        } else mutableListOf()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        mutableListOf()
    }

    private fun readExperiences(): MutableList<Experience> = try {
        if (experiencesFile.isFile) {
            json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(Experience.serializer()), experiencesFile.readText()).toMutableList()
        } else mutableListOf()
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        mutableListOf()
    }

    actual fun saveScenario(scenario: Scenario) {
        val list = readScenarios()
        list.removeAll { it.id == scenario.id }
        list.add(scenario)
        scenariosFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(Scenario.serializer()), list))
    }

    actual fun saveExperience(experience: Experience) {
        val list = readExperiences()
        list.removeAll { it.id == experience.id }
        list.add(experience)
        experiencesFile.writeText(json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(Experience.serializer()), list))
    }

    actual fun getAllScenarios(): List<Scenario> = readScenarios()

    actual fun getAllExperiences(): List<Experience> = readExperiences()

    actual fun searchExperiences(query: String): List<Experience> {
        if (query.isBlank()) return emptyList()
        val q = query.lowercase()
        return readExperiences().filter {
            it.choice.lowercase().contains(q) || it.result.lowercase().contains(q) || it.lesson.lowercase().contains(q)
        }
    }

    actual fun getPendingFollowUps(nowMillis: Long): List<Experience> =
        readExperiences().filter { !it.followUpDone && it.followUpAt in 1..nowMillis }
}

package com.learnagent.platform

import com.learnagent.data.CodeSnippet
import com.learnagent.data.Decision
import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechUsage
import kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File

/**
 * jvm 实现：~/.mentara/{tech_cards,tech_usage,decisions,snippets,mastery}/。
 * 每个实体一个 JSON 文件；读取时扫描目录，损坏文件静默跳过。
 */
actual class TechStore actual constructor() {

    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true; ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private val rootDir: File
        get() = File(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".mentara").apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun dir(name: String): File = File(rootDir, name).apply { mkdirs() }

    private fun safeName(id: String): String =
        id.replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-\\u4e00-\\u9fa5.]"), "_").take(80).ifBlank { "unnamed" }

    private fun <T> readAll(dirName: String, serializer: KSerializer<T>): List<T> {
        val files = dir(dirName).listFiles { f -> f.isFile && f.name.endsWith(".json") } ?: return emptyList()
        return files.mapNotNull { f ->
            try {
                json.decodeFromString(serializer, f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
    }

    private fun <T> write(dirName: String, id: String, serializer: KSerializer<T>, value: T) {
        File(dir(dirName), safeName(id) + ".json").writeText(json.encodeToString(serializer, value), Charsets.UTF_8)
    }

    actual fun saveTechCard(card: TechCard) = write("tech_cards", card.id, TechCard.serializer(), card)

    actual fun getAllTechCards(): List<TechCard> = readAll("tech_cards", TechCard.serializer())

    actual fun saveTechUsage(usage: TechUsage) = write("tech_usage", usage.techName, TechUsage.serializer(), usage)

    actual fun getAllTechUsage(): List<TechUsage> = readAll("tech_usage", TechUsage.serializer())

    actual fun saveDecision(decision: Decision) = write("decisions", decision.id, Decision.serializer(), decision)

    actual fun getAllDecisions(): List<Decision> = readAll("decisions", Decision.serializer())

    actual fun saveCodeSnippet(snippet: CodeSnippet) = write("snippets", snippet.id, CodeSnippet.serializer(), snippet)

    actual fun getAllCodeSnippets(): List<CodeSnippet> = readAll("snippets", CodeSnippet.serializer())

    actual fun saveMastery(mastery: KnowledgeMastery) = write("mastery", mastery.pointId, KnowledgeMastery.serializer(), mastery)

    actual fun getAllMastery(): List<KnowledgeMastery> = readAll("mastery", KnowledgeMastery.serializer())

    actual fun saveMeta(key: String, value: String) {
        File(dir("meta"), safeName(key) + ".txt").writeText(value, Charsets.UTF_8)
    }

    actual fun getMeta(key: String): String? {
        val f = File(dir("meta"), safeName(key) + ".txt")
        return if (f.isFile) f.readText(Charsets.UTF_8) else null
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.design.ContrastCheck
import com.learnagent.design.DesignTokens
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/** 对比度审计：TextHigh/Mid on Veil ≥ 4.5，TextMid on Glimmer ≥ 4.5，TextLow on Void ≥ 2.0 */
class ContrastCheckTest {

    private fun check(fg: Long, bg: Long, min: Double, label: String) {
        val ratio = ContrastCheck.contrast(fg, bg)
        assertTrue(ratio >= min, "$label contrast $ratio < $min (fg=#${fg.toString(16)}, bg=#${bg.toString(16)})")
    }

    @Test
    fun textHighOnVeil() =
        check(DesignTokens.ColorTextHigh, DesignTokens.ColorVeil, 4.5, "TextHigh on Veil")

    @Test
    fun textHighOnGlimmer() =
        check(DesignTokens.ColorTextHigh, DesignTokens.ColorGlimmer, 4.5, "TextHigh on Glimmer")

    @Test
    fun textMidOnVeil() =
        check(DesignTokens.ColorTextMid, DesignTokens.ColorVeil, 4.5, "TextMid on Veil")

    @Test
    fun textMidOnGlimmer() =
        check(DesignTokens.ColorTextMid, DesignTokens.ColorGlimmer, 4.5, "TextMid on Glimmer")

    @Test
    fun textLowOnVoid() =
        check(DesignTokens.ColorTextLow, DesignTokens.ColorVoid, 2.0, "TextLow on Void")

    @Test
    fun textMidOnVoid() =
        check(DesignTokens.ColorTextMid, DesignTokens.ColorVoid, 4.5, "TextMid on Void")
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.DebateEngine
import com.learnagent.core.LlmClient
import com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking

/**
 * 四轮对抗协议测试：交叉批判 3 条、中立裁判、连续一致性、onRound 流式回调。
 * （旧语义由 StageATest.testDebateEngineDivergence 覆盖，此处只验证新协议。）
 */
class DebateEngineTest {

    private class FakeLlm(private val reply: String) : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String = reply
    }

    @Test
    fun testCrossCritiqueProtocol() = runBlocking {
        val engine = DebateEngine(
            FakeLlm("提案甲：梯度下降通过迭代最小化损失。"),
            FakeLlm("提案乙：梯度下降依赖学习率，选择不当会发散。"),
            FakeLlm("提案丙：在小数据集上梯度下降表现稳定。")
        )
        val rounds = mutableListOf<Int>()
        val result = engine.debate(
            topic = "梯度下降是否有效",
            context = "上下文内容",
            onRound = { round, partial ->
                rounds.add(round)
                if (round == 1) {
                    assertTrue(partial.proposerA.isNotBlank(), "第 1 轮应包含提案 A")
                    assertTrue(partial.proposerC.isNotBlank(), "第 1 轮应包含提案 C")
                    assertTrue(partial.critiques.isEmpty(), "第 1 轮不应有批判")
                }
                if (round == 2) {
                    assertEquals(3, partial.critiques.size, "第 2 轮应有 3 条交叉批判")
                }
            }
        )

        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2, 3), rounds, "onRound 应按 1→2→3 触发")
        assertEquals(3, result.critiques.size, "交叉批判必须是 3 条")
        assertTrue(result.critiques.all { it.contains("批") }, "每条批判须注明谁批谁")
        assertTrue(result.judge.isNotBlank(), "中立裁决不能为空")
        assertTrue(result.agreement in 0.0..1.0, "agreement 应为 0~1 连续值，实际=${result.agreement}")
        assertTrue(result.proposerA.isNotBlank() && result.proposerB.isNotBlank() && result.proposerC.isNotBlank())
        assertTrue(result.minorityReport.isNotBlank(), "少数派报告应自动产生")
    }

    @Test
    fun testAgreementIdenticalProposals() = runBlocking {
        val same = "完全相同的提案内容用于验证一致性上限"
        val engine = DebateEngine(FakeLlm(same), FakeLlm(same), FakeLlm(same))
        val result = engine.debate("议题", "上下文")
        assertTrue(result.agreement > 0.99, "完全相同提案的 agreement 应接近 1，实际=${result.agreement}")
    }

    @Test
    fun testDegradedModelNeverFailsWhole() = runBlocking {
        // 模型 C 每次都抛错 → 降级文案，其余继续
        val broken = object : LlmClient {
            override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String =
                throw IllegalStateException("连接超时")
        }
        val engine = DebateEngine(
            FakeLlm("提案A"),
            FakeLlm("提案B"),
            broken
        )
        val result = engine.debate("议题", "上下文")
        assertTrue(result.proposerC.contains("不可用"), "失败的模型应有降级文案")
        assertEquals(3, result.critiques.size, "任一模型失败不影响整体")
        assertTrue(result.agreement >= 0.0, "agreement 仍应可计算")
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.LocalQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertNotNull

/**
 * 评测：用黄金集驱动 LocalQaEngine，统计答案命中率。
 *
 * 黄金集位于 `src/jvmTest/resources/golden_set.json`，共 10 题。
 * 判定方式：回答中是否包含期望的关键词（无匹配题期望包含“未提及”）。
 */
class EvaluationTest {

    @Serializable
    data class GoldenCase(val question: String, val expect: String)

    @Serializable
    data class GoldenSet(val cases: List<GoldenCase>)

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }

    private fun timeline(): List<TimelineItem> = merge(
        listOf(
            TranscriptSegment(0.0, 10.0, "这节课我们讲梯度下降", null),
            TranscriptSegment(10.0, 20.0, "它是优化算法里的基础方法", null),
            TranscriptSegment(20.0, 30.0, "接下来讲反向传播", null),
            TranscriptSegment(30.0, 40.0, "最后讲卷积神经网络处理图像", null)
        ),
        listOf(
            FrameOcr(2.0, "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", "frame_001.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(12.0, "学习率控制步长", "frame_002.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(22.0, "反向传播计算梯度", "frame_003.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(32.0, "CNN 用于图像识别", "frame_004.jpg")
        )
    )

    @Test
    fun testGoldenSetAccuracy() = runBlocking {
        val raw = javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/golden_set.json")
        assertNotNull(raw, "缺少 golden_set.json")
        val set = json.decodeFromString<GoldenSet>(raw.readBytes().decodeToString())

        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(timeline())
        val engine = LocalQaEngine { q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) }

        var matched = 0
        for (case in set.cases) {
            val answer = engine.ask(case.question)
            val hit = answer.answer.contains(case.expect)
            if (hit) matched++
            println("[${if (hit) "PASS" else "FAIL"}] Q='${case.question}' expect='${case.expect}' -> ${answer.answer.replace("\n", " ")}")
        }

        val accuracy = matched.toDouble() / set.cases.size
        println("EVAL_ACCURACY=$matched/${set.cases.size} (${(accuracy * 100).toInt()}%)")
        println("EVAL_BASELINE=${(accuracy * 100).toInt()}%")

        assertEquals(set.cases.size, matched, "黄金集应全部命中，实际 $matched/${set.cases.size}")
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.LocalQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import com.learnagent.data.VideoMeta
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.io.File
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/**
 * 完整流程测试：视频元数据 → 融合 → 落盘/读回 → 索引 → 检索 → 问答。
 */
class PipelineTest {

    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; isLenient = true }

    private val transcript = listOf(
        TranscriptSegment(start = 0.0, end = 10.0, text = "这节课我们讲梯度下降", speaker = null),
        TranscriptSegment(start = 10.0, end = 20.0, text = "它是优化算法里的基础方法", speaker = null),
        TranscriptSegment(start = 20.0, end = 30.0, text = "接下来讲反向传播", speaker = null),
        TranscriptSegment(start = 30.0, end = 40.0, text = "最后讲卷积神经网络处理图像", speaker = null)
    )

    private val frames = listOf(
        FrameOcr(timestamp = 2.0, text = "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", imagePath = "frame_001.jpg"),
        FrameOcr(timestamp = 22.0, text = "反向传播计算梯度", imagePath = "frame_003.jpg"),
        FrameOcr(timestamp = 32.0, text = "CNN 用于图像识别", imagePath = "frame_004.jpg")
    )

    @Test
    fun testFullPipelineVideoToAnswer() = runBlocking {
        // 1) 视频元数据序列化往返
        val meta = VideoMeta(
            videoId = "v1", deviceId = "d1", lastModified = 0L,
            schemaVersion = 1, title = "梯度下降课", duration = 40.0
        )
        val metaJson = json.encodeToString(meta)
        assertEquals("v1", json.decodeFromString<VideoMeta>(metaJson).videoId)

        // 2) 融合
        val timeline = merge(transcript, frames)
        assertTrue(timeline.isNotEmpty(), "融合结果不应为空")

        // 3) 落盘 + 读回（模拟 results 目录）
        val file = File.createTempFile("learnagent_timeline", ".json")
        try {
            file.writeText(json.encodeToString(timeline))
            val loaded = json.decodeFromString<List<TimelineItem>>(file.readText())
            assertEquals(timeline.size, loaded.size, "落盘读回后条目数应一致")

            // 4) 索引 + 检索
            val indexer = Indexer()
            indexer.index(loaded)
            val hits = indexer.search("反向传播")
            assertTrue(hits.isNotEmpty(), "应检索到'反向传播'")
            assertTrue(hits.any { it.speech.contains("反向传播") }, "命中项应包含关键词")

            // 5) 问答
            val engine = LocalQaEngine { q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) }
            val answer = engine.ask("反向传播")
            assertTrue(answer.answer.contains("反向传播"), "回答应包含相关内容")
            assertTrue(answer.citations.isNotEmpty(), "回答应有时间戳引用")

            // 6) 不存在的词
            assertEquals(0, indexer.search("量子力学").size, "不应检索到无关词")
        } finally {
            file.delete()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun testMonotonicTimelineAfterRoundTrip() {
        val timeline = merge(transcript, frames)
        val file = File.createTempFile("learnagent_timeline2", ".json")
        try {
            file.writeText(json.encodeToString(timeline))
            val loaded = json.decodeFromString<List<TimelineItem>>(file.readText())
            for (i in 1 until loaded.size) {
                assertTrue(
                    loaded[i].start >= loaded[i - 1].start,
                    "时间戳应递增：${loaded[i - 1].start} -> ${loaded[i].start}"
                )
            }
        } finally {
            file.delete()
        }
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.LocalQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class QaEngineTest {

    private fun timeline(): List<TimelineItem> = merge(
        listOf(
            TranscriptSegment(start = 0.0, end = 10.0, text = "梯度下降是优化算法", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 10.0, end = 20.0, text = "反向传播计算梯度", speaker = null)
        ),
        listOf(FrameOcr(timestamp = 2.0, text = "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", imagePath = "f1.jpg"))
    )

    private fun engine(items: List<TimelineItem>) = LocalQaEngine { q, k ->
        val keywords = q.split(" ").filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        items
            .filter { item -> keywords.any { item.speech.contains(it) || item.screenText.contains(it) } }
            .take(k)
    }

    @Test
    fun testLocalQaFindsContent() = runBlocking {
        val answer = engine(timeline()).ask("梯度")
        assertTrue(answer.answer.contains("梯度"), "答案应包含检索到的内容")
        assertTrue(answer.citations.isNotEmpty(), "应返回时间戳引用")
    }

    @Test
    fun testLocalQaNoMatch() = runBlocking {
        val answer = engine(emptyList()).ask("量子力学")
        assertEquals(emptyList(), answer.citations, "无匹配时不应有引用")
        assertTrue(answer.answer.contains("未提及"), "无匹配时应提示未提及")
    }

    @Test
    fun testLocalQaCitationFormat() = runBlocking {
        val answer = engine(timeline()).ask("梯度")
        assertTrue(answer.citations.all { it.matches(Regex("\\d{2}:\\d{2}")) }, "引用应为 mm:ss 格式")
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.LlmClient
import com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig
import com.learnagent.core.RemoteQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/**
 * 验证远程大模型问答引擎：用假 LlmClient 断言它正确构造带时间戳的上下文并返回引用。
 * 不访问网络。
 */
class RemoteQaEngineTest {

    private class FakeLlm(private val reply: String) : LlmClient {
        var lastPrompt: String = ""
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String {
            lastPrompt = prompt
            return reply
        }
    }

    private fun timeline() = merge(
        listOf(
            TranscriptSegment(start = 0.0, end = 10.0, text = "梯度下降是优化算法", speaker = null),
            TranscriptSegment(start = 20.0, end = 30.0, text = "反向传播计算梯度", speaker = null)
        ),
        listOf(FrameOcr(timestamp = 2.0, text = "梯度下降 = 沿负梯度更新参数", imagePath = "f1.jpg"))
    )

    @Test
    fun testRemoteQaBuildsContextAndCitations() = runBlocking {
        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(timeline())
        val llm = FakeLlm("梯度下降在 00:00 处提到。")
        val engine = RemoteQaEngine({ q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) }, llm)

        val answer = engine.ask("梯度下降")
        assertTrue(answer.answer.contains("梯度下降"), "应返回模型回答")
        assertTrue(answer.citations.isNotEmpty(), "应有时间戳引用")
        assertTrue(llm.lastPrompt.contains("00:00"), "prompt 应包含时间戳上下文")
        assertTrue(llm.lastPrompt.contains("梯度下降"), "prompt 应包含检索内容")
        assertTrue(llm.lastPrompt.contains("问题：梯度下降"), "prompt 应包含用户问题")
    }

    @Test
    fun testRemoteQaNoMatch() = runBlocking {
        val indexer = Indexer()
        indexer.index(emptyList())
        val engine = RemoteQaEngine({ q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) }, FakeLlm("x"))
        val answer = engine.ask("量子力学")
        assertEquals(emptyList(), answer.citations)
        // 新行为：不再拒答——检索无命中也照常回答（模型自由发挥 + 通识）
        assertEquals("x", answer.answer)
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.core.AgentLoop
import com.learnagent.core.CommandWhitelist

import com.learnagent.core.ContextManager
import com.learnagent.core.DebateEngine
import com.learnagent.core.Evaluator
import com.learnagent.core.ExperienceStore
import com.learnagent.core.Indexer
import com.learnagent.core.LearningUnitQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.LlmClient
import com.learnagent.core.LlmConfig
import com.learnagent.core.LocalQaEngine
import com.learnagent.core.ModelRouter
import com.learnagent.core.TaskType
import com.learnagent.core.ToolRegistry
import com.learnagent.core.merge
import com.learnagent.data.Experience
import com.learnagent.data.FrameOcr
import com.learnagent.data.LearningUnit
import com.learnagent.data.SemanticType
import com.learnagent.data.TimelineItem
import com.learnagent.data.TranscriptSegment
import com.learnagent.platform.currentTimeMillis
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertEquals
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

class StageATest {

    private fun timeline(): List<TimelineItem> = merge(
        listOf(
            TranscriptSegment(0.0, 10.0, "这节课我们讲 gradient descent 梯度下降", null),
            TranscriptSegment(10.0, 20.0, "它是优化算法 optimization 基础方法", null),
            TranscriptSegment(20.0, 30.0, "接下来讲 backpropagation 反向传播", null),
            TranscriptSegment(30.0, 40.0, "最后讲 CNN 图像识别", null)
        ),
        listOf(
            FrameOcr(2.0, "gradient descent 梯度下降", "f1.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(12.0, "optimization 学习率", "f2.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(22.0, "backpropagation 反向传播", "f3.jpg"),
            FrameOcr(32.0, "CNN 图像识别", "f4.jpg")
        )
    )

    private fun units(): List<LearningUnit> = timeline().mapIndexed { i, t ->
        LearningUnit(
            id = "v_$i", videoId = "v", start = t.start, end = t.end,
            speech = t.speech, screenText = t.screenText,
            semanticType = if (i == 0) SemanticType.DEFINITION else SemanticType.UNKNOWN,
            importance = 5 - i,
            oneLineSummary = t.speech.take(30)
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun testGenericQuestionFallback() = runBlocking {
        val items = timeline()
        val indexer = Indexer(); indexer.index(items)
        val engine = LocalQaEngine(allItems = { items }, search = { q, k -> indexer.search(q, k) })
        val ans = engine.ask("这个视频讲了什么？")
        assertTrue(ans.answer.contains("没有直接匹配") || ans.answer.contains("相关信息"), "泛问应返回核心内容，实际: ${ans.answer}")
        assertTrue(ans.citations.isNotEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun testLearningUnitQaEngine() = runBlocking {
        val engine = LearningUnitQaEngine(units = { units() })
        val generic = engine.ask("这个视频讲了什么？")
        assertTrue(generic.citations.isNotEmpty(), "泛问应有引用")
        assertTrue(generic.answer.contains("核心内容"), "泛问应以核心内容开头")
        val specific = engine.ask("gradient")
        assertTrue(specific.answer.contains("gradient", ignoreCase = true) || specific.answer.contains("核心内容"))
    }

    @Test
    fun testIndexerSemanticAndImportance() {
        val idx = Indexer(); idx.indexUnits(units())
        assertEquals(1, idx.searchBySemanticType(SemanticType.DEFINITION).size)
        val top = idx.searchByImportance(4)
        assertTrue(top.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(top.first().importance >= 4)
        assertTrue(idx.searchUnits("gradient").isNotEmpty())
    }

    private class FakeLlm(private val reply: String) : LlmClient {
        override suspend fun generateResponse(prompt: String, config: LlmConfig): String = reply
    }

    @Test
    fun testDebateEngineDivergence() = runBlocking {
        val engine = DebateEngine(FakeLlm("结论：梯度下降有效。"), FakeLlm("但是，这个结论有问题，存在反例。"))
        val r = engine.debate("梯度下降是否有效", "上下文")
        assertTrue(r.conclusion.isNotBlank())
        assertTrue(r.divergent, "含否定词应判定分歧")
        assertEquals(0.5, r.confidence)
    }

    @Test
    fun testContextManagerCompression() {
        val cm = ContextManager(maxTurns = 20)
        val history = (1..30).map { "turn$it" }
        val compressed = cm.compress(history)
        assertTrue(compressed.size < history.size)
        assertTrue(compressed.first().contains("摘要"))
        assertTrue(compressed.last() == "turn30")
    }

    @Test
    fun testModelRouter() {
        assertEquals(TaskType.CODE, ModelRouter.route("这段代码怎么改"))
        assertEquals(TaskType.DEBATE, ModelRouter.route("对比 A 和 B"))
        assertEquals(TaskType.SIMPLE_QA, ModelRouter.route("这是什么"))
        assertTrue(ModelRouter.modelFor(TaskType.COMPLEX_REASONING).isNotBlank())
    }

    @Test
    fun testToolRegistryTenTools() {
        val registry = ToolRegistry(
            search = { _, _ -> emptyList() },
            ask = { com.learnagent.core.QaAnswer("ok", emptyList()) }
        )
        val tools = registry.tools()
        assertEquals(10, tools.size, "应有 10 个工具")
        val names = tools.map { it.spec.name }.toSet()
        assertTrue(names.containsAll(listOf("search_video", "ask_question", "record_experience", "search_experience", "read_file", "write_file", "list_dir", "run_command", "search_code", "http_get")))
    }

    @Test
    fun testCommandWhitelistAndSandbox() = runBlocking {
        assertTrue(CommandWhitelist.isAllowed("dir ."))
        assertTrue(!CommandWhitelist.isAllowed("del /f"))
        val registry = ToolRegistry(search = { _, _ -> emptyList() }, ask = { com.learnagent.core.QaAnswer("ok", emptyList()) })
        val run = registry.tools().first { it.spec.name == "run_command" }
        assertTrue(run.execute(mapOf("cmd" to "del x")).contains("拒绝"), "非白名单命令应拒绝")
        val write = registry.tools().first { it.spec.name == "write_file" }
        assertTrue(write.execute(mapOf("path" to "C:/evil.txt", "content" to "x")).contains("拒绝"), "绝对路径应拒绝")
    }

    @Test
    fun testExperienceStoreJvm() {
        val scenarioId = "test_" + currentTimeMillis()
        val id = "exp_test_" + currentTimeMillis()
        ExperienceStore.saveExperience(
            Experience(id = id, scenarioId = scenarioId, choice = "c", result = "r", lesson = "梯度下降要调学习率", recordedAt = currentTimeMillis())
        )
        assertTrue(ExperienceStore.getAllExperiences().any { it.id == id })
        assertTrue(ExperienceStore.searchExperiences("学习率").any { it.id == id })
    }

    @Test
    fun testContextAnalyzerFallbackNoLlm() = runBlocking {
        val analyzer = ContextAnalyzer(null)
        val result = analyzer.analyze(timeline(), "v")
        assertEquals(4, result.size)
        assertTrue(result.all { it.oneLineSummary.isNotBlank() })
    }

    @Test
    fun testEvaluator() = runBlocking {
        val items = timeline()
        val idx = Indexer(); idx.index(items)
        val engine = LocalQaEngine(allItems = { items }, search = { q, k -> idx.search(q, k) })
        val report = Evaluator(engine).run(
            listOf(com.learnagent.core.TestCase("gradient", "gradient"), com.learnagent.core.TestCase("no_such_token_xyz", "不存在"))
        )
        assertEquals(2, report.totalTests)
        assertEquals(1, report.passed)
        assertTrue(report.accuracy > 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun testAgentLoopFinish() = runBlocking {
        val llm = FakeLlm("""{"thought":"done","action":"FINISH","answer":"最终答案"}""")
        val loop = AgentLoop(llm, ToolRegistry(search = { _, _ -> emptyList() }, ask = { com.learnagent.core.QaAnswer("ok", emptyList()) }).tools())
        val result = loop.run("目标")
        assertTrue(result.finished)
        assertEquals("最终答案", result.output)
    }
}

package com.learnagent

import com.learnagent.data.CodeSnippet
import com.learnagent.data.Decision
import com.learnagent.data.KnowledgeMastery
import com.learnagent.data.TechCard
import com.learnagent.data.TechCategory
import com.learnagent.data.TechStatus
import com.learnagent.data.TechUsage
import com.learnagent.platform.TechStore
import kotlin.test.Test
import kotlin.test.assertTrue

/** jvm actual TechStore 落盘往返（~/.mentara/...）。 */
class TechStoreJvmTest {

    private val stamp = System.currentTimeMillis()

    @Test
    fun techCardSaveAndRead() {
        val store = TechStore()
        val id = "test_card_$stamp"
        store.saveTechCard(
            TechCard(
                id = id,
                name = "TestZK",
                category = TechCategory.DISTRIBUTED,
                whatItIs = "测试",
                whatItSolves = "",
                whenToUse = "",
                whenNotToUse = "",
                howItWorks = "",
                source = "测试"
            )
        )
        assertTrue(store.getAllTechCards().any { it.id == id && it.name == "TestZK" })
    }

    @Test
    fun allEntitiesSaveAndRead() {
        val store = TechStore()
        store.saveTechUsage(
            TechUsage(techName = "TestTech_$stamp", firstSeenAt = 1L, lastSeenAt = 2L, status = TechStatus.DISCOVERED)
        )
        store.saveDecision(
            Decision(id = "test_decision_$stamp", problem = "p", chosen = "c", reason = "r", createdAt = 1L)
        )
        store.saveCodeSnippet(
            CodeSnippet(id = "test_snippet_$stamp", language = "kotlin", purpose = "p", code = "val x = 1")
        )
        store.saveMastery(KnowledgeMastery(pointId = "test_point_$stamp"))

        assertTrue(store.getAllTechUsage().any { it.techName == "TestTech_$stamp" })
        assertTrue(store.getAllDecisions().any { it.id == "test_decision_$stamp" })
        assertTrue(store.getAllCodeSnippets().any { it.id == "test_snippet_$stamp" })
        assertTrue(store.getAllMastery().any { it.pointId == "test_point_$stamp" })
    }
}

    interface IMFSourceReader

        [PreserveSig] int Flush(uint index);
        [PreserveSig] int GetPresentationAttribute(uint index, ref Guid attr, out PropVariant val);
        [PreserveSig] int GetCharacteristics(out uint characteristics);
    }

    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFStartup(uint version, uint flags);
    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFShutdown();
    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFCreateAttributes(out IMFAttributes attrs, uint count);
    [DllImport("mfplat.dll")] static extern int MFCreateMediaType(out IMFMediaType type);
    [DllImport("mfreadwrite.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
    static extern int MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(string url, IMFAttributes attrs, out IMFSourceReader reader);

    /// <summary>从视频按时间均匀抽 count 帧到 outDir（PNG），返回实际帧数。</summary>
    public static int Grab(string video, string outDir, int count, int fps = 0)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(outDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
        int hr = MFStartup(MF_VERSION, 0);
        if (hr < 0) throw new Exception("MFStartup 0x" + hr.ToString("X8"));
        IMFAttributes attrs = null; IMFSourceReader reader = null;
        try
        {
            if (MFCreateAttributes(out attrs, 1) < 0) throw new Exception("MFCreateAttributes");
            attrs.SetUINT32(ref MF_SOURCE_READER_ENABLE_VIDEO_PROCESSING, 1);
            if (MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(video, attrs, out reader) < 0) throw new Exception("MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL");

            uint videoIndex = MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM;
            try { reader.SetStreamSelection(MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, false); } catch { }
            for (uint i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                IMFMediaType t;
                if (reader.GetCurrentMediaType(i, out t) < 0 || t == null) continue;
                Guid major;
                hr = t.GetMajorType(out major);
                bool isVideo = hr >= 0 && major.Data1 == MFMediaType_Video.Data1 &&
                    major.Data2 == MFMediaType_Video.Data2 && major.Data3 == MFMediaType_Video.Data3 &&
                    major.B0 == MFMediaType_Video.B0 && major.B1 == MFMediaType_Video.B1 &&
                    major.B2 == MFMediaType_Video.B2 && major.B3 == MFMediaType_Video.B3;
                if (isVideo) { videoIndex = i; break; }
            }
            if (videoIndex == MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM) throw new Exception("未找到视频流");
            reader.SetStreamSelection(videoIndex, true);

            IMFMediaType outType;
            MFCreateMediaType(out outType);
            var vguid = MFMediaType_Video; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, ref vguid);
            var rguid = MFVideoFormat_RGB32; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_SUBTYPE, ref rguid);
            hr = reader.SetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, IntPtr.Zero, outType);
            if (hr < 0) throw new Exception("SetCurrentMediaType(RGB32) 0x" + hr.ToString("X8"));

            IMFMediaType cur;
            reader.GetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, out cur);
            ulong frameSize;
            cur.GetUINT64(ref MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, out frameSize);
            int width = (int)(frameSize >> 32);
            int height = (int)(frameSize & 0xFFFFFFFF);
            if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) throw new Exception("取帧尺寸失败");
            uint rot = 0; try { cur.GetUINT32(ref MF_MT_VIDEO_ROTATION, out rot); } catch { rot = 0; }

            PropVariant durPv;
            reader.GetPresentationAttribute(MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, ref MF_PD_DURATION, out durPv);
            double total = (durPv.vt == 20 || durPv.vt == 21) ? durPv.uhVal / 1e7 : 0.0;
            if (total <= 0.05)
            {
                // 时长属性不可用时：跳到远端读到最后样本的最大时间戳
                try
                {
                    var farPos = new PropVariant { vt = VT_I8, hVal = (long)(3600.0 * 1e7) };
                    var ng = new Guid();
                    reader.SetCurrentPosition(ref ng, ref farPos);
                    reader.Flush(videoIndex);
                    long maxTs = 0;
                    for (int g = 0; g < 5000; g++)
                    {
                        uint ai, sf; long ts; IMFSample s;
                        if (reader.ReadSample(videoIndex, 0, out ai, out sf, out ts, out s) < 0) break;
                        if (s == null) { if ((sf & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM) != 0) break; else continue; }
                        if (ts > maxTs) maxTs = ts;
                        Marshal.ReleaseComObject(s);
                    }
                    if (maxTs > 0) total = maxTs / 1e7;
                }
                catch { }
            }
            if (total <= 0.05) total = 60.0;

            int n = fps > 0 ? Math.Max(2, (int)Math.Round(total * fps)) : Math.Max(2, count);
            if (n > 4000) n = 4000;
            int saved = 0;
            var entries = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            {
                double sec = total * i / (n + 1.0);
                long target = (long)(sec * 1e7);
                var pos = new PropVariant { vt = VT_I8, hVal = target };
                var nullGuid = new Guid();
                reader.SetCurrentPosition(ref nullGuid, ref pos);
                reader.Flush(videoIndex);

                IMFSample sample = null; long ts = 0;
                for (int guard = 0; guard < 200; guard++)
                {
                    uint ai, sf; IMFSample s;
                    hr = reader.ReadSample(videoIndex, 0, out ai, out sf, out ts, out s);
                    if (hr < 0) break;
                    if (s == null)
                    {
                        if ((sf & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM) != 0) break;
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (ts + 200000 >= target) { sample = s; break; }
                    // 否则丢弃，继续找 >= target 的帧
                }
                if (sample == null) continue;

                IMFMediaBuffer buf;
                sample.ConvertToContiguousBuffer(out buf);
                IntPtr ptr; int maxLen, curLen;
                buf.Lock(out ptr, out maxLen, out curLen);
                var bmp = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
                var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
                int rowBytes = width * 4;
                // MF RGB32 为自底向上：逐行翻转拷贝（末尾不足一行的按可用长度截断）
                for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
                {
                    IntPtr src = IntPtr.Add(ptr, (height - 1 - y) * rowBytes);
                    long offset = (long)(height - 1 - y) * rowBytes;
                    if (offset + rowBytes > curLen) break;
                    IntPtr dst = IntPtr.Add(bd.Scan0, y * bd.Stride);
                    CopyMemory(dst, src, rowBytes);
                }
                bmp.UnlockBits(bd);
                buf.Unlock();
                if (rot == 180) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone);
                else if (rot == 90) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipNone);
                else if (rot == 270) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone);
                string outPath = Path.Combine(outDir, "frame_" + i.ToString("D3") + ".png");
                bmp.Save(outPath, ImageFormat.Png);
                bmp.Dispose();
                entries.Add("{\"timestamp\":" + sec.ToString("0.###", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ",\"imagePath\":\"" + outPath.Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"}");
                saved++;
            }
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outDir, "frames.json"), "[" + string.Join(",", entries) + "]", new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
            return saved;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (reader != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(reader);
            if (attrs != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(attrs);
            MFShutdown();
        }
    }

    [DllImport("kernel32.dll", EntryPoint = "RtlMoveMemory")]
    static extern void CopyMemory(IntPtr dest, IntPtr src, int count);

    // Scene-keyframe extraction: sequential decode at fps; keep only changed frames.
    public static int GrabScenes(string video, string outDir, int fps, int diffBits = 8, int outWidth = 0)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(outDir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(outDir);
        int hr = MFStartup(MF_VERSION, 0);
        if (hr < 0) throw new Exception("MFStartup fail");
        IMFAttributes attrs = null; IMFSourceReader reader = null;
        try
        {
            MFCreateAttributes(out attrs, 1);
            attrs.SetUINT32(ref MF_SOURCE_READER_ENABLE_VIDEO_PROCESSING, 1);
            if (MFCreateSourceReaderFromURL(video, attrs, out reader) < 0) throw new Exception("reader fail");
            uint videoIndex = MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM;
            try { reader.SetStreamSelection(MF_SOURCE_READER_MEDIASOURCE, false); } catch { }
            for (uint i = 0; i < 8; i++)
            {
                IMFMediaType t;
                if (reader.GetCurrentMediaType(i, out t) < 0 || t == null) continue;
                Guid major; if (t.GetMajorType(out major) >= 0 && SameGuid(major, MFMediaType_Video)) { videoIndex = i; break; }
            }
            if (videoIndex == MF_SOURCE_READER_FIRST_VIDEO_STREAM) throw new Exception("no video stream");
            reader.SetStreamSelection(videoIndex, true);
            IMFMediaType outType; MFCreateMediaType(out outType);
            var vg = MFMediaType_Video; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_MAJOR_TYPE, ref vg);
            var rg = MFVideoFormat_RGB32; outType.SetGUID(ref MF_MT_SUBTYPE, ref rg);
            if (reader.SetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, IntPtr.Zero, outType) < 0) throw new Exception("RGB32 fail");
            IMFMediaType cur; reader.GetCurrentMediaType(videoIndex, out cur);
            ulong fs; cur.GetUINT64(ref MF_MT_FRAME_SIZE, out fs);
            int width = (int)(fs >> 32), height = (int)(fs & 0xFFFFFFFF);
            uint rot = 0; try { cur.GetUINT32(ref MF_MT_VIDEO_ROTATION, out rot); } catch { rot = 0; }

            double step = 1e7 / Math.Max(1, fps);
            long lastSample = long.MinValue;
            ulong prevHash = 0;
            int saved = 0;
            var entries = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            var inv = System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

            for (int guard = 0; guard < 5000000; guard++)
            {
                uint ai, sf; long ts; IMFSample s;
                if (reader.ReadSample(videoIndex, 0, out ai, out sf, out ts, out s) < 0) break;
                if (s == null) { if ((sf & MF_SOURCE_READERF_ENDOFSTREAM) != 0) break; else continue; }
                if (lastSample == long.MinValue || ts - lastSample >= (long)step)
                {
                    lastSample = ts;
                    IMFMediaBuffer buf; s.ConvertToContiguousBuffer(out buf);
                    IntPtr ptr; int maxLen, curLen; buf.Lock(out ptr, out maxLen, out curLen);
                    ulong h = HashFrame(ptr, curLen, width, height);
                    bool changed = diffBits < 0 || prevHash == 0 || Hamming(h, prevHash) > diffBits;
                    if (changed)
                    {
                        prevHash = h;
                        bool ok; var bmp = BuildBitmap(ptr, curLen, width, height, rot, out ok);
                        if (ok)
                        {
                            string outPath = Path.Combine(outDir, "frame_" + (saved + 1).ToString("D4") + ".jpg");
                            if (outWidth > 0 && outWidth < width) { var sb = Scale(bmp, outWidth); bmp.Dispose(); SaveJpeg(sb, outPath); sb.Dispose(); }
                            else { SaveJpeg(bmp, outPath); bmp.Dispose(); }
                            double sec = ts / 1e7;
                            entries.Add("{\"timestamp\":" + sec.ToString("0.###", inv) + ",\"imagePath\":\"" + outPath.Replace("\\", "\\\\") + "\"}");
                            saved++;
                        }
                    }
                    buf.Unlock(); Marshal.ReleaseComObject(buf);
                }
                Marshal.ReleaseComObject(s);
            }
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(outDir, "frames.json"), "[" + string.Join(",", entries) + "]", new System.Text.UTF8Encoding(false));
            return saved;
        }
        finally
        {
            if (reader != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(reader);
            if (attrs != null) Marshal.ReleaseComObject(attrs);
            MFShutdown();
        }
    }

    static bool SameGuid(Guid a, Guid b) { return a.Data1 == b.Data1 && a.Data2 == b.Data2 && a.Data3 == b.Data3 && a.B0 == b.B0 && a.B1 == b.B1 && a.B2 == b.B2 && a.B3 == b.B3; }

    static int Hamming(ulong a, ulong b) { ulong x = a ^ b; int c = 0; while (x != 0) { c += (int)(x & 1); x >>= 1; } return c; }

    static ulong HashFrame(IntPtr ptr, int len, int width, int height)
    {
        int rowBytes = width * 4;
        ulong hash = 0;
        long sum = 0; var cell = new long[64];
        for (int cy = 0; cy < 8; cy++)
            for (int cx = 0; cx < 8; cx++)
            {
                int x0 = cx * width / 8, x1 = Math.Max(x0 + 1, (cx + 1) * width / 8);
                int y0 = cy * height / 8, y1 = Math.Max(y0 + 1, (cy + 1) * height / 8);
                long acc = 0; int n = 0;
                for (int y = y0; y < y1; y += 2)
                    for (int x = x0; x < x1; x += 2)
                    {
                        long off = (long)(height - 1 - y) * rowBytes + x * 4;
                        if (off + 3 >= len) continue;
                        byte bb = Marshal.ReadByte(ptr, (int)off);
                        byte gg = Marshal.ReadByte(ptr, (int)(off + 1));
                        byte rr = Marshal.ReadByte(ptr, (int)(off + 2));
                        acc += (rr * 3 + gg * 6 + bb) / 10; n++;
                    }
                cell[cy * 8 + cx] = n > 0 ? acc / n : 0; sum += cell[cy * 8 + cx];
            }
        long mean = sum / 64;
        for (int k = 0; k < 64; k++) if (cell[k] >= mean) hash |= (1UL << k);
        return hash;
    }

    static Bitmap BuildBitmap(IntPtr ptr, int curLen, int width, int height, uint rot, out bool ok)
    {
        ok = false;
        int rowBytes = width * 4;
        if (curLen < rowBytes) return null;
        var bmp = new Bitmap(width, height, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
        var bd = bmp.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, width, height), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb);
        for (int y = 0; y < height; y++)
        {
            long off = (long)(height - 1 - y) * rowBytes;
            if (off + rowBytes > curLen) break;
            CopyMemory(IntPtr.Add(bd.Scan0, y * bd.Stride), IntPtr.Add(ptr, (int)off), rowBytes);
        }
        bmp.UnlockBits(bd);
        if (rot == 180) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone);
        else if (rot == 90) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate90FlipNone);
        else if (rot == 270) bmp.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone);
        ok = true;
        return bmp;
    }

    static Bitmap Scale(Bitmap src, int w)
    {
        int h = Math.Max(1, src.Height * w / src.Width);
        var dst = new Bitmap(w, h);
        using (var g = Graphics.FromImage(dst))
        {
            g.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.HighQualityBilinear;
            g.DrawImage(src, 0, 0, w, h);
        }
        return dst;
    }

    static void SaveJpeg(Bitmap bmp, string path)
    {
        var codec = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageEncoders().First(c => c.FormatID == ImageFormat.Jpeg.Guid);
        using (var ep = new EncoderParameters(1))
        {
            ep.Param[0] = new EncoderParameter(Encoder.Quality, 85L);
            bmp.Save(path, codec, ep);
        }
    }
}
